title: FSSAI flags Bisleri water as unsafe, company says bromate within prescribed limit
description: Bisleri maintained its packaged drinking water is safe after the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution over a disputed bromate sample. The company claimed referral and independent tests showed compliance, promising full regulatory cooperation.
author: Onmanorama Staff
content:
FSSAI flags Bisleri water as unsafe, company says bromate within prescribed limit
Mail This Article
New Delhi: A day after the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International over an allegedly unsafe packaged drinking water sample, the company on Monday maintained that its product was safe for consumption and said it would cooperate with the regulator.
In a statement, Bisleri said it had not received any notice from the FSSAI and claimed that a referral laboratory had found the bromate level in the sample to be within the prescribed limit.
The company said the case dates back around 14 months and concerns a batch manufactured in September 2025 at its Goa facility, one of 143 plants in its network.
According to Bisleri, the FSSAI collected six samples from the facility on September 30, 2025. Initial tests found that five samples met all applicable standards. The sixth, however, recorded a bromate level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the permissible limit of 10 micrograms per litre.
Following an appeal by the company on November 22, 2025, the FSSAI sent the sample to a referral laboratory for further testing.
"The referral laboratory found bromate of the sample within the prescribed limit and separately flagged polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in the sample," Bisleri said.
The company said the differing test results prompted it to get the sample independently tested at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, which also found the bromate level to be within the permissible limit.
Bisleri submitted the independent test results to the FSSAI's Western Regional Office along with a formal letter dated February 2, 2026. It said it had received no further communication from the regulator and had assumed the matter was closed.
The company also claimed that it had not received any notice either by email or in hard copy and was unable to locate the reported notice on the FSSAI website.
"Drinking water safety is a priority for Bisleri. We maintain stringent quality controls of over 90 tests across our 10-step manufacturing process," the statement said.
Bisleri said it would continue to cooperate with the FSSAI and address the matter through the appropriate regulatory process.

title: Eight killed as van loses control, crashes into tree in Tiruchirappalli
description: The accident occurred while a group of 10 people was returning to Thanjavur after attending a function in Namakkal.
author: Onmanorama Staff
content:
Eight killed as van loses control, crashes into tree in Tiruchirappalli
Mail This Article
Tiruchirappalli: Eight people were killed, and two others were seriously injured after a van lost control and rammed into a roadside tree in Tamil Nadu’s Tiruchirappalli on Sunday evening. The accident occurred while a group of 10 people was returning to Thanjavur after attending a function in Namakkal.
Five people died on the spot, while two others sustained critical injuries. One of the deceased has been identified as A Sakthivel (45), a native of Maharajapuram in Thirukkattupalli, Thanjavur district.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay expressed deep condolences over the tragedy. He directed the district administration and hospital authorities to ensure the highest quality of medical care for the two critically injured victims currently undergoing treatment at the government hospital.
The Tamil Nadu Chief Minister posted on X (formerly Twitter), "I was deeply saddened and distressed to learn of the tragic news that five people, including Mr. A. Sakthivel (aged 45) of Maharajapuram, Thirukattupalli, Thanjavur district, who were travelling in a car, died at the scene of an accident in which the car hit a tree near Kothurpatti Four Roads on the Thuraiyur–Musiri Highway in Tiruchirappalli district this evening (22.11.2026), while three others who were admitted to Musiri Government Hospital with serious injuries died despite treatment, bringing the total death toll to eight,"
The Chief Minister also confirmed via X that officials have been instructed to extend all necessary medical facilities and assistance to the injured.

title: Sonia Gandhi’s Belonging book review: Love, loss and reluctant leadership
description: Sonia Gandhi's memoir, 'Belonging,' chronicles her journey from a shy Italian bride to Congress leader, detailing her romance with Rajiv, family dynamics, Indira Gandhi's influence, and her eventual reluctant entry into Indian politics.
author: Haritha Sharly Benjamin
content:
Sonia Gandhi’s Belonging book review: Love, loss and reluctant leadership
Mail This Article
“Luminous, dark eyes, in a face of striking openness, met mine for the first time... ‘How do you do?’ I replied. I knew, that very instant -- it was un colpo di fulmine, a bolt of lightning.”
“Why don’t you come with me?” I was tempted for a moment, then replied, “I’m still very tired, Rajiv. I’ll see you when you get back.” “All right,” he laughed. “It’s just two more days anyway.” My last living image of him is his smile as he looks back, waves to me, and steps into the car that will drive him to the airport.
These two excerpts from Sonia Gandhi’s memoir, ‘Belonging: A Journey of Love,’ frame her life with Rajiv Gandhi: their first meeting at a Greek restaurant in Cambridge in 1965 and their final conversation in May 1991, before his assassination in Sriperumbudur. They form the emotional heart of the Congress leader’s long-awaited memoir, a personal account of love, family, duty and loss set against India’s political history.
Gandhi sets out her premise in the prologue, describing the book as “an unusual story: of a girl from a small town in Italy transplanting herself to India, witnessing and later being part of landmark events and changes in the country.”
The narrative begins with a shy 21-year-old from Orbassano, near Turin, who moves to India in 1968 for love. She candidly recounts her early struggles with the folds of a sari, food that set her mouth on fire, and learning Hindi while adjusting to life within one of India’s most powerful political dynasties. Across 500 pages, she chronicles her journey from a young bride who preferred to stay out of the limelight to the longest-serving president of the Indian National Congress.
The memoir unfolds across three distinct phases: life inside Indira Gandhi’s household, years by Rajiv’s side, and her own struggle in a male-dominated political arena.
Navigating two worlds
The opening chapters help explain Sonia Gandhi’s later choices. The parallels she draws between her strict, traditional Italian father, Stefano Maino, and her formidable mother-in-law, Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, shed light on how she learnt to navigate strong-willed authority figures.
Her inner conflict during those early years is evident. Her conservative father only reluctantly allowed her to travel to India after she came of age, giving her a return ticket and extracting a promise that she would make no major life decisions without consulting her parents. Days after she arrived in New Delhi in 1968, however, news of her engagement to Rajiv reached her father through the press. The decision had been taken by Indira Gandhi. Stefano Maino stayed away from the wedding.
Sonia’s account of Indira moves beyond the public image of the ‘Iron Lady’ to recall intimate domestic moments. Indira picked up a needle and thread to stitch Sonia’s evening dress on the day they first met. When Sonia asked why she had been left out of preparations for her child’s namkaran (naming ceremony), Indira sheepishly admitted she was simply “used to having her way.” Another anecdote recounts how a young Sonia opened a trapdoor leading into the king’s bedroom during a state visit to Bhutan, prompting a mix of rebuke and laughter from the then Prime Minister.
Family dynamics and political silences
Gandhi does not attempt to justify Indira Gandhi’s authoritarian measures, though she offers her perspective on the pressures behind them. Her account of the extended family is nuanced. While she is critical of her sister-in-law Maneka Gandhi’s turbulent time in the household, she writes warmly about her late brother-in-law Sanjay Gandhi. Even as she questions his influence on Indira and his clashes with Rajiv, familial affection remains evident.
The silences in Belonging, however, are just as telling. She approaches some of India’s most contentious political episodes with noticeable restraint, including the Emergency, the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, the Bofors scandal, the Ayodhya dispute and India’s intervention in the Sri Lankan civil war.
Although she mentions her reservations about the Emergency and the 1985 Shah Bano case, Sonia largely views Indian politics through Rajiv and his immediate circle. At times, this limits her account of the wider political and social realities. Rajiv became prime minister at 40, still grieving his mother’s assassination in October 1984. His intentions, as Sonia describes them, were earnest and modernising, though some of his government’s decisions proved contentious.
While she is guarded about controversies within her own party, Gandhi is outspoken in her criticism of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), accusing them of propaganda. She traces the ideological divide back decades, noting that Indira Gandhi believed socialist leader Jayaprakash Narayan had fallen under the RSS’s influence in the 1970s.
Her views on BJP leaders vary across generations. She recalls former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee with warmth and respect but is less charitable towards Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Comparing his conduct with that of earlier leaders, she writes: “This is different from the past, when leaders across party divides would treat one another with cordiality. He tends to look away, avoiding eye contact.” She adds that their visions of India are fundamentally different.
Living with the threat of violence
One of the memoir’s most gripping threads is the pervasive sense of dread that shadowed the family. For Sonia, watching Rajiv become prime minister after witnessing Indira’s bullet-riddled body was harrowing.
As Rajiv prepared to become prime minister in 1984, Sonia cried, “You can’t do this to us… they will kill you too!” He, she recounts, replied, “They’ll kill me anyway.” Seven years later, two months before his assassination by a suicide bomber in Sriperumbudur on May 21, 1991, their son Rahul, now Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, warned her: “Ma, if something isn’t done about Pa’s security, I know I’ll soon have to come back for his funeral.”
She also writes about raising Rahul and Priyanka under the constant threat of violence. Homeschooled for years after their grandmother’s assassination, the children grew up aware of the risks that came with their surname. Rajiv’s assassination changed their lives overnight. Gandhi writes of leaning on her children for emotional support: “I had become the child to be protected, and they the parents.”
Widowed and adrift after 1991, she initially resisted calls to enter public life. But as the Congress weakened and its electoral fortunes declined in the late 1990s, she eventually stepped in. Rebuilding her life became intertwined with reviving a demoralised party, even as she faced attacks over her foreign birth. She writes candidly about feeling betrayed when senior Congress leaders questioned her eligibility to lead the party into an election because of her Italian origins. Standing her ground, she asserted her right to lead.
The 2004 turning point
In May 2004, against considerable odds, she led the Congress back to power at the head of the United Progressive Alliance (UPA). She then surprised many by declining the prime ministership and nominating Dr Manmohan Singh to head the government. Singh, a soft-spoken economist, had steered India’s 1991 economic liberalisation under Prime Minister P V Narasimha Rao.
Her decision to step aside became one of the defining moments of her political career. Rahul and Priyanka feared losing their only surviving parent to political violence, and Sonia herself was still haunted by past tragedies. She also believed Manmohan Singh was the right person to lead the country. The decision shaped the UPA’s decade in power.
“Belonging” may not be the tell-all political exposé some readers expect, but it offers a personal account of how love and bereavement shaped a woman who spent years resisting the political role she eventually assumed. Its guarded treatment of contentious events limits its value as a political reckoning. As a memoir of family and loss, it is more revealing.

title: Big Relief For Rahul Gandhi: No CBI, ED probe into disproportionate assets, detail here
description: The Supreme Court has overturned the Allahabad High Court's order asking the CBI and ED to examine allegations of disproportionate assets against Rahul Gandhi, directing that the matter be heard afresh by a new bench.
author: Manisha Chauhan
content:
INDIA
The Supreme Court has overturned the Allahabad High Court's order asking the CBI and ED to examine allegations of disproportionate assets against Rahul Gandhi, directing that the matter be heard afresh by a new bench.
The Supreme Court on Wednesday set aside an Allahabad High Court order directing the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Enforcement Directorate (ED) to examine allegations that Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi owns assets disproportionate to his known sources of income.
A bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant asked the Allahabad High Court Chief Justice to constitute a fresh bench to hear the matter again.
The order came on a petition filed by Gandhi challenging the high court's May directive. The earlier order had asked the CBI and ED to verify allegations made by BJP activist S Vignesh Shishir and submit an affidavit detailing the status of their enquiries.
Gandhi objects to proceedings held without his participation
Gandhi challenged the high court's order on the ground that it had been passed without hearing him. The Supreme Court bench, which also included Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, set aside the earlier direction and asked the high court to hear the matter afresh.
It also directed Shishir to make Gandhi a party to his petition. The bench kept all arguments on the merits of the allegations, including whether the petition itself was maintainable, open for consideration before the high court.
The Supreme Court said the fresh hearing must take place in an open court. Shishir had requested an in-camera hearing, citing threats to his life.
Court had earlier stopped agencies from submitting reports
On August 17, the Supreme Court had issued notice on Gandhi's petition and directed that the CBI, ED or any other agency should not submit a report under the Allahabad High Court's May order.
It had also asked the high court to defer further proceedings until the Supreme Court passed additional directions.
During an earlier hearing, the CBI and ED told the top court that they had only been permitted to conduct an enquiry into the allegations.
The bench questioned why the agencies had not acted earlier if the claims were as serious as suggested. It also stressed that courts must follow the principles of natural justice before directing investigative action.
The court had observed, “If there is prima facie material, our understanding of the law suggests that you can proceed as per law. But if the court wants to issue a direction, courts are expected to follow the principles of natural justice.”
Kapil Sibal questions maintainability of petition
Senior advocate Kapil Sibal, appearing for Gandhi along with advocate S Prasanna, questioned whether Shishir's petition was maintainable.
Sibal pointed out that the same petitioner had been making similar allegations since 2024.
Shishir, who was present during the Supreme Court hearing, also sought protection, saying he was a witness in the matter. However, the bench declined to pass any order on his request or the merits of the allegations at this stage.
What are the allegations against Rahul Gandhi?
Shishir's petition before the Allahabad High Court sought an investigation into allegations of disproportionate assets against Gandhi and other members of his family.
In May, the high court had directed the CBI and ED to verify the claims. On July 20, it expressed dissatisfaction with the agencies' response.
The high court subsequently considered the ED's response and said the agency had taken the required steps. It also observed that the ED was free to proceed if its investigation produced material warranting further action.
With the Supreme Court now setting aside the earlier directions, the allegations will be considered afresh by a new high court bench.
Separate petition alleges violation of citizenship laws
Shishir has also filed another petition before the Allahabad High Court seeking criminal action against Gandhi over alleged violations of citizenship laws.
He has claimed that Gandhi held a British passport in addition to his Indian passport. That matter remains pending before the high court.

title: Mumbai local train horror: Man slashes himself with blade after passengers try to wake him | VIDEO
description: Passengers panicked aboard a Nalasopara-Dadar local train after a man allegedly pulled out a blade hidden in his hair and injured himself when they tried to wake him in the handicapped compartment.
author: Manisha Chauhan
content:
MUMBAI
Passengers panicked aboard a Nalasopara-Dadar local train after a man allegedly pulled out a blade hidden in his hair and injured himself when they tried to wake him in the handicapped compartment.
A man allegedly injured himself with a blade inside the handicapped compartment of a Nalasopara-Dadar local train, triggering panic among passengers.
The incident reportedly began when commuters noticed the man sleeping inside the compartment and tried to wake him up. Instead of responding normally, he allegedly began shouting and pulled out a blade that he had hidden in his hair.
Passengers terrified as man attacks himself
The man then allegedly started attacking himself with the blade, sustaining injuries that left him bleeding. The sudden outburst frightened passengers, while the situation inside the compartment quickly turned chaotic.
The incident caused panic among commuters travelling on the local train.

title: ‘We are not beggars’: Congress’s Imran Masood hits out at SP amid UP seat-sharing row
description: The Samajwadi Party's decision to announce five candidates for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections while seat-sharing discussions with Congress are underway has sparked fresh tensions, with Congress MP Imran Masood questioning the SP's commitment to the alliance.
author: Manisha Chauhan
content:
INDIA
The Samajwadi Party's decision to announce five candidates for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections while seat-sharing discussions with Congress are underway has sparked fresh tensions, with Congress MP Imran Masood questioning the SP's commitment to the alliance.
The Samajwadi Party's announcement of its first list of five candidates for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections has caused unease within the Opposition alliance, with Congress leader Imran Masood questioning the party's intentions.
Masood, who is the Congress's Uttar Pradesh working president, said the SP was holding seat-sharing discussions with Congress while independently announcing candidates. He argued that the two developments raised doubts about whether the Akhilesh Yadav-led party was genuinely interested in reaching an agreement.
“Whatever is happening here, it seems that there is a lack of seriousness in this matter. While you [Samajwadi Party] are holding talks on one side, you are making declarations on the other. This indicates that the matter is not being taken seriously,” PTI quoted Masood as saying.
Masood objects to SP's 26-seat opening offer
The Congress leader also expressed displeasure over the SP's reported offer of 26 seats to Congress during discussions held in Delhi.
"We were discussing within the alliance, the meetings took place in Delhi. And after those meetings, if a declaration is made and it is said that ‘Sir, the starting point is 26 [seats]’ — we didn't even ask you for 26 seats. We are not beggars," Masood told ANI.
Speaking at an ABP News conclave, he criticised the SP for talking about alliance responsibilities on social media while announcing candidates without consulting its partner.
“On one hand, a long note is written on social media talking about alliance dharma, and on the other hand, candidates are declared unilaterally,” he said.
SP chief Akhilesh Yadav had posted on X on Tuesday that the upcoming election offered a “historic opportunity” for the Opposition parties to unite and defeat the BJP.
SP's first list includes five candidates
The SP announced its first set of candidates on Tuesday evening, hours after the seat-sharing discussions with Congress in Delhi.
The list includes four sitting MLAs who have been renominated and a former party district president who will contest from a constituency currently held by the BJP.
The five candidates are:
- Umar Ali Khan from Behat
- Ashu Malik from Saharanpur
- Nahid Hasan from Kairana
- Mehboob Ali from Amroha
- Jyoti Lodhi from Lalitpur
Behat and Saharanpur were reportedly among the constituencies included in a proposed list of 181 seats that Congress wanted to contest. However, neither party has confirmed the list.
Congress had also earlier sought a say in candidate selection for constituencies in Saharanpur district, from where Masood is the sitting MP.
Masood asks SP to clarify whom it wants to fight
Masood questioned whether the SP's decision to announce candidates in constituencies of interest to Congress was directed against the BJP or its alliance partner.
“When you have made this declaration against me, I don't understand whether you want to fight me, the Congress or the BJP. It has to be decided whether you want to fight the BJP or fight us,” PTI quoted him as saying.
He added that Congress would discuss the developments internally before deciding whether to continue the seat-sharing negotiations.
“We will discuss within our party what we should do and whether we should sit for talks or not. The decision on how to proceed in this situation will be taken by the party,” he said.
Shivpal Yadav denies differences within alliance
Amid the growing exchange, SP leader Shivpal Yadav dismissed suggestions that the announcement had created a rift between the two parties.
"There is no rift in the alliance, the alliance will remain intact," PTI quoted him as saying.
The disagreement comes as the SP and Congress attempt to work out a seat-sharing arrangement for the 403-member Uttar Pradesh Assembly ahead of the 2027 elections.

title: पुणे कोर्ट के बाहर खूनी खेल: बेल पर छूटे हत्या के आरोपी को गोलियों से भूना, काटे हाथ
description: पुणे के शिवाजीनगर कोर्ट के बाहर खूने खेल खेला गया। हत्या के एक आरोपी पर 5-6 हमलावरों ने हमला कर दिया। उन्होंने उसके हाथ काट दिए और उस पर गोलियां चला दीं, जिससे उसकी मौके पर ही मौत हो गई।
author: Devendra Kasyap
content:
पुणे कोर्ट के बाहर खूनी खेल: बेल पर छूटे हत्या के आरोपी को गोलियों से भूना, काटे हाथ
पुणे के शिवाजीनगर कोर्ट के बाहर खूने खेल खेला गया। हत्या के एक आरोपी पर 5-6 हमलावरों ने हमला कर दिया। उन्होंने उसके हाथ काट दिए और उस पर गोलियां चला दीं, जिससे उसकी मौके पर ही मौत हो गई।
महाराष्ट्र के पुणे से हैरान करने वाली खबर सामने आई है। यहां पर एक बेहद खौफनाक घटना हुई है। शिवाजीनगर जिला न्यायालय के बाहर हत्या के एक आरोपी पर 6 से 7 हमलावरों ने हमला कर दिया। हमलावरों ने उसके हाथ काट दिए और उस पर कई राउंड गोलियां चला दीं। जिससे उसकी मौके पर ही मौत हो गई। बताया जा रहा है कि यह हमला कोर्ट के गेट नंबर 4 के ठीक बाहर हुआ।
कौन था आरोपी और क्यों आया था कोर्ट?
बताया जा रहा है कि हमले का शिकार मंदार मारुति किवाले नाम का व्यक्ति था। वह 2025 में हुई शुभम सुभाष चव्हाण की हत्या के मामले में आरोपी था। शनिवार को उसे जमानत मिल गई थी और वह जेल से बाहर आया था। बुधवार को वह कोर्ट में सुनवाई के लिए आया था। लेकिन सुनवाई पूरी होने से पहले ही बाहर हमलावरों ने उस पर हमला बोल दिया।
2025 में क्या हुआ था?
बताया जा रहा है कि शुभम सुभाष चव्हाण की हत्या 20 अप्रैल 2025 को हुई थी। यह घटना पुणे के कटराज इलाके के संतोष नगर में हुई थी। पुलिस के मुताबिक, हत्या जमीन और पैसे के झगड़े की वजह से हुई थी। मंदार किवाले को इसी मामले में गिरफ्तार किया गया था। अब पुलिस जांच कर रही है कि बुधवार का हमला उसी पुरानी हत्या का बदला था या कोई और मामला था। फिलहाल पुलिसिया जांच जारी है।
कैसे हुआ हमला?
पुलिस के अनुसार, इस घटना का एक वीडियो भी सामने आया है। वीडियो में 5-6 लोग दो स्कूटरों पर सवार दिख रहे हैं। एक स्कूटर पर चार हमलावर थे और दूसरे स्कूटर पर दो। इनमें से एक हमलावर के हाथ में खून से सना चाकू भी दिख रहा था। हमले के बाद घायल मंदार किवाले फुटपाथ पर खून से लथपथ पड़ा था।
वहीं, घटना की जानकारी मिलते ही पुलिस मौके पर पहुंची। पुलिस को मौके से दो बंदूकें मिली हैं, जो सड़क पर पड़ी थी। इस दौरान एक मैगजीन भी बरामद हुई, जिसमें गोलीयां भरी हुई थीं। फिलहाल पुलिस ने दोनों बंदूकें और मैगजीन अपने कब्जे में ले ली है और आगे की कार्रवाई कर रही है। पुलिस के अनुसार, हमलावरों की पहचान और तलाश के लिए टीमें लगातार काम कर रही हैं। जल्द ही आरोपियों को पकड़ लिया जाएगा।
विपक्ष ने कानून-व्यवस्था पर उठाए सवाल
वहीं, इस घटना को लेकर सियासत भी तेज हो गई है। NCP सांसद सुप्रिया सुले ने कहा कि कोर्ट आम लोगों के लिए न्याय का मंदिर होता है। अगर इसी पवित्र जगह के बाहर दिनदहाड़े खून बह रहा है, जहां हर व्यक्ति न्याय और सुरक्षा मांगने आता है, तो पुणे के आम लोग कहां जाएं?
सुले ने आगे कहा कि पुणे में पिछले कुछ समय से पिकैक्स गैंग का आतंक, गोलीबारी की घटनाएं, सड़क पर हत्याएं और महिलाओं के खिलाफ हिंसा बहुत बढ़ गई है। उन्होंने सवाल उठाया कि पुणे का हर निवासी अब यही पूछ रहा है कि क्या शहर में कानून और व्यवस्था नाम की कोई चीज बची है? पुणे में कानून-व्यवस्था सचमुच खत्म हो चुकी है।

title: सिनेमा हॉल को CM शुभेंदु अधिकारी की दो टूक, हिंदू संत की फिल्म 'साधक बामाखेपा' को देना होगा प्राइम-टाइम
description: पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री शुभेंदु अधिकारी ने सिनेमाघर मालिकों और मल्टीप्लेक्स संचालकों को निर्देश दिया है कि संत के जीवन पर बनी बांग्ला फिल्म साधक बामाखेपा का प्रदर्शन प्राइम टाइम में जारी रहे।
author: Devendra Kasyap
content:
सिनेमा हॉल को CM शुभेंदु अधिकारी की दो टूक, हिंदू संत की फिल्म 'साधक बामाखेपा' को देना होगा प्राइम-टाइम
पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री शुभेंदु अधिकारी ने सिनेमाघर मालिकों और मल्टीप्लेक्स संचालकों को निर्देश दिया है कि संत के जीवन पर बनी बांग्ला फिल्म साधक बामाखेपा का प्रदर्शन प्राइम टाइम में जारी रहे।
पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री शुभेंदु अधिकारी ने प्रदेश के सिनेमाघर मालिकों और मल्टीप्लेक्स संचालकों को साफ निर्देश दिया है कि संत के जीवन पर आधारित बांग्ला फिल्म 'साधक बामाखेपा' का प्रदर्शन प्राइम टाइम में जारी रखा जाए। यह निर्देश उन खबरों के बीच आया है, जिनमें कहा गया था कि कई सिनेमाघर और मल्टीप्लेक्स 27 नवंबर को रिलीज होने वाली एक हिंदी फिल्म के लिए जगह बनाने के मकसद से 'साधक बामाखेपा' को रिलीज के महज एक हफ्ते के अंदर हटा रहे हैं।
सचिवालय में बैठक
मुख्यमंत्री ने नबान्न स्थित राज्य सचिवालय में फिल्म निर्माताओं, निर्देशकों, वितरकों और सिनेमाघर संचालकों के साथ बैठक बुलाई। बैठक में उन्होंने स्पष्ट किया कि जिन सिनेमाघरों में फिल्म बनाने वाले 'साधक बामाखेपा' का प्रदर्शन जारी रखना चाहते हैं, वहां फिल्म जरूर दिखाई जानी चाहिए। बताया जा रहा है कि इसके लिए दोपहर तीन बजे से रात नौ बजे के बीच प्राइम टाइम में शो देना अनिवार्य होगा। नियमों का पालन न करने वाले सिनेमाघर संचालकों के खिलाफ कड़ी कार्रवाई की चेतावनी भी दी गई।
बता दें कि 'साधक बामाखेपा' 20 नवंबर को रिलीज हुई थी। फिल्म को दर्शकों से अच्छी प्रतिक्रिया मिली और कई शो हाउसफुल बताए गए। इसके बावजूद इसे हटाने की खबरों से बंगाली फिल्म उद्योग के एक वर्ग में विरोध और नाराजगी पैदा हो गई थी।
बैठक में कौन-कौन?
बैठक में अभिनेत्री रूपा गांगुली, रुद्रनील घोष, हिरण चटर्जी, रितुपर्णा सेनगुप्ता, फिल्म वितरक शतदीप साहा और सिनेमाघर मालिक अरिजीत दत्ता समेत कई कलाकार और उद्योग प्रतिनिधि शामिल हुए। बंगाली सुपरस्टार प्रोसेनजीत चटर्जी और अभिनेता मिथुन चक्रवर्ती ऑनलाइन माध्यम से चर्चा में शामिल हुए।
मुख्यमंत्री ने कहा कि सरकार बांग्ला फिल्म उद्योग से जुड़े मुद्दों की समीक्षा करने और इस क्षेत्र को मजबूत करने के उपाय सुझाने के लिए 30 नवंबर तक एक समिति गठित करेगी। बैठक के बाद निर्देशक शुभ्रजीत मित्रा ने बताया कि प्रस्तावित समिति के सदस्यों का चयन मिथुन चक्रवर्ती और प्रोसेनजीत चटर्जी करेंगे। उन्होंने कहा, “यदि नुकसान की पुष्टि होती है, तो इस पर चर्चा की जाएगी कि क्या सरकार सब्सिडी दे सकती है या निर्माता नुकसान का कुछ हिस्सा साझा कर सकते हैं।
51 सिनेमाघर बनाने की योजना
मुख्यमंत्री ने आगे कहा कि राज्य में अगले डेढ़ साल में 51 नए सिनेमाघर बनाने की योजना है। उन्होंने राज्य में 500 एकल स्क्रीन वाले सिनेमाघर बनाने की अपनी महत्वाकांक्षा भी जाहिर की और निजी क्षेत्र के निवेशकों को सिनेमा के बुनियादी ढांचे में निवेश के लिए आमंत्रित किया। यह कदम बांग्ला सिनेमा को बढ़ावा देने और दर्शकों तक स्थानीय फिल्मों को आसानी से पहुंचाने की दिशा में उठाया गया है। सरकार का मानना है कि सिनेमाघरों की संख्या बढ़ने से फिल्म उद्योग को मजबूती मिलेगी और स्थानीय भाषा की फिल्में बेहतर तरीके से प्रदर्शित हो सकेंगी।

title: प्रिया सरोज और रिंकू सिंह की शादी में शामिल होंगे मोदी-योगी? शाहरुख को भी न्योता, जानें शेड्यूल
description: प्रिया सरोज के पिता और जौनपुर जिला की केराकत सीट से विधायक तूफानी सरोज ने बताया कि दोनों परिवार अपने-अपने पैतृक आवासों पर विवाह से पूर्व की रस्में पूरी करेंगे। रिंकू और प्रिया की शादी लखनऊ के होटल रमाडा में होगी।
author: Himanshu Jha
content:
प्रिया सरोज और रिंकू सिंह की शादी में शामिल होंगे मोदी-योगी? शाहरुख को भी न्योता, जानें शेड्यूल
प्रिया सरोज के पिता और जौनपुर जिला की केराकत सीट से विधायक तूफानी सरोज ने बताया कि दोनों परिवार अपने-अपने पैतृक आवासों पर विवाह से पूर्व की रस्में पूरी करेंगे। रिंकू और प्रिया की शादी लखनऊ के होटल रमाडा में होगी।
rinku singh priya saroj wedding: समाजवादी पार्टी की सांसद प्रिया सरोज और क्रिकेटर रिंकू सिंह चार दिसंबर को लखनऊ में एक भव्य समारोह में शादी के बंधन में बंधने जा रहे हैं। विवाह से पूर्व की सारी रस्में प्रिया सरोज के गांव करखियांव में उनके पैतृक आवास पर संपन्न होंगी। इसके बाद शादी लखनऊ में होगी, जहां 2000 से अधिक मेहमानों के पहुंचने की संभावना है। इस हाई-प्रोफाइल शादी के लिए प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी, उत्तर प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ, समाजवादी पार्टी के मुखिया अखिलेश यादव, कांग्रेस नेता राहुल और प्रियंका गांधी के साथ-साथ शाहरुख खान को न्योता दिया गया है। इसके अलावा क्रिकेट जगत के कई हस्तियों को भी आमंत्रित किया गया है। ऐसे करीब 2000 मेहमानों की लिस्ट है।
प्रिया सरोज के पिता और जौनपुर जिला की केराकत सीट से विधायक तूफानी सरोज ने बताया कि दोनों परिवार अपने-अपने पैतृक आवासों पर विवाह से पूर्व की रस्में पूरी करेंगे। रिंकू और प्रिया की शादी लखनऊ के होटल रमाडा में होगी। शादी के बाद पैतृक आवास पर प्रीति भोज का आयोजन होगा। लखनऊ नहीं पहुंचने वाले लोग प्रीतिभोज में शरीक हो सकेंगे। दोनों परिवारों की ओर से शादी की तैयारियां तेज कर दी गई हैं। निमंत्रण पत्र बांटने का सिलसिला अंतिम चरण में पहुंच चुका है।
आगंतुकों की लिस्ट में कौन-कौन?
इस हाई प्रोफाइल शादी में राजनीति, क्रिकेट और फिल्म जगत की कई प्रमुख हस्तियों के शामिल होने की संभावना है। दोनों परिवारों की ओर से विशिष्ट अतिथियों और करीबियों को निमंत्रण भेजे जा चुके हैं। रिंकू सिंह के क्रिकेट जगत के अपने साथियों और कई बड़े नेताओं के समारोह में पहुंचने की उम्मीद है। इस शादी समारोह में बॉलीवुड अभिनेता और कोलकाता नाइट राइडर्स के सह-मालिक शाहरुख खान की संभावित मौजूदगी की भी चर्चाएं तेज हैं। हालांकि, इसकी अभी आधिकारिक पुष्टि नहीं हुई है।
रिंकू सिंह ने पीएम मोदी को दिया न्योता
रिंकू सिंह ने चार दिसंबर को लखनऊ में होने वाली अपनी शादी के लिए प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी को आमंत्रित किया है। रिंकू सिंह ने अपने इंस्टाग्राम पेज पर प्रधानमंत्री मोदी के साथ एक तस्वीर साझा की और उनसे मुलाकात को अपने लिए सम्मान की बात बताया। रिंकू ने इंस्टाग्राम पर लिखा, ''अपने परिवार के साथ माननीय प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी से मिलना, उन्हें अपनी शादी का निमंत्रण देना और उनका आशीर्वाद लेना मेरे लिए सम्मान की बात है। यह हम सभी के लिए बेहद खास पल है।''
कब होंगी हल्दी और संगीत की रस्में
प्रिया सरोज और रिंकू सिंह की शादी की तैयारी अंतिम चरण में है। 4 दिसंबर की शादी से पहले 2 दिसंबर को हल्दी और संगीत की रस्में होंगी। दोनों ही अपने-अपने पैतृक घर पर इसे मनाएंगे। वहीं, 4 दिसंबर के बाद रिंकू सिंह के गृहनगर अलीगढ़ में रिसेप्शन और प्रीतिभोज का आयोजन किया जाएगा।
गौरतलब है कि रिंकू सिंह भारतीय क्रिकेट के चर्चित खिलाड़ियों में शामिल हैं, जबकि प्रिया सरोज उत्तर प्रदेश के मछलीशहर से समाजवादी पार्टी की सांसद हैं। दोनों की सगाई के बाद से ही उनके प्रशंसकों और समर्थकों में विवाह को लेकर उत्सुकता बनी हुई है। शादी की तारीख सामने आने के बाद परिवार और करीबियों में खुशी का माहौल है।

title: Khandwa News : फिर बाहर आया पानी में डूबा एमपी का ऐतिहासिक शहर, राजा हर्षवर्धन की नगरी के मंदिरों के शिखर दिखे
description: Khandwa News : राजा हर्षवर्धन द्वारा बसाए गए प्राचीन हरसूद के अवशेष नजर आए, बांध का पानी कम होने से दिखाई दे रहे मंदिर
author: deepak deewan
content:
फिर बाहर आया पानी में डूबा ऐतिहासिक हरसूद- image AI
Khandwa News : पानी में डूबा एमपी का एक ऐतिहासिक शहर फिर बाहर आ गया है। इंदिरा सागर बांध में डूबे हरसूद की पुराने इमारतें दिखाई देनी लगी हैं। बांध का जलस्तर कम होने से मंदिरों के शिखर और मस्जिद का गुंबद दिखने लगा है। हरसूद को राजा हर्षवर्धन की नगरी के रूप में जाना जाता था। खंडवा के पास का यह प्राचीन शहर 2004 में इंदिरा सागर बांध के बैक वाटर में डूब गया था।
हरसूद, मालवा निमाड़ इलाके का ऐतिहासिक शहर था। कहा जाता है कि इसे राजा हर्षवर्धन ने बसाया था। हरसूद करीब 700 साल से ज्यादा पुराना शहर था। इसकी पहचान बेहद शांत और सुरम्य नगरी के रूप में थी। इलाके में हरसूद बड़ा व्यापारिक केंद्र भी था। आसपास के गांवों के लोग यहां खरीदारी करने आते थे।
क्यों डूबा हरसूद?
नर्मदा नदी पर इंदिरा सागर बांध बनाया गया था। इस बांध की जद में हरसूद भी आ गया था। ऐसे में इसका डूबना तय हो गया था। बांध और हरसूद के डूबने का स्थानीय लोगों ने जमकर विरोध किया पर सरकार नहीं मानी। शहर के डूबने के बाद यहां के लोगों को विस्थापित करने के लिए नया छनेरा बसाया गया था। 30 जून 2004 को हरसूद, इंदिरा सागर के बैक वाटर में डूब गया। इसी के साथ इस ऐतिहासिक शहर की केवल यादें ही शेष रह गईं। इस घटना को 22 साल बीत चुके हैं।
बुरी बात यह भी है कि हरसूद के डूबने के बाद वहां के मूल निवासियों को छनेरा और उसके पासपास बसाने के लिए जो जमीन दी गई उनके पट्टे आज भी कई लोगों के पास नहीं है। कई प्रभावितों को तो मुआवजा तक नहीं मिला। दो दशक से ज्यादा समय से ऐसे लोग अदालती लड़ाई लड़ने में उलझे हैं।
इंदिरा सागर बांध में इस बार जलस्तर तेजी से घट रहा है। इसके कारण प्राचीन हरसूर के पानी में डूबे अवशेष नजर आने लगे हैं। पिछले करीब दो माह में इंदिरा सागर बांध का जलस्तर 2.13 मीटर कम हो चुका है। नवंबर में पहली बार यह स्थिति बनी है। बांध का जलस्तर घट जाने से पुराने हरसूद के कई अवशेष नजर आने लगे हैं। हाटकेश्वर महादेव मंदिर और किशनपुरा माताजी मंदिर के शिखर दिखाई देने लगे हैं। हरसूद की जामा मस्जिद की गुंबद भी दिखाई दे रही है।
बता दें कि इंदिरा सागर बांध में 262.13 मीटर तक पानी भरा जाता है। इस बारिश में जलभराव 261.830 मीटर तक हुआ था। इस प्रकार बांध में क्षमता का 97.43 प्रतिशत पानी था। दो दिन पहले बांध का जलस्तर 259.700 मीटर पर आ गया है।

title: कभी पैदल चले, कभी चलाई नाव… ओंकारेश्वर में अलग अंदाज में नजर आए मुख्यमंत्री मोहन यादव
description:
-संतों का सानिध्य ईश्वर से संवाद का अवसर देता है : मुख्यमंत्री
-दादा गुरु की पांचवीं नर्मदा परिक्रमा का शुभारंभ, मुख्यमंत्री ने किया नर्मदा पूजन 
-बोले- नर्मदा तट की पवित्रता और स्वच्छता बनाए रखना सबकी जिम्मेदारी
author: Manish Arora
content:
ओंकारेश्वर. मुख्यमंत्री ने नर्मदा विहार के दौरान चलाई नाव।
नर्मदा परिक्रमावासी दादा गुरु की पांचवीं नर्मदा सेवा परिक्रमा का मंगलवार को ओंकारेश्वर के गोमुख घाट से विधिवत शुभारंभ हुआ। मुख्यमंत्री डॉ. मोहन यादव कार्यक्रम में शामिल हुए और दादा गुरु के साथ मां नर्मदा का पूजन-अभिषेक कर प्रदेश की सुख-समृद्धि तथा परिक्रमा के निर्विघ्न पूर्ण होने की कामना की। कार्यक्रम के बाद मुख्यमंत्री डॉ. मोहन यादव एक नए अंदाज में नजर आए। नर्मदा में नौका विहार करने निकले सीएम ने खुद नाव का इंजन संभाला और कुछ देर नाव चलाई।
मुख्यमंत्री सुबह 9.25 बजे कोठी हेलीपैड पहुंचे, जहां से गोमुख घाट पहुंचकर नर्मदा परिक्रमा शुभारंभ कार्यक्रम में सहभागिता की। मुख्यमंत्री डॉ. यादव ने कहा कि संतों का सानिध्य मिलना सौभाग्य की बात है। संतों के माध्यम से हमें साक्षात ईश्वर से संवाद का अवसर मिलता है। दादा गुरु के सानिध्य में मां नर्मदा की पांचवीं परिक्रमा केवल धार्मिक यात्रा नहीं, बल्कि आस्था, साधना, सद्भाव और लोककल्याण का आध्यात्मिक मार्ग है। उन्होंने कहा कि सनातन परंपराएं समाज को जोडऩे और मानव कल्याण का संदेश देती हैं। प्रदेश सरकार आध्यात्मिक परंपराओं और सनातन संस्कृति के संरक्षण के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है। मुख्यमंत्री ने कहा कि नर्मदा का तट एक मठ के समान है। इसकी पवित्रता और स्वच्छता बनाए रखना प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का कर्तव्य है। परिक्रमा मार्ग में श्रद्धालुओं की सुविधा के लिए राज्य सरकार ने विशेष व्यवस्थाएं की हैं।
दादा गुरु ने कहा कि ईश्वरीय भक्ति और साधना व्यक्ति के जीवन और व्यक्तित्व का विकास करती है। मां नर्मदा हमारे लिए केवल नदी नहीं, बल्कि जीवन, ज्ञान, आचार-विचार, विकास और व्यवस्था का आधार है। नर्मदा तट पर अनेक सभ्यताओं के जन्म के प्रमाण मिलते हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि नर्मदा परिक्रमा मूल रूप से साधना है, जिसके केंद्र में लोककल्याण की भावना है। यह यात्रा समाज में सद्भाव और समरसता को मजबूत करती है। दादा गुरु ने परिक्रमा की आध्यात्मिक अनुभूति बताते हुए कहा कि जब पैदल चलते हैं तो साधना बन जाती है और बैठ जाते हैं तो आराधना।
कार्यक्रम में पंचायत एवं ग्रामीण विकास मंत्री प्रहलाद पटेल, नगरीय विकास एवं आवास मंत्री कैलाश विजयवर्गीय, सहकारिता मंत्री विश्वास सारंग, राज्य मंत्री गौतम टेटवाल, सांसद ज्ञानेश्वर पाटिल, मांधाता विधायक नारायण पटेल, पंधाना विधायक छाया मोरे, संभाग आयुक्त भास्कर लाक्षाकार, आईजी अनुराग, डीआईजी सिमाला प्रसाद, कलेक्टर ऋषव गुप्ता और पुलिस अधीक्षक अगम जैन सहित जनप्रतिनिधि एवं अधिकारी मौजूद रहे।
-सुबह करीब 9.25 बजे कोठी हेलीपैड से गोमुख घाट पहुंचे मुख्यमंत्री ने दादा गुरु के साथ मां नर्मदा का पूजन-अभिषेक किया और परिक्रमा के धार्मिक आयोजन में सहभागिता की।
-मुख्यमंत्री गोमुख घाट से पुराने बस स्टैंड तक दादा गुरु और नर्मदा परिक्रमा वासियों के साथ पैदल चले। इस दौरान उन्होंने श्रद्धालुओं का अभिवादन भी स्वीकार किया।
-मुख्यमंत्री ने ओंकारेश्वर ज्योतिर्लिंग और ममलेश्वर ज्योतिर्लिंग के दर्शन कर पूजा-अर्चना की। उन्होंने मां नर्मदा में नौका विहार भी किया और कुछ देर स्वयं नाव की पतवार संभाली।
-मुख्यमंत्री ने जोड़ गणपति हनुमान मंदिर पहुंचकर दर्शन किए। यहां उन्होंने षड्दर्शन मंडल के अध्यक्ष महंत मंगलदास त्यागी से भेंट की और आश्रम में भोजन भी किया।

title: Delhi Riots Case: उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को नहीं मिली अंतरिम जमानत, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने क्यों कहा- ‘आज नहीं’
description: Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam: दिल्ली दंगों से जुड़े मामले में उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को सुप्रीम कोर्ट से अंतरिम जमानत नहीं मिली। अदालत ने दिल्ली पुलिस से जवाब मांगा है।
author: Imran Sheikh
content:
Hindi News / Delhi / New Delhi / Delhi Riots Case: उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को नहीं मिली अंतरिम जमानत, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने क्यों कहा- ‘आज नहीं’
Delhi Riots Case: उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को नहीं मिली अंतरिम जमानत, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने क्यों कहा- ‘आज नहीं’
Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam: दिल्ली दंगों से जुड़े मामले में उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को सुप्रीम कोर्ट से अंतरिम जमानत नहीं मिली। अदालत ने दिल्ली पुलिस से जवाब मांगा है।
सुप्रीम कोर्ट में उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम की जमानत पर सुनवाई। (फोटो सोर्स-ANI)
UAPA Case: दिल्ली दंगों से जुड़े मामले में जेल में बंद उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को सुप्रीम कोर्ट से फिलहाल राहत नहीं मिली है। दोनों की जमानत याचिकाओं पर सुनवाई के दौरान उनके वकीलों ने अंतरिम जमानत देने की मांग की, लेकिन अदालत ने इस पर तुरंत फैसला देने से इनकार कर दिया। मुख्य न्यायाधीश सूर्यकांत की अध्यक्षता वाली पीठ ने कहा, 'आज नहीं, पहले सरकार का जवाब आने दीजिए।'
सुनवाई के दौरान वरिष्ठ वकील सिद्धार्थ दवे और कपिल सिब्बल ने अदालत से कहा कि नियमित जमानत पर फैसला होने तक दोनों को अंतरिम राहत दी जाए। इस पर पीठ ने दिल्ली पुलिस को नोटिस जारी कर जवाब मांगा। अदालत का कहना था कि अंतरिम जमानत की मांग पर विचार करने से पहले सरकार का पक्ष सुनना जरूरी है। फिलहाल दोनों को जेल में ही रहना होगा।
पहले भी खारिज हो चुकी है जमानत
उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम की जमानत याचिकाएं पहले भी अदालतों में खारिज हो चुकी हैं। 5 जनवरी 2026 को सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने दोनों को नियमित जमानत देने से इनकार कर दिया था। हालांकि, अदालत ने कहा था कि अभियोजन पक्ष के गवाहों की गवाही पूरी होने या एक साल बीतने के बाद, जो भी पहले हो, वे दोबारा जमानत मांग सकते हैं।
इसके बाद दोनों ने निचली अदालत में फिर से जमानत याचिका लगाई, लेकिन 4 जुलाई 2026 को उनकी मांग खारिज कर दी गई। दिल्ली हाईकोर्ट ने भी 30 सितंबर को इस फैसले में दखल देने से इनकार कर दिया। इसके बाद दोनों ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट का रुख किया।
2020 के दिल्ली दंगों से जुड़ा है मामला
यह मामला फरवरी 2020 में उत्तर-पूर्वी दिल्ली में हुई हिंसा से जुड़ा है। इन दंगों में 53 लोगों की मौत हुई थी और कई लोग घायल हुए थे। जांच एजेंसियों का आरोप है कि हिंसा के पीछे बड़ी साजिश थी और उमर खालिद तथा शरजील इमाम भी इसमें शामिल थे। दोनों पर गैरकानूनी गतिविधियां रोकथाम कानून (UAPA) के तहत मामला दर्ज है।
अंतरिम जमानत पर भी नहीं मिली राहत
उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम की ओर से पेश वकीलों ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट से मांग की कि नियमित जमानत पर फैसला होने तक दोनों को अंतरिम जमानत दे दी जाए। इस पर अदालत ने फिलहाल राहत देने से इनकार करते हुए कहा, 'आज नहीं'। कोर्ट ने पहले दिल्ली पुलिस का पक्ष सुनने की बात कही है।
तीन जजों की पीठ के सामने जा सकता है मामला
सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मामले को तीन जजों की पीठ के गठन के लिए चीफ जस्टिस के सामने रखने का निर्देश दिया है। इससे अब इस मामले की सुनवाई तीन जजों की पीठ के सामने होने की संभावना है। हालांकि, अगली सुनवाई की तारीख अभी स्पष्ट नहीं है।
दोनों लंबे समय से जेल में हैं। उनकी ओर से जमानत की मांग करते हुए जेल में बिताए समय और मुकदमे की धीमी रफ्तार का मुद्दा उठाया गया है। अब सुप्रीम कोर्ट में आगे की सुनवाई दिल्ली सरकार के जवाब के बाद होगी। फिलहाल अदालत ने अंतरिम जमानत पर राहत देने के बजाय पहले दिल्ली पुलिस का पक्ष सुनने का फैसला किया है।

title: Meerut Hotel Case: Accused Salman Who Dragged Woman On Road Arrested After Encounter; Watch Video
description: Meerut hotel case accused Salman, 29, has been arrested after an encounter. A video shows him crying and pleading with police, saying, 'I made a mistake.'
author: Swastika Sruti
content:
Meerut Hotel Case: Accused Salman Who Dragged Woman On Road Arrested After Encounter; Watch Video
The primary accused in the Meerut hotel case, Salman, has been arrested by Uttar Pradesh Police while staying absconded. A video uploaded after the arrest of the accused on Wednesday showed the accused crying and requesting the police to forgive him repeatedly.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
"Sir, I made a mistake, please forgive me. I won't make it again," Salman can be heard saying in the video as he is being taken away by the police.
Salman, 29, was accused of kidnapping a woman and attempting to rape her before making an effort to force her to get married to him. In addition, the accused had allegedly assaulted and kidnapped the victim, who managed to escape from the attack.
The details of the case allegedly emerged from CCTV camera footage which caught parts of the alleged assault and kidnapping. According to the police, Salman sustained injuries while trying to escape from his arrest.
 #WATCH | Meerut, Uttar Pradesh: SSP B.B.G.T.S. Murthy says, "A complaint was received at the Sadar Bazar Police Station alleging that a Dalit woman had been held captive and sexually assaulted by an individual named Salman. A case has been registered under the relevant legal sections, and necessary legal action is being initiated. Today, on November 25, 2026, we received specific information that the accused was hiding near an underpass under construction, located close to Nahar Narhera village within the jurisdiction of the Lohia Nagar Police Station. Teams from both the Lohia Nagar and Sadar Bazar police stations immediately reached the spot and surrounded the area. Realising he was cornered, the accused opened fire on the police party. As the police attempted to apprehend him—while taking precautions to ensure their own safety—the accused tried to flee by climbing onto a nearby bridge. He subsequently slipped and fell from the bridge, sustaining injuries to his right and left arms. He has been promptly sent to a hospital for medical treatment, and further necessary legal action is being taken."(Source: Police)
— ANI (@ANI) November 25, 2026
How Meerut Police Arrested Salman
As per the statement issued by the police press note, Salman, who was a wanted accused in the case registered at Sadar Bazaar police station, was apprehended from Lohiya Nagar by the police.
He was reportedly surrounded by the police near the under-construction underpass adjacent to Narheda village. As soon as the police surrounded him, he fired upon them to kill them.
When the police tried to arrest him, he reportedly jumped into a bridge in order to run away but fell down and injured himself in his right leg and left hand.
He was then apprehended by the police and taken to PL Sharma District Hospital.
Illegal Pistol And Ammunition Recovered
During the arrest, police recovered an illegal .315-bore pistol, one live cartridge and one spent cartridge from Salman's possession.
Officials said Salman is a resident of the Rohta area and has several criminal cases registered against him at police stations in Meerut and Ghaziabad.
Police are now collecting evidence related to the case and have initiated further legal proceedings.
What Is The Meerut Hotel Case?
Salman is accused of holding a Hindu woman hostage inside a hotel in Meerut and attempting to rape her. He allegedly pressured her to marry him.
The woman reportedly managed to escape from the hotel, but the accused allegedly caught up with her, assaulted her on the road and abducted her. CCTV footage of the incident reportedly captured the sequence of events and became an important part of the case.
With Salman's arrest, police are continuing their investigation into the allegations and examining the available evidence.

title: Supreme Court Refuses Interim Bail To Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam In 2020 Delhi Riots Case
description: The Supreme Court has declined interim bail to Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in the 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case and sought the Delhi Police's response to their pleas.
author: Madhuri Adnal
content:
Supreme Court Refuses Interim Bail To Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam In 2020 Delhi Riots Case
The Supreme Court on Wednesday, November 25, declined to grant interim bail to activists Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in the case relating to the alleged larger conspiracy behind the February 2020 northeast Delhi riots. The two have approached the apex court challenging the Delhi High Court's decision to reject their bail applications under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA).
A three-judge bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued notices to the Delhi Police, asking it to respond to the interim bail applications filed by the two accused.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
During the hearing, senior advocate Kapil Sibal, appearing for Khalid, requested temporary release while the main pleas were being considered. Senior advocate Siddharth Dave, representing Imam, also sought interim bail, pointing to the lengthy period his client had spent in custody.
The bench, however, declined to consider the requests at this stage, telling the lawyers, "Not today". It said the Delhi Police would first have to submit its response before the court could take up the question of interim relief.
The Supreme Court also directed that the matter be placed before the Chief Justice of India on the administrative side for the formation of a three-judge bench to hear the case.
Why have Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam sought bail?
In their petitions, both activists have questioned the continued delay in the trial and argued that their prolonged detention cannot be justified when the prosecution has made limited progress in examining witnesses.
Imam's plea states that the chargesheet in the case was filed on September 25, 2020. A total of 18 accused are facing trial, while the prosecution has listed more than 900 witnesses, including 47 protected witnesses.
He has also pointed out that despite spending six years and nine months in custody as an undertrial, not a single witness has been examined by the prosecution, according to his petition.
Khalid has raised similar concerns about the delay in recording the statements of protected witnesses. His petition also refers to the one-year restriction on bail imposed by the Supreme Court and argues that, with the embargo nearing its end, continued detention would infringe upon his right to life and personal liberty under Article 21 of the Constitution.
Both have relied on the prolonged nature of the proceedings and the delay in the trial as grounds for seeking relief.
Delhi High Court had rejected their bail pleas
The latest proceedings follow the Delhi High Court's September 30 decision refusing bail to Khalid and Imam in the UAPA case linked to the alleged conspiracy behind the northeast Delhi riots.
The two activists subsequently moved the Supreme Court, challenging the High Court's order.
The case concerns the violence that broke out in northeast Delhi in February 2020 during protests against the Citizenship (Amendment) Act (CAA), 2019, and the proposed National Register of Citizens (NRC).
Imam was arrested on August 25, 2020, while Khalid was taken into custody on September 13, 2020. Both have remained in custody as undertrials in the case.
The Supreme Court has now sought the Delhi Police's response before considering their requests for interim bail.

title: Punjab's Industrial Ecosystem: Strong Infrastructure, Better Logistics and Skilled Workforce to Transform the State into an Industrial Hub
description: Punjab's Industrial Policy 2026 aims to modernise the base, attract investment, boost exports and create jobs by leveraging roads, railways, power and a skilled workforce.
author: Oneindia Staff
content:
Punjab's Industrial Ecosystem: Strong Infrastructure, Better Logistics and Skilled Workforce to Transform the State into an Industrial Hub
Punjab aims to diversify from agriculture to a robust industrial and manufacturing hub. The 2026 policy highlights improved road and rail networks, power reliability, and skilled human resources as key to attracting investment, boosting exports, and creating jobs, supported by SEZs and a strengthened industrial land base.
Punjab has long been recognised as one of India's leading agricultural producers and foodgrain suppliers. From the Green Revolution to its significant contribution to agricultural production, the state has played an important role in strengthening the country's economy. However, with changing economic conditions, Punjab is now working towards expanding its identity beyond an agriculture-based economy and establishing itself as a strong industrial and manufacturing centre.
Attracting investments alone is not enough to transform a state into a major industrial hub. It requires a strong road and railway network, modern industrial infrastructure, reliable power supply, skilled human resources, efficient transportation facilities and industry-friendly government policies.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
Punjab already enjoys several advantages in these areas, including an established industrial base and a strategic geographical location. Ludhiana's bicycle and engineering industries, Jalandhar's sports goods industry, Mandi Gobindgarh's steel sector, Mohali's IT and electronics industry, and Amritsar's textile and food processing industries reflect the state's industrial potential.
The Punjab Government's new Industrial Policy 2026 is an important step in this direction. Its objective is to modernise the existing industrial base, attract new investments, boost exports and create employment opportunities for the state's youth.
Land, electricity, water, roads, transportation and communication facilities are among the most fundamental requirements for any industry. Before making an investment, entrepreneurs assess how easily raw materials can reach their manufacturing units and how much time and money will be required to transport finished products to markets.
Punjab's existing infrastructure provides the state with a significant advantage in this regard. According to Punjab's Industrial Policy 2026, the state has an extensive road network of approximately 1,47,862 kilometres and a railway network spanning 2,265 kilometres. It also has two international airports in Amritsar and Mohali, along with four domestic airports in Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Bathinda and Pathankot.
To promote industrial activities, Punjab also has 52 focal points and three operational Special Economic Zones (SEZs). According to the policy, approximately 1,974.53 hectares of industrial land is available in the state.
These facilities can support the establishment of new industries as well as the expansion of existing industrial units. Improved connectivity in industrial centres such as Ludhiana, Jalandhar, Amritsar, Mohali, Patiala and Bath

title: Dalai Lama allotted government accommodation in Delhi for three years
description: The Accommodation Was Allotted To Gaden Phodrang Trust Following A Request From The Ministry Of External Affairs, Sources Say
author: PTI
content:
The central government has allotted a bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi to Tibetan spiritual leader the Dalai Lama, with the accommodation granted to his office, Gaden Phodrang Trust, following a request from the Ministry of External Affairs, sources said.
The bungalow is located on Pandit Ravi Shankar Shukla Lane in the national capital. Although the Union Housing and Urban Affairs Ministry has not issued any official statement on the allotment, sources said on Tuesday that the accommodation had been approved.
The allotment to Gaden Phodrang Trust, which serves as the office of the Dalai Lama, has been made following the Ministry of External Affairs' request, they said.
Such government accommodation is generally allotted for a period of three years, with a provision for extension.
According to the Gaden Phodrang Trust's website, the organisation is dedicated to preserving and upholding the institution of the Dalai Lama and his spiritual work, while advancing his humanitarian vision.
The Trust also supports the Dalai Lama's core commitments, including promoting human values, fostering interfaith harmony, preserving Tibetan culture and identity, protecting the environment, and encouraging a deeper appreciation of ancient Indian wisdom, the website states.

title: India condemns Houthi attack on Riyadh financial district; two Indians among 11 injured
description: New Delhi Expresses Solidarity With Saudi Arabia And Calls For An Immediate Cessation Of Strikes On Civilian, Economic And Energy Infrastructure
author: PTI
content:
Two Indians were among 11 people injured in a Houthi attack on a tower in Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh, prompting India to strongly condemn the strike and call for an immediate cessation of attacks targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in the Kingdom.
The attack took place on Tuesday at Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District. According to Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence, those injured included two Saudi citizens, two Indians, three Nepalese and four Egyptian nationals.
Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence described the incident as a "terrorist attack" by Yemen's Houthi militia. Authorities responded immediately and took necessary measures to protect lives and property.
The Indian Embassy in Riyadh confirmed that two Indian nationals sustained injuries in the attack and said it was providing all possible assistance to them and their families.
"Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district. The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families," the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said.
In a statement, the MEA strongly condemned the attack and continued strikes on civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.
"These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability. We call for immediate cessation of such attacks," it said.
India also reiterated its firm solidarity with the people and government of Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed its unwavering support to the Kingdom in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity.
"We earnestly hope that peace and normalcy will return to the region at the earliest," the MEA said.
Earlier, Saudi-led Coalition Spokesperson Maj Gen Turki Al Malki said a tower in the financial district had been targeted and that competent authorities were responding at the site.
Following the incident, the Indian Embassy also urged Indian nationals residing in Saudi Arabia to abide by local rules and regulations. In a post on X, it said further details of the incident were being ascertained and all possible assistance would be extended to the injured Indians and their families.
The Houthis have claimed responsibility for attacks on Riyadh in the past.
There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, particularly after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia.
India has consistently voiced serious concern over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's civilian infrastructure and economic assets, cautioning that such strikes undermine regional stability and threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.
The West Asia conflict began in February following attacks on Iran by the US and Israel. New Delhi has consistently called for a resolution through dialogue and diplomacy.

title: ‘Not today’: SC defers interim bail for Khalid, Imam as CJI Surya Kant’s 2021 ruling comes up
description: Surya Kant Authored The 2021 Judgment That Held Constitutional Courts Can Grant Bail Despite UAPA Restrictions When A Timely Trial Is Unlikely. The Supreme Court Sought Delhi Police’s Response And Deferred Consideration Of Interim Bail
author: Our Web Desk & PTI
content:
“Not today,” Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said on Wednesday as the Supreme Court deferred consideration of interim bail for Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam, who have spent more than six years in custody in the 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case. The court issued notice to Delhi Police and said it would hear the police before considering interim relief.
The bench of Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana directed that the matter be placed before the CJI on the administrative side for constitution of a three-judge bench. Khalid and Imam have challenged the Delhi High Court’s refusal to grant them bail in the case, which concerns an alleged larger conspiracy behind the February 2020 northeast Delhi riots.
Senior advocate Kapil Sibal, appearing for Khalid, pressed for interim bail, citing his years in custody. Senior advocate Siddharth Dave sought similar relief for Imam. Sibal pointed out that the court had granted interim bail to co-accused Tasleem Ahmed when it referred a question about the application of the 2021 K.A. Najeeb judgment to a larger bench. Kant replied, “Not today.”
‘It was my judgment which is being discussed’
The hearing turned to K.A. Najeeb, the judgment Kant authored in 2021. It held that constitutional courts can grant bail despite the stringent restrictions under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act when prolonged detention and the prospect of a delayed trial threaten the right to personal liberty. In May, the court flagged differing interpretations of that ruling in the Tasleem Ahmed case and referred the issue to a larger bench.
“It was my judgment which is being discussed. So I am feeling a little embarrassed,” Kant said, according to LiveLaw. Dave argued that the May reference had no bearing on the fresh pleas, which were filed under the terms of the court’s January order. Solicitor general Tushar Mehta, appearing for Delhi Police, pointed out that the reference arose from the same FIR.
Sibal asked for an early hearing and later asked whether the interim bail requests could be listed separately. Kant said the case itself would be listed.
On January 5, the Supreme Court denied bail to Khalid and Imam but allowed them to apply again once the prosecution had finished examining protected witnesses or one year had elapsed, whichever came first. In their fresh pleas, the two argue that the examination is unlikely to be completed by January 5, 2027, and cite their prolonged incarceration in seeking bail.
Imam was arrested in the case on August 25, 2020, while Khalid was arrested on September 13, 2020.

title: Saurav Das CJP: Indian government has 'lost the plot' says 'cockroach' party leader after being barred from UK flight
description: Saurav Das says immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been flagged.
author: Rajini Vaidyanathan, Jamie Whitehead
content:
Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
- Published
One of the leaders of India's "cockroach" movement has said the Delhi government has "completely lost the plot" after he was stopped from leaving the country for the UK.
Saurav Das said he was meant to board a flight on Tuesday morning but was told by immigration officers his passport had been "flagged" because of discrepancies involving his date of birth.
In an interview with the BBC, Das said there were no discrepancies in his documents, accusing the Indian government of using cheap tactics to stop activists from travelling and speaking on issues that matter to young people.
The BBC has reached out to the federal home ministry, Delhi police and airport officials for comment.
Saurav told the BBC World Service's Newshour programme the incident showed the government was "scared".
"They are scared of the cockroach movement. They're scared of young people asking them questions because they have never had to deal with a generation that wants to ask questions so head on. So that jitters them."
By not allowing him to travel, he said the government had lowered India's stature in the world.
"It's international news that I am unable to travel to the UK," he said. "And this shows Prime Minister Modi in such poor light.
"It's a way to harass, to target activists, young voices in India by the Modi government."
Das said he had been invited by the Oxford Union, as well as universities including Cambridge and Edinburgh, to speak about the movement.
Ratna Singh, another leader of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), wrote: "The manner in which Saurav was not allowed to board today raises deeply troubling questions about the state of freedom of expression and the space being allowed for young voices in this country."
On Tuesday, the London School of Economics Student Union's Amnesty International Unit, a student-led charity group, shared a post on Instagram saying that an event featuring Das had been "indefinitely postponed".
Das, a former journalist, became one of the faces of the CJP - a Gen Z-led movement that began as satire but has since emerged as a youth-led pressure group.
In July, protests spearheaded by the CJP over exam paper leaks led to the resignation of India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan .
In October, CJP leaders including Das were among thousands detained by the police for trying to hold protests demanding the resignation of India's Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. Kumar and the Election Commission have denied wrongdoing.
The same month, Das and Ashutosh Ranka, another CJP leader, were jailed for seven days after being arrested for trespassing at a banned protest site in Delhi.
Das insisted the CJP would continue protesting, but it did not want to be a political party "as of today".
"It's a long haul. We are not here for a short time. We are looking at India in the next 10 to 20 years. How do we develop India into a better country? That is the vision that we want to carry forward."
Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of CJP, wrote on X that if Das "had looted a bank or committed financial fraud", he may have been allowed to fly to London, referring to billionaire bank-loan defaulters who have left India.
There have been other instances in recent years of people being prevented from boarding flights.
In September 2025, Bhanu Tatak, an environmental and anti-dam activist from India's north-eastern Arunachal Pradesh state, was stopped from boarding a flight to Dublin.
In March 2022, Rana Ayyub, an investigative journalist and outspoken critic of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government, was also stopped from boarding a flight to London at the Mumbai airport. She was due to speak at different events on media freedom and the targeting of journalists.
Additional reporting by Cherylann Mollan.

title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi: 15-year-old smashes the record for the fastest List A double century
description: India's 15-year-old sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi blazes 204 from 53 balls for India A, almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket.
author: Mike Peter
content:
Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record by scoring 204 off 53 balls
- Published
India's 15-year-old batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings in blazing 204 from 53 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates.
While almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket, Sooryavanshi hit 28 sixes and seven fours in the Asia Cup Rising Stars competition - easily breaking Chad Bowes' previous record of 103 balls from 2024.
The teenage opener also broke the record for the fastest century and 150, the latter of which he already held, before being caught at long-off with his side five runs from victory.
India A ultimately passed their target of 250, played against a UAE side that featured a number of internationals but was not their current first-choice side, in 14.2 overs in Doha.
Sooryavanshi now holds the following records in List A cricket, the categorisation given to senior one-day matches:
- Fastest fifty: 11 balls v Sri Lanka A, 21 June (previously Kaushalya Weeraratne, 12 balls, 1 November 2005)
- Fastest hundred: 28 balls, today (previously Jake Fraser-McGurk, 29 balls, 8 October 2023)
- Fastest 150: 40 balls, today (previously himself, 59 balls, 24 December 2025)
- Fastest 200: 52 balls, today (previously Chad Bowes, 103 balls, 22 October 2024)
The previous record for the most sixes in senior matches was 26, struck by Tanmay Agarwal in an innings of 366 for Hyderabad against Arunachal Pradesh in India's first-class Ranji Trophy competition in January 2024.
The record in List A cricket was 23 sixes, struck by D'Arcy Short for Queensland in his 257 against Tasmania on 28 September 2018.
Sooryavanshi also holds the records of being the youngest century-maker in both List A and T20 cricket and the youngest captain in T20s.
"The first thing that's required in this format is being fearless, he's got plenty of that," former India batter Deep Dasgupta told BBC Radio 5 Live.
"Technically he's quite unique. There is a tendency of being over-coached in this generation, there's so many coaches and when you start playing franchise cricket.
"The best part is he has been fast-tracked so he hasn't had a lot of coaches, he's kind of untouched. What you see of him is predominantly what his natural game is.
"That bat swing, the hand speed, which is very, very natural and one of the quickest you'll come across. Technically he's very gifted, he's very special and he's definitely the real deal."
Sooryavanshi has rapidly become a sensation in T20 cricket since making his debut in the Indian Premier League in 2025 at the age of 14.
He has hit two hundreds and six fifties in his first two seasons in the competition and has earned 10 caps for India in the shortest format since making his debut against England in July.
The left-hander, who was batting in only his 16th List A innings in Doha and made his second century in the format, is yet to play for India in 50-over cricket.
He put on partnerships of 68 with opening partner Abhishek Sharma, who scored 12, 40 with Prabhsimran Singh, who added just three, and 137 with Rinku Singh, who scored an unbeaten 27.
The India A side, which featured a number of internationals, restricted the UAE to 249-8 in 50 overs, external after their opposition had chosen to bat and swiftly reached 254-3 to win by seven wickets and guarantee their place in the semi-finals.
The Rising Stars competition features A sides from India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and Afghanistan alongside squads from the UAE, Nepal and Hong Kong.
India A, who now top Group B, beat Nepal and lost to Pakistan A in their previous two matches in the competition, with Sooryavanshi making scores of 26 and 11.
Pakistan A will retake the top spot if they beat Nepal on Tuesday, with semi-finals on Thursday and Friday to follow before Sunday's final.
