title: 15 मिनट से ज्यादा रुके तो देना पड़ेगा तगड़ा जुर्माना! एक दिसंबर से एयरपोर्ट में लागू होगा नया नियम
description: 15 मिनट से ज्यादा रुके तो देना पड़ेगा तगड़ा जुर्माना! Stay of More Than 15 Minutes at Pune Airport will Attract a Fine of Rs 500
author: IBC24
content:
15 मिनट से ज्यादा रुके तो देना पड़ेगा तगड़ा जुर्माना! एक दिसंबर से एयरपोर्ट में लागू होगा नया नियम
15 मिनट से ज्यादा रुके तो देना पड़ेगा तगड़ा जुर्माना! Stay of More Than 15 Minutes at Pune Airport will Attract a Fine of Rs 500
पुणे हवाई अड्डा प्राधिकरण एक दिसंबर से यात्रियों को चढ़ाने या उतारने के लिए तय 15 मिनट की समय सीमा से अधिक देर तक रुकने वाले वाहनों पर 500 रुपये का जुर्माना लगाएगा। अधिकारियों ने बुधवार को यह जानकारी दी। हवाई अड्डे ने कहा कि इस कदम का उद्देश्य भीड़भाड़ कम करना, यातायात सुगम बनाना और विशेष रूप से व्यस्त समय के दौरान सड़क किनारे उपलब्ध निर्धारित स्थान का अधिक कुशलता से उपयोग सुनिश्चित करना है।
हवाई अड्डे द्वारा जारी एक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति के अनुसार, इस प्रतिबंध में यात्रियों के चढ़ने या उतरने के लिए पांच मिनट का समय भी शामिल है और इसकी निगरानी प्रवेश एवं निकास द्वारों पर लगाई गई स्वचालित नंबर प्लेट पहचान (एएनआरपी) प्रणाली के माध्यम से की जाएगी। वाहन चालकों को इस नयी व्यवस्था से परिचित कराने के लिए इस प्रणाली को परीक्षण के आधार पर शुरू किया गया है। 30 नवंबर तक चलने वाली परीक्षण अवधि के दौरान कोई जुर्माना नहीं लगाया जाएगा, जबकि 'हवाई अड्डा विनियम, 2003' के लागू प्रावधानों के तहत एक दिसंबर से 500 रुपये का यह जुर्माना प्रभावी हो जाएगा।
प्रवेश और निकास द्वारों पर लगे कैमरे वाहनों के निर्धारित मार्ग में बिताए गए समय की गणना करने के लिए उनके पंजीकरण विवरण और तस्वीरें दर्ज करेंगे। निर्धारित अवधि से अधिक समय लेने वाले वाहनों की पहचान की जाएगी और जुर्माना डिजिटल भुगतान सुविधाओं, विशेष रूप से 'फास्टैग' या 'क्यूआर-कोड' आधारित भुगतान माध्यमों के जरिए वसूला जाएगा। केंद्रीय नागरिक उड्डयन एवं सहकारिता राज्य मंत्री मुरलीधर मोहोल ने कहा कि यात्रियों की सुविधा और हवाई अड्डे तक सुगम पहुंच प्रमुख प्राथमिकताएं हैं।

title: Umesh Ragde Threat Case: रायपुर में कांग्रेस नेता उमेश रगड़े पर केस, कारोबारी को जान से मारने की धमकी देने का आरोप, ऑडियो वायरल
description: Umesh Ragde Threat Case: रायपुर में कांग्रेस नेता उमेश रगड़े के खिलाफ कारोबारी को धमकाने के आरोप में FIR दर्ज की गई है। छत्तीसगढ़ | लेटेस्ट न्यूज
author: BP Shrivastava
content:
Umesh Ragde Threat Case: रायपुर में कांग्रेस नेता उमेश रगड़े के खिलाफ कारोबारी को धमकाने (Umesh Ragde Threat Case) के आरोप में FIR दर्ज की गई है। कारोबारी विजय जेठानी (Vijay Jethani) ने आरोप लगाया है कि मारपीट के पुराने मामले की रिपोर्ट वापस लेने के लिए उन पर दबाव बनाया गया। इस दौरान गाली-गलौज करने और जान से मारने की धमकी देने की भी शिकायत की गई है। धमकाने का ऑडियो भी वायरल हो रहा है। जिसमें उमेश कारोबारी को मां-बहन की गंदी गालियां दे रहा है।
रिपोर्ट वापस लेने का बनाया दबाव
शिकायत के मुताबिक, 22 नवंबर को उमेश रगड़े (Umesh Ragde) ने फोन कर कारोबारी विजय जेठानी (Vijay Jethani) पर मारपीट की पुरानी रिपोर्ट वापस लेने का दबाव बनाया। कारोबारी ने इस मामले की शिकायत आजाद चौक थाने में की। पुलिस ने शिकायत के आधार पर BNS की धारा 296 और 351(4) के तहत FIR दर्ज की है।
वायरल ऑडियो की जांच, मारपीट मामले में कार्रवाई
मामले से जुड़ा एक ऑडियो भी वायरल हुआ है, जिसकी जांच की जा रही है। वहीं, मारपीट के पुराने मामले में अतुल तलमेल जेल में है, जबकि गोलू रगड़े और उमेश रगड़े फरार बताए जा रहे हैं। पुलिस पूरे मामले की जांच कर रही है।

title: Arun Yadav Controversy: खंडवा में पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री अरुण यादव अधिकारियों पर भड़के, कहा- तुम्हारी माई की तुम्हारी, देखें वीडियो
description: Arun Yadav Controversy: खंडवा में पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री अरुण यादव ने अधिकारियों को मंच से चेतावनी देते हुए तुम्हारी माई की तुम्हारी कह दिया। जावर-उद्धव सिंचाई योजना और विकास कार्यों में लापरवाही को लेकर अरुण यादव ने नाराजगी जताई।
author: Rahul Garhwal
content:
Arun Yadav Controversy: खंडवा में पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री अरुण यादव (Arun Yadav) का विवादित बयान सामने आया है। उन्होंने एक मंच से अधिकारियों को चेतावनी देते हुए कहा, "तुम्हारी माई की तुम्हारी।" जावर-उद्धव सिंचाई योजना और विकास कार्यों में लापरवाही को लेकर अरुण यादव अधिकारियों पर भड़क गए।
'तुम्हारी माई की... तुम्हारी!'
मंच से अफसरों पर भड़के अरुण यादव
'तुम्हारी माई की...', 650 करोड़ की सिंचाई योजना पर अफसरों पर भड़के!
मध्यप्रदेश के खंडवा में जावर-सिहाड़ा उद्वहन सिंचाई योजना को लेकर पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री अरुण यादव का आक्रामक अंदाज सामने आया है। किसानों के विरोध… pic.twitter.com/pSHmnyojYf
— Bansal News Official (@BansalNews_) November 25, 2026
अधिकारियों को मंच से दी चेतावनी
पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री अरुण यादव ने मंच से अधिकारियों को संबोधित करते हुए नाराजगी जाहिर की। इस दौरान उन्होंने विवादित शब्दों का इस्तेमाल करते हुए अधिकारियों को चेतावनी दी। उनका बयान अब चर्चा में है। (Arun Yadav Controversy)
सिंचाई योजना को लेकर जताई नाराजगी
जावर-उद्धव सिंचाई योजना को लेकर अरुण यादव ने नाराजगी जताई। इसके साथ ही विकास कार्यों में हो रही लापरवाही को लेकर भी उन्होंने अधिकारियों को घेरा। अरुण यादव ने अधिकारियों को मंच के पास बुलाया। पूछा कि सरकारी रिकॉर्ड में परियोजना के कई काम पूरे दर्ज हैं। इसके बाद भी किसानों को सिंचाई के लिए पानी क्यों नहीं मिल रहा है ? (MP News)
ये खबर भी पढ़ें: इंदौर में मंडी हटाने को लेकर बवाल, कर्मचारी को थप्पड़ मारने वाली नेता प्रतिपक्ष समित 5 लोग हिरासत में
आखिर पानी कहां जा रहा है ?
पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री अरुण यादव ने पूछा कि जब कागजों में सबकुछ कम्प्लीट लिखा है तो आखिर यह पानी जा कहां रहा है। इसी दौरान गुस्से में उन्होंने तुम्हारी माई की तुम्हारी शब्द का इस्तेमाल किया। अधिकारियों से किसानों के सवालों का जवाब देने को कहा।

title: Bhopal India Alliance Rally: कांग्रेस ने इंडिया गठबंधन की रैली के लिए मांगा लाल परेड ग्राउंड, बोर्ड ऑफिस से होगी पदयात्रा, 12 दिसंबर भोपाल में जुटेंगे नेता
description: Bhopal India Alliance Rally: कांग्रेस ने इंडिया गठबंधन की रैली के लिए मांगा लाल परेड ग्राउंड, बोर्ड ऑफिस से होगी पदयात्रा, 12 दिसंबर भोपाल में जुटेंगे नेता
author: Preeti Dwivedi
content:
Bhopal India Alliance Rally: मध्य प्रदेश  (Madhya Pradesh News)  की राजधानी भोपाल  (Bhopal News) में अगले महीने यानी 12 दिसंबर को INDIA गठबंधन (INDIA Alliance) की प्रस्तावित रैली को लेकर कांग्रेस ने तैयारी तेज कर दी हैं। इसके लिए कांग्रेस ने लाल परेड ग्राउंड में सरकार से रैली के लिए जगह मांगी है। इसके लिए आवेदन दे दिया गया है। आपको बता दें कांग्रेस की बोर्ड ऑफिस चौराहे से लाल परेड ग्राउंड तक मार्च भी निकालने की तैयारी है। 
7 दिसंबर से 13 दिसंबर तक चलते वाले इस कार्यक्रम के लिए कांग्रेस पूरी जोर लगा रही है। 
दिल्ली से बाहर प्रदर्शन की तैयारी
आपको बता दें दिल्ली (Delhi News) के बाहर पहली बार हो रही इंडिया गठबंधन की रैली के बहाने कांग्रेस शक्ति प्रदर्शन (Congress Shakti Pradarshan) करने की भी तैयारी में है। यही कारण है कि पार्टी 12 दिसंबर को भोपाल के बोर्ड ऑफिस चौराहे स्थित डॉ. भीमराव अंबेडकर की प्रतिमा से वोट रक्षा मार्च भी निकालने की तैयारी में है। ये मार्च लाल परेड ग्राउंड तक पहुंचेगा। इतना ही नहीं इसके बाद यहां INDIA गठबंधन की संयुक्त सभा आयोजित किए जाने की तैयारी भी पार्टी की है।
जुटेंगे ये नेता
सूत्रों के अनुसार इंडिया गठबंधन की रैली में कांग्रेस के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे, लोकसभा में नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी (Rahul Gandhi) , प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा (Priyanka Gandhi) और समाजवादी पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव (Akhilesh Yadav) सहित INDIA गठबंधन के कई बड़े नेताओं के शामिल होने की संभावना भी जताई जा रही है। इतना ही नइसमें ममता बनर्जी समेत अन्य विपक्षी नेताओं को भी लेकर चर्चाएं हैं।
दिल्ली के बाद मध्य प्रदेश होगा पहला राज्य
आपको बता दें बीते महीने दिल्ली में SIR और मतदाता सूची से जुड़े मुद्दों पर विरोध प्रदर्शन के बाद ही अब कांग्रेस इस अभियान को आगे बढ़ाते हुए अलग-अलग राज्यों में ले जाने की तैयारी कर रही है।
ऐसे में मध्य प्रदेश (MP) देश का पहला ऐसा राज्य होगा, जहां दिल्ली के बाद INDIA गठबंधन (INDIA Alliance) के बैनर तले वोट रक्षा मार्च का बड़ा आयोजन होने जा रहा है। आपको बता दें मतदाता सूची के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) और वोट से जुड़े मुद्दों को लेकर गठबंधन की ओर से 'वोट रक्षा मार्च' निकाला जाएगा। इसे लेकर ही तैयारियों के लिए कांग्रेस ने लाल परेड ग्राउंड की अनुमति मांगी है।

title: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನಾಗರಿಕ ಸೇವೆಗಳು
description: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದು, ಮಹಾನಗರ ಕೋಟಿ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಹಲವಾರು ಇಲಾಖೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಸೇವೆ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ. ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗುವಂತೆ, ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಹೊಸ ಹಾಗೂ ಹಾಲಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ನಮ್ಮ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಲೇಖನ ಸರಣಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಜನರಿಗೆ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಲ್ಲ ಒಂದು ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪರೋಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳು, ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸಿಗಲಿದೆ.

ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದು, ಮಹಾನಗರ ಕೋಟಿ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಹಲವಾರು ಇಲಾಖೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಸೇವೆ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ. ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗುವಂತೆ, ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಹೊಸ ಹಾಗೂ ಹಾಲಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ "ನಮ್ಮ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು" ಲೇಖನ ಸರಣಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಜನರಿಗೆ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಲ್ಲ ಒಂದು ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪರೋಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳು, ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸಿಗಲಿದೆ.
ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದು, ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಹಲವಾರು ಇಲಾಖೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಸೇವೆ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ. ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗುವಂತೆ, ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಹೊಸ ಹಾಗೂ ಹಾಲಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ "ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಯೋಜನೆ" ಲೇಖನ ಸರಣಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಲೇ ಇದ್ದು, ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಒಂದೂವರೆ ಕೋಟಿಗೆ ಸಮೀಪಿಸಿದೆ. ಇದಲ್ಲದೇ, ನಿತ್ಯ ಇಲ್ಲಿಗೆ 25 ರಿಂದ 30 ಲಕ್ಷ ಮಂದಿ ಬಂದು ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ರಾಜ್ಯ ರಾಜಧಾನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಜನರ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಗೆ ಹತ್ತಾರು ಇಲಾಖೆ, ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರ, ಮಂಡಳಿಗಳಿವೆ. ನೂರಾರು ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತರಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪೈಕಿ ಆಡಳಿತ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಹೊತ್ತ ಬಿಬಿಎಂಪಿ, ಹೊಸ ಬಡಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಬಿಡಿಎ, ಮನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾವೇರಿ ನೀರು ಹರಿಸುವ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಜಲಮಂಡಳಿ, ಬೆಳಕು ಹರಿಸುವ ಬೆಸ್ಕಾಂ, ಸಂಚಾರಿ ಜೀವನಾಡಿಗಳಾದ ಬಿಎಂಟಿಸಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿವೆ. ನಿತ್ಯ ಈ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಜತೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಕೋಟ್ಯಾಂತರ ಜನ ಜನ ಒಂದಲ್ಲ ಒಂದು ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದರೂ, ಇವುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಹಲವರಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತೇ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನಮ್ಮ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಈ ಕುರಿತು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ವಿಷಯ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ "ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಯೋಜನೆ" ಎಂಬ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಲೇಖನಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಜಯಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಲೇಖನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾರಿದ ಹೊಸ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಯೋಜನೆ, ಹಾಲಿ ಜಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಇರಲಿದೆ. ಆ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶ, ಸೌಲಭ್ಯಗಳು, ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಗಳು, ನೋಂದಣಿಯಾಗುವ ವಿಧಾನ, ಸೇವೆ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಹಲವು ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿಕೊಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಶ್ನೋತ್ತರಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಆ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇರುವ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಹಾರ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗೆ ನೀವು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನಿವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಬಿಬಿಎಂಪಿ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಪಾವತಿ ವಿಧಾನಗಳೇನು? ಕಡೆಯ ದಿನ ಯಾವಾಗ? ದಂಡ ಎಷ್ಟು? ಇ ಖಾತಾ ಪಡೆಯುವುದೇಗೆ? ಇ ಖಾತಾ ಹೊಸ ನಿಯಮ ಏನು? ಎಂಬ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಲೇಖನಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಿಬಿಎಂಪಿ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಿ ಇವೆ? ಯಾವ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್‌? ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಸಿಗಲಿದೆ? ಎಂಬ ಸಲಹೆ ಮಾದರಿಯ ಲೇಖನಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಇನ್ನೂ ನೀವು ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಅಥವಾ ಬಿಎಂಟಿಸಿ ಹೊಸ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಆರಂಭ ಯಾವಾಗ? ಎಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಗಳು? ಬಸ್‌ ಅಥವಾ ರೈಲಿನ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಏನು? ಎಂಬ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಲೇಖನಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುತ್ತವೆ. ಒಟ್ಟಾರೆಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳು, ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುವ ಸರಳವಾಗಿ, ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ನೀಡುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ನಮ್ಮದಾಗಿದೆ.

ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ 12 ಸಾವಿರ ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿಅಕ್ರಮ ಒಎಫ್‌ಸಿ ಕೇಬಲ್‌: ತಲೆ ಮೇಲೆ ತೂಗುತ್ತಿರುವ 5 ಲಕ್ಷ ತಂತಿ ತೆರವು ಎಂದು?

ಹೊಸಪೇಟೆ-ಅರಸೀಕೆರೆಗೆ ಡೆಮು ರೈಲು ಸಂಚಾರ ಆರಂಭ: ಮಧ್ಯಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ 5 ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ! ಎಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಚಾರ, ಟೈಮಿಂಗ್ಸ್‌ ಏನು?
ಶತಕದ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಗಭದ್ರಾ ಜಲಾಶಯ, ಡ್ಯಾಂ ಭರ್ತಿಗೆ ಇನ್ನೂ 3 ಅಡಿಯಷ್ಟೇ ಬಾಕಿ: ಒಂದೇ ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಡ್ಯಾಂಗೆ 68 ಟಿಎಂಸಿ ನೀರು!
ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಉಸ್ತುವಾರಿ ಹೊರಗಿನವರಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸರಿ? ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ತಾಲೂಕುಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾಲಿಡದ ಹಿಂದಿದ್ದ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾಉಸ್ತುವಾರಿ ಸಚಿವರು, ಹೊರಗಿನವರಿಂದ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯ ಆರೋಪ
ಜಮೀರ್ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದ್ದ ಧ್ವಜಾರೋಹಣ ನೆರವೇರಿಸಿದ ಸಚಿವ ಕೆ.ಎಸ್‌. ಬಸವಂತಪ್ಪ: "ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಉಸ್ತುವಾರಿ ಪೂರ್ವಜನ್ಮದ ಪುಣ್ಯ" ಎಂದು ವಿವಾದಕ್ಕೆ ತೆರೆ ಎಳೆಯಲು ಯತ್ನ
ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಮೈತ್ರಿಕೂಟ ರ‍್ಯಾಲಿ, ಬಿಜೆಪಿ ಪ್ರತಿಭಟನೆ ಮತ್ತು 10 ಸಾವಿರ ಪೊಲೀಸರು: ಹೀಗಿದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ದಿಲ್ಲಿ ಗಲ್ಲಿಗಳ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ
`ಪಟಾಕಿ ಬಳಕೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿರಾಟ್ ಕೊಹ್ಲಿಯಿಂದ ಜಾಗೃತಿ ಮೂಡಿಸಿ': ದಿಲ್ಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೀಪಾವಳಿ ಆಚರಣೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೇನು?
ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಪಾನ್ ಮಾದರಿ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ಪ್ಲಾನ್‌ ಹೇಳಿದ ಡಿಕೆ ಶಿವಕುಮಾರ್; 'ನೆನೆಸಿಕೊಂಡ್ರೆ ಭಯವಾಗುತ್ತೆ' ಎಂದ ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ ಸೂರ್ಯ
ನ.28-ನ.30ರವರೆಗೆ ಮಲ್ಲೇಶ್ವರ ಕಡಲೆಕಾಯಿ ಪರಿಷೆ: ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್‌ ಮುಕ್ತ ಪರಿಷೆಗೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಶೇಷತೆ?
ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ 12 ಸಾವಿರ ಕಿ.ಮೀ. ಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿಅಕ್ರಮ ಒಎಫ್‌ಸಿ ಕೇಬಲ್‌: ತಲೆ ಮೇಲೆ ತೂಗುತ್ತಿರುವ 5 ಲಕ್ಷ ತಂತಿ ತೆರವು ಎಂದು?
ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಹಣಕಾಸು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಶೇ 200ರಷ್ಟು ಅಧಿಕ: ದರ ಏರಿಕೆ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಬಿಎಂಆರ್‌ಸಿಎಲ್‌, ಎಷ್ಟಾಗಲಿದೆ ಟಿಕೆಟ್‌ ರೇಟ್‌?
ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಸೈಬರ್‌ ದರೋಡೆ: 30 ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಪನಿ ಖಾತೆಯಿಂದ 42 ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂ. ಕಳವು, 11 IMPS ವಹಿವಾಟು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಿದ್ದೇಗೆ?
ದಿಲ್ಲಿ-ಚೆನ್ನೈ ವಿಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ `ಪವರ್‌ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌' ದೋಷದಿಂದ ಬೆಂಕಿ! ಹೈದರಾಬಾದ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ತುರ್ತು ಲ್ಯಾಂಡಿಂಗ್; ಘಟನೆ ನಡೆದದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ?
ಹನಿ ನೀರಿಲ್ಲದ ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಣೇಶ ಮೂರ್ತಿಯನ್ನ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಹೋದ ಭಕ್ತರು! ಸಂಜೆಯೇ ಅಬ್ಬರದ ಮಳೆ - ಆಂಧ್ರದ ಚಿತ್ರಾವತಿಯಲ್ಲೊಂದು ವಿಸ್ಮಯ

title: Blood Test Before Buying Alcohol? Madhya Pradesh's Unusual Campaign After Liquor Deaths
description: As part of the initiative, medical teams have been visiting different tehsils, where doctors set up tables outside liquor shops to examine customers.
author: Ritu Singh
content:
In an unusual health awareness initiative, doctors and health workers in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar district have started conducting medical check-ups outside liquor shops to assess the health of people who come to buy alcohol. The campaign, being jointly conducted by the health department, excise department and police, aims to identify potential health risks among regular drinkers and encourage them to reduce alcohol consumption. As part of the initiative, medical teams have been visiting different tehsils, where doctors set up tables outside liquor shops to examine customers.
Health workers interact with people arriving to purchase alcohol, ask them about their drinking habits and collect information about their medical history. Doctors also conduct basic health examinations, while blood samples are collected from some individuals to assess their health conditions.
Following more than 20 deaths linked to adulterated liquor, medical teams in Madhya Pradesh are checking the blood pressure of individuals outside liquor shops and collecting samples for liver and kidney function tests. Ironically, this is happening while government hospitals in Madhya Pradesh are in a dire state and facing a shortage of doctors.
— Shruti Dhore (@ShrutiDhore) November 25, 2026
Videos showing doctors with stethoscopes and medical screening equipment stationed outside liquor shops have attracted attention on social media. While some users have welcomed the initiative, saying it could help reach people who may otherwise avoid medical check-ups, others have questioned whether customers arriving to purchase alcohol would be receptive to health advice at such locations.
🚨 DOCTORS SET UP HEALTH CHECKUP CAMP OUTSIDE LIQUOR SHOP IN MADHYA PRADESH In an unusual initiative, government doctors and health officials set up a medical camp outside a liquor shop in Bina, Sagar district. Customers were offered health screenings, including blood pressure and sugar tests along with liver and kidney-related tests. The initiative aims to raise awareness about the health risks of alcohol consumption and encourage people to quit drinking. The check-ups are voluntary not mandatory for purchasing alcohol. 🎥 Video Shared Online #MadhyaPradesh #Sagar #HealthAwareness
— contentkikamii (@contentkikamii) November 24, 2026
The campaign comes amid concerns over alcohol-related deaths in Sagar district. In September, a suspected spurious liquor tragedy in the district claimed more than 20 lives, triggering scrutiny of illegal liquor sales and enforcement measures. Post-mortem reports in the Banda cases reportedly indicated that some of the deceased had pre-existing health conditions. Following these findings, the administration decided to focus on the health risks faced by people who consume alcohol regularly.
Apart from conducting health checks, medical teams are also educating people about the risks associated with excessive alcohol consumption.
Officials are providing medicines and multivitamins wherever required and counselling people on ways to reduce their alcohol intake. They are also advising people against drinking on an empty stomach and consuming alcohol from bottles that have already been opened.
The teams are further urging customers to purchase alcohol only from licensed government outlets to avoid the risks associated with unauthorised liquor. On Monday, the joint team conducted health check-ups of 97 individuals across Sagar city, Deori, Rahli, Bina and Khurai, providing medical counselling and advice, an official said.
(With Inputs from Honey Dubey)

title: Cabinet Clears Rs 2,014-Crore Greenfield Airport In Assam's Silchar
description: Doloo, situated in the Cachar District of Assam, serves as the strategic heart of the Barak Valley - a region renowned for its extensive tea gardens, agro-based industries, and immense potential for eco and cultural tourism.
author: Indo Asian News Service
content:
The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, on Wednesday approved the development of a new greenfield airport at Doloo in Silchar, Assam, by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) at an estimated cost of Rs 2,014 crore.
The project aims to overcome the severe operational and spatial constraints of the existing defence landlocked civil enclave at Silchar Airport and to accommodate sustained passenger growth, according to an official statement.
Doloo, situated in the Cachar District of Assam, serves as the strategic heart of the Barak Valley - a region renowned for its extensive tea gardens, agro-based industries, and immense potential for eco and cultural tourism.
The proposed Terminal Building will span a total area of 12,351 sqm with a capacity to handle 800 passengers during peak hours, designed with modern passenger amenities, sustainable green building principles, and modular expansion capability. In addition, the project encompasses the development of a 2,705m x 45m, Code-4C compliant runway suitable for A-320 aircraft operations, along with the construction of a new apron capable of parking six A-320 aircraft and a dedicated isolation bay, the statement said.
As a project of immense strategic significance, the Doloo Greenfield Airport will meet the rapidly growing demands of air traffic in South Assam and adjoining areas of neighbouring states. It will significantly decongest existing infrastructure, unlock regional economic potential by boosting trade and tourism, and offer a world-class gateway integrating Northeast India with broader national and international growth corridors, the statement added.
The government is expanding and upgrading several airports across the country's North-East under initiatives like the Regional Connectivity Scheme (UDAN) to boost passenger and cargo connectivity.
The airports and heliports that have been identified for development and operation of RCS flights in the North-East states under the UDAN scheme include Pasighat, Tezu, Hollongi, Jorhat, Lilabari, Rupsi, Tezpur, Dimapur, Shillong and Pakyong. Under the UDAN scheme, 90 routes have been operationalised.

title: Kashi Tamil Sangamam to take Thirukkural to 1,000 campuses, offer Rs 10,000 stipend
description: NEW DELHI: From university campuses to railway stations, airports and highway toll plazas, the Centre is taking the teachings of Thirukkural, the
author: Manash Pratim Gohain
content:
NEW DELHI: From university campuses to railway stations, airports and highway toll plazas, the Centre is taking the teachings of Thirukkural, the classical Tamil literary work on ethics and conduct, to a nationwide audience. The fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam, scheduled from November 28 to December 12, will involve 1,000 higher education institutions, with eligible students receiving a stipend of Rs 10,000 for undertaking research on the text.Moving beyond cultural exchanges between Tamil Nadu and Varanasi, the education ministry’s initiative will see each participating institution nominate one student on merit. Selected students will undergo online academic orientation in any of the 22 scheduled languages or English, followed by a month-long research engagement.Under faculty supervision, students will prepare a four-to-10-page article or research note and make an hour-long presentation at their institution.Authored by Thiruvalluvar, the Thirukkural comprises 1,330 couplets covering virtue, wealth and love. The Central Institute of Classical Tamil has translated it into 25 Indian languages, including all 22 constitutionally scheduled languages, besides several foreign languages and Braille.
While 50 teachers from Tamil Nadu will teach the text in schools and colleges across Uttar Pradesh, selected couplets and their translations are proposed to be displayed at railway stations, airports and highway toll plazas. Animated videos, short films and audiobooks will complement the multilingual outreach.Launched in 2022 to strengthen cultural and civilisational ties between Tamil Nadu and Kashi, the Sangamam will this year bring around 1,400 delegates in seven groups to Varanasi, Prayagraj and Ayodhya.Last year’s edition focused on teaching Tamil, reaching over 1,500 students across 50 schools.
Manash Pratim Gohain is a seasoned journalist with over two decades at The Times of India, where he has built a rich body of work spanning education policy, politics, and governance. Renowned for his incisive coverage of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, accreditation reforms, and skilling initiatives, he has also reported on student politics, urban policy, and social movements. His political reportage—both reflective and news-driven—adds depth to his writing, bridging policy with public impact. Through his 2,500 articles and related outlets, he has emerged as a trusted voice in national discourse, particularly in linking education reform to broader societal change.

title: 'Voluntary return plan separate from Bangladesh extradition request': India on Sheikh Hasina
description: NEW DELHI: Ahead of Sheikh Hasina's planned return to Bangladesh on December 16, India on Wednesday described the matter as \"separate\" from Dhaka's
author: Karan Manral
content:
Sheikh Hasina has been living in New Delhi since fleeing Bangladesh on August 5, 2024 (File photo)
NEW DELHI: Ahead of Sheikh Hasina's planned return to Bangladesh on December 16, India on Wednesday described the matter as "separate" from Dhaka's request to extradite the former prime minister."The case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily to her country on a travel document is a matter separate from an extradition request," ministry of external affairs (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal told reporters at a press conference in New Delhi.Jaiswal reiterated that Bangladesh's extradition request for Sheikh Hasina was being examined in accordance with established procedures."The extradition request, as I've said earlier, is being examined in line with our established processes," he added.The MEA's statement came a day after Sheikh Hasina's spokesperson announced that she would return to Bangladesh on December 16, when the country celebrates its victory over Pakistan in the 1971 Liberation War.Sheikh Hasina had also requested the Bangladesh government, now led by Tarique Rahman, son of her long-time political rival Khaleda Zia, to issue the necessary travel documents. However, the request was turned down.
The former prime minister has been living in India since fleeing Bangladesh on August 5, 2024, following a student-led uprising that brought down her 15-year government. In November 2025, she was sentenced to death in absentia for crimes against humanity over the crackdown on protesters in 2024.
She has rejected the charges and expressed her intention to return to Bangladesh and surrender before a court.In July, ahead of the second anniversary of her resignation, Sheikh Hasina had, for the first time, announced a specific timeline for her return to Bangladesh, saying she planned to return in December.Bangladesh has been seeking her extradition from India, while New Delhi has maintained that Dhaka's request is being examined through established legal processes. The issue has become a source of tension between the two countries, with Dhaka insisting that Hasina be handed over under the bilateral extradition treaty.(With PTI inputs)
Karan Manral is a journalist at the Times of India. He covers politics, social issues, and international affairs, exploring stories that affect people’s everyday lives. He also writes explainers to make these stories easier for readers to follow.

title: 'Congress wants regime change through violence, not votes': Rajnath Singh's big charge
description: NEW DELHI: Defence minister Rajnath Singh on Wednesday launched a broadside against Congress, accusing it of inciting anarchy through its \"regime change\"
author: Rohitashwa Ranjan
content:
NEW DELHI: Defence minister Rajnath Singh on Wednesday launched a broadside against Congress, accusing it of inciting anarchy through its "regime change" plan.During a speech in Karnataka's Kalaburagi, Rajnath warned leader of opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi that India's democracy could not be weakened by his party creating ruckus on the streets."Now, when all their tactics have failed, the Congress party and several of their allies say, 'Modi is not going to leave like this; now there must be a regime change here.' By spreading anarchy, spreading unrest, and inciting bloodshed, they want to change the government here," the defence minister said."Regime change has happened in this manner in many of our neighbouring countries; do they want to form a government here by creating similar anarchy?" he asked.Noting that politics should not be a means to capture power but a means to build the nation, he alleged: "The Congress wants regime change through violence and anarchy, not through votes. I want to tell Rahul Gandhi clearly that Indian democracy is not so weak that regime change can happen through anarchy on the streets."
Rajnath also said that a change of power in the country could happen "strictly through votes"."Forget the fantasy of regime change that you have imagined by spreading anarchy on the streets," Rajnath said.
"Power in Hindustan can never be changed by spreading anarchy; if a change of power ever happens, it will happen solely and strictly through votes," he added.During his address, Rajnath also said that Rahul Gandhi was unable to digest the fact that Congress was being rejected everywhere in the country.
Rohitashwa Ranjan is a digital journalist with The Times of India, where he decodes Indian politics as a carefully staged production with scripts, subtext and everything behind. His stories track elections, party dynamics and the things that often are buried beneath the headlines. When not parsing vote shares or alliances, he is usually reading between the lines, where the real story tends to reside.

title: Chittoor expands dialysis facilities, but access remains a hurdle
description: Chittoor targets 20% yearly dialysis bed growth under PM National Dialysis Programme, expanding access amid transport and wage challenges for rural patients.
author: K. Umashanker
content:
For hundreds of kidney patients in Chittoor district, dialysis is not merely a medical procedure but a relentless struggle to stay alive. While government-supported dialysis facilities have brought relief to economically disadvantaged families, access to regular treatment remains a challenge for patients from remote villages. Long distances, transportation costs and loss of daily wages add to their hardship.
Chittoor district has five dialysis centres operating round the clock at government hospitals in Chittoor, Bangarupalem, Palamaner and Kuppam, and PES Medical College Hospital in Kuppam. Together, these centres registered around 200 new patients between 2022 and 2025.
A 40-year-old patient from Kuppam, who works as a security guard in Bengaluru, said travelling to a dialysis centre often meant losing an entire day’s earnings.
“I often depend on relatives for transportation and assistance. Elderly patients and those weakened by prolonged illness face even greater difficulties in travelling to the centres. Missing a scheduled session due to financial or transportation constraints can have serious health consequences. Fortunately, we have two centres in Kuppam,” he said.
District Collector Sumit Kumar told *The Hindu* that Chittoor district currently had five dialysis centres providing round-the-clock services under the Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme, funded by the Union government.
“The government has recently established dialysis centres in Bangarupalem and Kuppam. Our action plan is to increase the number of beds by 20% at each centre every year. With sustained efforts, we hope to achieve the annual targets,” he said.
He added that financial assistance provided to patients had been particularly helpful to those from rural areas, enabling them to meet their regular expenses.
Published - November 25, 2026 06:37 pm IST

title: KCCI seeks early completion of 24x7 water supply project in Hubballi-Dharwad
description: KCCI urges fast-tracking Hubballi-Dharwad 24x7 water project, highlighting delays in 40 wards and outlining remaining works to ensure continuous supply.
author: The Hindu Bureau
content:
The Karnatak Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) has urged the State government to expedite the pending works under the Hubballi-Dharwad 24x7 drinking water supply project, while pointing out that residents of 40 wards continue to receive water at intervals ranging from two to six days.
In a representation to Urban Development Minister Yatindra Siddaramaiah, KCCI president Sandeep Bidasaria has called for time-bound completion of the project, which was initiated in 2003-04.
Though more than two decades have passed since the project was launched, uninterrupted water supply has not been extended to all parts of the twin cities.
According to KCCI, Hubballi-Dharwad has 1.86 lakh water connections across 82 wards. Of these, 17,120 connections in 13 demonstration zones receive 24-hour water supply, while 44,769 connections in 29 wards receive water on a daily basis.
The remaining 40 wards continue to face irregular supply. Water is supplied once every two to four days in 22 wards and once every five to six days in 18 wards.
The target is to provide 1.20 lakh household connections in these 40 wards. Of these, works on 64,240 connections, or 53.27%, have been completed, the KCCI said.
Of the proposed 1,688-km distribution network, 1,327 km (78.61%) has been laid. Work on the 29.7-km raw water pipeline from the Saundatti Jackwell to Amminabhavi has been completed, while 74.20 km of the 75.40-km treated water pipeline between Amminabhavi and Rayapur is ready.
Work on the 43 million litres per day water treatment plant and all 22 overhead and ground-level storage tanks have also been completed, according to the chamber.
With the project deadline extended to June 2027, the KCCI has called for expediting the remaining infrastructure work, including providing household connections. It has also sought measures to address pipeline defects, repair roads damaged during the works and review progress ward-wise.
The chamber said that uninterrupted drinking water supply is essential in view of the growing population, urbanisation and industrial development in the twin cities. It urged the State government, elected representatives and officials to ensure that the project is completed without further delay.
Published - November 25, 2026 06:35 pm IST

title: Railways put in place extensive arrangements for Sabarimala pilgrimage; 204 train services notified
description: Southern Railway gears up for Mandala–Makaravilakku 2026–27 with 204 Sabarimala special trains and enhanced pilgrim facilities at key stations.
author: The Hindu Bureau
content:
Southern Railway has put in place extensive arrangements to ensure safe, comfortable and hassle-free travel for pilgrims during the Mandala–Makaravilakku pilgrimage season 2026–27. Since the season commenced on November 16, 2026, a series of measures has been implemented across railway stations, especially the major stations that serve as transit points for devotees travelling to Sabarimala.
Southern Railway has put in place extensive arrangements to meet the increased passenger demand during the Mandala–Makaravilakku pilgrimage season 2026–27 in coordination with other railway zones, by introducing a record number of special train services, to facilitate the travel of Sabarimala-bound pilgrims from different parts of the country.
As on November 23, a total of 204 trips of Sabarimala special trains have been notified, covering inter-zonal and intra-zonal services with the majority of services operating between Chennai – Kollam, Thiruvananthapuram–Mangaluru, Panvel–Kottayam, Visakhapatnam–Kollam, Hyderabad–Kollam and Vijayawada–Kottayam. Further services will be planned based on passenger demand and reservation trends, said the railways in a statement here on Wednesday.
Pilgrim facilities at key transit stations
Kottayam, Chengannur, Ernakulam Junction and Ernakulam Town are the key transit stations for Sabarimala pilgrims, where special arrangements have been made for accommodation, rest, catering, sanitation and onward transportation. A three-storeyed pilgrim facilitation centre near the main entrance of Kottayam station is fully operational and can accommodate up to 900 pilgrims at a time.
In Chengannur, three spacious pilgrim shelters can accommodate up to 600 passengers. Since Ernakulam Junction is an important transit point for pilgrims from different parts of the country, AC waiting halls, catering facilities and cloakroom services are available although station redevelopment works are underway. Temporary prefabricated pay-and-use toilets have also been provided at the station for the benefit of Sabarimala pilgrims.
Pilgrim assistance booths, manned by Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel, function round the clock at Chengannur and Kottayam to guide and assist devotees. Additional unreserved ticket counters and reservation facilities have been opened at Chengannur and Kottayam, also functioning round the clock, to handle the heavy demand for tickets.
Southern Railway is working closely with the State Revenue department, Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC), Travancore Devaswom Board, Police and Medical departments for the smooth movement and welfare of pilgrims. Security has also been strengthened at important stations and on trains to ensure the safety of pilgrims throughout their journey.
Round-the-clock monitoring by railway officials
Railway officials from various departments are closely monitoring special train operations, passenger amenities, station management and crowd movement throughout the season. A dedicated task force will be deployed on Makaravilakku Day at Chengannur, Ernakulam Junction and Kottayam stations to coordinate passenger movement, monitor special train operations and ensure the smooth functioning of the additional booking counters and other facilities.
Published - November 25, 2026 06:35 pm IST

title: Saurav Das was advised not to use passport until he clarifies birthplace: Govt
description: The ministry039s statement came after Das alleged that he was stopped at Delhi airport on Monday before he could board a 1 am flight to London
author: India Today News Desk
content:
Saurav Das was advised not to use passport until he clarifies birthplace: Govt
The ministry's statement came after Das alleged that he was stopped at Delhi airport on Monday before he could board a 1 am flight to London.
The Regional Passport Office in Chennai has asked Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convener Saurav Das to clarify his place of birth within seven days and advised him against using his passport until he responds, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said on Wednesday.
Jaiswal said the passport office issued the show-cause notice on November 23 after receiving reports from law enforcement authorities. He said the notice gives Das an opportunity to explain the discrepancy flagged in the birthplace information he provided. Jaiswal did not specify what the discrepancy was.
The ministry’s statement came after Das alleged that he was stopped at Delhi airport on Monday before he could board a 1 am flight to London. He told PTI that immigration officials informed him his passport had been flagged.
DELHI HIGH COURT TO HEAR DAS’S PLEA ON THURSDAY
Das moved the Delhi High Court on Wednesday over the airport incident. His counsel sought an urgent hearing before a bench of Acting Chief Justice Nitin Wasudeo Sambre and Justice Sanjay Sharma. The bench said it would list the plea for Thursday.
His counsel told the court that immigration officials had shown Das no order barring him from travelling. He said Das could still make it to the UK on November 27.
Das told PTI that the Oxford University Students’ Union had invited him to speak about the “cockroach movement” at a panel discussion. In a post on X, he blamed the Modi government for stopping him from travelling and said he had also been invited to speak at Cambridge, the London School of Economics and the University of Edinburgh.
Das added that the incident would not deter him from continuing his work or travelling abroad.

title: Dumper brakes suddenly on Rajasthan highway, car rams into it killing 3
description: The victims were returning to their village after attending a wedding when the speeding dumper stopped abruptly on the highway leading to a fatal crash 3 were killed and 2 are seriously injured
author: India Today News Desk
content:
Dumper brakes suddenly on Rajasthan highway, car rams into it killing 3
The victims were returning to their village after attending a wedding when the speeding dumper stopped abruptly on the highway, leading to a fatal crash. 3 were killed and 2 are seriously injured.
Three men were killed, and two others seriously injured after their car rammed into a dumper truck on the Jaipur-Delhi National Highway 48 in Rajasthan, early Wednesday morning.
The accident occurred around 1.30 am when the five men were returning to Bhundanwada Kalan village after attending a wedding in Bhagwadi village. The car rammed into a dumper that had stopped abruptly in the middle of the highway without giving any indication through brake lights or indicators.
The collision was so severe that the car was badly damaged, leaving three occupants dead and two seriously injured.
TWO DIED BEFORE REACHING HOSPITAL. THIRD SUCCUMBED LATER
The five occupants of the car were Devendra Kumar, Hemant Kumar, Harish Kumar, Harsh Kumar and Sahil Kumar. They were returning to Bhundanwada Kalan village after attending the wedding of their cousins.
After the accident, police rushed to the spot after receiving information about the accident and took the injured to Park Hospital in Behror. Doctors declared Devendra Kumar and Hemant Kumar dead on arrival.
Harish Kumar, who was driving the car, was shifted to a government hospital in Alwar for treatment, where he later succumbed to his injuries.
The two other injured men, Harsh Kumar and Sahil Kumar, were admitted to NIMS Hospital and Satish Hospital, respectively. Both are reported to be in serious condition.
According to the police, the dumper driver stopped the vehicle abruptly in the middle of the road while descending near Dahmi culvert, without switching on the brake lights or giving an indicator. The car, approaching from behind, crashed into the dumper.
The complainant has alleged that the dumper driver's negligence led to the accident.
DUMPER SEIZED, POLICE PROBE ON
Police have seized the dumper, bearing registration number HR 30 AM 6716, and parked it at a designated parking facility. Necessary action is also being taken regarding the damaged car, bearing registration number HR 35Q 7012.
The police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the accident. A complaint has been filed seeking legal action and post-mortem examinations of the deceased.

title: One year since labour reforms introduced, only 3 states notify, enforce rules
description: The labour codes consolidate labour regulations and expand social security, particularly for unorganised sector workers. | India News
author: Pallavi Singhal
content:
Pallavi Singhal covers agriculture, food policy and the rural economy from New Delhi. Over the past four years, she has reported extensively on farm policy, food inflation, procurement, agri-markets and rural livelihoods. Before joining Hindustan Times, she worked at Moneycontrol and Informist. A journalism post-graduate, she started as a trainee reporter in 2019 with The Indian Express, Chandigarh. Away from the newsroom, she enjoys travelling and crime fiction—preferably mysteries easier to crack than government policy.
One year since labour reforms introduced, only 3 states notify, enforce rules
The labour codes consolidate labour regulations and expand social security, particularly for unorganised sector workers.
Only three states — Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar — have notified and implemented rules under all four labour codes, a year after the Centre brought the reforms into effect. The Centre has also notified and implemented its rules.
Andhra Pradesh and Arunachal Pradesh, and the Union territories of Ladakh and Lakshadweep, have notified the rules but are yet to implement them. Chhattisgarh, Goa, Maharashtra, Mizoram, Punjab and Rajasthan have notified rules under only some of the codes, according to the latest state-wise status, said Mahesh Krishnamoorthy, MD of Coreintegra, a labour law compliance services provider listed on the National Stock Exchange.
The four labour codes — on wages, industrial relations, social security, and occupational safety and working conditions — came into effect on November 21, 2025, replacing 29 central labour laws.
ALSO READ | From pay to leave: How India’s new labour laws impact you | 7 key takeaways
A working paper by the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER), published in April 2026, said the delay reflected differences in administrative processes, consultation mechanisms and policy priorities across states. The paper, “Pathways to Jobs: A Review of India’s Labour Reforms”, said the effectiveness of the codes would depend on how states frame their rules, given differences in labour-market conditions, cost of living, institutional capacity and the size of businesses in their jurisdictions. Strengthening the capacity of state governments would be critical to avoid uneven implementation, it said.
“The States took their own time to prepare the draft rules, and the same pace seems to continue for the implementation as well,” said Krishnamoorthy. He said the delay was significant because the codes were intended to standardise definitions, applicability and compliance procedures that previously varied from state to state. Employers operating across states therefore continue to face different compliance requirements.
At a regional conference in Goa on January 7, 2026, the Union labour ministry asked states to notify their rules after consulting their law departments, and to identify gaps and differences in the provisions they had framed. The ministry also flagged the need to integrate state systems with the Centre’s Shram Suvidha and Samadhan portals, address overlaps between the codes and state Shops and Establishments Acts, and set up the boards, funds and other institutional mechanisms the codes envisage.
ALSO READ | 1998 murder: 3-year-jail to former Rajya Sabha MP, 2 others
The codes seek to consolidate labour regulations and expand social security coverage, particularly for workers in the unorganised sector. They also change how wages are calculated for statutory benefits. Under the revised definition, basic pay, dearness allowance and retaining allowance must make up at least 50% of an employee’s remuneration for statutory calculations. This can increase employers’ provident fund and gratuity liabilities, while reducing take-home pay for employees whose salary structures are adjusted.
Krishnamoorthy said that because the codes focus on labour welfare and social security, the deductions would come largely from workers’ pay. Employees might initially see lower take-home salaries, but higher social security benefits could help them in the long term, he said.
The Social Security Code also formally recognises gig and platform workers and provides for contributions from aggregators towards their social security. The extent of benefits available to these workers, however, will depend on how the schemes and contribution mechanisms are operationalised.
ALSO READ | Ankita Bhandari case: Ex-MLA to undergo narco test in Gujarat
The Industrial Relations Code has drawn criticism from employee organisations over provisions on retrenchment and trade union recognition. Dr Manjeet Singh Patel, national president of the All India NPS Employees Federation, said raising the threshold for prior government approval for layoffs, retrenchment and closure from 100 to 300 workers could weaken workers’ ability to challenge employers’ decisions. He argued that a large number of establishments employ fewer than 300 workers and would fall outside the requirement, making it easier for employers to dismiss workers and weakening collective bargaining.
Patel questioned the requirement that a trade union have the support of at least 51% of workers to be recognised as the sole negotiating union. If no union meets this threshold, the code provides for a negotiating council, with representation for unions that have at least 20% support. Securing the required majority could be difficult in establishments with multiple unions, he said, and a negotiating council might not have the same bargaining strength as a recognised union.
He said states with higher existing minimum wage rates could find it difficult to align them with the national framework, and states with weaker revenue bases could struggle to implement the provisions fully.
The government should have held wider consultations with major trade union organisations before bringing the codes into force, he added.
Krishnamoorthy said the codes would not directly improve job security, but would bring greater clarity on working conditions and extend social security coverage, especially among unorganised workers. “The new labour codes are definitely a major step towards transforming, simplifying and digitalising workforce regulations, but implementation could be expedited,” he said.

title: Indian Navy ships, helicopters deployed to search for 7 fishermen missing off Andhra coast: Officials
description: The seven fishermen from Kakinada’s Subbampeta village were last sighted near Odisha’s Paradip Port on November 18 after losing contact with their families. | India News
author: Srinivasa Rao Apparasu
content:
Srinivasa Rao is Senior Assistant Editor based out of Hyderabad covering developments in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana . He has over three decades of reporting experience.
Indian Navy ships, helicopters deployed to search for 7 fishermen missing off Andhra coast: Officials
The seven fishermen from Kakinada’s Subbampeta village were last sighted near Odisha’s Paradip Port on November 18 after losing contact with their families.
Indian Navy ships and helicopters have been deployed as the search continues for seven fishermen from Andhra Pradesh’s Kakinada district who went missing in the Bay of Bengal amid cyclonic conditions, officials said on Wednesday. The fishermen were last sighted near Odisha’s Paradip Port on November 18.
Kakinada district collector M N Harendhira Prasad said the Indian Coast Guard and the Indian Navy had launched a joint search operation to trace the seven fishermen from Subbampeta village in Uppada mandal.
The missing fishermen have been identified as D Simhadri, the boat owner, Kodanda Rao, Gampala Prakash, Tirri Narayana, Korada Chinna, Merugu Narayana and Kandala Ramu. They set out on a fishing expedition from Subbampeta on November 4.
According to officials, they reached Visakhapatnam harbour on November 11 and informed their families that they would venture further into the sea for fishing. On November 14, Simhadri called his wife and said they had been caught in turbulent waters amid cyclonic conditions. Communication with their families and officials was subsequently lost.
The district administration received information about the missing fishermen from their families on November 19, following which it alerted the Coast Guard and began coordinating with the concerned agencies to trace them, the collector said.
Preliminary information received through the Coast Guard’s toll-free helpline suggested that the fishermen were last sighted near Paradip Port in Odisha on November 18. “However, no further communication could be established with them either through mobile phones or the vessel’s transponder,” Prasad said.
Following the alert, Coast Guard officials in Kakinada intensified search operations and contacted their counterparts in Odisha and Chennai to coordinate efforts across the maritime region.
The Coast Guard and Navy are jointly using Navy ships and helicopters to search for the missing fishermen. Information about the vessel and its crew has also been shared with naval authorities in Bangladesh and Myanmar, given the possibility that it may have drifted towards waters near those countries.
The agencies are gathering further information about the fishermen and their last known movements. Surveillance and communication systems are also being deployed to establish their whereabouts, the collector said.
State agriculture and fisheries minister Kinjarapu Atchannaidu said the state government was closely monitoring the incident and making every effort to rescue the missing fishermen.
He said the state government had written to the Centre seeking assistance and requesting all necessary support to trace the seven men.
In a separate incident, seven other fishermen who went missing off the Uppada-Tuni coast after their boat developed an engine problem on Monday were rescued and brought safely to Kakinada Fishing Harbour.
Atchannaidu said the mechanised fishing boat developed a technical fault on the night of November 23 and became stranded near Krishnapuram along the Uppada-Tuni coastline.
“The boat was approximately three kilometres from the shore when its driver, Dammu Apparao, alerted the authorities about the situation. The driver and six other fishermen aboard the vessel were subsequently brought back safely to Kakinada Fishing Harbour,” he said.
The minister praised officials for responding promptly to the emergency call. He said the Vakallapudi inspector alerted the Coast Guard and Navy and coordinated with the Fisheries department without delay, despite the incident occurring around midnight.

content:

‘He was issued notice over birthplace query’: MEA on Saurav Das’s passport amid UK travel row
Das had alleged that the government issued a show-cause notice over alleged discrepancies in his passport details to prevent him from travelling to the UK.
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) on Wednesday said that a show-cause notice had been issued to Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das over an alleged discrepancy in his passport application regarding the information about his place of birth, after the latter alleged that the government had barred him from flying to the UK.
Das said on Monday that he was stopped from travelling to London to deliver a lecture at Oxford Union, calling it an attempt to harass him and intimidate the youth. He accused the BJP-led Central government of sending a show-cause notice over alleged discrepancies in his passport to prevent his trip.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai issued a show-cause notice to Das on November 23, requesting a clarification within seven days regarding his place of birth.
"The passport application process requires the applicant to provide accurate information. If, at any stage, a discrepancy is noted or reported by the authorities, amounting to a suppression of facts, we issue a show-cause notice to the applicant, allowing them to present their side of the matter," he said at a press briefing.
Also Read | CJP launches ‘Cockroach Club’ to give young people a place to think, learn and laugh
Deep Dive
Das told not to use passport for 7 days
Jaiswal said that issuing a show-cause notice to Das was in line with the "established procedure" when a shortcoming or discrepancy is identified in the passport application form.
"Based on reports that we received from the relevant law enforcement authorities, the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai issued a show-cause notice to Saurav Das on November 23, requesting a clarification within seven days regarding his place of birth. He was also advised not to use the passport until he had submitted his response," Jaiswal said.
The show-cause notice asked Das to explain the inconsistencies in the details provided in his passport application form in relation to the information they had originally provided.
Also Read | Abhijeet Dipke questions govt over CJP’s Saurav Das being stopped from travelling abroad
Saurav Das moves Delhi HC
This came after Das approached the Delhi high court, challenging the decision to prevent him from travelling to London. The CJP leader said the action was aimed at preventing him from addressing students at foreign universities.
The matter was mentioned before Acting Chief Justice Nitin Sambre and Justice Sanjay Sharma on Wednesday. The plea, filed through advocate Krishnaraj Bapat, will be argued by senior advocate Akhil Sibal on Thursday.
Das said he was on his way to the UK to deliver a lecture about the 'Cockroach movement' at the University of Oxford, Cambridge University, the London School of Economics and the University of Edinburgh. He claimed that the show-cause notice was issued just five hours before his flight, and immigration officials stopped him and asked him to check his email.
"These discrepancies you are now referring to— about my place of birth and other matters— are being raised only because I am associated with the CJP movement. Because I am a CJP leader, you are targeting me and questioning my nationality and place of birth," he said.

content:
Pahalgam Tourism Surges To 20,000 Daily Visitors; Radisson Blu Upgrade Signals Long-Term Confidence In Valley | Exclusive
Senior government sources noted that sustaining this momentum will depend on converting short-term footfall surges into longer stays and higher per-capita spending
Got Question about the News?
Pahalgam is firmly stepping out of the shadow of the April 2025 terror attack, with tourism recording a decisive recovery as traveller confidence returns to the Kashmir Valley. Daily tourist footfall in the resort town has climbed to 20,000 on peak days this year—surpassing pre-attack benchmarks and signalling a strong revival in domestic travel appetite.
Around the time of the April 2025 attack, daily arrivals in Pahalgam averaged roughly 16,000 before plunging to near zero in the immediate aftermath and remaining muted through much of the following year. The sharp rebound to 20,000 visitors a day marks a significant turnaround for the local economy, which relies heavily on seasonal hospitality, transport, and allied services.

Reflecting renewed investor and operator optimism in the region’s prospects, the Grand Mumtaz Group has upgraded its hospitality portfolio, elevating one of its Radisson properties to the upper-upscale Radisson Blu brand. Industry observers view such brand upgrades as a clear indicator that major hospitality players are betting on sustained long-term demand rather than short-lived seasonal spikes.
Mushtaq Ahmad Chaya, Chairman of the Mushtaq Group of Hotels (Grand Mumtaz Group) and head of the J&K Hotelier Club, pointed to close coordination between the hospitality industry and the administration as a central driver behind the steady return of tourists and broader economic revival.
“Pahalgam is a fantastic destination. Kashmir is India’s crown, and people should come here without any fear. Especially since the time Article 370 sections ceased to apply, people come here joyously and enjoy themselves," said Chaya.

Senior government sources noted that sustaining this momentum will depend on converting short-term footfall surges into longer stays and higher per-capita spending. Consistent security messaging, seamless infrastructure readiness, and targeted pan-India marketing remain essential to reshaping public perception beyond the narrative of last year’s attack.

title: Separate North Karnataka State By 2035? BJP MLA Balachandra Jarkiholi’s Big Prediction Sparks Debate
description: Karnataka minister HC Balakrishna dismissed Jarkiholi’s timeline as politically motivated rhetoric
author: Pathikrit Sen Gupta
content:
Separate North Karnataka State By 2035? BJP MLA Balachandra Jarkiholi’s Big Prediction Sparks Debate
Karnataka minister HC Balakrishna dismissed Jarkiholi’s timeline as politically motivated rhetoric
Got Question about the News?
The longstanding demand for a separate North Karnataka state could become a reality within the next five to 10 years, senior BJP MLA Balachandra Jarkiholi has declared, reigniting a politically sensitive debate just days before the Karnataka Legislature convenes in Belagavi.
Speaking ahead of the winter session scheduled to begin on December 2, the Arabhavi legislator argued that holding annual legislative sittings in the northern border district has failed to deliver genuine economic parity. While acknowledging that irrigation projects and state schemes have brought some relief, Jarkiholi maintained that North Karnataka continues to lag behind southern districts centred around Bengaluru.

- BJP's Sat Sharma Hits Out At Mehbooba, Warns Against Reigniting 2008 Amarnath Land Row Memories
Echoing Umesh Katti’s Statehood Pitch
Jarkiholi invoked the legacy of the late BJP minister Umesh Katti, who was for decades the most vocal proponent of carving out a separate state from northern Karnataka. Recalling Katti’s frequent assertion that comprehensive progress would remain elusive without administrative autonomy, Jarkiholi said the region has not received the level of investment and attention it deserves despite successive governments.
He further urged legislators to set aside party lines during the upcoming nine-day winter session at the Suvarna Vidhana Soudha. Jarkiholi stated he would press his party’s state leadership to ensure that at least five full days—if not the entire session—are dedicated exclusively to debating North Karnataka’s pressing concerns, including irrigation bottlenecks, drought relief, and agrarian distress, rather than issues tied to Bengaluru.
Sharp Political Pushback and Border Tensions
The remarks drew swift pushback from the ruling Congress. Karnataka minister HC Balakrishna dismissed Jarkiholi’s timeline as politically motivated rhetoric, questioning why the BJP failed to resolve regional imbalances when it held power both at the Centre and in the state.
