-भारत एक्सप्रेस
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: अहिंसा विश्व भारती के गौरवशाली 20 वर्ष: बेंगलुरु में ‘शांति, सद्भाव एवं विकास’ पर राष्ट्रीय संगोष्ठी, श्री श्री रविशंकर, आचार्य लोकेश मुनि के साथ CMD उपेन्द्र राय होंगे विशिष्ट अतिथि
description: Ahimsa Vishwa Bharti 20 Years: बेंगलुरु के आर्ट ऑफ लिविंग सेंटर में 'शांति, सद्भाव एवं विकास' पर राष्ट्रीय संगोष्ठी. श्री श्री रविशंकर, आचार्य लोकेश जी और CMD उपेन्द्र राय होंगे शामिल.
author: Bharat Express Desk
content:
विश्व शांति, अहिंसा, सामाजिक सद्भाव और मानवता की सेवा के लिए संकल्पित संस्था ‘अहिंसा विश्व भारती’ अपनी स्थापना के गौरवशाली 20 वर्ष पूर्ण होने के उपलक्ष्य में एक ऐतिहासिक राष्ट्रीय आयोजन करने जा रही है. संस्था की स्थापना के दो दशक पूरे होने पर शनिवार, 28 नवंबर 2026 को सायं 6:30 बजे बेंगलुरु स्थित ‘द आर्ट ऑफ लिविंग इंटरनेशनल सेंटर’ में ‘शांति, सद्भाव एवं विकास’ विषय पर एक भव्य राष्ट्रीय संगोष्ठी का आयोजन किया जाएगा.
इस गरिमामयी और ऐतिहासिक अवसर पर कर्नाटक की माननीय राज्यपाल डॉ. सुधा यादव, विश्वविख्यात आध्यात्मिक गुरु एवं आर्ट ऑफ लिविंग के संस्थापक परम पूज्य श्री श्री रविशंकर जी तथा अहिंसा विश्व भारती के संस्थापक, प्रख्यात जैन आचार्य एवं विश्व शांति के प्रणेता परम पूज्य आचार्य लोकेश जी का पावन सान्निध्य प्राप्त होगा.
एक मंच पर जुटेंगे अध्यात्म, शासन और पत्रकारिता के दिग्गज
संगोष्ठी में देश की नीति, विचार और पत्रकारिता जगत की कई प्रतिष्ठित हस्तियां विशिष्ट अतिथि के रूप में शिरकत करेंगी:
- कपिल मिश्रा: कैबिनेट मंत्री, दिल्ली सरकार
- CMD उपेन्द्र राय: चेयरमैन, प्रबंध निदेशक एवं प्रधान संपादक, भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ नेटवर्क
- विनोद दुगड़: चेयरमैन, वर्ल्ड पीस सेंटर
धर्म, अध्यात्म, शासन व्यवस्था, मीडिया, उद्योग और समाज सेवा के क्षेत्र से जुड़े इन प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्तित्वों का यह समागम राष्ट्रीय एकता, सामाजिक समरसता और वैश्विक शांति का सशक्त संदेश देगा.
मानवता की सेवा को समर्पित गौरवशाली दो दशक
वर्ष 2005 में परम पूज्य आचार्य लोकेश जी के दूरदर्शी नेतृत्व में स्थापित ‘अहिंसा विश्व भारती’ विगत दो दशकों से अहिंसा, आपसी भाईचारे, सर्वधर्म समभाव, मानवीय मूल्यों और विश्व बंधुत्व की स्थापना के लिए निरंतर सक्रिय है. संस्था ने विभिन्न धर्मों, संस्कृतियों और समुदायों के बीच संवाद का सेतु निर्मित करते हुए शांतिपूर्ण सह-अस्तित्व की भावना को मजबूत करने में उल्लेखनीय योगदान दिया है. यह बीस वर्षीय उत्सव केवल संस्थागत उपलब्धियों का पर्व नहीं, बल्कि मानवता के प्रति समर्पण और सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व के संकल्प का अभिनंदन है.
‘वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्’ और समग्र विकास का संदेश
वर्तमान वैश्विक परिदृश्य में बढ़ते भू-राजनीतिक संघर्ष, हिंसा, वैचारिक ध्रुवीकरण और असहिष्णुता के बीच ‘शांति, सद्भाव एवं विकास’ विषय पर केंद्रित यह राष्ट्रीय संगोष्ठी अत्यंत प्रासंगिक मानी जा रही है. संगोष्ठी में इस बात पर गहन विचार-मंथन होगा कि भारत की प्राचीन सांस्कृतिक विरासत में निहित अहिंसा, करुणा और ‘वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्’ (संपूर्ण विश्व एक परिवार है) के जीवन दर्शन से समकालीन वैश्विक चुनौतियों का समाधान कैसे निकाला जा सकता है. यह समागम एक ऐसे समाज के निर्माण का मार्ग प्रशस्त करेगा, जहां विकास का आधार केवल आर्थिक प्रगति न होकर नैतिक नेतृत्व, मानवीय संवेदनशीलता और पारस्परिक सद्भाव भी हो.
यह भी पढ़िए: कुशीनगर महोत्सव-2026: सांस्कृतिक प्रस्तुतियों के बीच भारत एक्सप्रेस के CMD उपेन्द्र राय ने की शिरकत, देखें VIDEO
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: शादी के बाद पहली बार ससुराल पहुंचा दामाद और हो गया बड़ा कांड! घर से गायब हुआ सबकुछ, जानें फिर क्या हुआ
description: Odisha News: भुवनेश्वर के यूनिट-8 में पहली बार ससुराल पहुंचे दामाद पर 5 लाख रुपया के गहने चुराने और ससुर की बाइक गिरवी रखने का आरोप. नयापल्ली पुलिस ने किया गिरफ्तार.
author: Shubhra Rai
content:
(AI IMAGE)
Odisha News: ओडिशा की राजधानी भुवनेश्वर के यूनिट-8 इलाके से चोरी का हैरान करने वाला मामला सामने आया है, जहां शादी के बाद पहली बार ससुराल पहुंचे दामाद को 5 लाख रुपया के सोने के गहने चुराने के आरोप में पुलिस ने गिरफ्तार कर लिया है. आरोपी पर अपने ससुर की मोटरसाइकिल भी गिरवी रखने का आरोप है.
भुवनेश्वर के यूनिट-8 में हुए इस मामले में नयापल्ली पुलिस ने शिकायत के आधार पर त्वरित कार्रवाई करते हुए आरोपी दामाद को गिरफ्तार कर लिया है. गहनों की चोरी और गिरवी रखी गई मोटरसाइकिल से जुड़े पहलुओं को लेकर आगे की जांच व कानूनी कार्रवाई जारी है.
पहली बार ससुराल पहुंचे दामाद ने उड़ाए 5 लाख रुपया के गहने
पुलिस के मुताबिक, नयागढ़ निवासी और यूनिट-8 में किराये पर रह रहे आरोपी राजेश कुमार नायक की कुछ दिन पहले ही इलाके की युवती से शादी हुई थी. आरोप है कि शादी के बाद पहली बार ससुराल पहुंचने पर घर में किसी के न होने का मौका पाकर उसने अलमारी से करीब पांच लाख रुपया मूल्य के सोने के गहने चुरा लिए.
ससुर की बाइक गिरवी रखने का आरोप
परिवार वालों को अलमारी से गहने गायब मिलने पर चोरी की जानकारी हुई, जिसके बाद नयापल्ली थाने में शिकायत दर्ज कराई गई और पुलिस ने कार्रवाई करते हुए आरोपी को गिरफ्तार कर लिया. जांच में यह भी सामने आया कि आरोपी ने अपने ससुर की मोटरसाइकिल ले जाकर उसे कहीं और गिरवी रख दिया था.
शहर में चोरी की अन्य घटनाओं का संदर्भ
भुवनेश्वर में इससे पहले दुर्गापूजा के दौरान भी चोरी की घटनाओं के मामले सामने आए थे, जब भीड़ और उत्सवों के बीच चोरों ने घरों और लोगों को निशाना बनाया था. इसके अलावा बुधवार को शहीदनगर थाना क्षेत्र के वीएसएस नगर स्थित एक सरकारी क्वार्टर में दिनदहाड़े चोरी की वारदात हुई थी.
-भारत एक्सप्रेस
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: 'He Is Not Allowed To Use It Until...': MEA Explains Why Saurav Das' Passport Was Flagged
description: The MEA issued a show-cause notice to Saurav Das due to a discrepancy in his place of birth on his passport, which was flagged by law enforcement.
author: Akanksha Swarup, Ananya Varma
content:
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has said that a show-cause notice was issued to Saurav Das after law enforcement agencies flagged a discrepancy in his place of birth mentioned in his passport.
Responding to a question from Times Now, the MEA said that providing accurate information is imperative at every stage of the passport application process. It said the Chennai passport office issued a show-cause notice to Das on November 23, seeking an explanation for the discrepancy in his place of birth within seven days.
The MEA further clarified that Das would not be allowed to use his passport until the discrepancy was clarified.
Asked why the discrepancy was being examined now, given that Das's passport was issued in 2019 and he had travelled abroad previously, the MEA said the matter had been taken up after law enforcement agencies flagged it.
"The law enforcement raised the discrepancy now, which is when the show-cause notice was issued. We can do so only when law enforcement flags such discrepancy to us," the MEA said.
Das had claimed in a post on X on Monday night that he was stopped at Delhi airport from travelling to London, where he was scheduled to deliver a lecture at the University of Oxford.
Delhi HC denies hearing Saurav Das' plea
The Delhi High Court on Wednesday declined to hear urgently a plea filed by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leader on the matter. The issue was mentioned before Acting Chief Justice (ACJ) Nitin Wasudeo Sambre by counsel for Das, who sought an urgent hearing on Wednesday.
The counsel told the High Court that Das was stopped at the immigration counter at the Delhi airport and that no order or Look Out Circular (LOC) had been shown to him restricting his travel abroad.
"I was stopped at immigration. No order was shown to me. No LOC or prohibition by any authority from letting me travel. I am seeking an urgent listing of my petition today. I can still make it to the United Kingdom on the 27th," the counsel submitted.
He further urged the High Court to take up the matter on Wednesday, informing it that his flight was scheduled for Thursday evening and that the plea might become infructuous if not heard urgently.
However, ACJ Sambre declined the request for an urgent hearing and said the matter would be taken up on Thursday. "Let it be tomorrow," the Acting Chief Justice said.
Das, in a post on X on Monday night, claimed that he had been stopped at the Delhi airport from travelling to London to deliver a lecture at the University of Oxford.
The development comes amid a political exchange over Das's proposed overseas visit, with the Delhi BJP accusing him of making misleading claims about being prevented by the Union government from travelling abroad.
In a statement on Tuesday, Delhi BJP spokesperson Praveen Shankar Kapoor claimed that Das was scheduled to attend an event organised by the Oxford Union and not deliver a lecture at the University of Oxford.
Kapoor also alleged that Das had independently paid for registration for the event and wanted to leave the country to defame India from abroad on Constitution Day, November 26, in the style of Rahul Gandhi.

title: Congress Wants 181, SP Offers Only 26: Inside the Seat-Sharing Deadlock In UP | EXPLAINED
description: The Congress bases its demands on historical victories from the late 1980s, while the SP emphasises recent election results, particularly from 2022.
author: Sabyasachi Roy Chowdhury, Ananya Varma
content:
The Congress-SP deadlock over seat-sharing comes down to how the two parties are assessing their strength in UP. Congress is relying on victories from 1985 and 1990, before the emergence of Mandal and Kamandal politics reshaped the state’s electoral landscape. The SP, meanwhile, is basing its claims on more recent results, particularly the 2022 Assembly and 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
1. Why Congress’s 181-seat demand is a tough sell
Of the 181 seats Congress initially sought:
- 144 went to the BJP and its allies in 2022.
- Around 24 were won by the SP.
- 13 went to the SP’s former allies, RLD and SBSP, now part of the NDA.
- More than 60 saw the SP finish a close second.
In all, nearly 85 seats are constituencies where the SP either has a sitting MLA or a strong claim based on its recent performance.
Amethi and Rae Bareli underline the point. Of their 10 Assembly seats, Congress won none in 2022, while the SP won six.
2. How the SP arrived at its 26-seat offer
The SP's offer follows a simple formula based on the 2022 results:
- 2 seats won by Congress: Rampur Khas (Pratapgarh) and Pharenda (Maharajganj).
- 4 seats where Congress finished second: Mathura, Kheragarh (Agra), Jagdishpur (Amethi) and Kidwai Nagar (Kanpur).
- 20 seats where the SP had a strong vote base: It polled 60,000–70,000 votes in each, while Congress managed around 2,000.
These 20 seats are Baghpat, Modinagar, Hapur, Jewar, Syana, Khurja, Khair, Iglas, Mant, Agra North, Fatehpur Sikri, Bilgram-Mallanwan, Govind Nagar, Nanpara, Gorakhpur City, Khajani, Padrauna, Fazilnagar, Pindra and Varanasi Cantonment.
The difference is straightforward: Congress is banking on its pre-Mandal, pre-Kamandal electoral strength. The SP wants seat-sharing to reflect where the parties stand today. That is the gap the two sides need to bridge.
The Uttar Pradesh assembly elections are expected to be held in February-March next year. The BJP has won two back-to-back terms in the state since 2017, an outcome the SP is desperate to change this time.
The SP and the Congress fought the 2022 elections independently. The two contested the 2024 Lok Sabha elections together as part of the opposition INDIA bloc, and the alliance won 43 of the state's 80 seats.

title: Sheshnag Lake Row: Why Roadwork Near Amarnath Yatra Route Has Sparked A Debate
description: The Jammu and Kashmir government has pushed back against allegations of environmental damage near Sheshnag Lake along the Amarnath Yatra route.
author: Suhail Nazeer Bhat, Diana George
content:
The Jammu and Kashmir government on Wednesday sought to counter allegations of environmental damage near the pristine Sheshnag Lake, with Forest Minister Altaf Kaloo saying that "nothing has happened to Sheshnag" and that the work involved only a tiled track.
The Forest Department has also released fresh videos of the site, claiming that no major damage has occurred near the lake. The minister is expected to submit a preliminary report to Chief Minister Omar Abdullah following his assessment of the ground situation.
The controversy erupted after videos showing heavy earthmoving machinery, including a JCB excavator, operating near the high-altitude lake along the Amarnath Yatra route surfaced on social media.
The visuals triggered concerns over possible damage to the fragile Himalayan ecosystem.
The Border Roads Organisation (BRO), which is executing the work, has maintained that the activity is part of post-Amarnath Yatra road-widening and stabilisation work along existing tracks.
The BRO says the work is part of post-Yatra road widening and stabilisation to ensure safer movement of pilgrims.
It said the project aims to ease congestion and ensure safer movement of pilgrims, while following prescribed safety norms and environmental safeguards.
The issue has now taken a political turn, with contrasting positions emerging in Jammu and Kashmir. The Shiv Sena and Dogra Front staged a protest in Jammu against opposition to the road development work. The organisations accused Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti of attempting to create communal tension by opposing infrastructure development along the Amarnath Yatra route.
Mufti had attempted to visit Sheshnag Lake on Tuesday to assess the situation but was stopped by police at Chandanwari, with authorities citing security concerns. She has questioned the construction activity in the fragile glacial zone and warned of possible long-term ecological consequences.
The PDP has described the work as an "ecological disaster", while the Congress has also raised concerns over the environmental impact and the religious significance of the lake.
Kashmir's chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq has launched an online petition seeking protection of the region's alpine lakes and called for construction activity around them to stop.
Sheshnag Lake, situated at around 3,590 metres, is among the 14 high-risk glacial lakes identified in Jammu and Kashmir.
The controversy has also brought a 2012 Supreme Court judgment on the Amarnath Yatra tracks back into focus.
The court had directed that walking tracks be widened to at least 12 feet and equipped with railings and retaining walls for pilgrim safety. However, it clarified that the directions did not call for constructing motorable metalled roads in place of walking tracks.

title: No power in the world wants India to progress: RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat
description: Speaking at the Padmaa Festival in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat said dominant global powers do not want India to progress, contrasting hegemonic geopolitics with New Delhi's humanitarian assistance to neighbouring nations during crises.
author: Aakash Mudgal
content:
No power in the world wants India to progress: RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat
Speaking at the Padmaa Festival in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat said dominant global powers do not want India to progress, contrasting hegemonic geopolitics with New Delhi's humanitarian assistance to neighbouring nations during crises.
New Delhi: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) Chief Mohan Bhagwat on Wednesday asserted that dominant global powers are unwilling to see India rise because they operate on a “survival of the fittest” mindset aimed at keeping other nations under pressure.
Speaking at the inauguration of the fifth Padmaa Festival at the Manthan Hall on the MIT Campus in Maharashtra’s Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Bhagwat contrasted hegemonic power politics with India’s civilisational approach of extending humanitarian and financial support even to hostile neighbours.
“No power in the world wants India to progress because these powers seek to retain their dominance and believe in the principle of ‘survival of the fittest’. They keep everyone under pressure. This is how they are considered powerful and able to boss people around. If India grows, these powerful people’s ‘shops’ will shut because India wants to help everyone,” Bhagwat said, according to PTI.
Assistance to neighbours during crises
Illustrating New Delhi’s regional outreach, the RSS chief cited instances where India stepped in to support neighbouring countries during emergencies regardless of bilateral friction.
“India helps its neighbours when they are in need, even if they hate it. When the Maldives was in trouble, India transported water. India provided financial assistance to economically distressed Sri Lanka. India helps Nepal when it faces environmental problems and also assists Bangladesh. We have also helped Pakistan during floods and earthquakes,” he said, adding that India views true strength as a means to protect the vulnerable and foster peace.
Turning to India’s demographic strength, Bhagwat observed that the current generation of young Indians is free from a colonial mindset and responds strongly to sincerity and integrity.
“If someone speaks genuinely, the youth are prepared to stand behind him. They hate lies and want to make their country great,” he noted, urging young citizens to emulate the selfless dedication of the Padma awardees participating in the conclave.
Ex-CDS Gen Anil Chauhan flags development hurdles and youth role
Former Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) General Anil Chauhan (Retd), who shared the dais as the event’s chief guest, echoed the call for national self-reliance while cautioning that established powers frequently create obstacles for developing economies.
Addressing the gathering, General Chauhan said young citizens would serve as both the primary drivers and chief beneficiaries of the Viksit Bharat (Developed India) vision by 2047.
“If we want to achieve the goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047, the youth will make the biggest contribution and will also be its biggest beneficiaries. Fulfilling this dream is the responsibility of everyone. We have to learn from our past successes and bring our intellectual energy to the fore,” PTI quoted him as saying.
Organised by the local Gyanyajnah Foundation on Beed Bypass Road, the three-day Padmaa Festival brings together Padma Shri awardees across science, medicine, literature, agriculture, classical arts, and social work—including Air Marshal Padma Bandopadhyay (Retd), writer Ramesh Patange, and violinist Dr N Rajam—for public interactive sessions running through November 27.

title: Mirwaiz-led clerics’ body objects to Vande Mataram at Srinagar Waqf Day event
description: The Mutahida Majlis-e-Ulama has objected to the playing of Vande Mataram at Jammu and Kashmir’s first Waqf Day ceremony, where Union Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju was the chief guest. The body, led by Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, said it was considering seeking legal advice. It also said it would formally ask authorities to end what it called the compulsory use of the national song at public events.
author: Adan Khan
content:
Mirwaiz-led clerics’ body objects to Vande Mataram at Srinagar Waqf Day event
The Mutahida Majlis-e-Ulama has objected to the playing of Vande Mataram at Jammu and Kashmir’s first Waqf Day ceremony, where Union Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju was the chief guest. The body, led by Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, said it was considering seeking legal advice. It also said it would formally ask authorities to end what it called the compulsory use of the national song at public events.
New Delhi: The Mutahida Majlis-e-Ulama (MMU), an umbrella body of Islamic religious organisations in Jammu and Kashmir, on Wednesday objected to the playing of Vande Mataram at a Waqf Day ceremony in Srinagar. The body, headed by Kashmir’s chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, said it would submit a formal representation to authorities and was considering seeking legal advice.
The Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board held the event on Monday at the convention centre of the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Kashmir. Union Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju attended as the chief guest. Neither Rijiju nor the Waqf Board had responded to the criticism at the time of reporting.
Glimpse of address by Hon’ble Minister for Minority Affairs @KirenRijiju at the Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Day at Convention Centre of Sher-i-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences & Technology of Kashmir (SKUAST-K), Srinagar. https://t.co/ZAyj9AWyWh
— National Commission for Minorities (@NCM_GoI) November 25, 2026
Clerics cite religious concerns
The MMU said the Board had no legal obligation to play the national song at the ceremony. It argued that verses which depict the motherland as a goddess conflict with Tawheed, the Islamic belief in the oneness of God. The body also cited the All India Muslim Personal Law Board’s opposition to compulsory renditions of the song.
MMU Strongly Condemns Playing of Vande Mataram at Waqf Day Ceremony
Raises Concern Over Its Growing Imposition in J&K
To seek legal opinion and submit formal representation to authorities against its forcible imposition
Reiterates that there can be no compromise on Tawheed and religious freedom
Srinagar Nov 25, 2026: Mutahida Majlis-e-Ulama (MMU) Jammu and Kashmir, the representative amalgam of religious organisations and institutions across various schools of Islamic thought, has taken strong exception to the playing of Vande Mataram at the Waqf Day ceremony organised by the J&K Waqf Board in Srinagar.
MMU stated that, as it has categorically made clear on several occasions in the past, the fundamental and non-negotiable principle of Tawheed in islam — the absolute Oneness of Allah. Islam strictly prohibits associating any partner with Allah or attributing divinity to any person, object, land or creation.
While Islam encourages love for one’s homeland, it draws a clear distinction between love for one’s homeland and its worship or deification. Any expression or practice that attributes divinity to the motherland is contrary to the fundamental Islamic belief of Tawheed and is, therefore, un-Islamic and impermissible for Muslims.
MMU pointed out that the All India Muslim Personal Law Board (AIMPLB) has also categorically clarified the Islamic position on Vande Mataram and strongly opposed its compulsory rendition on both religious and constitutional grounds.
“It is highly regrettable and unacceptable that Vande Mataram was played at a function organised by the Waqf Board itself, an institution entrusted with safeguarding Muslim religious endowments and their sanctity. There was no legal obligation to play Vande Mataram simply because it was an official function, and playing it was optional . Yet the waqf board went ahead with it with utter disregard for the fundamental religious beliefs and sensitivities of Kashmiri Muslims, which has caused deep hurt and anguish among people
MMU expresses grave concern over the increasingly routine inclusion of Vande Mataram at official government functions across Muslim-majority Jammu and Kashmir, despite the well-known religious reservations of Muslims. Such imposition disregards their religious convictions and constitutional rights and deepens distrust and alienation.
In view of the growing seriousness of the issue, MMU is deliberating upon seeking legal opinion in this matter and will also submit a formal representation to the concerned authorities , seeking an immediate end to the forcible imposition of Vande Mataram at government functions, educational institutions and other public events in Jammu and Kashmir, urging respect for the constitutionally guaranteed freedom of faith and conscience.
MMU also reminds Muslims, particularly those entrusted with religious responsibilities, of their obligation to uphold the fundamental principles of Islam, irrespective of any pressure, position or consideration.
MMU once again makes it unequivocally clear that on matters of faith, particularly the cardinal principle of Tawheed, there can be neither ambiguity nor compromise.
— Mirwaiz Manzil-Office of Mirwaiz-e-Kashmir (@mirwaizmanzil) November 25, 2026
The objection comes amid a wider debate over the Union Home Ministry’s January 28 order requiring all six stanzas of Vande Mataram to be played or sung before the national anthem at specified official functions. The order also requires the audience to stand. Petitions before the Supreme Court have challenged the mandate.
Political leaders react
Apni Party chief Altaf Bukhari said the organisers should have left the song out of the programme. “Muslims have reservations over singing of Vande Mataram. I think singing of Vande Mataram should have been avoided during the Waqf function. I fail to understand why it was included,” he said.
#WATCH | Srinagar: J&K Waqf Board Chairperson Dr Darakhshan Andrabi says, “… Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has encouraged the Waqf Board and inaugurated various initiatives, which is a matter of great pride for us… With the vision of Prime Minister Modi Ji and the encouragement of our Union Minister, you have witnessed that, for the first time in history, Waqf Day has been celebrated on such a grand scale…”
— ANI (@ANI) November 23, 2026
National Conference leader Bashir Ahmad accused the BJP of using the song for political purposes ahead of the Uttar Pradesh elections. He also said he opposed its rendition at a Waqf Board event.
Waqf property registration
At the ceremony, Rijiju said the government would ask the Supreme Court to allow six more months for Waqf property registration. Earlier that day, he and Waqf Board chairperson Darakhshan Andrabi inaugurated a women’s prayer hall, a guest house and a museum at the Hazratbal shrine. Rijiju also laid the foundation stone for a nursing and medical technology college run by the Board.

title: Was Pranab Mukherjee behind Suvendu Adhikari’s exit from TMC? Here’s what West Bengal CM reveals
description: Suvendu Adhikari said the Trinamool Congress was a party where he felt treated more like an 'employee' than an independent political leader.
author: News9Live Staff
content:
Was Pranab Mukherjee behind Suvendu Adhikari’s exit from TMC? Here’s what West Bengal CM reveals
Suvendu Adhikari said the Trinamool Congress was a party where he felt treated more like an 'employee' than an independent political leader.
Kolkata: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has revealed the reason behind his decision to leave the Trinamool Congress (TMC) in December 2020. According to him, the advice of former President Pranab Mukherjee played an important role in his political journey and decision to join the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
In a recent interview with a private media outlet, Suvendu Adhikari said he left the TMC because he did not want to work in a party that he felt operated like a private organisation.
Suvendu Adhikari explains his exit from TMC
Suvendu Adhikari said the Trinamool Congress was a party where he felt treated more like an ’employee’ than an independent political leader. He described the organisation as a “PC-Vaipo” party, referring to the political influence of Abhishek Banerjee and the leadership structure within the party. He also said that Pranab Mukherjee was his real mentor and guardian.
According to Suvendu, he visited Pranab Mukherjee at Rashtrapati Bhavan, also known as Raisina Hills, after Mukherjee became the President of India. During the meeting, Mukherjee advised him to think carefully about his political future.
Suvendu recalled that Mukherjee suggested he could continue working under the existing leadership or choose a path that allowed him to grow independently with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The West Bengal Chief Minister said the advice was clear and helped him make an important political decision. However, he added that sharing more details about the conversation could create controversy.
From TMC leader to BJP chief minister
Suvendu Adhikari resigned from the Trinamool Congress on December 16, 2020. Later that year, he joined the BJP at a political rally in Midnapore, where he accepted the party flag from Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
His departure became a major turning point in West Bengal politics. He later defeated Mamata Banerjee in the Nandigram Assembly election in 2021.
Suvendu’s latest remarks have once again brought attention to his political shift and the role of Pranab Mukherjee’s advice in his decision.

title: मार्च 2027 तक भारतीय वायुसेना को मिलेंगे 18 तेजस Mk-1A, एचएएल ने दिया भरोसा- रिपोर्ट
description: वायुसेना ने एचएएल को 1.1 लाख करोड़ रुपये में कुल 180 तेजस Mk-1A विमानों का ऑर्डर दिया है. पहला कॉन्ट्रैक्ट फरवरी 2021 में 83 विमानों के लिए किया गया था. इसके बाद सितंबर 2025 में 97 अतिरिक्त विमानों का ऑर्डर दिया गया.
author: Saurabh Sharma
content:
भारत के स्वदेशी लड़ाकू विमान तेजस Mk-1A कार्यक्रम में लंबे समय से चल रही देरी दूर होने की उम्मीद बढ़ गई है. सरकारी कंपनी एचएएल ने भारतीय वायुसेना (IAF) को 31 मार्च 2027 तक 16 से 18 तेजस Mk-1A लड़ाकू विमान सौंपने का भरोसा दिया है. हिंदुस्तान टाइम्स ने सूत्रों के हवाले से ये रिपोर्ट दी है. इसके साथ ही वायुसेना को मौजूदा वित्त वर्ष के अंत तक इन विमानों का एक स्क्वाड्रन शामिल करने की उम्मीद है.
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, पिछले सप्ताह एयर हेडक्वार्टर में हुई उच्चस्तरीय समीक्षा बैठक में HAL ने डिलीवरी की समयसीमा को लेकर आश्वासन दिया. बैठक में विमान से जुड़ी तकनीकी समस्याओं और उनके समाधान की स्थिति की समीक्षा की गई. अधिकारियों के मुताबिक, विमान के हार्डवेयर से जुड़ी सभी समस्याएं दूर कर ली गई हैं. इनमें हथियारों के परीक्षण से संबंधित दिक्कतें भी शामिल थीं. वहीं, रडार सहित कुछ सॉफ्टवेयर से जुड़ी समस्याओं का समाधान अंतिम चरण में है.
हालांकि, वायुसेना ने साफ किया है कि विमानों को शामिल करने के लिए अपनी निर्धारित क्षमता संबंधी शर्तों में कोई ढील नहीं दी जाएगी. यानी HAL को डिलीवरी से पहले विमान को IAF की सभी तय तकनीकी और परिचालन जरूरतों के अनुरूप तैयार करना होगा.
करीब दो साल की देरी से चल रहा है कार्यक्रम
तेजस Mk-1A की पहली खेप की डिलीवरी मूल कार्यक्रम के मुकाबले करीब दो साल पीछे चल रही है. इन स्वदेशी लड़ाकू विमानों को वायुसेना के पुराने MiG-21 बेड़े की जगह शामिल किया जाना है. MiG-21 विमानों ने छह दशक से अधिक समय तक भारतीय वायुसेना की सेवा की थी और पिछले साल उन्हें सेवा से बाहर कर दिया गया था.
वायुसेना ने HAL को कुल 180 तेजस Mk-1A विमानों का ऑर्डर दिया है. इन दोनों सौदों की कुल कीमत करीब 1.1 लाख करोड़ रुपये है. पहला कॉन्ट्रैक्ट फरवरी 2021 में 83 विमानों के लिए किया गया था. इसके बाद सितंबर 2025 में 97 अतिरिक्त विमानों का ऑर्डर दिया गया.
मार्च 2027 तक 16-18 विमानों की डिलीवरी का लक्ष्य पूरा होने पर वायुसेना को स्वदेशी लड़ाकू विमानों का एक स्क्वाड्रन शामिल करने में मदद मिलेगी. हालांकि, इस लक्ष्य की पूर्ति HAL की उत्पादन क्षमता, शेष सॉफ्टवेयर समस्याओं के समाधान और वायुसेना की निर्धारित तकनीकी शर्तों को पूरा करने पर निर्भर करेगी.
तेजस Mk-1A की खासियत
तेजस Mk-1A भारत का स्वदेशी सिंगल-इंजन, हल्का और मल्टीरोल लड़ाकू विमान है. इसे हवाई सुरक्षा, दुश्मन के ठिकानों पर हमला और समुद्री मिशन जैसी अलग-अलग जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है. यह पहले से वायुसेना में शामिल तेजस Mk-1 का अधिक उन्नत संस्करण है. इसमें Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) रडार लगाया गया है, जो एक साथ कई लक्ष्यों को ट्रैक करने और लंबी दूरी से उनकी पहचान करने में सक्षम है. इसके अलावा, इसमें Beyond Visual Range (BVR) मिसाइल क्षमता, आधुनिक इलेक्ट्रॉनिक वॉरफेयर सूट, बेहतर एवियोनिक्स और हवा में ही ईंधन भरने की सुविधा है. ये खूबियां इसे आधुनिक हवाई युद्ध की जरूरतों के अनुरूप बनाती हैं.

title: दशकों पुरानी दोस्ती, दो बार टूटा गठबंधन, लेकिन अब फिर आएंगे साथ! कुछ ऐसी है बीजेपी-अकाली दल के रिश्ते की कहानी
description: बीजेपी और अकाली दल के गठबंधन की कहानी बीजेपी के बनने से भी पुरानी है. इसकी शुरुआत 1950 के दशक में हुई थी, जब अकाली दल ने भारतीय जनसंघ से हाथ मिलाया था. लगभग 6 दशक के इस सफर में दोनों ने कई चुनाव साथ लड़े, पंजाब में सरकार बनाई, लेकिन फिर तीन कृषि कानूनों के मुद्दे पर 2020 में रास्ते अलग हो गए.
author: Samarth Saraswat
content:
पंजाब की राजनीति में एक बार फिर बड़ा बदलाव होने जा रहा है. भारतीय जनता पार्टी (BJP) और शिरोमणि अकाली दल (SAD) 2027 के विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले अपना पुराना गठबंधन फिर से शुरू करने जा रहे हैं. दोनों पार्टियों का रिश्ता करीब 6 दशक पुराना है. इस दौरान दोस्ती हुई, कई चुनाव साथ लड़े, पंजाब में सरकार बनाई और फिर तीन कृषि कानूनों के मुद्दे पर 2020 में रास्ते अलग हो गए. लेकिन अब केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह की घोषणा के साथ दोनों दल एक बार फिर साथ आने की तैयारी में हैं.
जनसंघ से शुरू हुई बीजेपी-अकाली दल की दोस्ती
बीजेपी और अकाली दल के गठबंधन की कहानी बीजेपी के बनने से भी पुरानी है. इसकी शुरुआत 1950 के दशक में हुई थी, जब अकाली दल ने भारतीय जनसंघ से हाथ मिलाया था. 
जनसंघ को ही बाद में बीजेपी के रूप में नई पहचान मिली. उस समय अकाली दल का मजबूत आधार सिख और ग्रामीण वोटर्स के बीच था, जबकि जनसंघ को हिंदू वोटर्स से समर्थन मिलता था. भले ही दोनों की विचारधारा अलग थी, लेकिन चुनावी फायदे के लिए साथ आने की गुंजाइश भी थी. 
साल 1967 में दोनों ने पंजाब में कांग्रेस के खिलाफ दूसरे दलों के साथ मिलकर गठबंधन सरकार बनाई. इस रिश्ते को आगे बढ़ाने में प्रकाश सिंह बादल की अहम भूमिका रही. वह राजनीतिक मतभेदों के बावजूद साथ काम करने में विश्वास रखते थे. 
इसके बाद 1980 में बीजेपी की नींव रखी गई. इस दौरान भी दोनों दलों के बीच पुराना राजनीतिक रिश्ता बना रहा. हालांकि, 1980 के दशक में पंजाब आतंकवाद, ऑपरेशन ब्लू स्टार और सिख विरोधी हिंसा जैसी घटनाओं से गुजर रहा था. 
ऐसे कठिन दौर में दोनों पार्टियों का रिश्ता भी प्रभावित हुआ. साल 1996 में प्रकाश सिंह बादल, अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी और लालकृष्ण आडवाणी ने मिलकर इस साझेदारी को मजबूत राजनीतिक गठबंधन का रूप दिया. 1997 के पंजाब विधानसभा चुनाव में गठबंधन ने बड़ी जीत हासिल की और बादल मुख्यमंत्री बने. इसके बाद 2007 और 2012 में भी दोनों दलों ने मिलकर सरकार बनाई. 
इस दौरान 2012 की जीत खास थी, क्योंकि पंजाब में पहली बार किसी सरकार ने लगातार दूसरी बार सत्ता में वापसी की थी. साल 2014 के लोकसभा चुनाव में भी दोनों पार्टियां साथ लड़ीं. केंद्र में नरेंद्र मोदी की सरकार बनने के बाद हरसिमरत कौर बादल को केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल में जगह मिली. इस तरह 2014 तक बीजेपी और अकाली दल का रिश्ता पंजाब की राजनीति में सबसे मजबूत और लंबे समय तक चलने वाले गठबंधनों में शामिल हो चुका था.
2017 के चुनाव में लगा झटका, लेकिन गठबंधन रहा कायम
2014 के बाद बीजेपी और अकाली दल के रिश्ते में नई पीढ़ी के नेताओं की भूमिका बढ़ने लगी. बीजेपी की ओर से नरेंद्र मोदी और अकाली दल की ओर से सुखबीर सिंह बादल गठबंधन का प्रमुख चेहरा बन गए. हालांकि, 2017 के पंजाब विधानसभा चुनाव में दोनों पार्टियों को बड़ा झटका लगा. कांग्रेस ने कैप्टन अमरिंदर सिंह के नेतृत्व में सरकार बनाई. 
आम आदमी पार्टी भी राज्य में मजबूत विपक्ष के रूप में उभरी. अकाली दल के लिए यह चुनाव खास तौर पर निराशाजनक रहा, क्योंकि पार्टी का मजबूत वोट बैंक कमजोर होता दिखाई दिया. दूसरी तरफ बीजेपी भी पंजाब के ग्रामीण इलाकों में अपनी पकड़ मजबूत नहीं कर पाई. इसके बावजूद दोनों पार्टियों ने अपना गठबंधन जारी रखा.
2019 के बाद बढ़ने लगीं दूरियां
2019 का लोकसभा चुनाव दोनों पार्टियों ने आखिरी बार साथ लड़ा था. केंद्र में मोदी सरकार बनने के बाद भी अकाली दल एनडीए का हिस्सा बना रहा. हरसिमरत कौर बादल केंद्रीय मंत्री थीं. लेकिन इसी दौरान केंद्र सरकार के तीन कृषि कानूनों को लेकर पंजाब में विरोध शुरू हो गया. पंजाब की राजनीति में किसानों की अहम भूमिका है. ऐसे में अकाली दल के सामने बड़ी मुश्किल खड़ी हो गई. एक तरफ केंद्र में उसकी सहयोगी बीजेपी थी, तो दूसरी तरफ पंजाब के किसान इन कानूनों का विरोध कर रहे थे.
2020 में तीन कृषि कानून बने गठबंधन टूटने की वजह
साल 2020 में तीन कृषि कानून बीजेपी और अकाली दल के बीच दरार की सबसे बड़ी वजह बने. पंजाब सहित देश के कई हिस्सों में किसानों ने इन कानूनों के खिलाफ आंदोलन शुरू कर दिया.
किसानों के बढ़ते विरोध को देखते हुए हरसिमरत कौर बादल ने सितंबर 2020 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल से इस्तीफा दे दिया. इसके बाद सुखबीर सिंह बादल ने एनडीए से अलग होने का फैसला किया. सितंबर 2020 में अकाली दल ने बीजेपी के साथ अपना गठबंधन तोड़ दिया था. 
यह करीब दो दशक से ज्यादा समय तक मजबूत रहे राजनीतिक रिश्ते का बड़ा अंत था. केंद्र सरकार ने नवंबर 2021 में तीनों कृषि कानून वापस ले लिए, लेकिन इसके बावजूद दोनों पार्टियों के बीच पुराना भरोसा वापस नहीं आया.
2022 के चुनाव में दोनों पार्टियों को हुआ नुकसान
गठबंधन टूटने के बाद 2022 के पंजाब विधानसभा चुनाव में बीजेपी और अकाली दल अलग-अलग मैदान में उतरे. इस चुनाव में आम आदमी पार्टी ने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए 117 में से 92 सीटें जीत लीं. अकाली दल को सिर्फ 3 सीटें मिलीं, जबकि बीजेपी 2 सीटों पर सिमट गई. इससे पहले 2007 और 2012 में दोनों पार्टियां साथ मिलकर सरकार बना चुकी थीं. ऐसे में 2022 का परिणाम दोनों दलों के लिए बड़ा राजनीतिक झटका था.
2024 में भी नहीं बन पाई बात
2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव से पहले दोनों पार्टियों के बीच गठबंधन को लेकर बातचीत हुई थी. हालांकि, सीटों के बंटवारे और राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर सहमति नहीं बन पाई. इसके चलते दोनों दलों ने अलग-अलग चुनाव लड़ा. अकाली दल के प्रमुख सुखबीर सिंह बादल का कहना था कि पंजाब के हितों और लोगों के भरोसे को ध्यान में रखकर ही कोई राजनीतिक फैसला लिया जाएगा.
2026 में फिर नजदीक आए मोदी और बादल
अब 2027 के विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले दोनों पार्टियों के बीच फिर से नजदीकियां बढ़ने लगी हैं. साल 2026 में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और सुखबीर सिंह बादल के बीच मुलाकात हुई. इस मुलाकात को दोनों दलों के रिश्तों में सुधार के संकेत के तौर पर देखा गया. 
इसके बाद परिसीमन और महिला आरक्षण जैसे मुद्दों पर भी अकाली दल की राजनीतिक गतिविधियों से गठबंधन की संभावनाओं को लेकर चर्चा तेज हुई. केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने भी पंजाब में 2027 में एनडीए की सरकार बनने की बात कही थी. उनके इस बयान को बीजेपी और अकाली दल के दोबारा साथ आने के संकेत के तौर पर देखा गया.
दोनों पार्टियों को गठबंधन से क्या फायदा?
दोनों दलों के लिए यह गठबंधन राजनीतिक रूप से अहम माना जा रहा है. अकाली दल का पंजाब के ग्रामीण इलाकों और सिख वोटर्स के बीच पुराना आधार रहा है. वहीं बीजेपी की ताकत मुख्य रूप से शहरी इलाकों में रही है. इनके साथ आने से दोनों पार्टियां अपने-अपने वोट बैंक को जोड़ने की कोशिश कर सकती हैं. अकाली दल को राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर बीजेपी का साथ मिलेगा, जबकि बीजेपी को पंजाब में मजबूत क्षेत्रीय सहयोगी मिल सकता है.
हालांकि, 2027 के चुनाव में इस पुराने गठबंधन को कितना फायदा होगा, यह वोटर्स के रुख और दोनों दलों की चुनावी रणनीति पर निर्भर करेगा. लेकिन 6 दशक पुराने इस रिश्ते की वापसी अब पंजाब की राजनीति में एक नया अध्याय खोल सकती है.

title: IIT धारवाड़ ने बनाया सेना के लिए खास बंकर, AK-47 की गोलियां भी नहीं कर पाएंगी असर
description: IIT धारवाड़ ने भारतीय सेना की ईस्टर्न कमांड के साथ मिलकर इस बंकर को तैयार किया है. पुराने बंकर रेत, मिट्टी और कंक्रीट जैसी भारी चीजों से बनाए जाते हैं. इन्हें बनाने और एक जगह से दूसरी जगह ले जाने में काफी समय और मेहनत लगती है. इसके मुकाबले IIT धारवाड़ का नया बंकर खास तरह के मजबूत मटेरियल से बनाया गया है.
author: Samarth Saraswat
content:
भारतीय सेना के जवानों को सीमा पर कई बार ऐसी जगहों पर तैनात रहना पड़ता है, जहां भारी सामान पहुंचाना आसान नहीं होता. 
इस दौरान पहाड़ी और दूर-दराज के इलाकों में सुरक्षा के लिए बंकर बनाना भी बड़ी चुनौती होती है. इस समस्या को देखते हुए IIT धारवाड़ के रिसर्चर्स ने सेना के लिए एक खास हल्का बंकर तैयार किया है. इसकी खासियत यह है कि इसका वजन पुराने बंकरों के मुकाबले करीब 90% कम है और यह AK-47 राइफल की गोलियों का सामना भी कर सकता है. 
इस नए बंकर का वजन करीब 500 किलो है, जबकि रेत की बोरियों से बने सामान्य बंकर का वजन 5,000 किलो से ज्यादा हो सकता है.
भारतीय सेना के साथ मिलकर तैयार किया बंकर
IIT धारवाड़ ने भारतीय सेना की ईस्टर्न कमांड के साथ मिलकर इस बंकर को तैयार किया है. इस प्रोजेक्ट में पश्चिम बंगाल के पानागढ़ स्थित 6 इंजीनियर्स रेजिमेंट ने भी योगदान दिया है. इस प्रोजेक्ट के लिए करीब 29.53 लाख रुपए की राशि दी गई थी. इस पर काम 28 मार्च 2025 को शुरू हुआ और अक्टूबर 2025 तक इसका पहला मॉडल तैयार हो गया था.
खास मटेरियल से बना है बंकर
पुराने बंकर रेत, मिट्टी और कंक्रीट जैसी भारी चीजों से बनाए जाते हैं. इन्हें बनाने और एक जगह से दूसरी जगह ले जाने में काफी समय और मेहनत लगती है. इसके मुकाबले IIT धारवाड़ का नया बंकर खास तरह के मजबूत मटेरियल से बनाया गया है. 
इसका डिजाइन ऐसा है कि इसे छोटे-छोटे हिस्सों में ले जाया जा सकता है. जरूरत पड़ने पर इसे आसानी से जोड़ा और खोला भी जा सकता है. इससे उन इलाकों में काफी मदद मिल सकती है, जहां भारी मशीनें और कंस्ट्रक्शन मटेरियल पहुंचाना मुश्किल होता है.
AK-47 की गोलियों का किया सामना
बंकर तैयार होने के बाद सेना के जवानों ने इसका लाइव फायर टेस्ट किया. इस दौरान AK-47 राइफल से गोलियां चलाई गईं. IIT धारवाड़ के मुताबिक, बंकर इन टेस्टिंग में गोलियों का सामना करने में कामयाब रहा. हालांकि, भारी हथियारों, विस्फोटों और तोप के हमलों से ये कितने सुरक्षित हैं, इसको लेकर कोई जानकारी शेयर नहीं की है. टेस्टिंग के बाद ऐसे तीन बंकर तैयार करके सेना को भेजे गए हैं. जरूरत के हिसाब से इनके आकार में बदलाव भी किया जा सकता है.
IIT की टीम ने मिलकर किया काम
इस प्रोजेक्ट को IIT धारवाड़ के मैकेनिकल, मटेरियल्स और एयरोस्पेस इंजीनियरिंग विभाग ने तैयार किया है. इसमें असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर डॉ. व्योम शर्मा ने मुख्य भूमिका निभाई. वहीं, डॉ. पुन्नग चटर्जी को-प्रिंसिपल इन्वेस्टिगेटर रहे. इसके अलावा तकनीकी कर्मचारी कुलदीप सिंह, आनंद डोड्डामणि और संस्थान के चार छात्रों ने भी इस प्रोजेक्ट में योगदान दिया.
मुश्किल इलाकों में सेना को मिलेगी मदद
IIT धारवाड़ के इस नए बंकर से सेना को कई तरह से फायदा हो सकता है. कम वजन होने के कारण इसे पहाड़ी और दूर-दराज के इलाकों तक पहुंचाना आसान होगा. इसके साथ ही जरूरत पड़ने पर इसे जल्दी लगाया और हटाया जा सकेगा. यह खोज भारत में ही रक्षा से जुड़ी टेक्नोलॉजी डेवलप करने की दिशा में एक अहम कदम है. इससे यह भी पता चलता है कि देश के एजुकेशनल इंस्टीट्यूट सेना की जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए नई तकनीक तैयार करने में बड़ी भूमिका निभा रहे हैं.

title: Kerala semi-high-speed rail project may cost less than new tracks, says E Sreedharan
description: The proposed railway line would largely run on an elevated viaduct, reducing land acquisition requirements and allowing a narrower infrastructure design
author: Business Today Desk
content:
Speaking after delivering a lecture titled ‘High-Speed Rail for Keralam’, organised by the Kochi centre of the Institution of Engineers (India), Sreedharan said the project could be a more practical option than developing third and fourth railway lines across the state.
READ THIS: ‘How can this happen?’: Passenger gets berth 54 in AC 2-tier coach with only 52 berths
“The cost involved, the huge extent of land required and the time needed for completion make the third and fourth lines less viable. High-speed rail is a better alternative and can substantially reduce the need for additional railway lines,” he said, as reported by The New Indian Express.
Elevated corridor and solar power to reduce costs
The proposed railway line would largely run on an elevated viaduct, reducing land acquisition requirements and allowing a narrower infrastructure design. The project would use standard-gauge tracks designed for a 15-tonne axle load, compared with the 25-tonne axle load used by conventional broad-gauge railway lines.
Sreedharan has also proposed installing solar panels along both sides of the elevated corridor to meet the railway’s electricity requirements. According to his estimates, the arrangement could reduce operating and maintenance expenses by nearly one-third.
The proposed funding model envisages the Centre and Kerala government jointly contributing 60% of the capital expenditure, with the remaining 40% raised through crowdfunding. Sreedharan has also suggested equity-based crowdfunding as an option if the state faces difficulties arranging its share.
The proposed fare for the complete Thiruvananthapuram-Kannur journey is ₹800. The corridor would initially operate 12-coach trains at 30-minute intervals, with the frequency potentially increasing to one train every five minutes depending on passenger demand. Stations are proposed at intervals of approximately 25 km.
ALSO READ: India-Nepal ties get major boost: PM Modi announces ₹15,000-cr development package, eight pacts with PM Balen Shah
Sreedharan flags delay in government response
Despite outlining the project's potential benefits, Sreedharan expressed disappointment over the lack of a formal response from the state government to his interim report, submitted in May. He said an expert committee had also submitted its recommendations, but a decision remained pending.
“The project is the need of the hour for the state. The people are ready and have welcomed the project. But I have no idea why the state government is not taking proactive steps,” he said.

title: IAF to get first full Tejas Mk-1A squadron by March 2027 as HAL commits 16-18 jets
description: The IAF’s acceptance of the aircraft will be a key step towards getting the delayed Mk-1A programme into service.
author: Business Today Desk
content:
The Indian Air Force is set to get its first full squadron of Tejas LCA Mk-1A fighter jets by March 31, 2027, with Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd committing to deliver 16 to 18 aircraft by the deadline, even as the indigenous fighter programme remains nearly two years behind schedule, Hindustan Times reported on Monday.
The commitment came during a high-level review meeting at Air Headquarters last week, where the IAF said it was ready to accept the delayed aircraft without giving HAL any concessions on their required capabilities.
“All hardware-related issues with the indigenous fighter, including those linked to weapons trials, have been resolved. Remaining software-related issues, including those concerning the radar, are in the final stages of resolution,” one of the officials, who asked not to be named, told Hindustan Times.
Don't Miss: Air India to overhaul its senior management team; CEO Tewolde Gebremariam gets free hand to build team: Report
The IAF’s acceptance of the aircraft will be a key step towards getting the delayed Mk-1A programme into service. HAL will now begin the documentation process and approach the Bengaluru-based Centre for Military Airworthiness and Certification (CEMILAC) for the release to service document (RSD).
It will also seek the ‘signal-out certificate’ from the Directorate General of Aeronautical Quality Assurance, another official said.
These documents allow the user to operate a new air system within specified conditions and approved flight envelopes.
Those who attended the November 16 review meeting included IAF chief Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit and HAL chairman and managing director Ravi K.
HAL aims to deliver a full squadron of LCA Mk-1As to the IAF by March 31, without seeking any concessions on the aircraft’s capabilities, an HAL official said.

title: 'Skip the long commute, hear more cases': Bengal SIR tribunal may go WFH as 22 lakh voter appeals pile up
description: Bengal tribunal judges have been offered work from home as they hear deleted voters' appeals. The move could ease logistical constraints while the Supreme Court presses for priority hearings.
author: Business Today Desk
content:
The development follows the Supreme Court's direction to the Election Commission to prioritise appeals filed by deleted voters, particularly in Calcutta, Howrah and five other municipalities where civic polls are due.
Work-from-home option for judges
The tribunals currently operate from SPM-Niwas, a central government institute in Joka, around a kilometre beyond IIM Calcutta. Several judges have complained about the time spent commuting between their homes and the hearing centre.
“The judges have recently received calls from the state election commission via nodal officers for the tribunals. They were asked if they would be comfortable working from home,” a source in the tribunal said.
At least two judges have reportedly expressed willingness to work remotely, provided the Election Commission arranges adequate infrastructure and staff support.
“One judge, who has to spend four hours commuting between his home and Joka, said the WFH option was welcome, but it had to be backed up with adequate staff and their transportation to and from his home,” an official said.
Long commute, logistical hurdles slow hearings
The proposed arrangement is expected to address some of the logistical challenges limiting the number of appeals judges can hear each day.
A source attached to one of the 19 tribunals said a presiding judge could hear only 10 to 12 appeals daily, despite the best intentions, because of logistical constraints.
“The judge starts working around 11am. By 4.30pm, work gets wrapped up for the day because the staff have to leave. In between, some time is taken up during lunch,” the official added.
Currently, four buses ferry tribunal staff between Joka and Howrah, Sealdah, Baruipur and Diamond Harbour.
Supreme Court asks poll panel to prioritise deleted voters' appeals
On Monday, the Supreme Court directed the Election Commission to prioritise appeals filed by voters deleted from the electoral rolls over applications challenging the inclusion of names.
A bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant asked the poll panel to give precedence to appeals by excluded voters in Calcutta, Howrah and five other municipalities where civic elections are due.
During the hearing, advocate Prashant Bhushan told the bench that around 38 lakh appeals had been filed, of which only about one lakh had been disposed of by the tribunals. Re-inclusion orders were issued in around 93% of the applications against deletion that had been decided.
Of the total appeals, around 22 lakh were filed by voters challenging the removal of their names, while about 16 lakh challenged the inclusion of names. Most of the latter applications were filed by Election Commission officials. Tribunal officials said judges would, for now, hear only appeals against deletion.
Around one lakh appeals pending in Calcutta
Around one lakh appeals against exclusion remain pending across the 17 Assembly constituencies within the Kolkata Municipal Corporation area.
Retired Calcutta High Court Chief Justice T.S. Sivagnanam was initially entrusted with hearing appeals from Calcutta but stepped down in May. Justice (retired) Kanchan Chakraborty was subsequently assigned the cases but fell ill soon after taking charge. He resumed hearings earlier this month.

title: MEA issues clarification on showcause notice to Saurav Das over passport details, asks him not to travel- Moneycontrol.com
description: Jaiswal stressed that the notice provides the passport holder an opportunity to explain the discrepancies before the authorities take a decision.
content:
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) on Wednesday clarified why Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das was stopped from travelling to London, saying a showcause notice was issued to him over alleged discrepancies in his place of birth mentioned in his passport records.
Addressing a press conference, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai issued the notice to Das on November 23, asking him to submit an explanation within seven days. He was also advised not to use his passport until he had responded to the notice.
"The passport application process requires the applicant to provide accurate information. If, at any stage, a discrepancy is noted or reported by the authorities, amounting to a suppression of facts, we issue a show-cause notice to the applicant, allowing them to present their side of the matter," Jaiswal said.
Elaborating on the procedure, the MEA spokesperson said applicants are required to furnish correct information while filling out passport application forms. If authorities subsequently flag any discrepancy or inconsistency, the passport office follows the established procedure of seeking an explanation from the applicant.
"When an individual applies for a passport and fills out the application form, it is implicit that they must provide correct information. If we identify any shortcomings or discrepancies, brought to our attention by the authorities, the established procedure is to issue a show-cause notice to the applicant (or the passport holder)," he said.
Jaiswal stressed that the notice provides the passport holder an opportunity to explain the discrepancies before the authorities take a decision. The seven-day period will allow Das to submit his clarification to the RPO, following which the matter will be examined in accordance with the prescribed procedure.
The clarification comes after Das was stopped by immigration officials at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport on the night of November 23 while attempting to board a London-bound flight. He was scheduled to travel to the United Kingdom for a series of engagements, including a panel discussion organised by the Oxford Union.
As per reports, the discrepancy concerns the place of birth mentioned in Das's passport and other official documents. Government sources said his passport incorrectly listed Chennai as his place of birth while discrepancies were flagged in his birth particulars across documents, including his Aadhaar card, birth certificate and school certificate. These reportedly involved his date of birth and father's name as well.
Das's passport was issued by the Regional Passport Office in Chennai on August 21, 2019. According to government sources, inputs received over the past few months prompted authorities to undertake fresh verification of the information and documents submitted with his passport application.
The RPO subsequently sought an explanation from Das regarding the alleged suppression of material facts and asked him to furnish supporting documents. The notice reportedly warns that failure to provide a satisfactory explanation could lead to further action, including impounding of his passport.
Under the Passports Act, 1967, passport authorities can impound or revoke a passport on specified grounds, including furnishing incorrect information or suppressing material information while obtaining the document.
Why was Saurav Das travelling to the UK?
Das had planned to visit the United Kingdom for engagements involving Oxford, Cambridge, the London School of Economics and Edinburgh, where he was expected to speak about the 'Cockroach Movement' associated with the CJP.
In a post on X, Das accused the government of preventing him from travelling, alleging that it was afraid of him speaking at prestigious institutions. He described the action as an attempt to silence him and questioned why discrepancies had surfaced seven years after his passport was issued.
The passport controversy has now reached the courts. Das moved the Delhi High Court on Wednesday challenging the action that prevented him from travelling to the UK. His lawyer sought an urgent hearing, saying immigration officials had stopped him without showing him an order. The court agreed to hear the matter on November 26.
The development also comes against the backdrop of a separate public interest litigation before the Madras High Court seeking an investigation into Das's background and questioning the validity of his passport and Aadhaar card. The petition has raised allegations concerning his family background and citizenship, which remain separate from the RPO's ongoing verification process.
Jaiswal, meanwhile, maintained that the show-cause notice was part of the established procedure followed when discrepancies are brought to the passport authorities' attention. He said applicants are given an opportunity to explain inconsistencies before the authorities take a decision.

title: 'Matter between Bangladesh govt and her': MEA on Sheikh Hasina's extradition request and return- Moneycontrol.com
description: Hasina plans to return home on December 16, the day the country celebrates its victory over Pakistan in the 1971 Liberation War, says her spokesperson Syed Mozammel Ali
content:
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) on Wednesday said Bangladesh's request for the extradition of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina was being examined in accordance with the established process.
The ministry also clarified that the case of a citizen willing to return voluntarily was separate from the extradition request, distinguishing between a voluntary return and a formal extradition process.
“It is a matter between Sheikh Hasina and the Government of Bangladesh,” MEA said, responding to her announcement of a return on December 16.
Hasina plans to return home on December 16, the day the country celebrates its victory over Pakistan in the 1971 Liberation War, her spokesperson Syed Mozammel Ali said on Tuesday.
Hasina, 79, has also asked the Bangladesh government to arrange her air travel from New Delhi on the national carrier, her spokesperson said in a statement.
The statement has triggered strong reactions in Dhaka with the government saying that she would be brought back "in handcuffs" and treated under the same laws applicable to any other convicted fugitive staying abroad.
Hasina’s spokesperson Ali said she had requested the necessary travel documents from the Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi through communications sent by her lawyer on November 9 and 19.
"She has further indicated that her return will be on Bangladesh's Victory Day on December 16th, coinciding with the end of the Liberation War in 1971. Sheikh Hasina has insisted that she would return on the flag carrier of Bangladesh, Biman Airlines," Ali said in the statement shared with PTI.
"Since Sheikh Hasina was flown to India on a Bangladesh aircraft on August 5, 2024, she now calls upon the Government to arrange for her air transport from Delhi back to Dhaka," he said.
Ali said the government had a responsibility to facilitate her return, alleging that she had been exiled in violation of the Constitution.
"Having exiled her contrary to the Constitution under such circumstances, it is now the responsibility of the Government to make possible her return to Bangladesh on Victory Day on December 16," he said.
Hasina has been living in India since fleeing Bangladesh on August 5, 2024, following a student-led uprising that toppled her 15-year government. In November 2025, Hasina was sentenced to death in absentia for crimes against humanity over the 2024 crackdown on protesters.

title: Karnataka’s Namma Clinic doctors, staff await four months’ salaries; warn of impact on healthcare services- Moneycontrol.com
description: Healthcare workers across Karnataka allege that salaries have remained unpaid for four months, raising concerns over staff retention and the delivery of primary healthcare services.
content:
Doctors and other healthcare workers employed at Karnataka’s Namma Clinics have sought government intervention over four months of unpaid salaries, warning that prolonged delays could affect healthcare delivery.
Employees said they had continued providing services despite not receiving their monthly remuneration.
"We have not received our salaries for the last four months. The authorities have told us that payments may be made in February, which would mean waiting for six months. We have continued performing our duties despite not receiving our salaries," a medical officer told Moneycontrol.
Around 470 Namma Clinics are operational across Karnataka, including 250 in Bengaluru. Each clinic is expected to have five personnel: a medical officer, staff nurse, laboratory technician, junior health inspector and a Group D employee.
Doctors receive monthly salaries ranging from Rs 60,000 to Rs 75,000, while staff nurses earn between Rs 18,000 and Rs 21,000. Salaries for other categories of employees range from Rs 14,000 to Rs 21,000, employees said.
The delay has caused financial hardship, with workers struggling to meet household expenses, pay rent and service loan repayments.
"Many of us have submitted representations individually and collectively to the health department and local MLAs. However, there is no clarity on when the pending salaries will be released," another employee said.
Moneycontrol reached out to Karnataka Health Minister UT Khader and National Health Mission officials, including director Akram Pasha, for comments. Their responses are awaited.
Staff seek intervention over pending dues
Apart from the release of four months' salaries, employees have sought an explanation for the delay and an assurance of timely payments. They have also flagged arrears and incentives allegedly pending for nearly two years. Their other demands include a 10 percent salary increment for employees who have completed three years of service.
Doctors said prolonged uncertainty over salary payments could affect employee morale and make it difficult to retain qualified medical professionals, disrupting the delivery of primary healthcare services.
Namma Clinics operate under NUHM
Namma Clinic programme is part of Karnataka's urban primary healthcare framework and is implemented under National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).
In July 2022, the then Karnataka government, led by Basavaraj Bommai, approved Rs 103.73 crore for establishing 438 Urban Health and Wellness Centres, branded as Namma Clinics.
The clinics were designed to provide basic consultations, medicines, diagnostic services and screening for non-communicable diseases. They also serve as the first point of contact for urban residents, referring patients requiring specialised treatment to higher healthcare facilities.

title: కాంగ్రెస్‌-ఎస్పీ పొత్తు.. అమేథీ, రాయ్‌బరేలీతో అసలు సమస్య..
description: ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్‌ అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల నేపథ్యంలో కాంగ్రెస్, సమాజ్‌వాదీ పార్టీ (ఎస్పీ) మధ్య సీట్ల పంపకం రోజురోజుకూ ఆసక్తికరంగా మారుతోంది. వచ్చే ఏడాది జరగనున్న అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల్లో కలిసి పోటీ చేయాలని భావిస్తున్న ఈ రెండు పార్టీలు సీట్ల విషయంలో మాత్రం ఏకాభిప్రాయానికి రాలేకపోతున్నాయి.
author: ABN
content:
కాంగ్రెస్‌-ఎస్పీ పొత్తు.. అమేథీ, రాయ్‌బరేలీతో అసలు సమస్య..
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 25 , 2026 | 06:31 PM
ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్‌ అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల నేపథ్యంలో కాంగ్రెస్, సమాజ్‌వాదీ పార్టీ (ఎస్పీ) మధ్య సీట్ల పంపకం రోజురోజుకూ ఆసక్తికరంగా మారుతోంది. వచ్చే ఏడాది జరగనున్న అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల్లో కలిసి పోటీ చేయాలని భావిస్తున్న ఈ రెండు పార్టీలు సీట్ల విషయంలో మాత్రం ఏకాభిప్రాయానికి రాలేకపోతున్నాయి.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్‌ అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల నేపథ్యంలో కాంగ్రెస్, సమాజ్‌వాదీ పార్టీ (ఎస్పీ) మధ్య సీట్ల పంపకం రోజురోజుకూ ఆసక్తికరంగా మారుతోంది. వచ్చే ఏడాది జరగనున్న అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల్లో కలిసి పోటీ చేయాలని భావిస్తున్న ఈ రెండు పార్టీలు సీట్ల విషయంలో మాత్రం ఏకాభిప్రాయానికి రాలేకపోతున్నాయి. ఇప్పటికే సహరాన్‌పూర్ నియోజకవర్గాల విషయంలో ఇరు పార్టీల మధ్య విభేదాలు బయటపడ్డాయి. ఇక అమేథీ, రాయ్‌బరేలీ స్థానాలు ఈ పొత్తకు మరో పెద్ద సమస్యగా మారే సూచనలు కనిపిస్తున్నాయి (Congress Samajwadi Party Alliance).
అమేథీ, రాయ్‌బరేలీ ప్రాంతాల్లోని మొత్తం పది అసెంబ్లీ స్థానాలపై కాంగ్రెస్ కన్నేసింది. ఈ రెండు లోక్‌సభ నియోజకవర్గాలు గాంధీ కుటుంబానికి రాజకీయంగా ఎంతో ప్రాధాన్యం కలిగిన ప్రాంతాలు. 2024 లోక్‌సభ ఎన్నికల్లో అమేథీ నుంచి కాంగ్రెస్ నేత కిషోరీ లాల్ శర్మ, రాయ్‌బరేలీ నుంచి రాహుల్ గాంధీ విజయం సాధించారు. ఈ రెండు లోక్‌సభ నియోజకవర్గాల పరిధిలోని మొత్తం పది అసెంబ్లీ స్థానాలనూ తమకు కేటాయించాలని కాంగ్రెస్ కోరుతున్నట్లు సమాచారం. గత అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల్లో ఈ నియోజకవర్గాల్లో కాంగ్రెస్ ఒక్క స్థానంలోనూ గెలవలేదు (Congress SP Seat Sharing).
అమేథీలోని నాలుగు స్థానాల్లో రెండింటిని, రాయ్‌బరేలీలోని ఆరు స్థానాల్లో నాలుగింటిని ఎస్పీ గెలుచుకుంది. మిగిలిన నాలుగు స్థానాల్లో బీజేపీ విజయం సాధించింది. అందుకే గత ఎన్నికల్లో తాము గెలిచిన స్థానాలను కాంగ్రెస్‌కు కేటాయించడానికి ఎస్పీ నాయకత్వం వెనుకాడుతోంది. ఈ నేపథ్యంలో రాహుల్, అఖిలేష్ యాదవ్ నేరుగా చర్చలు జరిపే అవకాశం కనబడుతోంది (INDIA Alliance).
కాగా, ఇప్పటికే సహరాన్‌పూర్ అసెంబ్లీ స్థానం గురించి వివాదం మొదలైంది (UP Assembly Elections 2027). యూపీ కాంగ్రెస్ కార్యనిర్వాహక అధ్యక్షుడు, ఎంపీ ఇమ్రాన్ మసూద్ సహరాన్‌పూర్ స్థానాన్ని ఆశించారు. అయితే పొత్తు చర్చలు కొనసాగుతుండగానే ఎస్పీ తన ఐదుగురు అభ్యర్థులతో తొలి జాబితాను ప్రకటించింది. ఇందులో సహరాన్‌పూర్ ప్రాంతంలోని స్థానాలు కూడా ఉండటంతో కాంగ్రెస్ వర్గాల్లో అసంతృప్తి వ్యక్తమైంది. తమను సంప్రదించకుండా అభ్యర్థులను ప్రకటించడంపై కాంగ్రెస్ నేతలు అభ్యంతరం వ్యక్తం చేస్తున్నారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి..
ఆకాశంలో వెండివెన్నెల.. హిమాలయాల మధ్య చంద్రోదయం.. వీడియో వైరల్..
తిరుపరంకుండ్రం కొండపై దీపం వివాదం.. వందేళ్ల క్రితం అసలేం జరిగిందంటే..

title: హిందూ మహాసముద్రం దేశాలను కలిపే వారధిగా ఉండాలి: అజిత్ డోభాల్
description: హిందూ మహాసముద్ర ప్రాంత దేశాల మధ్య వ్యూహాత్మక సహకారం మరింత బలోపేతం కావాలని జాతీయ భద్రతా సలహాదారు (ఎన్‌ఎస్‌ఏ) అజిత్ డోభాల్ పిలుపునిచ్చారు. ఈ ప్రాంతం దేశాలను విభజించేదిగా కాకుండా, కలిపే వారధిగా నిలవాలని బుధవారం ఆయన స్పష్టం చేశారు.
author: ABN
content:
హిందూ మహాసముద్రం దేశాలను కలిపే వారధిగా ఉండాలి: అజిత్ డోభాల్
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 25 , 2026 | 06:11 PM
హిందూ మహాసముద్ర ప్రాంత దేశాల మధ్య వ్యూహాత్మక సహకారం మరింత బలోపేతం కావాలని జాతీయ భద్రతా సలహాదారు (ఎన్‌ఎస్‌ఏ) అజిత్ డోభాల్ పిలుపునిచ్చారు. ఈ ప్రాంతం దేశాలను విభజించేదిగా కాకుండా, కలిపే వారధిగా నిలవాలని బుధవారం ఆయన స్పష్టం చేశారు.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: హిందూ మహాసముద్ర ప్రాంత దేశాల మధ్య వ్యూహాత్మక సహకారం మరింత బలోపేతం కావాలని జాతీయ భద్రతా సలహాదారు (ఎన్‌ఎస్‌ఏ) అజిత్ డోభాల్ పిలుపునిచ్చారు. ఈ ప్రాంతం దేశాలను విభజించేదిగా కాకుండా, కలిపే వారధిగా నిలవాలని బుధవారం ఆయన స్పష్టం చేశారు. మాల్దీవుల రాజధాని మాలెలో జరుగుతున్న 8వ ‘కొలంబో సెక్యూరిటీ కాన్‌క్లేవ్’ (సీఎస్‌సీ) జాతీయ భద్రతా సలహాదారుల సమావేశంలో డోభాల్ పాల్గొన్నాను.
జాతీయ భద్రతా సలహాదారుల సమావేశంలో అజిత్ డోభాల్ ప్రసంగిస్తూ.. మారుతున్న భద్రతా సవాళ్లను సమష్ఠిగా ఎదుర్కొనేందుకు భాగస్వామ్య దేశాల సామర్థ్యాన్ని పెంచడానికి భారత్ కట్టుబడి ఉందని పేర్కొన్నారు. ఈ వేదికను భారత్ ‘నైబర్‌హుడ్ ఫస్ట్’ విధానంతో పాటు ప్రధాని నరేంద్ర మోదీ ‘మహాసాగర్’ దార్శనికతతో అనుసంధానించారు. సముద్ర భద్రత, ఉగ్రవాద కట్టడి, అక్రమ రవాణా నియంత్రణ, సైబర్ భద్రత, విపత్తు సహాయం వంటి ఐదు కీలక స్తంభాల ఆధారంగా సీఎస్‌సీ పనిచేస్తోంది. భారత్, మాల్దీవులు, శ్రీలంక, మారిషస్, బంగ్లాదేశ్, సీషెల్స్ ఈ కూటమిలో భాగంగా ఉన్నాయి.హిందూ మహాసముద్రంలో చైనా తన ఆర్థిక, దౌత్య, నావికా ప్రభావాన్ని విస్తరిస్తున్న నేపథ్యంలో డోభాల్ వ్యాఖ్యలు ప్రాధాన్యం సంతరించుకున్నాయి.
అంతర్జాతీయ వాణిజ్యం, ఇంధన రవాణాకు కీలకమైన ఈ ప్రాంతంలో ద్వీప దేశాలు, పొరుగు దేశాలతో సమష్ఠి భద్రతా వ్యవస్థను నిర్మించేందుకు భారత్ కృషి చేస్తోంది.మరోవైపు సదస్సు సందర్భంగా మంగళవారం మాల్దీవుల రక్షణ, జాతీయ భద్రతా శాఖ మంత్రి హసన్ రషీద్‌తో డోభాల్ భేటీ అయ్యారు. ఇరు దేశాల మధ్య రక్షణ, భద్రతా సహకారాన్ని బలోపేతం చేయడంపై చర్చించారు. మాల్దీవుల అధ్యక్షుడు మహ్మద్ మొయిజ్జు ఇటీవల పాకిస్థాన్‌లో పర్యటించి రక్షణ, సముద్ర సహకారం సహా పలు ఒప్పందాలు చేసుకున్నారు. ఈ నేపథ్యంలో.. న్యూఢిల్లీ, మాలె మధ్య జరిగిన ఈ ఉన్నత స్థాయి భేటీ దౌత్యపరంగా కీలకంగా మారిందని రాజకీయ విశ్లేషకులు అభిప్రాయపడుతున్నారు.

title: మీరట్‌లో షాకింగ్ ఘటన.. నడిరోడ్డుపై యువతిని ఈడ్చుకెళ్లిన మాజీ ప్రియుడు!
description: ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్‌లోని మీరట్‌లో షాకింగ్ ఘటన చోటు చేసుకుంది. హోటల్ గదిలోనే సోమవారం రాత్రంతా నిర్భంధించిన తన మాజీ ప్రియుడి చెర నుంచి ఓ యువతి తప్పించుకుంది. హోటల్ నుంచి ‘హెల్ప్.. హెల్ప్’ అంటూ బయటకు పరుగులు తీసింది.
author: ABN
content:
మీరట్‌లో షాకింగ్ ఘటన.. నడిరోడ్డుపై యువతిని ఈడ్చుకెళ్లిన మాజీ ప్రియుడు!
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 25 , 2026 | 02:45 PM
ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్‌లోని మీరట్‌లో షాకింగ్ ఘటన చోటు చేసుకుంది. హోటల్ గదిలోనే సోమవారం రాత్రంతా నిర్భంధించిన తన మాజీ ప్రియుడి చెర నుంచి ఓ యువతి తప్పించుకుంది. హోటల్ నుంచి ‘హెల్ప్.. హెల్ప్’ అంటూ బయటకు పరుగులు తీసింది.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్‌లోని మీరట్‌లో షాకింగ్ ఘటన చోటుచేసుకుంది. ఓ యువతిని ఆమె మాజీ ప్రియుడు హోటల్ గదిలో రాత్రంతా నిర్బంధించాడు. సోమవారం రాత్రి నుంచి అతడి చెరలో ఉన్న యువతి.. మరుసటిరోజు ఎలాగోలా తప్పించుకుని హోటల్ నుంచి బయటకు పరుగులు తీసింది. ‘హెల్ప్.. హెల్ప్’ అంటూ కేకలు వేస్తూ సాయం కోసం వేడుకుంది. అయితే ఆమెను వెంబడించిన మాజీ ప్రియుడు పట్టుకుని తిరిగి హోటల్‌లోకి ఈడ్చుకెళ్లేందుకు ప్రయత్నించాడు. ఘజియాబాద్‌లోని సదర్ బజార్ ప్రాంతంలో చోటుచేసుకున్న ఈ ఘటనకు సంబంధించిన వీడియో ప్రస్తుతం సోషల్ మీడియాలో వైరల్‌ అవుతోంది.
సదరు యువతి కేకలు విన్న స్థానికులు ఆమెను కాపాడేందుకు హోటల్‌లోకి వెళ్లే ప్రయత్నం చేయగా.. సిబ్బంది అడ్డుకున్నట్లు ఆరోపణలు వచ్చాయి. ఈలోగా అక్కడ జనం భారీగా గుమిగూడటంతో యువతిని బంధించిన వ్యక్తి హోటల్ పైకప్పు ఎక్కి పరారయ్యాడు. ఈ వ్యవహారంపై స్పందించిన పోలీసులు.. ఘటనాస్థలికి వెళ్లి విచారణ చేపట్టారు. ఎలాంటి వివరాలు నమోదు చేయకుండానే ఆ వ్యక్తికి రూమ్ ఇచ్చినట్లు గుర్తించారు. దీంతో పోలీసులు హోటల్‌ను సీజ్ చేశారు.
కాగా బాధితురాలు ఘజియాబాద్‌కు చెందిన మహిళగా పోలీసులు గుర్తించారు. తనను హోటల్‌లో బంధించిన వ్యక్తి పేరు సల్మాన్ అని, అతడు మీరట్‌లోని కంకర్‌ఖేడా ప్రాంతానికి చెందినవాడని ఆమె తెలిపింది. సోమవారం నుంచి తనను హోటల్‌లోనే ఉంచాడని, తప్పించుకోవడానికి అవకాశం దొరకడంతో బయటకు పరుగులు తీసినట్లు ఫిర్యాదులో వెల్లడించింది. అయితే సల్మాన్‌తో తనకు రెండున్నరేళ్లుగా పరిచయం ఉందని, అతడు తనను కిడ్నాప్ చేయలేదని మహిళ పోలీసులకు చెప్పినట్లు సదర్ కాంట్ సర్కిల్ అధికారి సంజయ్ గుప్తా వెల్లడించారు. ఇద్దరూ హోటల్‌లో కలిసి ఉండగా.. వారి మధ్య తలెత్తిన ఓ వివాదం చివరకు ఘర్షణకు దారితీసినట్లు తెలిపారు. మహిళను సురక్షితంగా బయటకు తీసుకొచ్చిన పోలీసులు ఆమెను పోలీస్ స్టేషన్‌కు తరలించారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి:
ప్రియా సరోజ్‌కు రింకూ సింగ్‌ బర్త్‌డే విషెస్‌..
వైభవ్ సూర్యవంశీ పెను విధ్వంసం.. 28 సిక్సర్ల వీడియో వైరల్!

title: అర్ధరాత్రి సరదా.. తెల్లవారుజామున విషాదం.. బర్త్ డేనే డెత్ డే అయింది !
description:
మైహర్: మధ్యప్రదేశ్⁫లో విషాద ఘటన జరిగింది. మైహర్⁯లోని ఒక హోటల్⁭లో జబల్‌పూర్‌కు చెందిన 22 ఏళ్ల విద్యార్థిని సోమవారం(నవంబర్ 23, 2026)  తెల్లవారుజామున మృతి చెందింది. తన పుట్టినరోజు వేడుకలు జరుపుకోవడానికి ఆరుగురు స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఆమె హోటల్⁫కు వెళ్లినట్లు పోలీసులు తెలిపారు. జబల్‌పూర్‌కు చెందిన ఏడుగురు యువతీయువకులు సోమవారం తెల్లవారుజామున 3 గంటలకు మైహర్ చేరుకున్నారు.

A young girl went out with her friends without informing her family. The next morning, her family got the news of her death. She went to religious city Maihar to celebrate her 21st birthday with her boyfriend, elder sister, a female friend and some other boys. They booked three separate rooms in a hotel near Sharda Devi Temple. Around 4 AM, her health suddenly got worse. Her boyfriend informed others, and they rushed her to the hospital. But doctors declared her dead. When they tried to take her body away, hospital staff stopped them and informed the police. During police questioning, her boyfriend reportedly said that she had excessive bleeding from her private parts and was also vomiting. Police informed her family and sent the body for postmortem. An investigation is going on. Police and media have not revealed anyone’s identity yet.

— Pasha Nadeem (@PashaNadeem3) November 24, 2026

దేవీజీ రోడ్డులో ఉన్న ఆస్థా యాత్రి నివాస్ గెస్ట్ హౌస్‌లో మూడు రూమ్‌లు బుక్ చేసుకున్నారు. తెల్లవారుజామున 4 గంటల సమయంలో ఒక రూమ్‌లో ఉన్న విద్యార్థిని ఆరోగ్యం అకస్మాత్తుగా క్షీణించింది. వెంటనే ఆమె స్నేహితులు సివిల్ హాస్పిటల్‌కు తరలించారు. పరీక్షించిన డాక్టర్లు ఆమె అప్పటికే చనిపోయినట్లు ప్రకటించారు.

హాస్పిటల్ దగ్గర విద్యార్థిని మృతదేహాన్ని జబల్‌పూర్ తీసుకెళ్లే విషయంలో వివాదం జరిగింది. పోలీసులు రాకముందే మృతదేహాన్ని తమకు అప్పగించాలని ఆమె స్నేహితులు కోరారు. దీనికి డాక్టర్లు నిరాకరించారు. సమాచారం అందుకున్న కోత్వాలీ పోలీసులు హాస్పిటల్‌కు చేరుకొని మృతదేహాన్ని స్వాధీనం చేసుకున్నారు. అనంతరం పోస్ట్‌మార్టం కోసం మార్చురీకి తరలించారు. 

పోలీసులు ఈ ఘటనపై దర్యాప్తు ప్రారంభించారు. గెస్ట్ హౌస్‌లోని సీసీటీవీ ఫుటేజీని పరిశీలిస్తున్నారు. ఇందుకోసం డీవీఆర్‌ను స్వాధీనం చేసుకున్నారు. విద్యార్థినితో పాటు వచ్చిన ఇద్దరు యువతులు, నలుగురు యువకులను పోలీసులు ప్రశ్నిస్తున్నారు. మరణానికి గల కారణాలు ఇంకా తెలియాల్సి ఉందని పోలీసులు చెప్పారు.

A young girl went out with her friends without informing her family. The next morning, her family got the news of her death. She went to religious city Maihar to celebrate her 21st birthday with her boyfriend, elder sister, a female friend and some other boys. They booked three separate rooms in a hotel near Sharda Devi Temple. Around 4 AM, her health suddenly got worse. Her boyfriend informed others, and they rushed her to the hospital. But doctors declared her dead. When they tried to take her body away, hospital staff stopped them and informed the police. During police questioning, her boyfriend reportedly said that she had excessive bleeding from her private parts and was also vomiting. Police informed her family and sent the body for postmortem. An investigation is going on. Police and media have not revealed anyone’s identity yet.
