title: TVK Govt on Thin Ice as 6 Bypolls Loom, Allies Press Vijay on Issues
description: National | Tamil Nadu CM Vijay faces a majority test as six bypolls, alliance demands and controversies put his 117-member governing bloc under pressure.
author: PratidinTime National Desk
content:
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay met MLAs from the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) alliance and supporting parties, one party at a time, at his camp office in Chennai on Monday. His six-month-old minority government is under strain from a razor-thin House majority, six pending bypolls and a growing list of controversies.
The allies used the meetings to press for drought declaration in the Cauvery delta districts, compensation for farmers, drinking water measures and firmer action on law and order. CPI(M) MLAs also raised the allegation against TVK MLA C Arul Vignesh, who is accused of sending obscene messages to Kallakurichi district collector JE Padmaja. The MLA has denied it, calling it politically motivated, and Vijay reportedly promised to look into the matter. CPI MLAs sought a firm commitment to secularism over the Thiruparankundram dispute and said they received that assurance.
Numbers Behind the Worry
TVK won 108 seats in April, ten short of the 118 needed in the 234-member House. The death of Kolathur MLA VS Babu on November 19 brought it back to 108 after the party briefly touched 109 with two bypoll wins. With 228 sitting members, the majority mark is now 115. TVK and its governing partners, Congress (5), VCK (2) and IUML (2), together hold 117. The CPI, CPI(M) and MDMK back the government from outside.
Six seats are vacant. Kolathur and Tiruchirappalli East were won by TVK, and Vijay vacated the latter to retain Perambur. The other four, Perundurai, Ambasamudram, Viralimalai and Karur, were held by AIADMK MLAs S Jayakumar, E Subaya, C Vijayabaskar and M R Vijayabhaskar, who resigned and joined TVK. The bypolls are expected in the first fortnight of January 2027.
Once all six are filled, the House returns to 234, and the majority mark rises to 118. The governing bloc's 117 would then be one short. Even if TVK wins all six, it reaches only 114 on its own, so it still needs its allies. If it loses all six, the DMK and AIADMK gain ground and the government depends entirely on outside supporters. A DMK win in Kolathur could also bring former chief minister MK Stalin back to the House if the party fields him.
Mounting Pressure
The government is also dealing with the cancellation of the Parandur airport project and criticism over free cars for all 234 MLAs. It has faced flak over higher legislators' allowances and reported Deepavali gifts to ruling-party MLAs during a Mahabalipuram retreat. Vanniyarasu, a VCK minister, told reporters on Monday that no such gifts were given to his party's MLAs. Other issues include allegations that investment data was leaked to the Andhra Pradesh government, at least five to six prison and custody escapes, and criticism of Vijay's London trip.
The Supreme Court has allowed the Karthigai Deepam lamp to be lit at Thiruparankundram as a one-time measure, and the state has sought a review. The court also ruled against Tamil Nadu's plea for more Cauvery water, while Karnataka pushes ahead with the Mekedatu dam.

title: BJP, Akali Dal Reunite After Six Years Ahead Of 2027 Punjab Polls
description: NATIONAL | Reacting to the reunion, Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the alliance as a natural partnership and welcomed the Akali Dal back into the NDA.
author: PratidinTime News Desk
content:
The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) have announced an alliance for the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections, bringing the former partners together six years after their split over the now-repealed farm laws.
The announcement was made at a press conference in New Delhi on the occasion of Guru Nanak Dev Ji's Prakash Purab. BJP president Nitin Nabin, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal were present at the event.
Welcoming the Akali Dal's return to the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), Shah described the reunion as a significant development for Punjab.
"It is a matter of great happiness that NDA's oldest ally, the Akali Dal, is now back in the NDA," he said.
Shah also said Prime Minister Narendra Modi was happy with the development and viewed the alliance as a symbol of Hindu-Sikh brotherhood.
Recalling the long association between the two parties, Shah said the alliance would strengthen ties between the two communities not only in Punjab but across the country and the world.
Although the parties did not announce a seat-sharing arrangement, Shah indicated that the Akali Dal would have the leading position in the alliance, with the chief minister also coming from the Punjab-based party.
"Bada Bhai hi Chief Minister hota hai," Shah said, suggesting that the senior partner in the alliance would lead the government.
He added that the two parties would contest all 117 Assembly seats in Punjab.
According to sources, the BJP is likely to contest around 40 seats, nearly double the 23 seats it contested when the two parties were last together. The Akali Dal had traditionally contested 94 seats under their previous arrangement.
The BJP and SAD had fought the 2022 Punjab Assembly elections separately. The BJP won two seats, while the Akali Dal secured victories in three constituencies.
Shah also targeted the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government and the previous Congress government over the drug problem in Punjab. He reiterated his promise to make the state drug-free by December 2029.
The BJP and Akali Dal had shared a 24-year-old alliance before the regional party walked out in September 2020 over the three farm laws introduced by the Centre, which were subsequently repealed.
Reacting to the reunion, Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the alliance as a natural partnership and welcomed the Akali Dal back into the NDA.
In a post on X, Modi said the alliance would prioritise Punjab and the welfare of its people, expressing confidence that the partnership would emerge as the preferred choice of voters.
Putting Punjab and the welfare of Punjabis first! 
I am extremely delighted that the Shiromani Akali Dal returns to the NDA family and that too on the Parkash Purab of Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji. 
Ours is a natural alliance that will ensure Punjab gets pro-people governance that…
— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 24, 2026
He also recalled the role of former Prime Ministers Atal Bihari Vajpayee and LK Advani, along with former Punjab Chief Minister Parkash Singh Badal, in nurturing the alliance.
BJP president Nitin Nabin also termed the partnership a natural alliance and expressed confidence about its prospects in the upcoming Assembly elections.
Meanwhile, Sukhbir Singh Badal described the reunion as more than a political arrangement, calling it an emotional alliance for the welfare of Punjab.
He recalled that the partnership had originally been built by his father, Parkash Singh Badal, and former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
Targeting the AAP government, Badal alleged that the state administration was busy looting Punjab and claimed that the renewed BJP-Akali Dal partnership would work to save the state.

title: IndiGo Flight Diverts To Agartala After Passenger Falls Ill Mid-Air, Resumes Journey
description: National | An IndiGo flight travelling from Shanghai in China to Kolkata made an emergency landing at Maharaja Bir Bikram (MBB) Airport in Agartala on Tuesday morning after a passenger fell ill during the journey.
author: PratidinTime News Desk
content:
An IndiGo flight travelling from Shanghai in China to Kolkata made an emergency landing at Maharaja Bir Bikram (MBB) Airport in Agartala on Tuesday morning after a passenger fell ill during the journey.
According to reports, the flight landed at Agartala Airport at around 8:50 am following a medical emergency involving a passenger identified as Abhishek Singhal, a resident of Delhi. The passenger reportedly fell ill while the aircraft was en route to Kolkata, prompting the crew to divert the flight to Agartala to arrange immediate medical assistance.
Following the landing, medical assistance was arranged at the airport, and the passenger was shifted to ILS Hospital in Agartala for treatment.
The Airport Authority of India coordinated the emergency response to ensure that the passenger received timely medical attention.
According to the information available, Singhal was subsequently declared fit to travel after receiving medical attention. He later returned to the airport and boarded the same IndiGo flight.
The aircraft resumed its journey to Kolkata at around 10 am, following the brief halt in Agartala.
The emergency diversion was carried out to ensure that the passenger could receive medical care without delay. No further details regarding the nature of his medical condition were immediately available.
The incident highlights the emergency procedures followed by airlines when passengers require urgent medical attention during a flight.

title: Bisleri Denies Reports of Unsafe Drinking Water, Says Samples Were Within Permissible Limits
description: After reports emerged claiming that Bisleri water was unsafe for consumption, the company issued a clarification, rejecting the claims that its packaged drinking water failed FSSAI safety tests. |National | Top Stories|
author: DY365
content:
Bisleri Denies Reports of Unsafe Drinking Water, Says Samples Were Within Permissible Limits
After reports emerged claiming that Bisleri water was unsafe for consumption, the company issued a clarification, rejecting the claims that its packaged drinking water failed FSSAI safety tests.
New Delhi: Bisleri has dismissed media reports claiming that its packaged drinking water was found unfit for consumption in tests conducted by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).
In a clarification posted on X, the company said its water is safe for consumption and explained that the matter relates to a specific batch produced at its manufacturing unit in Goa in September 2025.
According to Bisleri, the FSSAI had collected six samples from the facility, of which five were found to be within the prescribed safety limits. However, the sixth sample recorded a bromate level of 12 micrograms per litre, slightly above the permissible limit of 10 micrograms per litre.
https://t.co/qOBmfxcYj9
— BisleriZone (@BisleriZone) November 23, 2026
Following this, Bisleri filed an appeal on November 22, 2025, and sent the sample to a referral laboratory for retesting. The laboratory found the bromate level to be within the prescribed limit but separately flagged the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in the sample.
Due to the difference in the test results, Bisleri arranged for the same sample to be tested at another FSSAI-approved laboratory. The test again found the bromate level to be within the permissible limit.
The company said it submitted the test report to the FSSAI's Western Regional Office along with a formal letter on February 2, 2026. However, it claimed that it received no further communication from the authority and considered the matter closed.
Bisleri also stated that the alleged notice could not be found on the FSSAI's official website. It maintained that no such notice had been issued declaring its drinking water unsafe for consumption.
The company has reiterated that its packaged drinking water is safe, rejecting the claims circulating in media reports.

title: Haryana: Two Army Soldiers Killed After Tank Runs Over Them During Military Drill
description: Two Army personnel were killed after a tank ran over them during a military exercise involving 32 tanks near Bhojraj village in Haryana's Hisar district on Saturday. |National | Top Stories|
author: DY365
content:
Haryana: Two Army Soldiers Killed After Tank Runs Over Them During Military Drill
Two Army personnel were killed after a tank ran over them during a military exercise involving 32 tanks near Bhojraj village in Haryana's Hisar district on Saturday.
New Delhi: Two Indian Army soldiers were killed after a tank accidentally ran over them during a routine military exercise in Haryana's Hisar district on Saturday.
The incident happened near Bhojraj village, where around 32 tanks were taking part in the exercise. Some soldiers were stationed on the ground during the drill.
According to the Hisar police, dust raised by the moving tanks made it difficult to see clearly. Due to poor visibility, the driver of one tank failed to notice the two soldiers and ran over them.
The deceased have been identified as Naik Manish Kumar from Shamli district and Naik Ankush Kumar from Badaun district, both in Uttar Pradesh.
Both soldiers suffered serious injuries and were rushed to the Military Hospital in Hisar. However, doctors declared them dead.
Senior Army officers were informed about the incident, and post-mortem examinations were conducted.
Manish Kumar belonged to a family of Army personnel. His father, Ramveer, is a retired Army soldier.
Meanwhile, Ankush Kumar was scheduled to go on leave on Sunday. His cousin, Amit Kumar, said Ankush had spoken to his children over the phone at around 2 pm on Saturday, shortly before the accident.

title: 4 Lakh Guests, 200 Horses and A Thar! Grand Wedding of Daughter of a Bihar MLA
description: Bihar MLA Anant Kumar Singh, popularly known as ‘Chote Sarkar’, is all set to host a grand wedding for his daughter Shivangi Singh on November 25. |Politics | National | Top Stories|
author: DY365
content:
4 Lakh Guests, 200 Horses and A Thar! Grand Wedding of Daughter of a Bihar MLA
Bihar MLA Anant Kumar Singh, popularly known as ‘Chote Sarkar’, is all set to host a grand wedding for his daughter Shivangi Singh on November 25.
Patna: Haven't we all heard of the term 'Big Fat Indian Wedding'? Well, let's talk about one Indian wedding that is not just big or fat, but one that is likely to be remembered for years to come, at least by the people of Bihar.
Anant Kumar Singh, MLA from the Mokama Assembly constituency in Bihar, is also popularly known as 'Chote Sarkar'. His younger daughter, Shivangi Singh, is set to tie the knot on November 25. His soon-to-be son-in-law, Rishikesh Kumar M, is a Commandant in the CRPF. But does the story end there? Well, far from it! Wondering why? Let's take a look!
Firstly, everyone is welcome at this wedding, whether you have an invitation or not, and whether you are from India or even Pakistan. Yes, you heard that right! "This is not a cinema hall where you need a ticket to enter," says Anant Singh.
A helipad is being constructed for guests, while a massive 25-acre area is being prepared for the wedding arrangements. Nearly 4 lakh guests are expected to be served food. And that's not all! A horse race is also being organised as part of the celebrations, with around 200 horses expected to participate. And what will the winner get? A Thar!
Several Bollywood celebrities are also expected to attend the wedding, including Sonu Sood. Classical singer and Bihar MLA from the Alinagar constituency, Maithili Thakur, is also expected to be present.
The internet is already flooded with pictures and videos from the wedding preparations, giving people a glimpse of the grand celebrations.
As Anant Singh gets ready to celebrate his daughter's wedding, all eyes are now on Bihar for what promises to be a truly grand and once-in-a-blue-moon kind of Indian wedding!

title: India Emerges as Asia's Rising Power, Narrowing Gap with China in 2026 Index
description: India has further strengthened its position as a major power in Asia, with the gap between India and China narrowing to its lowest level, according to the 2026 edition of the Asia Power Index released by Australia’s Lowy Institute.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
NEW DELHI: India has further strengthened its position as a major power in Asia, with the gap between India and China narrowing to its lowest level, according to the 2026 edition of the Asia Power Index released by Australia’s Lowy Institute. India’s overall score rose to 40.5, making it the only country in Lowy’s Major Power tier, behind the two superpowers, the US and China, and ahead of Japan, Russia and Australia.
The 2026 Asia Power Index assesses 27 countries and territories across 131 indicators, examining economic and military capabilities, diplomatic influence, defence partnerships and cultural reach. Launched in 2018, the index tracks the distribution of power across Asia and changes in the regional balance of influence.
India's growing diplomatic influence, stronger long-term economic prospects and expanding regional security partnerships have contributed to its rising stature. India ranked fourth when the index was first launched in 2018 and retained that position in 2023. It moved to third place in 2024 after overtaking Japan and has maintained the position for the third consecutive edition. In 2025, India crossed the 40-point threshold, regaining its status in Lowy’s Major Power category. (PIB)

title: MHA Issues Alert on WhatsApp Web: Cyber Threats Linked to Pakistan-Based Operatives
description: The Union Home Ministry’s nodal cyber security agency I4C has cautioned government functionaries against sharing sensitive information through WhatsApp Web sessions, a move that follows detection of suspicious activities of ‘Pakistan-based intelligence operatives’.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
NEW DELHI: The Union Home Ministry’s nodal cyber security agency I4C has cautioned government functionaries against sharing sensitive information through WhatsApp Web sessions, a move that follows detection of suspicious activities of ‘Pakistan-based intelligence operatives’.
The cybersecurity advisory cautioning against using WhatsApp Web for official or sensitive work follows a probe that revealed Pakistan-based intelligence operatives infiltrated over 50 defence-related WhatsApp groups, said an official source on Monday.
Advising government officials to avoid staying logged in on computers and laptops, the National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit (NCTAU), Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), warned that such sessions could be misused to take control of the account for fraud or phishing, said an official statement.
Sources said the Pakistan-based intelligence operatives used spoofed Indian numbers to join as ‘dead members’, monitoring chats in groups linked to the NSG, CRPF, commandos, and even DRDO without drawing attention. (IANS)

title: 5 Jan 2026 · 1 min read Northeast integration rally begins in Kolkata KOLKATA, 4 Jan: The Northeast integration rally began its journey from Kolkata (WB) on 4 January, setting the tone for a month-long initiative aimed at strengthening regional integration and people-to-people ties across…
description: KOLKATA, 4 Jan: The Northeast integration rally began its journey from Kolkata (WB) on 4 January, setting the tone for a month-long initiative aimed at strengthening regional integration and people-to-people ties across…
content:
KOLKATA, 4 Jan: The Northeast integration rally began its journey from Kolkata (WB) on 4 January, setting the tone for a month-long initiative aimed at strengthening regional integration and people-to-people ties across the Northeastern states.
The inaugural session was attended by a wide range of public representatives, professionals, cultural figures, and civil society members. Among those present were MLA AL Hek, Dumdum Municipal Corporation Vice Chairperson Lopamudra Dutta Choudhury, and others.
Speakers praised the initiative, describing it as a small but meaningful step that could grow into a larger movement for unity and understanding. Many shared personal and professional links with the Northeastern states, underlining the importance of sustained engagement between regions. The next leg of the rally will be held in Malda.
A cultural highlight of the event was a performance by K Bobin, who rendered the official title song of the rally.
During the session, speakers reiterated the rally’s objectives, which include promoting infrastructure development, expanding economic opportunities, encouraging cultural exchange, and deepening people-to-people engagement across states.
The rally also received a warm welcome at Panihati in Kolkata, where members of Udayer Pathe greeted the participants and expressed support for the Northeast integration rally and its objectives.
The rally’s pre-launch ceremony had been held on 24 December, 2025, at The Countryside Retreat in Lamshang, Imphal, formally marking the start of preparations for the 2026 edition.
Built around the central theme of peace, progress, and prosperity, the Northeast integration rally aims to draw attention to development, connectivity, and social cohesion across the region.
The rally is scheduled to conclude on 4 February.

title: YSRCP demands apology from Andhra Government over demolition of Abhaya Anjaneya Temple
description: The YSRCP on Wednesday demanded that the coalition government take responsibility for the demolition of the Abhaya Anjaneya Temple and apologise to the public, alleging that the centuries-old temple was demolished for road widening despite the possibility of realigning the road.
content:
Tadepalli (Andhra Pradesh) [India], November 25 (ANI): The YSRCP on Wednesday demanded that the coalition government take responsibility for the demolition of the Abhaya Anjaneya Temple and apologise to the public, alleging that the centuries-old temple was demolished for road widening despite the possibility of realigning the road.
Speaking to the media in Tadepalli, former Minister Vellampalli Srinivas and former MLA Malladi Vishnu said the demolition of the temple was unacceptable and demanded that the Endowments Department take responsibility for the decision.
They alleged that the demolition was not carried out in accordance with the prescribed Agama Shastra procedures, further adding to the sacrilege, and demanded that the government own up to its responsibility.
The YSRCP leaders also alleged that a series of untoward incidents had taken place under the coalition government at Tirupati, Srikalahasti, Srisailam, Simhachalam and Kasibugga, including stampedes, thefts and the deaths of cows. They alleged that neither the government nor the Temple Board had taken responsibility for these incidents.
They further alleged that Chandrababu Naidu had demolished temples in Vijayawada during the Krishna Pushkarams and said the YSRCP rebuilt them after coming to power.
The leaders also said that former Chief Minister YS Jagan Mohan Reddy had initiated the construction of thousands of temples through the Vani Trust, but the coalition government had stalled the process. (ANI)

title: "No place for falsehoods, propaganda, or confusion": Harivansh Narayan Singh cites Chandra Shekhar’s memoir over Rajiv Gandhi security row
description: Citing the memoir, Harivansh pointed out that security agencies had repeatedly flagged concerns over Rajiv Gandhi’s safety and urged him not to breach security protocols. According to the account shared by Harivansh, Chandra Shekhar personally advised Rajiv Gandhi on the matter and wrote to him twice, urging caution and adherence to security measures.
content:
Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh) [India], November 25 (ANI): Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh Narayan Singh on Wednesday pushed back against Rahul Gandhi’s allegations regarding the removal of security for his father and former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi, calling the controversy a "deeply tragic episode in Indian politics" and urging leaders in high positions to rely on verified facts rather than propaganda.
Speaking in Varanasi to ANI, Harivansh, who served as Additional Information Adviser in the Prime Minister’s Office during former Prime Minister Chandra Shekhar’s tenure, outlined what he described as key facts drawn from Chandra Shekhar’s autobiography, 'Chandra Shekhar: Zindagi Ka Karwan'.
"This is a deeply tragic episode in Indian politics. Those in positions of high authority should present only the truth and verified facts regarding such sensitive matters; there is no place for falsehoods, propaganda, or the creation of confusion among the public," Harivansh said.
Citing the memoir, Harivansh pointed out that security agencies had repeatedly flagged concerns over Rajiv Gandhi’s safety and urged him not to breach security protocols. According to the account shared by Harivansh, Chandra Shekhar personally advised Rajiv Gandhi on the matter and wrote to him twice, urging caution and adherence to security measures.
Harivansh further quoted Chandra Shekhar’s memoir as stating that Rajiv Gandhi’s own associates prioritised political gain over his security—encouraging direct public contact that led to breaches of security protocols. According to the passage cited, trusted aides established contact with the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) during the election period without informing security officials, receiving assurances of future cooperation that Rajiv Gandhi trusted despite repeated government intelligence warnings to the contrary. Chandra Shekhar wrote that Rajiv Gandhi was being deceived—a failure of assessment—before falling victim to a "human bomb."
Former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi was assassinated on May 21, 1991, at Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu, by a suicide bomber ("human bomb") linked to the LTTE.
Recalling the night of the assassination, Harivansh noted that Chandra Shekhar wrote of receiving the news while in Bhubaneswar, adding that he had travelled with the former prime minister that very night and witnessed his deep distress firsthand. "If we fail to present the authentic facts to the nation and instead sow confusion among the people for the sake of our own personal interests and selfish motives, could there be any greater injustice?" Harivansh asked.
The exchange revisits a long-running and politically sensitive chapter from India’s 1991 general election campaign. Chandra Shekhar served as Prime Minister from November 1990 to June 1991 with external support from the Congress party led by Rajiv Gandhi, before the government collapsed in 1991. Over the years, Congress leaders—including Rahul Gandhi—have alleged that the withdrawal of Special Protection Group (SPG) cover diluted Rajiv Gandhi’s security before his assassination on May 21, 1991, at Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu.
Official inquiry commissions, including the Justice JS Verma Commission and the Justice Milap Chand Jain Commission, examined security arrangements, intelligence alerts, and protocol breaches surrounding the assassination, noting that security norms were repeatedly bypassed or flouted during campaigning despite threat warnings. (ANI)

title: Delhi cafe gangrape case: Court grants 2 days’ police custody to one accused, sends two women to judicial custody
description: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (ACJM) Rinku Jain remanded the accused to 2 days' police custody. The court remanded 2 women accused to 14 days' judicial custody after considering the application moved by the investigating officer.
content:
New Delhi [India], November 25 (ANI): The Karkardooma Court in Delhi remanded one accused to 2 days' police custody. The women arrested in this case have been remanded to judicial custody by the court. 
They have been arrested in connection with the alleged gang rape committed by colleagues in a cafe in the Preet Vihar area.
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (ACJM) Rinku Jain remanded the accused to 2 days' police custody. The court remanded 2 women accused to 14 days' judicial custody after considering the application moved by the investigating officer.
The police are looking for other accused persons allegedly involved in this case. The accused will be produced before the court after 2 days of police custody.
A 22-year-old woman was allegedly gangraped by her colleagues at a cafe in East Delhi's Preet Vihar on Monday night. 
Police have arrested three people, including two women, in connection with the case, while three other suspects remain on the run. The survivor works at a cafe where the accused are also employed.
On Monday night, the survivor attended a party with her colleagues at Saltanate Cafe in Preet Vihar. The group continued drinking and dancing even after the cafe closed at 11:30 pm, as one of them had a key to the place. They left around 3:30 am on Tuesday. (ANI)

title: Parag, an initiative of Tata Trusts, announces its 2026 winners in children’s literature
description: The winners will receive their awards at the Parag Utsav to be held on November 27 at NCPA, Mumbai.
author: Scroll Staff
content:
Parag, an initiative of Tata Trusts, has announced its 2026 winners in children’s literature. They will receive their awards at the Parag Utsav to be held on November 27 at NCPA, Mumbai.
The winner of the Children’s Choice Award is Ghar Ka Rasta. It is written by Indrasen Pawar, a teenager from a denotified tribal community in Bhopal and was chosen the winner by more than 7,000 children across 156 libraries in 11 states and UTs.
Here is the complete list of winners:
- Parag Children’s Choice Award: Ghar Ka Rasta, Indrasen Pawar, illustrated by Gagan Holkar (Muskaan).
- Parag Author Prize (Kannada): Kannada writer K Shivalingappa Handihal, celebrated for chronicling the everyday lives of rural children.
- Parag Illustrator Prize: Shivam Choudhary (Bombay is Mumbai, Meera Mukherjee: Breaking Moulds).
- 7th Parag Honour List: 68 standout English and Hindi titles selected from 425 submissions nationwide.

title: 15 साल का युवा रैपर हिप-हॉप के जरिए उठाएगा संविधान और अधिकारों की आवाज, ‘SAVIDHAN AWAAZ-E-HAQ’ करेंगे लांच
description: महाराष्ट्र के छत्रपति संभाजीनगर के राज भीमराव गायकवाड़ ने तैयार किया अनूठा संगीत प्रोजेक्ट; संविधान निर्माण, डॉ. आंबेडकर की विरासत और मौजूदा सामाजिक-राजनीतिक परिस्थितियों को हिप-हॉप के जरिए सामने लाने की कोशिश।
author: Ankit Pachauri
content:
मुंबई। संगीत की दुनिया में हिप-हॉप को अक्सर युवा पीढ़ी की अभिव्यक्ति, मनोरंजन और विरोध के एक माध्यम के रूप में देखा जाता है। लेकिन महाराष्ट्र के छत्रपति संभाजीनगर के 15 वर्षीय स्वतंत्र रैपर राज भीमराव गायकवाड़ इस विधा के जरिए एक अलग तरह की पहल करने की तैयारी में हैं। पेशेवर रूप से RBGKALAKAAR के नाम से पहचाने जाने वाले राज भारतीय संविधान, सामाजिक न्याय और डॉ. बी.आर. आंबेडकर की विरासत को केंद्र में रखकर एक विशेष हिप-हॉप प्रोजेक्ट विकसित कर रहे हैं।
इस प्रोजेक्ट का नाम है ‘SAVIDHAN AWAAZ-E-HAQ: REVOLUTION OF 1950’। इसका उद्देश्य संविधान के ऐतिहासिक महत्व, उसके निर्माण और अंगीकरण की प्रक्रिया, समय के साथ हुए संवैधानिक बदलावों और संविधान में निहित आदर्शों को संगीत के माध्यम से लोगों तक पहुंचाना है।
राज अपने स्वतंत्र क्रिएटिव प्लेटफॉर्म ‘RBG UNIVERSE’ के तहत इस प्रोजेक्ट पर काम कर रहे हैं। कम उम्र में संविधान जैसे गंभीर और व्यापक विषय को हिप-हॉप के माध्यम से प्रस्तुत करने की उनकी कोशिश इसे एक अलग तरह की रचनात्मक पहल बनाती है।
संविधान की कहानी को संगीत के जरिए लोगों तक पहुंचाने की कोशिश
राज के मुताबिक, यह प्रोजेक्ट केवल संगीत तैयार करने तक सीमित नहीं है। इसके केंद्र में भारतीय संविधान का ऐतिहासिक सफर और उससे जुड़े सामाजिक सवाल हैं। वह संविधान के निर्माण, उसके अंगीकरण, संवैधानिक बदलावों और डॉ. बी.आर. आंबेडकर की भूमिका एवं विरासत को अपनी रचनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति का हिस्सा बनाना चाहते हैं।
प्रोजेक्ट में एक महत्वपूर्ण पहलू संविधान के आदर्शों और मौजूदा राजनीतिक एवं सामाजिक वास्तविकताओं के बीच के अंतर को सामने लाना भी है।
संविधान प्रत्येक नागरिक को समानता, स्वतंत्रता, न्याय और गरिमा के सिद्धांतों से जोड़ता है। लेकिन इन संवैधानिक मूल्यों का वास्तविक जीवन में कितना प्रभाव दिखाई देता है, यह सवाल आज भी सामाजिक विमर्श का हिस्सा है। राज इसी अंतर को संगीत और हिप-हॉप की भाषा में अभिव्यक्त करने का प्रयास कर रहे हैं।
डॉ. आंबेडकर की विरासत को नई पीढ़ी तक पहुंचाने की पहल
इस प्रोजेक्ट में डॉ. भीमराव आंबेडकर की विरासत को विशेष स्थान दिया गया है। भारतीय संविधान के निर्माण में उनकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका और सामाजिक समानता के लिए उनके विचार आज भी सार्वजनिक विमर्श का हिस्सा हैं।
राज का यह प्रोजेक्ट इसी ऐतिहासिक विरासत को युवा पीढ़ी की रचनात्मक भाषा से जोड़ने की कोशिश करता है। हिप-हॉप की खासियत यह है कि इसमें कलाकार अपने अनुभवों, विचारों और सामाजिक सवालों को सीधे शब्दों और संगीत के जरिए व्यक्त कर सकते हैं।
ऐसे में संविधान जैसे विषय को इस विधा में प्रस्तुत करना युवाओं के बीच संवैधानिक अधिकारों, सामाजिक न्याय और लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों पर बातचीत का एक नया माध्यम बन सकता है।
महाराष्ट्र के छत्रपति संभाजीनगर के 15 वर्षीय युवा रैपर राज भीमराव गायकवाड़ संविधान की बात अब हिप-हॉप के जरिए लोगों तक पहुंचाने की तैयारी में हैं। पेशेवर रूप से RBGKALAKAAR के नाम से पहचाने जाने वाले राज ने भारतीय संविधान पर आधारित आठ गानों का एल्बम तैयार किया है। ‘SAVIDHAN AWAAZ-E-HAQ: REVOLUTION OF 1950’ नाम से तैयार यह एल्बम 26 नवंबर को संविधान दिवस के अवसर पर रिलीज किया जाएगा। इसमें संविधान के निर्माण और ऐतिहासिक सफर, संवैधानिक बदलावों, डॉ. बी.आर. आंबेडकर की विरासत और सामाजिक न्याय जैसे विषयों को शामिल किया गया है।
द मूकनायक से बातचीत में राज ने बताया कि इस रैप को लिखने का मुख्य उद्देश्य संविधान की जानकारी अधिक से अधिक लोगों तक पहुंचाना है। वह चाहते हैं कि युवा पीढ़ी संविधान, अपने अधिकारों और उसमें निहित समानता, स्वतंत्रता, न्याय और बंधुता जैसे मूल्यों को समझे। राज अपने स्वतंत्र क्रिएटिव प्लेटफॉर्म RBG UNIVERSE के तहत इस प्रोजेक्ट पर काम कर रहे हैं। उनका प्रयास है कि हिप-हॉप जैसी लोकप्रिय संगीत विधा को केवल मनोरंजन तक सीमित न रखते हुए सामाजिक जागरूकता और संवैधानिक विचारों की अभिव्यक्ति का माध्यम बनाया जाए।
15 साल की उम्र में स्वतंत्र रचनात्मक पहचान बनाने की कोशिश
राज भीमराव गायकवाड़ महाराष्ट्र के छत्रपति संभाजीनगर से हैं और RBGKALAKAAR के नाम से अपनी पहचान बना रहे हैं। वह किसी बड़े संगीत संस्थान या स्थापित म्यूजिक लेबल के बजाय अपने स्वतंत्र क्रिएटिव प्लेटफॉर्म RBG UNIVERSE के माध्यम से काम कर रहे हैं।
उनका आगामी प्रोजेक्ट इस बात की ओर भी ध्यान खींचता है कि युवा कलाकार अब केवल मनोरंजन तक सीमित नहीं रहना चाहते, बल्कि सामाजिक और संवैधानिक विषयों को भी अपनी कला का हिस्सा बना रहे हैं।
हालांकि, इस प्रोजेक्ट की वास्तविक पहुंच और प्रभाव उसके संगीत, गीतों की विषयवस्तु और प्रस्तुति के बाद ही सामने आएगा। फिलहाल इसकी अवधारणा भारतीय संविधान को युवा संस्कृति और समकालीन संगीत से जोड़ने की एक रचनात्मक कोशिश के रूप में देखी जा सकती है।
क्या हिप-हॉप बन सकता है संवैधानिक चेतना का माध्यम?
भारत में संविधान और उसके मूल्यों पर चर्चा अक्सर शैक्षणिक संस्थानों, राजनीतिक मंचों, सामाजिक आंदोलनों और सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रमों तक सीमित रह जाती है। ऐसे में संगीत जैसी लोकप्रिय विधा के जरिए इन विषयों को प्रस्तुत करना युवाओं के साथ संवाद स्थापित करने का एक विकल्प हो सकता है।
इस प्रोजेक्ट के जरिए राज भीमराव गायकवाड़ संविधान को केवल एक कानूनी दस्तावेज के रूप में नहीं, बल्कि सामाजिक जीवन, अधिकारों और समानता से जुड़े व्यापक विमर्श के रूप में प्रस्तुत करना चाहते हैं।
द मूकनायक की प्रीमियम और चुनिंदा खबरें अब द मूकनायक के न्यूज़ एप्प पर पढ़ें। Google Play Store से न्यूज़ एप्प इंस्टाल करने के लिए यहां क्लिक करें.
'द मूकनायक' जनवादी पत्रकारिता करता है. यह संविधान, लोकतंत्र और सामाजिक न्याय पर चलने वाला मीडिया समूह है। अगर आप भी चाहते हैं कि 'द मूकनायक' हमेशा हाशिए पर खड़े लोगों की आवाज बुलंद करता रहे, बेजुबानों की पीड़ा दिखाते रहें तो सब्सक्राइब करें।

title: V S Babu, who ended Stalin's 15-year winning streak in Kolathur, passes away
description: TVK's Kolathur MLA V S Babu, who defeated M K Stalin in the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly election, dies in Chennai at 75.
author: Onmanorama Staff
content:
V S Babu, who ended Stalin's 15-year winning streak in Kolathur, passes away
Mail This Article
Chennai: Ruling TVK MLA V S Babu, who effected perhaps the biggest political shock of the April 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly elections by defeating DMK president and then chief minister, M K Stalin, died here on Thursday.
Babu (75), MLA of Kolathur constituency, was admitted to the MGM Healthcare here on September 9 with a prolonged respiratory illness and remained under intensive care.
"Despite comprehensive medical management and the best efforts of our multidisciplinary clinical team, his condition continued to deteriorate. He subsequently suffered a cardiac arrest and passed away at 2.24 pm on Thursday," Rajesh Agarwal, Director (Medical Services), said in an official statement.
Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar, Chief Minister and TVK founder C Joseph Vijay and DMK president M K Stalin were among the leaders who condoled Babu's death.
Expressing profound grief and sorrow over his passing, Arlekar conveyed his heartfelt condolences to the bereaved family members, friends and supporters.
Chief Minister Vijay visited the MLA's house in Perambur here and paid floral tributes to the mortal remains of Babu that were brought from the hospital in the evening for the public and party members to pay their last respects.
He expressed deep grief and anguish over Babu's demise, and termed his death an "irreparable loss". "The sudden passing of Mr V S Babu, who devoted himself entirely to public life, lived among the people as one of them, and earned everyone’s love, support and trust, is an irreplaceable loss. I extend my deepest condolences and sympathy to his family, relatives, friends, and TVK functionaries, and all the people of the Kolathur constituency, who are grieving his loss," Vijay said.
Stalin said he was saddened by the news of the passing of Babu, who days ago seemed to show an improvement in his health status.
Babu, who was formerly with the DMK, had defeated Stalin in the April 2026 Assembly election from Kolathur, securing 82,997 votes and winning by a margin of 8,795 votes. Stalin polled 74,202 votes.
Born V Sundarampillai Babu (1951-2026), he completed his schooling at Singarapillai Higher Secondary School in Villivakkam and lived in Sembiyam, Perambur. Known across North Chennai, from Ayanavaram and ICF to Purasawalkam and Jamalia, he built his reputation as an organisational strategist and booth-level campaign manager.
He had earlier served as MLA from the Purasawalkam Assembly constituency from 2006-11, representing the DMK then. He joined the AIADMK in 2016 and later the Vijay-led TVK in February 2026. He was popularly known in political circles as Purasai Babu.
Leader of the Opposition Udayanidhi Stalin, AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami, DMK deputy general secretary Kanimozhi, BJP state chief Nainar Nagenthran, former finance minister Thangam Thennarasu, PMK president Dr Anbumani Ramadoss, AMMK general secretary T T V Dhinakaran, NTK chief coordinator Seeman, former Governor Dr Tamilisai Soundararajan too, condoled his death.
Meanwhile, in a statement here, the TVK general secretary and Rural Development Minister N Anand said the party would observe mourning for seven days due to Babu's demise.
Further, he announced that all party events stood cancelled during the mourning period and that the party flag would be flown at half-mast.

title: PUC certificate validity extended to 3 years for newer BS VI private vehicles | Check new rules
description: The government revises PUC certificate validity, granting longer renewal periods for newer BS-VI private and transport vehicles.
author: Onmanorama Staff
content:
PUC certificate validity extended to 3 years for newer BS VI private vehicles | Check new rules
Mail This Article
The government has revised the validity periods of Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates, allowing newer BS VI compliant vehicles to go longer between renewals while retaining shorter validity periods for older vehicles.
Under the new rules notified by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, PUC certificates for BS VI compliant private vehicles up to six years old will be valid for three years. Those aged more than six years but up to 10 years will require annual renewal, while vehicles older than 10 years must renew their certificates every six months.
The revised schedule also provides longer validity periods for BS VI compliant transport vehicles. Certificates for those up to six years old will be valid for two years, while vehicles aged more than six years but up to 10 years will require annual renewal. Transport vehicles older than 10 years will continue to require renewal every six months.
For vehicles complying with BS-I, BS-II and BS-III emission norms, PUC certificates will be valid for three months. Those complying with BS IV norms will have a validity period of six months.
The changes have been notified through the Central Motor Vehicles (Sixteenth Amendment) Rules, 2026, under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988. The amended rules came into force upon publication in the Official Gazette.
When will the renewed PUC certificate become valid?
The amended rules also clarify when a renewed certificate will take effect.
If a vehicle owner applies for renewal within the 10 days preceding the expiry of the existing certificate, the renewed certificate will take effect from the date of expiry of the existing one.
In all other cases where renewal is sought after the existing certificate has expired, the new certificate will take effect from the date of renewal.
For certificates issued before the amended rules came into force, the revised validity schedule will apply only when they are first renewed after the new rules take effect.
Vehicle category and Certificate validity
BS-I, BS-II and BS-III vehicles: 3 months
BS-IV vehicles: 6 months
BS-VI private vehicles up to 6 years old: 3 years
BS-VI private vehicles over 6 to 10 years old: 1 year
BS-VI private vehicles over 10 years old: 6 months
BS-VI transport vehicles up to 6 years old: 2 years
BS-VI transport vehicles over 6 to 10 years old: 1 year
BS-VI transport vehicles over 10 years old: 6 months

title: ‘My fight is for every woman’: Bilkis Bano on 24 years of pain, displacement and seeking justice
description: Bilkis Bano continues her twenty-four-year battle for justice after the Supreme Court suspended two convicts' sentences, enduring continuous displacement and fear while demanding equal dignity and accountability for the Gujarat riots.
author: Sharanya Bhuvanendran
content:
‘My fight is for every woman’: Bilkis Bano on 24 years of pain, displacement and seeking justice
Mail This Article
Bilkis Bano is once again standing before the conscience of the nation. A Supreme Court order suspending the life sentences of two of the 11 convicts in the 2002 Gujarat riots case has brought her ordeal back into focus.
On March 3, 2002, Bilkis was gang-raped and 14 people, including her three-year-old daughter Saleha, were murdered. The order has renewed attention on the long and painful battle Bilkis has waged for justice, even as she struggles to rebuild her life amid fear and displacement.
While the convicts have secured yet another reprieve, the trauma of that day continues to haunt her. In a conversation with Malayala Manorama, Bilkis speaks about the ordeal she has endured over the past 24 years and the strength that has helped her carry on.
What has it been like to live through these 24 years?
Not a single day has passed since that incident without tears. After I was rendered unconscious during the gang rape , the assailants left me on a hilltop inside a forest, believing I was dead. I lay there, half-naked, through an entire night and day. Some kind-hearted people eventually found me and took me to a relief camp. The very next day, I lodged a police complaint. What followed was a long battle for justice, taking me from the trial courts to the higher courts.
I have suffered irreparable losses, including the loss of my three-year-old daughter and my parents. While the convicts are able to exercise their rights and enjoy their freedom, I continue to live a life of displacement. Over the past two and a half decades, I have been forced to change homes more than 50 times.
The fear has stayed with me all these years. From my days in the relief camp, when I was struggling with deep physical and emotional scars, to this day, women's rights activists, human rights activists and my husband have stood by me. They have been my strength. They helped me regain my faith in people and my hope for the future. Every time fear forced us to leave a place, they helped us find a new home and start afresh. They also helped me heal my emotional wounds. They embraced me and my children and stood by us. They continue to support us even today.
What keeps you going when the legal battle seems endless?
This is not a fight for me alone. I do not want any other woman to go through what I have endured. I am fighting to ensure that no woman ever has to suffer a similar ordeal. That is why I have never considered giving up.
No one can imagine the extent of the brutality, cruelty and pain I went through. Nor can anyone understand the depth of the wounds they left in my heart. How can I give up seeking justice for my slain family members? How can I give up the fight for my little daughter, my mother, my mother-in-law and my other relatives? They were all killed before my eyes. Seeking justice for them is what gives me the strength to carry on.
What is your response to the Supreme Court order suspending the sentences of two convicts and granting them bail?
I feel that the dignity of the law has been undermined. I fear that this order will shake my faith in the judiciary. I am also afraid that those who subjected us to such cruelty may once again walk free. I worry that they may target us again. Why are these perpetrators repeatedly given special consideration and allowed to go free?
Some of them were initially convicted but were later granted remission of their sentences. I had to fight another legal battle against that decision. While they move around freely, my children and I keep living in constant fear.
After all that you have endured, what kind of justice do you still hope for?
Justice means being able to live without fear in the land where I was born and raised, and to enjoy the right to live with equality and dignity. I will continue to fight to restore my faith in the principle of equal justice. I have the same right to justice as anyone else and the same right to live with dignity.
The court heard the State government's submissions before granting bail to the two convicts but did not give you an opportunity to present your side. What is your response to this?
What does an order passed without hearing the survivor's voice mean? Our right to be heard must never be denied. Every survivor must have the opportunity to speak before the court. I will challenge the present order in court.
Many women across the country face violence, but fear keeps many of them from speaking out. What would you like to tell survivors in such situations?
I would urge every survivor to fight against injustice. When you raise your voice for yourself, you will realise that others, too, will come forward to hold your hand and stand by you through your darkest days. My daughter and women everywhere deserve to live in a country filled with love rather than hatred.
Saleha was just three years old when the attackers killed her by smashing her against the ground. What memories of your daughter do you hold on to?
Saleha lives on in my heart. Memories of her give me courage. Justice for her means ensuring that those who took her life receive the punishment prescribed by the law of the land. I ask for nothing more and nothing less. It is also part of the justice she deserves that her sisters and brother should be able to lead their lives in this country with equal rights, free from the shadow of fear.
Is it true that you have left Gujarat in the wake of the Supreme Court's latest order?
As my life is under threat, I am unable to comment on this for the time being.

title: Air Pollution, AQI Skyrocket: Delhi gets 6,500 new lung cancer cases, a death every third day
description: More than 6,500 lung cancer cases and hundreds of deaths have been reported across six Delhi hospitals between 2020 and July 2026.
author: Manisha Chauhan
content:
INDIA
More than 6,500 lung cancer cases and hundreds of deaths have been reported across six Delhi hospitals between 2020 and July 2026.
Delhi's lung cancer burden is raising concern, with more than 6,500 new cases recorded across six hospitals between 2020 and July 2026. The data also points to a death from the disease approximately every three days during the period.
The figures, obtained through a Right to Information (RTI) query by news agency PTI, include data from premier institutions such as the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS).
However, doctors believe the actual number of cases could be considerably higher because the RTI covers only six hospitals. Many patients from Delhi-NCR seek treatment at other institutions or travel to different cities for medical care.
The findings come amid recurring episodes of hazardous air pollution across Delhi and other parts of North India, particularly during winter.
Doctors report more cases among women and non-smokers
Medical experts are increasingly concerned about lung cancer affecting people who have never smoked. Younger patients and women are also becoming a more visible part of the patient population.
Adenocarcinoma, a type of lung cancer more commonly associated with non-smokers, is also being reported more frequently.
"The RTI numbers are a warning, but they probably understate the problem," said Dr Nitesh Rohatgi, a medical oncologist at Fortis Gurugram.
He said the actual situation could be more serious, considering the number of patients being treated at hospitals outside those covered by the RTI.
"More and more people are getting lung cancer in Delhi and all over India, there is definitely something wrong," said Dr Geeta Kadayaprath, principal lead at Apollo Athena Women's Cancer Centre.
India recorded over 1.12 lakh lung cancer cases in 2024
The problem extends beyond Delhi. According to Globocan 2024 estimates, India recorded 1,12,659 new lung cancer cases that year, making it the country's third most common cancer.
The disease also caused 98,687 deaths, the highest number of deaths among all cancer types in the country.
Lung cancer is among the deadliest forms of cancer worldwide. One of the major challenges is that it is often detected only after reaching an advanced stage, reducing the chances of successful treatment.
How air pollution may increase lung cancer risk
Smoking remains the biggest established risk factor for lung cancer, but doctors say several other factors can also contribute to the disease.
These include long-term exposure to outdoor air pollution, passive smoking, household pollution caused by cooking fuels and harmful substances encountered at workplaces.
In Delhi-NCR, the duration and intensity of exposure to polluted air are major concerns. Fine particulate matter such as PM2.5 can travel deep into the lungs.
Dr Indoo Ammbulkar, a medical oncologist at HCG Cancer Hospital in Mumbai, said prolonged exposure to these particles can cause inflammation, oxidative stress and cellular damage, potentially contributing to the development of cancer.
The International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC), the cancer research agency of the World Health Organization, has classified outdoor air pollution and particulate matter as carcinogenic to humans.
This does not mean that pollution is responsible for every individual lung cancer case. However, its possible contribution to the overall disease burden is becoming an important public health concern.
Lung cancer symptoms are often mistaken for other illnesses
Delayed diagnosis is another major reason lung cancer continues to have high mortality.
In its early stages, the disease may cause few or no noticeable symptoms. When symptoms do appear, they can include:
- Persistent cough
- Breathlessness
- Chest pain
- Unexplained weight loss
- Blood in sputum
These signs are often mistaken for respiratory infections, tuberculosis or problems caused by air pollution.
In India, where tuberculosis and pollution-related respiratory complaints are common, some patients undergo repeated treatment before doctors suspect cancer.
"Most patients reach us at stage III or IV, when treatment is largely palliative," Dr Rohatgi said.
He pointed to delays in investigating persistent coughs, which are frequently attributed to tuberculosis or polluted air.
Late diagnosis limits treatment options
Medical advances have improved treatment possibilities for some lung cancer patients. Targeted therapies and immunotherapy can help in certain cases, but their benefits depend on early diagnosis, molecular testing and access to appropriate treatment.
India also does not have a screening strategy that adequately identifies all people at risk, particularly non-smokers exposed to environmental pollutants.
Low-dose CT scans are recommended for certain high-risk smokers. However, the existing eligibility criteria may not identify non-smokers whose risk is linked to pollution or other environmental factors.
Doctors call for better screening and affordable treatment
Medical experts believe lung cancer prevention in India must extend beyond campaigns against tobacco use.
They have called for greater attention to air pollution, workplace exposure, indoor air quality and timely investigation of persistent respiratory symptoms.
Molecular testing is another important area. A significant proportion of Indian lung cancer patients have genetic changes such as EGFR and ALK mutations, which may make them eligible for targeted medicines.
However, the cost of testing and treatment remains a major challenge for many families.
Dr Rohatgi called for a dedicated lung cancer registry, screening models suited to India's population, clearer referral systems for patients with persistent respiratory symptoms and more affordable access to diagnostic tests and medicines.

title: No Money, No Beauty: IIT groom earning Rs 1.27 crore wants wife who struggled like him, calls it 'Two-Nation Theory'
description: An IIT graduate earning Rs 1.27 crore wants a wife who grew up in a small town, moved to a big city and became successful like him.
author: Anshika Pandey
content:
INDIA
An IIT graduate earning Rs 1.27 crore wants a wife who grew up in a small town, moved to a big city and became successful like him.
An IIT graduate earning Rs 1.27 crore a year has gone viral for a marriage requirement that has nothing to do with money, looks or family background. He wants a wife who has lived the same journey as him. The story was shared on X by Jasveer Singh, CEO of Gurugram-based KnotDating. He said it was a requirement he had never heard before.
He was raised in a tiny town, attended school there till Class 12, then relocated to a large metropolis, enrolled at IIT, and went on to have a prosperous career. But it was hard to locate a spouse. In South Bombay and South Delhi, he had dated women from affluent families. They matched flawlessly on paper, yet something was lacking in practice. Their upbringing, lifestyle, tastes and views on family and relationships were very different from his.
He then met women from small towns, but their interests did not match his after a decade in metro cities. He felt stuck between two worlds. "Women from wealthy metro families understood my present but not my past. Women who had never left small towns understood my past but not my present," he said.
Also read: Suryakumar Yadav says 'you are my inspiration now' after Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 204 off 53 balls
His requirement was simple: "I want a woman who grew up in a small town, moved to a big city and made it big." He wants an educated, independent and successful woman who has experienced both worlds. He says women with a similar journey connect with him instantly because they understand both his past and present.
He called it his "Two Nation Theory" two completely different worlds within the same country. Singh claimed that the man was seeking a similar life path rather than a job or family money. He questioned whether this made sense or if the man was merely seeking a female counterpart. A significant internet debate has been triggered by the post.

title: Pakistan Terror Plot Busted: 22-year-old arrested in Meerut for planning suicide attack on army camp
description: 22-year-old Uzaid from Meerut arrested for plotting fidayeen attack on Army camp. Linked to Pakistan-backed online radicalisation network, Jaish-e-Mohammed chief Masood Azhar.
author: Monica Singh
content:
INDIA
22-year-old Uzaid from Meerut arrested for plotting fidayeen attack on Army camp. Linked to Pakistan-backed online radicalisation network, Jaish-e-Mohammed chief Masood Azhar.
A 22-year-old man from Uttar Pradesh's Meerut has been arrested on charges of plotting to carry out a 'fidayeen' (suicide) attack on an Army camp.
The man, identified as Uzaid, a resident of Baniyapada in Meerut, was linked to a Pakistan-backed online radicalisation network, the police said on Tuesday.
He allegedly used to consume 'anti-India' content on Instagram and YouTube, and was influenced by Masood Azhar, the chief of Pakistan-based terror group Jaish-e-Mohammed.
He was in touch with a Jammu-based resident, Mohammad Sajid, who was arrested in November last year, and the two were running an online network, which was backed by Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti, the police said.
They were running online groups called 'Tuition-40', '005 Brigade' and 'Al-Muzzahid' on Instagram and the 'Session' messaging app to radicalise youth, the police said.
The accused were planning the attack during a conversation on November 8, 2025, in the '005 Brigade' group on 'Session', an end-to-end encrypted messaging app designed to protect user privacy.
An alleged Pakistani handler, said to be Aamir Hamza and codenamed 'Drugs', then shares the plan.
"Plan ye he ke Sajid ko bombs jacket pehna kr Indian Army checkpost pr bhejna he or boom kr dena he. ok? (The plan is to make Sajid wear a bomb jacket and send him to an Indian Army check post and blow him up)," he wrote.
Sajid then responds that "he is ready".
"Inshaallah pura checkpost udha dunga. Inshaallah ma apna 100% dunga (I will blow up the entire check post. I will give MY 100 per cent," he wrote.
Uzaid, who was codenamed 'Ibnaadam', then asks, "Kaha h jacket" (Where is the jacket?).
"Bana lenge ghr me hi (We will make them at home)," Hamza responds.
According to the police, Uzaid was preparing to build a large army of 'mujahideen'. He would incite people across various groups by claiming that Muslims in India were being subjected to oppression.
The police said both had planned to carry out a 'fidayeen' attack on a major Army camp in November 2025. While Sajid was tasked with conducting reconnaissance, Uzaid was responsible for procuring weapons and explosive-laden vests.
The plan, however, didn't materialise as Sajid was arrested.
The case came to light on November 24, 2025, after police at Bahu Fort police station in Jammu registered a complaint about terror-related activities. The police began a probe and subsequently arrested Sajid.
His arrest then led a joint team of Jammu and Meerut police to raid Meerut in January and again in February in search of Uzaid. He, however, could not be traced.
He was then arrested from Meerut following a tip-off by the informers, a police officer said.
"The accused was absconding for 10 months. During this period, he would sometimes stay at his mama's (maternal uncle's) place and sometimes at any other location," the officer told the news agency PTI.
The officer said Uzaid watched videos by Masood Azhar. He came into contact with Sajid after commenting "hum bhi taiyaar hain" (we are also ready) on one of his videos.

title: अपनी सही बर्थप्लेस बताओ; CJP के सौरभ दास के पासपोर्ट पर विवाद, नोटिस जारी
description: विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल ने बुधवार को कहा कि चेन्नई के रीजनल पासपोर्ट ऑफिस ने कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के को-कन्वीनर सौरभ दास को सात दिनों के अंदर अपनी जन्म जगह बताने को कहा है। साथ ही उन्हें जवाब आने तक पासपोर्ट इस्तेमाल न करने की सलाह दी गई है।
author: Devendra Kasyap
content:
अपनी सही बर्थप्लेस बताओ; CJP के सौरभ दास के पासपोर्ट पर विवाद, नोटिस जारी
विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल ने बुधवार को कहा कि चेन्नई के रीजनल पासपोर्ट ऑफिस ने कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के को-कन्वीनर सौरभ दास को सात दिनों के अंदर अपनी जन्म जगह बताने को कहा है। साथ ही उन्हें जवाब आने तक पासपोर्ट इस्तेमाल न करने की सलाह दी गई है।
कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के सौरभ दास को लंदन जाने से क्यों रोका गया? अब इस पर सरकार की ओर से जवाब आ गया है। सरकार ने साफ किया कि इसकी वजह पासपोर्ट में जन्म स्थान (बर्थप्लेस) की जानकारी से जुड़ी है। विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल ने बुधवार को बताया कि चेन्नई के रीजनल पासपोर्ट ऑफिस ने कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के को-कन्वीनर सौरव दास को शो-कॉज नोटिस जारी किया है। नोटिस में उनसे सात दिनों के अंदर अपनी सही जन्म जगह बताने को कहा गया है और जवाब आने तक पासपोर्ट इस्तेमाल न करने की सलाह दी गई है।
जायसवाल ने आगे कहा कि पासपोर्ट के लिए आवेदन करते समय आवेदकों को हर जानकारी सही-सही और पूरी देनी होती है। जन्म स्थान, पता, नाम और अन्य जरूरी विवरण सही होना चाहिए। अगर किसी आवेदक के खिलाफ कोई शिकायत आती है, या यह पता चलता है कि उसने कोई तथ्य छिपाया है या गलत जानकारी दी है, तो पासपोर्ट ऑफिस तुरंत नोटिस जारी कर स्पष्टीकरण मांगता है। यह सामान्य प्रक्रिया है और नियमों के तहत होती है।
दरअसल, मंत्रालय का यह बयान सौरभ दास के उस आरोप के बाद आया, जिसमें उन्होंने कहा था कि सोमवार को दिल्ली के एयरपोर्ट पर उन्हें रोका गया। दास के अनुसार, रात करीब 1 बजे वे लंदन जाने वाली फ्लाइट में चढ़ने वाले थे, तभी इमिग्रेशन अधिकारियों ने उन्हें रोक लिया। अधिकारियों ने बताया कि उनका पासपोर्ट फ्लैग कर दिया गया है, यानी पासपोर्ट पर कोई रोक लगी हुई है, जिसके कारण उन्हें यात्रा की इजाजत नहीं दी जा रही।
बाद में सौरभ दास ने पीटीआई से बात करते हुए बताया था कि वह ब्रिटेन जा रहे थे क्योंकि ऑक्सफोर्ड यूनिवर्सिटी स्टूडेंट्स यूनियन ने एक पैनल डिस्कशन का आयोजन किया था। इस कार्यक्रम में उन्हें 'कॉकरोच मूवमेंट' के बारे में अपनी बात रखनी थी। सौरभ दास ने आगे बताया कि उन्हें अचानक रोके जाने से उनकी यात्रा रुक गई और वे कार्यक्रम में शामिल नहीं हो सके। इसके बाद इसको लेकर जमकर बयानबाजी हुई थी। सीजेपी फाउंडर अभिजीत दीपके ने भी केंद्र सरकार पर हमला बोला था।
हालांकि अब विदेश मंत्रालय ने साफ कर दिया कि दास को लंदन जाने से क्यों रोका गया था। इसके साथ ही पासपोर्ट ऑफिस ने अब सौरभ दास को सात दिनों का समय दिया है कि वे अपनी जन्म जगह की सही जानकारी लिखित में दें। जब तक वे जवाब नहीं देते और मामला स्पष्ट नहीं होता, तब तक उन्हें पासपोर्ट इस्तेमाल न करने की सलाह दी गई है।

title: 2008 के अमरनाथ विवाद की यादें न कुरेदें महबूबा मुफ्ती, बीजेपी नेता सत शर्मा ने क्यों कहा ऐसा
description: बीजेपी अध्यक्ष और राज्यसभा सांसद सत शर्मा ने PDP प्रमुख महबूबा मुफ्ती पर तीखा हमला बोला। उन्होंने कहा कि महबूबा बिना वजह शेषनाग रोड को चौड़ा करने के मुद्दे को राजनीतिक बना रही हैं और जम्मू-कश्मीर में शांति बिगाड़ने की कोशिश कर रही हैं।
author: Devendra Kasyap
content:
2008 के अमरनाथ विवाद की यादें न कुरेदें महबूबा मुफ्ती, बीजेपी नेता सत शर्मा ने क्यों कहा ऐसा
बीजेपी अध्यक्ष और राज्यसभा सांसद सत शर्मा ने PDP प्रमुख महबूबा मुफ्ती पर तीखा हमला बोला। उन्होंने कहा कि महबूबा बिना वजह शेषनाग रोड को चौड़ा करने के मुद्दे को राजनीतिक बना रही हैं और जम्मू-कश्मीर में शांति बिगाड़ने की कोशिश कर रही हैं।
जम्मू-कश्मीर में शेषनाग रोड को चौड़ा करने के प्रस्ताव को लेकर सियासी विवाद और गहरा हो गया है। भारतीय जनता पार्टी (BJP) के जम्मू-कश्मीर अध्यक्ष और राज्यसभा सांसद सत शर्मा ने पीपुल्स डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी (PDP) की प्रमुख महबूबा मुफ्ती पर निशाना साधते हुए कहा कि वे बिना वजह इस मुद्दे को राजनीतिक रंग दे रही हैं। शर्मा का आरोप है कि महबूबा मुफ्ती जानबूझकर शांतिपूर्ण माहौल बिगाड़ने की कोशिश कर रही हैं और धार्मिक भावनाओं को चोट पहुंचाने वाली बातें कर रही हैं।
न्यूज18 से बात करते हुए सत शर्मा ने कहा कि महबूबा मुफ्ती अमरनाथ यात्रा से जुड़े इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर के काम पर विवाद खड़ा कर 2008 जैसी स्थिति पैदा करना चाहती हैं। उन्होंने चेतावनी दी कि विकास और तीर्थयात्रा से जुड़े मुद्दों को सांप्रदायिक या राजनीतिक टकराव में न बदला जाए। शर्मा ने कहा कि अगर महबूबा मुफ्ती इसी रास्ते पर चलती रहीं तो उन्हें और हाशिए पर धकेला जा सकता है और वे जम्मू-कश्मीर में शांति भंग करने में कामयाब नहीं होंगी।
2008 का अमरनाथ भूमि विवाद क्या था?
2008 का अमरनाथ भूमि विवाद जम्मू-कश्मीर के इतिहास का एक बहुत संवेदनशील अध्याय माना जाता है। उस समय की जम्मू-कश्मीर सरकार ने अमरनाथ यात्रा करने वाले श्रद्धालुओं के लिए अस्थायी सुविधाएं बनाने के लिए करीब 40 हेक्टेयर जंगल की जमीन श्री अमरनाथजी श्राईन बोर्ड को देने का फैसला किया था।
इस फैसले के खिलाफ कश्मीर घाटी में बड़े पैमाने पर विरोध प्रदर्शन शुरू हो गए। बाद में जब सरकार ने यह आदेश वापस ले लिया तो जम्मू क्षेत्र में भी जोरदार आंदोलन हुआ। दोनों क्षेत्रों में हुए इन आंदोलनों ने जम्मू और कश्मीर के बीच गहरे क्षेत्रीय बंटवारे को सामने ला दिया। यह विवाद लंबे समय तक चला और जम्मू-कश्मीर की राजनीति को काफी प्रभावित किया। सत शर्मा ने इसी पुराने विवाद का जिक्र करते हुए कहा कि शेषनाग रोड के मुद्दे को भी वैसा ही संवेदनशील बनाने की कोशिश न की जाए।
महबूबा मुफ्ती ने क्या चिंता जताई?
इस बीच महबूबा मुफ्ती ने शेषनाग झील के पास सड़क निर्माण और खुदाई के काम पर सवाल उठाए हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि यह इलाका हिमालय का बहुत नाजुक हिस्सा है और यहां बड़े पैमाने पर निर्माण कार्य से पर्यावरण को नुकसान पहुंच सकता है। महबूबा मुफ्ती ने केंद्रीय सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्री नितिन गडकरी से भी इस मामले में हस्तक्षेप करने की मांग की है। उनका कहना है कि इतने संवेदनशील क्षेत्र में किसी भी इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्रोजेक्ट की पहले पूरी जांच होनी चाहिए।
जम्मू में शिवसेना डोगरा फ्रंट का विरोध प्रदर्शन
राजनीतिक माहौल को और गर्म करते हुए शिवसेना डोगरा फ्रंट के कार्यकर्ताओं ने जम्मू में महबूबा मुफ्ती के खिलाफ सड़कों पर उतरकर विरोध प्रदर्शन किया। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने उन पर इलाके में शांति भंग करने और पाकिस्तान के इशारों पर काम करने का आरोप लगाया। उन्होंने मांग की कि महबूबा मुफ्ती के बयानों को लेकर उन पर पब्लिक सेफ्टी एक्ट (PSA) लगाया जाए।

title: चले थे भारत को तोड़ने, खुद हो गए दो फाड़; PoK में भड़के विरोध-प्रदर्शन से ISI और JeM में ही दरार
description: पाक सेना और ISI ने कुछ महीने पहले जैश और लश्कर-ए-तैयबा (LeT) के आतंकियों को प्रदर्शन स्थलों में घुसपैठ करने, हिंसा भड़काने और बल प्रयोग को सही ठहराने के लिए चुना था लेकिन ISI की यह साजिश उलटी पड़ गई।
author: Pramod Praveen
content:
चले थे भारत को तोड़ने, खुद हो गए दो फाड़; PoK में भड़के विरोध-प्रदर्शन से ISI और JeM में ही दरार
पाक सेना और ISI ने कुछ महीने पहले जैश और लश्कर-ए-तैयबा (LeT) के आतंकियों को प्रदर्शन स्थलों में घुसपैठ करने, हिंसा भड़काने और बल प्रयोग को सही ठहराने के लिए चुना था लेकिन ISI की यह साजिश उलटी पड़ गई।
पाकिस्तान के कब्जे वाले यानी पाक अधिकृत कश्मीर (PoK) में पिछले कुछ समय से स्थानीय लोग पाकिस्तान सरकार के खिलाफ हल्ला बोल किए हुए हैं। ये लोग महंगाई, आटे-बिजली की किल्लत और बुनियादी सुविधाओं की मांग पर पाकिस्तान सरकार के खिलाफ मुजफ्फराबाद, रावलाकोट, कोटली, मीरपुर और धीरकोट सहित कई इलाकों की सड़कों पर उतर कर हंगामा कर रहे हैं। जॉइंट आवामी एक्शन कमेटी (JAAC) के नेतृत्व में चल रहे इन प्रदर्शनों को कुचलने के लिए पाकिस्तान सेना और खुफिया एजेंसी ISI ने जिस तरह के हथकंडे अपनाए हैं, खासकर ऑपरेशन सिंदूर के बाद से ISI ने PoK में जिस तरह की बर्बरताएं की हैं, उसकी वजह से ISI और आतंकी संगठन जैश-ए-मोहम्मद (JeM) में फूट पड़ गई है।
दरअसल, भारत को तोड़ने की साजिश रचने वाला आतंकी संगठन JeM पिछले साल मई में हुए 'ऑपरेशन सिंदूर' के बाद से काफी हद तक निष्क्रिय रहा है लेकिन PoK में जारी विरोध-प्रदर्शनों को लेकर पाकिस्तानी प्रशासन के रवैये से जैश के कुछ सदस्य नाराज हो गए हैं। एक मीडिया रिपोर्ट में कहा गया है कि पिछले छह महीनों में विरोध-प्रदर्शनों से निपटने के पाकिस्तानी सरकार के तरीके से इस आतंकी संगठन के कुछ सदस्य खुश नहीं हैं। उन्होंने इस बात पर सवाल उठाए हैं कि बुनियादी अधिकारों, बेहतर नागरिक सुविधाओं और जीवन स्तर में सुधार की मांग कर रहे शांतिपूर्ण प्रदर्शनकारियों के खिलाफ इतनी ज्यादा ताकत का इस्तेमाल क्यों किया गया?
ISI की साजिश पड़ी उलटी
पाकिस्तान की इंटर-सर्विसेज इंटेलिजेंस (ISI) और जैश-ए-मोहम्मद के बीच तकरार इस हद तक पहुंच गया है कि ISI ने हाल ही में JeM को एक डोजियर सौंपा है। इसमें संगठन के नेतृत्व से कहा गया है कि वे कम से कम 23 ऐसे सदस्यों को काबू में रखें, जो रावलकोट में हो रहे विरोध-प्रदर्शनों में शामिल हो गए थे। एक अधिकारी के हवाले से कहा गया है कि शुरुआत में जिसे विरोध-प्रदर्शनों में खलल डालने के लिए की गई घुसपैठ की कोशिश माना जा रहा था, वह असल में जैश-ए-मोहम्मद के कुछ सदस्यों की नाराजगी का ही एक रूप निकला।
23 आतंकियों पर तुरंत लगाम कसने की हिदायत
दरअसल, पाक सेना और ISI ने कुछ महीने पहले जैश और लश्कर-ए-तैयबा (LeT) के आतंकियों को प्रदर्शन स्थलों में घुसपैठ करने, हिंसा भड़काने और बल प्रयोग को सही ठहराने के लिए चुना था लेकिन ISI की यह साजिश उलटी पड़ गई और जिसे घुसपैठ समझा जा रहा था, वह जैश के सदस्यों का वास्तविक असंतोष निकला, जो खुद प्रदर्शनों का हिस्सा बन गए। स्थिति बिगड़ते देख ISI ने जैश कमांडर मसूद इलियास कश्मीरी को एक डोजियर सौंपकर रावलकोट (Rawalakot) में प्रदर्शनों में शामिल 23 आतंकियों पर तुरंत लगाम कसने की हिदायत दी है।
मासूमों पर जुल्म और मसूद अजहर का गायब होना
अब जैश के लोगों ने ही पाक सेना पर पाकिस्तानी प्रतिष्ठान पर प्रदर्शनकारियों के खिलाफ गोलियां चलाने, उन्हें जबरन गायब करने और अत्यधिक बल प्रयोग करने के संगीन आरोप लगाए हैं। वहीं ऑपरेशन सिंदूर के बाद से मसूद अजहर (Masood Azhar) समेत जैश की शीर्ष नेतृत्व छिपा हुआ है और कोई सार्वजनिक उपस्थिति दर्ज नहीं कराई है, जिससे कैडर अपने संगठन से जुड़ने पर ही सवाल उठा रहे हैं और भगदड़ मच रही है। ऐसी स्थिति में रावलकोट में जैश के ठिकानों पर संकट मंडराने लगा है। उन्हें स्थानीय समर्थन खोने का डर सता रहा है। खुफिया ब्यूरो (IB) के अनुसार, जैश का मानना है कि पाकिस्तान की इस कठोर कार्रवाई ने स्थानीय आबादी को अलग-थलग कर दिया है, जिसके गंभीर परिणाम देखने को मिल सकते हैं।

Banswara Zila Pramukh : बांसवाड़ा जिला प्रमुख चुनाव में खेला हुआ। बांसवाड़ा में बीएपी ने अपना जिला प्रमुख बनाया। बीएपी की रीना रावत बांसवाड़ा की जिला प्रमुख चुनी गईं। कांग्रेस से विकास बामनिया ने अपना नामांकन भरा। इधर बीएपी की तरफ से रीना रावत ने अपना नामांकन भरा। रिजल्ट आने के बाद बांसवाड़ा जिला परिषद में BAP प्रत्याशी रीना रावत जिला प्रमुख बनी हैं। जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए भाजपा और बीएपी पार्टी के बीच गठबंधन हुआ है। कांग्रेस यहां एक सीट के अंतर से हार गई। 43 सदस्यी जिला परिषद में कांग्रेस की 21, बीएपी की 17 और भाजपा की 5 सीटें आई थी, लेकिन भाजपा और बीएपी का गठबंधन होने से रीना रावत के पक्ष में कुल 22 वोट मिले। जबकि कांग्रेस के उम्मीदवार विकास बामणिया को सिर्फ 21 वोट ही मिल सके। भाजपा ने इस पद के लिए नामांकन नहीं किया है।
यह थी सदस्यों की गणित
यहां कुल सीटें : 43 बहुमत का आंकड़ा : 22 कांग्रेस: 21 बीएपी: 17 भाजपा: 5
जिला प्रमुख के निर्वाचन के अगले दिन 26 नवंबर को उप जिला प्रमुख पद के लिए चुनाव होगा। इसके बाद 27 नवंबर को जिले की सभी पंचायत समितियों के मुख्यालयों पर प्रधान पद के लिए निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया आयोजित की जाएगी। वहीं, 28 नवंबर को उप प्रधान पद के लिए चुनाव कराया जाएगा। इन सभी पदों के निर्वाचन में भी जिला प्रमुख चुनाव की तरह ही नामांकन, संवीक्षा, नाम वापसी और आवश्यकता होने पर मतदान की प्रक्रिया अपनाई जाएगी। इस तरह चार दिनों तक चलने वाली निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया के साथ जिले की जिला परिषद और पंचायत समितियों को नए मुखिया मिल जाएंगे। न्यूज अपडेट हो रही है।

title: MP पर क्यों है BJP-कांग्रेस का फोकस? बढ़ने लगी भाजपा-कांग्रेस की सियासी हलचल?
description: BJP Congress Strategy in MP: मध्यप्रदेश में कांग्रेस और भाजपा में राजनीतिक हलचल तेज है...। एक और उपचुनाव की सुगबुगाहट के बीच जबलपुर में कांग्रेस का शक्ति प्रदर्शन हो रहा है, वहीं भाजपा भी यूपी चुनाव से पहले संगठन को मजबूत करने में जुटी है...।
author: Manish Gite
content:
एमपी में भाजपा - कांग्रेस का फोकस। image patrika
BJP Congress Strategy in MP: उत्तर प्रदेश में तीन माह बाद चुनाव होने वाले हैं, लेकिन भाजपा और कांग्रेस का फोकस मध्यप्रदेश में क्यों बढ़ रहा है, इस बारे में राजनीतिक में क्या चल रहा है, भाजपा और कांग्रेस अपनी-अपनी चौपड़ बिछाने की तैयारी कर रहे हैं। पिछले पिछले दो दशकों से मध्यप्रदेश में भाजपा काबिज है, जिसे हटाने के लिए कांग्रेस जोर मार रही है। विश्लेषक मानते हैं कि देश के केंद्र में होने के कारण आसपास के राज्यों को भी मध्यप्रदेश की राजनीति प्रभावित कर सकती है। इसी बहानें दोनों ही दल अपने संगठन को मजबूत कर लेंगे। इसके बाद 2028 के अंत में होने वाले एमपी चुनाव की तैयारी में जुट जाएंगे।
मध्यप्रदेश के दतिया में कुछ माह पहले उपचुनाव में मिली जीत के बाद से कांग्रेस उत्साहित है। इसके बाद अब बीना उपचुनाव भी संभावित है। क्योंकि कि वहां के कांग्रेस विधायक निर्मला सप्रे ने भाजपा का दामन थाम लिया है। उनके मामले में अभी तक विधानसभा में फैसला नहीं हो पाया है। नेता प्रतिपक्ष उमंग सिंघार की याचिका पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मध्यप्रदेश विधानसभा के अध्यक्ष नरेंद्र सिंह तोमर को दो माह में फैसला लेने को कहा है। यह वक्त भी करीब आ गया है। जिसके बाद निर्मला सप्रे की सदस्यता जा सकती है। फिर मध्यप्रदेश में उपचुनाव हो सकते हैं। इसमें भी कांग्रेस ने तैयारी शुरू कर दी है, उसका दावा है कि हम इस चुनाव में भी जीत जाएंगे।
कांग्रेस 26 नवंबर को जबलपुर में संविधान दिवस के मौके पर कार्यक्रम करने वाली है। इसे लेकर पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री कमलनाथ भी अपने कार्यकर्ताओं से अपील कर रहे हैं। मध्यप्रदेश कांग्रेस के कई बड़े नेता जबलपुर में एकत्र हो रहे हैं। कांग्रेस ने इससे पहले राहुल गांधी का बालाघाट दौरा और इंदौर में छात्रों की गूंज कार्यक्रम किया था। इससे कांग्रेस को ऊर्जा मिली है।
यूपी चुनाव से पहले कांग्रेस का बार-बार मध्यप्रदेश की ओर फोकस करने के मायने भी निकाले जा रहे हैं। राजनीतिक विश्लेषक मानते हैं कि दतिया उपचुनाव, वोट चोरी के मुद्दे, बालाघाट में आदिवासी बच्चों की मौतें और छात्रों की गूंज कार्यक्रम के जरिए कांग्रेस कार्यकर्ताओं को जो ऊर्जा मिल रही है, भीड़ जुटाने में भी कांग्रेस को सफलता मिल रही है, इसी ऊर्जा को कांग्रेस अगले विधानसभा चुनाव तक बरकरार रखना चाहती है।
भाजपा भी एक के बाद संगठनात्मक नियुक्तियां करती जा रही है। हाल ही में भाजपा ने कई बड़े पदों पर नियुक्तियां की हैं। इसके अलावा संघ ने भी अपने कार्यकर्ताओं के साथ संवाद तेज कर दिया है। भाजपा ने हाल ही में उत्तर प्रदेश के लिए मध्यप्रदेश के बड़े नेताओं को जिम्मा देने की भी तैयारी कर ली है। एमपी के कई नेताओं को उत्तर प्रदेश की कई विधानसभा सीटों को जिताने का जिम्मा भी देने की तैयारी कर ली है। आने वाले दिनों में और भी नियुक्तियों का दौर भाजपा में देखने को मिलेगा, जिन्हें यूपी में भाजपा को तीसरी बार जीत दिलाने का जिम्मा दिया जाएगा।
देश का केंद्र होने के कारण और हिन्दी बेल्ट में होने के कारण भी मध्यप्रदेश आसपास के राज्यों के लिए अहम स्थान रखता है। मध्यप्रदेश की सीमाएं उत्तरप्रदेश, छत्तीसगढ़, राजस्थान से लगती है, वहीं महाराष्ट्र और गुजरात से भी कनेक्ट होती है। इन राज्यों में बड़ी संख्या में ऐसे लोग हैं जो सीमा के आसपास रहते हैं या नौकरी के लिए राज्यों में आना-जाना करते हैं। इसलिए मध्यप्रदेश की राजनीतिक गतिविधियां आसपास के राज्यों को भी प्रभावित करती है। और यह सभी भाजपा शासित राज्य हैं।
मध्यप्रदेश में बीना विधानसभा सीट पर उपचुनाव की सुगबुगाहट भी तेज हो गई है। यहां से निर्मला सप्रे पर दल बदल का आरोप है। उमंग सिंघार की याचिका पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने विधानसभा अध्यक्ष को दो माह में फैसला करने के निर्देश दिए थे। 7 दिसंबर से शुरू होने वाली विधानसभा के शीतकालीन सत्र के बाद इस पर फैसला हो जाएगा। निर्मला सप्रे फिलहाल भाजपा के साथ खड़ी दिखाई दे रही हैं, वहीं कांग्रेस अब उन्हें अपने साथ नहीं रखना चाहती है। इसलिए आने वाले दो माह में मध्यप्रदेश के बीना में उपचुनाव हो सकते हैं। फिलहाल निर्मला सप्रे कांग्रेस की विधायक थी, लेकिन वे भाजपा में शामिल हो गई हैं। यदि बीना में उपचुनाव हुए और कांग्रेस ने फिर यह सीट हथिया ली तो यह भाजपा के लिए बड़ा झटका होगा।

title: MP में बना पश्चिमी विक्षोभ, उत्तरी हवाओं ने बढ़ाई ठंड, जानिए कैसी पड़ेगी दिसंबर में ठंड !

author: Astha Awasthi
content:
Hindi News / Madhya Pradesh / Bhopal / MP में बना पश्चिमी विक्षोभ, उत्तरी हवाओं ने बढ़ाई ठंड, जानिए कैसी पड़ेगी दिसंबर में ठंड !
MP में बना पश्चिमी विक्षोभ, उत्तरी हवाओं ने बढ़ाई ठंड, जानिए कैसी पड़ेगी दिसंबर में ठंड !
MP Weather update: नवंबर के आखिरी सप्ताह में मौसम शुष्क रहेगा और दिसंबर में सर्दी और तेज हो सकती है, अगले दो दिनों में तापमान में और 2-3 डिग्री गिरावट संभव है।
बदलेगा मौसम का मिजाज, प्रतिकात्मक फोटो (Photo Source: AI Image)
MP Weather update: मध्यप्रदेश के कई जिलों में आसमान से बादलों की विदाई के साथ ही उत्तरी हवा का प्रभाव बढ़ने लगा है वहीं रात के तापमान में गिरावट का सिलसिला शुरू हो चुका है। इस सीजन में तीसरी बार न्यूनतम तापमान 10 डिग्री सेल्सियस से नीचे पहुंचा। नवंबर के आखिरी सप्ताह में मौसम शुष्क रहने की संभावना है, दिसंबर की शुरुआत के साथ ही सर्दी के तेवर और तीखे हो सकते हैं। ऐसे में इस बार नवंबर के मुकाबले दिसंबर में ठंड का ज्यादा असर देखने को मिल सकता है।
उत्तरी सर्द हवा के चलते एक बार फिर फिजा में ठंडक घुल गई है। बुधवार को भी विजिबिलिटी 2 हजार मीटर रही। अधिकतम तापमान 27.9 और न्यूनतम तापमान 9 डिग्री दर्ज किया गया। ये तापमान बीते दिन के मुकाबले न्यूनतम तापमान में 3.4 डिग्री की गिरावट आई है, वहीं तापमान सामान्य से 4.6 डिग्री कम रहा। जबलपुर में न्यूनतम तापमान 10.5 डिग्री, इंदौर में 10.6 डिग्री, ग्वालियर में 10.8 डिग्री और उज्जैन में 11 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया।
कैसी रहेंगी मौसमी परिस्थितियां
- ऊपरी हवा का चक्रवाती परिसंचरण माध्य समुद्र तल से 1.5 किमी की ऊंचाई पर दक्षिणी बांग्लादेश और आसपास के क्षेत्रों के ऊपर बना हुआ है।
- ऊपरी हवा का चक्रवाती परिसंचरण माध्य समुद्र तल से 3.1 किमी की ऊंचाई पर गुजरात और संलग्न दक्षिण-पश्चिमी राजस्थान के ऊपर बना हुआ है।
मौसम विभाग का कहना है कि फिलहाल कोई सिस्टम नहीं है। पश्चिमी विक्षोभ भी बना हुआ है, इसके कारण सर्द हवा आ रही है। अगले चार पांच दिनों तक मौसम शुष्क ही रहने की संभावना है। इस समय हवा का रुख उत्तरी और उत्तर पश्चिमी है। इसके कारण अगले दो दिनों में तापमान में और 2 से 3 डिग्री की गिरावट हो सकती है। इसके बाद विशेष परिवर्तन नहीं है, वहीं दिसंबर में सर्दी और बढ़ सकती है और कड़ाके की सर्दी के आसार बन सकते हैं।
