title: Shifting political allegiance under guise of dissent can topple elected governments, Uddhav Thackeray tells Supreme Court
description: Thackeray faction argues in Supreme Court that defections aren’t dissent, demand disqualification and caution against toppling governments through party realignments.
author: PTI
content:
If shifting political allegiance under the guise of dissent is permitted then elected governments can be destabilised by engineering defections even among a handful of legislators, the Uddhav Thackeray-led faction told the Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026).
A Bench of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana was told by senior advocate Kapil Sibal that the Maharashtra Assembly Speaker committed a constitutional error by treating the Eknath Shinde group’s legislative majority as proof that it represented the original Shiv Sena.
Mr. Sibal, advancing rejoinder submissions on behalf of the Thackeray faction, said that the legislative majority cannot transform a legislature party into the original political party under the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution.
The defence of the Shinde group that it had expressed dissent was not even the foundation of the Speaker's decision recognising it as the original Shiv Sena.
"If shifting political allegiance under the guise of dissent is permitted, governments can be destabilised by engineering defections even among a handful of legislators," Mr. Sibal told the Bench which is likely to reserve the verdict on the two petitions.
The lead plea, filed by Sunil Prabhu of the Uddhav Thackeray faction, challenges the Maharashtra Assembly speaker's January 10, 2024 decision declining to disqualify the MLAs of the Shinde faction under the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution.
A connected plea filed by Mr. Thackeray challenges the ECI’s decision recognising the Shinde faction as the official Shiv Sena and allotting it the party symbol.
During the hearing, Mr. Sibal submitted that the Speaker's approach was contrary to the Constitution Bench ruling in the Subhash Desai case.
"The identity of the original political party has to be determined with reference to June 21, 2022, when the alleged act of defection first occurred," Mr. Sibal said, adding that the Election Commission’s subsequent recognition of a faction under the Symbols Order could not retrospectively determine whether an earlier act amounted to defection.
He also emphasised that disqualification proceedings before the Speaker and proceedings before the Election Commission were legally distinct and could not be conflated.
"This is not an act of dissent, but an attempt to topple the government", he said.
Countering the Shinde faction's argument that its legislators had merely dissented against the Thackeray leadership, Mr. Sibal said their actions went beyond an expression of disagreement and were aimed at displacing the government led by Mr. Thackeray.
"If you want to dissent, you call a meeting of the party. You have a discussion... Instead, you say, forget it, I don't even recognise you.
"You're not the leader. I am the leader now. It's my whip, not your whip. That's not an act of dissent. That's to topple my government," he said.
Mr. Sibal said that the legislators could have convened meetings of the party's organisational bodies and resolved their ideological differences through internal discussions if their intention was genuinely to dissent.
He referred to the June 2022 developments, including the removal of the party-appointed whip, the reaffirmation of Mr. Shinde as Legislature Party leader and the communication of the resolution to the Governor, as evidence of an attempt to undermine the existing government rather than an exercise of legitimate dissent.
Referring to the Governor's decision to call a floor test in June 2022, Mr. Sibal said that the constitutional premise behind the move was that a substantial number of Shiv Sena legislators had moved away from the Thackeray-led party.
He said the top court subsequently held that the Governor's decision to call for a floor test was illegal, saying that the Governor could not use internal differences within a political party as the basis for directing a floor test.
"Their submission that on June 21 they were the political party is not just perverse, it is contrary to the constitutional mandate of the Tenth Schedule," he said.
Mr. Sibal also referred to the events of June 30, 2022, when Mr. Shinde, backed by the rebel MLAs and the BJP, met the Governor to stake claim to form the government in Maharashtra and subsequently took oath as Chief Minister.
He said that this development could not be dismissed as a subsequent event unrelated to the disqualification proceedings.
"That cannot be an act of dissent. It is an act which is inconsistent with his conduct and results in his having voluntarily given up membership of the party," he said.
He also referred to the election of BJP candidate Rahul Narwekar as Maharashtra Assembly Speaker, saying that 37 MLAs belonging to the Shinde faction had voted against the MVA-backed candidate Rajan Salvi.
He questioned how voting against the candidate supported by the then Shiv Sena leadership could be characterised as mere dissent.
On November 18, Shinde faction, represented by senior lawyer Dhruv Mehta, had said that the decision of the Uddhav Thackeray-led leadership to sever ties with the BJP and form the Maha Vikas Aghadi government in November 2019 with the Congress and the NCP was a departure from the ideological platform on which the Shiv Sena had sought votes.

title: Winter Session likely from December 15 as govt seeks to push Delimitation Bill
description: With the Monsoon Session still not formally prorogued after 103 days the government faces a crucial test of numbers floor management and opposition resistance as it prepares to revisit the delimitation-linked women039s reservation bill
author: Himanshu Mishra
content:
Winter Session likely from December 15 as govt seeks to push Delimitation Bill
With the Monsoon Session still not formally prorogued after 103 days, the government faces a crucial test of numbers, floor management and opposition resistance as it prepares to revisit the delimitation-linked women's reservation bill.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has asked his ministerial colleagues to complete preparations for the next Parliament session before December 15 and avoid foreign travel in the run-up to it, according to PTI. The government is considering convening the session before December 15, with the Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs expected to decide its dates and duration.
The proposed delimitation-linked women's reservation bill is likely to be a key focus of the session, with the government also preparing for a possible debate on the proposed redistribution of Lok Sabha and Assembly seats.
According to PTI, the next Parliament session was discussed at Wednesday's Cabinet meeting chaired by PM Modi. The Prime Minister asked ministers to ensure their respective ministries were prepared for the session.
The development comes amid mounting questions from opposition parties over the delay in convening the Winter Session. The Monsoon Session, which was adjourned indefinitely on August 13, has not yet been formally prorogued, with 103 days having passed since both Houses were adjourned.
DELIMITATION-LINKED WOMEN'S RESERVATION BILL IN FOCUS
Attention is likely to be on whether the government introduces the delimitation-linked women's reservation bill during the upcoming session. The proposed Constitution amendment could face a tough numbers test as it requires a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha, or 361 votes in the 543-member House.
The Lok Sabha currently has 540 members due to three vacancies. The ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA) has 320 MPs and would need support from opposition parties to reach the required threshold.
The political arithmetic has changed since the bill was defeated in the Lok Sabha on April 17. Twenty-six MPs have since left the opposition camp, including 20 Trinamool Congress MPs who broke away and merged with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India, pledging support to the NDA. Six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs also joined the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena.
While these developments have strengthened the government's position, it still needs additional support to secure the required numbers. The DMK, with 22 Lok Sabha MPs, and the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar), with eight MPs, could play a crucial role.
OPPOSITION LIKELY TO PROTEST OVER SIR
The government could also face protests during the session, with opposition parties intensifying their campaign against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
An MP from the ruling alliance told PTI that a debate and vote on a Constitution amendment bill would not be possible unless Parliament functioned in an orderly manner. The opposition is expected to continue raising the SIR issue during the session.
GOVERNMENT EXPLORING 50% INCREASE IN LOK SABHA SEATS
The government is also exploring a proposal to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 per cent across states to address concerns, particularly among southern states, over the impact of delimitation.
The proposed framework is expected to retain the existing share of seats among states based on the 1971 Census. However, no final decision has been taken on the proposal.
The proposed Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026, failed to secure the required numbers during a special sitting of Parliament on April 17. With the next session likely to be convened before December 15, the government's preparations, opposition protests and the fate of the delimitation-linked bill are expected to shape proceedings.
While extending the existing session requires at least two days' notice, convening a fresh session requires a minimum notice of 14 days.

title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Court finds shooter to be minor, turns 18 in 5 days
description: A special MCOCA court found that an alleged shooter in the Tiger Shroff firing case was a minor The ruling sends him before the Juvenile Justice Board for further orders
author: Vidya
content:
Tiger Shroff firing case: Court finds shooter to be minor, turns 18 in 5 days
A special MCOCA court found that an alleged shooter in the Tiger Shroff firing case was a minor. The ruling sends him before the Juvenile Justice Board for further orders.
One of the alleged shooters in the October 18 firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff has been found to be a minor by a special Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) court. The court has directed that he be produced before the Juvenile Justice Board (JJB) for further orders.
The accused, who turns 18 on November 30, was the first person to be arrested in the case. Special Judge Satyanarayan R Navander passed the order after verifying his age under Section 9 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act.
The age verification was initiated after the accused's father approached the court, claiming that his son was under 18 when the firing took place and should, therefore, be dealt with under juvenile justice laws.
The court had ordered an inquiry into the claim. In a report submitted on Wednesday, the investigating officer confirmed the accused's date of birth as November 30, 2008.
The police verified his age using his school-leaving certificate, secondary examination certificate, school admission and withdrawal register, and birth registration records, including his birth certificate.
The accused had also submitted photocopies of his birth certificate and Aadhaar card to support his claim. He was around 17 years and 10 months old when the firing incident took place on October 18.
AGE CLAIM NOT RAISED BEFORE EARLIER COURTS
The court noted that the accused had been produced before three courts after his arrest in Sonipat, Haryana on October 19. These included a transit magistrate in Sonipat, the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Esplanade in Mumbai and the special MCOCA court, after the stringent law was invoked in the case.
However, neither the accused nor his lawyers had raised the issue of his age before these courts, the court had earlier observed.
The accused, on the other hand, claimed that police personnel had asked him not to disclose that he was a minor and had not given him sufficient opportunities to meet his lawyers.
He also has a previous motorcycle theft case against him, but claimed that he was acquitted by a Juvenile Court.
FIVE ROUNDS FIRED AT ACTOR'S CAR
The firing took place on October 18, when two alleged shooters, accompanied by a motorcycle rider, fired five rounds at Shroff's car as he was leaving a football ground in Mumbai's Juhu area.
The actor escaped with minor injuries, while his driver and a bystander, a vlogger, sustained bullet injuries.
Anil Pandit, an alleged member of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, later claimed responsibility for the attack. Police named him a wanted accused in the case.

title: Amid UK travel row, Saurav Das claims BJP-linked handles leaked passport details
description: Saurav Das alleged that BJP-aligned social media handles leaked and circulated his passport details The claim follows his blocked UK trip a show cause notice to him and his Delhi High Court challenge
author: Amit Bhardwaj
content:
Amid UK travel row, Saurav Das claims BJP-linked handles leaked passport details
Saurav Das alleged that BJP-aligned social media handles leaked and circulated his passport details. The claim follows his blocked UK trip, a show cause notice to him and his Delhi High Court challenge.
Cockroach Janta Party co-convener Saurav Das on Wednesday alleged that his passport details had been leaked and circulated by BJP-aligned social media handles, accusing them of targeted harassment and threatening to file a criminal complaint against those involved. The allegations come after he was stopped at Delhi airport from flying to London on Tuesday and issued a show-cause notice on Wednesday seeking an explanation for discrepancies in his place of birth mentioned in his passport.
In a post on X, Das claimed the alleged leak was part of a series of incidents in which his personal information was exposed and he was targeted online. He also sought clarification from the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) on whether the leaking of citizens' passport details was a routine affair.
"Certain BJP-aligned social media handles have now leaked my passport. This is a matter of serious concern. Will the Ministry of External Affairs clarify whether such leaks of citizens’ passports are a routine affair? Has doxxing been legalised in NewIndia?" he wrote on X.
The CJP leader, who was at the forefront of protests over NEET irregularities, further alleged that his Delhi residential address had earlier been leaked by a BJP-aligned social media handle, after which YouTubers allegedly entered his house while he was away. He further claimed that fabricated stories about his family life and a morphed photograph of him were circulated online.
Das added he had specifically sought protection against the leakage of his rent agreement while approaching the SEM Court, citing what he described as a pattern of targeted harassment.
"I shall be filing a criminal complaint with the relevant authorities against EVERY social media handle involved in circulating my passport," he said, adding that he was documenting every instance of alleged harassment.
The allegations come amid a controversy over Das being stopped from travelling to the United Kingdom to attend an event at the University of Oxford, where he was invited to speak about the Cockroach Janta Party mobilisation.
Das had alleged that he was stopped at the immigration counter at Delhi airport before boarding his flight to London, scheduled for 1 am on Tuesday. He claimed that his passport had been flagged and that he was not allowed to travel despite invitations to speak at institutions including Oxford, Cambridge, the London School of Economics and Edinburgh.
On Wednesday, the MEA said the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai had issued a show-cause notice to Das over discrepancies concerning his place of birth on his passport. MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said the notice was issued on November 23, asking Das to respond within seven days, and officials added that he was advised not to use his passport until he clarifies his birthplace.
According to the MEA, the notice followed inputs from relevant law enforcement authorities regarding discrepancies in the information furnished in his passport application. Das was also advised not to use his passport until he submitted his response to the notice.
Das has challenged the authorities' decision to prevent him from travelling abroad before the Delhi High Court. His counsel told the court that he was stopped at immigration without being shown an order or a lookout circular prohibiting his travel and sought an urgent hearing, saying he could still travel to the UK on November 27.
The controversy has drawn criticism from the Cockroach Janta Party, which accused the government of attempting to silence educated voices. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke alleged that someone in power was jealous of Das receiving an invitation to speak at Oxford.

title: Surat doctor gets two-year jail term for negligence in treatment of composer Ismail Darbar’s mother
description: A Surat court sentenced Dr Pareshkumar Bhajiyawala to two years in jail for medical negligence that caused burn injuries to Ismail Darbar’s mother in 2009. | India News
author: HT Correspondent
content:
Surat doctor gets two-year jail term for negligence in treatment of composer Ismail Darbar’s mother
A Surat court sentenced Dr Pareshkumar Bhajiyawala to two years in jail for medical negligence that caused burn injuries to Ismail Darbar’s mother in 2009.
A Surat court on Wednesday sentenced a doctor to two years of simple imprisonment for causing grievous injuries to the mother of Bollywood music composer Ismail Darbar through medical negligence during her treatment at a private hospital in 2009. The court also imposed a fine of ₹1,000.
In a 95-page judgment, Judicial Magistrate First Class Pooja Surana convicted Dr Pareshkumar Bhajiyawala under Section 338 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), which deals with causing grievous hurt through an act that endangers human life or personal safety. The court ordered a further six months of simple imprisonment if he fails to pay the fine. It also granted him bail of ₹15,000 during the appeal period.
The case concerns Zetunbibi Darbar, 70, who was admitted to Girish Group of Hospital in Surat on January 17, 2009, with fever and other health complications. During treatment, she complained of back pain. Bhajiyawala, who was on night duty, instructed a nurse to apply a hot-water bag to her back. She died at the hospital on February 12.
Advocate Ketan Reshamwala, who represented the complainant, said the bag was supposed to be removed within a stipulated time but remained in contact with the patient’s body throughout the night. This caused severe burns to her back and arm, he said.
“The historic verdict was delivered today by the Surat court in the medical negligence case linked to the death of music composer Ismail Darbar’s mother,” Reshamwala said.
The complainant, Shahidabanu Hussain Darbar, Ismail Darbar’s sister, told the court that the family had warned hospital staff that the water bag was too hot. However, the nurse did not remove it. The patient’s skin was found burnt the following morning.
The court relied on the testimonies of doctors and hospital staff to establish that the hot-water bag had been applied on Bhajiyawala’s instructions.
“The facts that the hot-water bag was placed on the patient’s instructions by Dr Paresh Bhajiyawala are proved beyond doubt. The evidence of other hospital employees also establishes that the doctor was present on duty at the hospital at the time of the incident. In these circumstances, the doctor’s negligence is clearly evident.”
The post-mortem report recorded two healing burn injuries, one on the left side of the back near the shoulder and another on the back of the left arm. The investigating officer also told the court that the nurse had stated that the hot-water bag was applied on the doctor’s instructions.
The court held that the prosecution had established that Bhajiyawala was on duty when the incident occurred and that the injuries were caused during treatment. It noted that Zetunbibi remained under treatment for more than 20 days, suffering severe physical pain and being unable to carry out her routine activities.
The court convicted Bhajiyawala under Section 338 but acquitted him under Section 337, which deals with causing simple hurt through a negligent act. It held that the same injury could not attract convictions under both provisions.
While sentencing the doctor, the judge rejected the defence’s plea for a fine instead of imprisonment.
“In the doctor’s profession, such a negligent act cannot be considered excusable, and since the patient’s death occurred because of the doctor’s negligence, it is a serious matter, so it is necessary that an example be set in society,” the order said.
The judgment, however, records the conviction under Section 338 for causing grievous hurt, not for causing death.
The first information report (FIR) was registered at Athwalines police station on January 25, 2009, under Sections 337, 338 and 114 of the IPC. The chargesheet was filed on June 4, 2009. Evidence in the trial began on December 16, 2021, and the judgment was reserved on September 21, 2026.
The case was filed against Bhajiyawala and nurse Chinchupalli Parampil Sukumaran. The court had separated the nurse’s trial on October 6, 2021, after a non-bailable warrant was issued against her. It directed the Athwalines police inspector to file a separate chargesheet against her.

title: Ex-Congress MLA Vinay Kulkarni must surrender in 2 weeks as SCt cancels bail in 2016 murder case
description: The Supreme Court set aside the Karnataka high court order staying Vinay Kulkarni’s conviction and directed him and seven co-convicts to surrender within two weeks. | India News
author: Abraham Thomas
content:
Ex-Congress MLA Vinay Kulkarni must surrender in 2 weeks as SCt cancels bail in 2016 murder case
The Supreme Court set aside the Karnataka high court order staying Vinay Kulkarni’s conviction and directed him and seven co-convicts to surrender within two weeks.
The Supreme Court on Wednesday held that long pendency in deciding criminal appeals cannot be a ground to suspend sentence and grant bail in grave offences, as it set aside the order of the Karnataka high court staying the conviction and sentence of former Congress legislator Vinay Kulkarni in a 2016 murder case.
Directing him to surrender in two weeks, the top court termed the July 31, 2026, high court order as “perverse” for staying the conviction on a “misconception” that the convict would stand disqualified as a member of the legislative assembly if the conviction order is sustained.
The order by a bench of justices PK Mishra and Shree Chandrashekhar said, “It is a wrong notion that pendency of the criminal appeal and its remote possibility of hearing in near future can be a ground to suspend the sentence in grave offences like murder, dacoity, rape, ransom etc….The gravity of the crime which affects the administration of criminal justice system may at times take precedence over other considerations.”
The court also found fault with the HC order staying the conviction of Kulkarni and others. It said, “This is a misconception that the judgment of conviction should be stayed because the convict would be disqualified to be a member of the legislative assembly. If that is how the power of the court to stay the judgment of conviction is to be interpreted then every convicted legislator would automatically become entitled to an order staying the conviction.”
The court was of the view that once convicted, the statutory consequence of disqualification under section 8(3) of the Representation of People Act, 1951 cannot be avoided by showing that there is an arguable case for acquittal. “The decision of the high court is clearly perverse and, thus, liable to be set aside.”
It said that long pendency of criminal appeals is a reality across several high courts which does not automatically entitle a life convict to suspension of sentence. “It is also a matter of equality and liberty of hundreds of other convicts who are sentenced to life imprisonment and have served a substantial part of their sentence,” the Supreme Court said, pointing out that the high court overlooked the fact that Kulkarni, along with seven others, were convicted on April 15 this year giving no reason for them to be “treated differently”.
Setting aside the HC order, the bench cancelled the bail bonds furnished by the eight life convicts and directed them to surrender before the concerned court within two weeks.
The court was hearing separate appeals against conviction filed by Karnataka government and against sentence filed by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the kin of the deceased Yogesh Goudar, a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader and the then Dharwad Zilla Panchayat member.
The high court had passed the order while hearing the appeals filed by Kulkarni and others against the trial court verdict convicting them in the case. The order said that the high court failed to pinpoint any “serious error” in the judgment of the trial court to make out a case for acquittal of the accused.
The bench said that a judgment of stay of conviction is an exceptional remedy and has a higher threshold to meet which means existence of a “palpable mistake” in the judgment of conviction that renders it illegal. Further, it said that an order of suspension of sentence can be passed where the high court forms an opinion that the convict has a fair chance of acquittal, that is to say, that he has a good prima facie case for acquittal.
The CBI had identified Kulkarni as the “mastermind” of the crime and named the other seven convicts to have facilitated the commission of crime by providing logistics, weapons used in the murder that took place on June 15, 2016. The Karnataka government had transferred the case to CBI on September 6, 2019 pursuant to which Kulkarni was named as an accused.

title: Government extends free travel for Chakra series gallantry awardees in all trains including Vande Bharat
description: The Army said the Railways and Defence ministries made the change without altering existing entitlements, calling it a “shared commitment” to honour valour. | India News
author: PTI
content:
Government extends free travel for Chakra series gallantry awardees in all trains including Vande Bharat
The Army said the Railways and Defence ministries made the change without altering existing entitlements, calling it a “shared commitment” to honour valour.
Published on: Nov 25, 2026, 21:26:23 IST
PTI
Share via
Copy link
The government has extended the complimentary train travel facility for recipients of Chakra series gallantry awards to all trains, including Vande Bharat, without changing their existing entitlements, officials said on Wednesday.
The Army shared the update in a post on X.
"Honouring valour, in a significant welfare initiative, the Ministry of Railways, in consultation with the Ministry of Defence, has enhanced the complimentary train travel facility for Chakra Series Awardees," it said.
"The facility now extends to all trains, including Vande Bharat, without any change in their existing entitlements," it added.
The initiative reflects a "shared commitment" to honouring the courage, sacrifice and service of the country's "yoddhas" and recognising their invaluable contribution to the nation, the Army said.
The first three gallantry awards instituted by the government after Independence were the Param Vir Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra and Vir Chakra. They were instituted on January 26, 1950, with retrospective effect from August 15, 1947, according to the official website of gallantry awards.
Subsequently, three other gallantry awards were instituted.
The order of precedence of the six awards is Param Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, Mahavir Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Vir Chakra and Shaurya Chakra.

title: Why Was Lamp Lit At Mandapam, Not Deepathoon? Governor Seeks Answer From CM Vijay
description: Madurai district collector Nishant Krishna apologised to the Supreme Court for failing to implement its order.
author: Shuddhanta Patra
content:
Why Was Lamp Lit At Mandapam, Not Deepathoon? Governor Seeks Answer From CM Vijay
Madurai district collector Nishant Krishna apologised to the Supreme Court for failing to implement its order.
Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Arlekar on Wednesday asked Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay to explain why the ceremonial lamp at Tirupparankundram was lit at the Deepam Mandapam near the Uchi Pillayar Temple instead of the Deepathoon (stone pillar), as directed by the Supreme Court.
As per reports, Arlekar has invoked Article 167(b) of the Constitution, which requires the chief minister to furnish information relating to the administration of state affairs and legislative proposals when sought by the governor.
- Constitution Day: Nitin Nabin, Shah And Nadda to Take BJP’s Message Across North, East and West India
- 53 Fall Sick After Eating Shawarma at Thane Roadside Stall, 17 Children Among Hospitalised
- No Active Local Militants Left In J&K, 65 Pakistani Terrorists Still On Security Radar: Report
- 'Clear Case Of Disobedience': Fomer Justice K. Kannan On SC Order | Thiruparankundram Deepam Row
The development comes after the ceremonial lamp was lit at the Deepam Mandapam near the Uchi Pillayar Temple at Tirupparankundram, near Madurai, on November 24, coinciding with the Karthigai Deepam festival. The lighting was carried out at the customary spot instead of the Deepathoon, where the Supreme Court had allowed the lamp to be lit as a one-time measure.
Political parties react to Deepam controversy
Several political parties, including the Congress, Left parties and the Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK), welcomed the move. However, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) and Hindu outfits criticised the TVK government.
The temple board defended the decision to light the lamp at the Deepam Mandapam, saying the location was part of the temple’s customary practice.
“It is customary for the Karthigai Deepam to be lit at the Deepa Mandapam near the Uchi Pillayar Temple atop the hill as it is located directly above the head of the main presiding deity (Moolavar)," the board said.
It added that a unanimous decision had been taken to light the lamp at the customary location, arguing that age-old practices should be protected.
“Such long standing continuous practices, religious traditions and rituals and the Agama rules are considered the unique religious identity of the temple," a detailed press note signed by temple board of trustees chairperson V Shanmugasundaram read.
Madurai collector apologises to Supreme Court
On Wednesday, Madurai district collector Nishant Krishna apologised to the Supreme Court for failing to implement its order.
“I sincerely apologise for the lamp not been lit at the Deepathoon," Krishna said in his status report to the top court.
He said he had taken “all the steps" between November 21 and 24 to secure the Devasthanam’s authorisation for a team to light the lamp at the Deepathoon, in accordance with the court’s November 20 order.
The Karthigai Deepam controversy centres on a dispute over where and by whom the ceremonial lamp should be lit on the Thiruparankundram hill.
For decades, the deepam was lit at the Deepa Mandapam near the Uchipillaiyar Temple on the lower slopes. Hindu groups had sought permission to light it at the Deepathoon, an ancient stone lamp pillar located higher up the hill, around 50 metres from the Hazrat Sultan Sikandar Badusha Auliya Dargah.
Quick Answers
Tamil Nadu Governor asked Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay to explain why the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam lamp was lit at the Deepam Mandapam instead of the Deepathoon stone pillar, failing to follow a Supreme Court directive.

title: Constitution Day: Nitin Nabin, Shah And Nadda to Take BJP’s Message Across North, East and West India
description: The three engagements come at a time when the Constitution and Ambedkar's legacy have become important political battlegrounds between the BJP and the Opposition.
author: Saurabh Verma, Anindya Banerjee
content:
Constitution Day: Nitin Nabin, Shah And Nadda to Take BJP’s Message Across North, East and West India
The three engagements come at a time when the Constitution and Ambedkar's legacy have become important political battlegrounds between the BJP and the Opposition.
On Constitution Day, the BJP will deploy its current national president and two of his predecessors across three regions of the country, underlining the political importance the party attaches to the occasion and its effort to shape the national discourse around the Constitution and its chief architect, Dr BR Ambedkar.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah will lead the party’s programme in Delhi, BJP national president Nitin Nabin will be in Patna, while former party president and Union Health Minister JP Nadda will attend an event in Gujarat.
- BJP Wants to Grow, But Is It Leaving Party Workers Behind? Saffron Scoop
- Punjab Assembly Elections | BJP–SAD Alliance: Seat-Sharing Formula Takes Centre Stage | News18
- BJP And Akali Dal To Reunite After Six-Year Split? Amit Shah-Sukhbir Singh Badal's Joint Presser At 1 PM
- 'Too Bad To Even Squad Up With': BJP Posts GTA 6 Memes Targeting Rahul Gandhi, Mamata Banerjee, Kejriwal
The three engagements, spanning north, east and west India, come at a time when the Constitution and Ambedkar’s legacy have become important political battlegrounds between the BJP and the Opposition. The party’s decision to involve its present and two former national presidents also signals that the exercise is being accorded importance beyond routine commemorative events.
In Delhi, Shah will be the chief guest and keynote speaker at the BJP’s ‘Samvidhan Gaurav Diwas Samaroh’ at the Civic Centre. Chief Minister Rekha Gupta will also address the gathering, which is expected to include MPs, intellectuals, professionals, teachers and students.
In Patna, Nitin Nabin will inaugurate the Constitution Day programme at Gyan Bhawan at 2 pm. The event is expected to bring together representatives from different fields, including education, law, industry, commerce and sports, to discuss constitutional values and social justice.
In Gujarat, Nadda is expected to participate in the BJP’s main programme at Ahmedabad’s Tagore Hall, alongside Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel and state BJP president Jagdish Vishwakarma.
Significance Of November 26
November 26 marks the day the Constituent Assembly adopted the Indian Constitution in 1949. It came into force on January 26, 1950.
The Narendra Modi government formally designated November 26 as Constitution Day in 2015, coinciding with the 125th birth anniversary year of Ambedkar, who chaired the Constitution’s Drafting Committee. Before that, the date was observed as National Law Day, primarily by the legal fraternity.
The decision to institutionalise the occasion also gave the BJP an opportunity to foreground Ambedkar’s contribution to nation-building and take the Constitution beyond the traditional observance of Republic Day.
The political significance of the occasion has grown over the years, particularly as the BJP and the Opposition have increasingly contested the question of who represents Ambedkar’s legacy and who can claim to be the defender of the Constitution.
In 2024, then BJP president JP Nadda declared: “We can say with pride that we are the champions of the Constitution." He also questioned why it had taken 65 years after Independence for the country to begin formally celebrating Constitution Day, taking a swipe at the Congress.
Last year, Amit Shah, in his Constitution Day message, said the Constitution provides every Indian with equal opportunities, a dignified life, national duties and rights. He credited Modi with initiating Constitution Day to make citizens more aware of democratic values.
Delhi BJP president Harsh Malhotra has also described the Constitution as “not just a book" but “a document of the faith and aspirations of 140 crore Indians".
Who Owns Ambedkar’s Legacy?
For the BJP, the Constitution Day exercise is also about making a larger political argument: that Ambedkar’s legacy and the constitutional ideals he championed cannot be viewed through the prism of any one political party or family.
The party has sought to highlight initiatives such as the constitutional status granted to the National Commission for Backward Classes and the 10 per cent reservation for economically weaker sections as examples of its commitment to constitutional principles.
The Opposition, particularly the Congress, has meanwhile sought to make the defence of the Constitution a central political plank, raising questions about institutional independence, federalism, civil liberties and the protection of constitutional rights.
This makes November 26 more than a ceremonial occasion. It has become a platform for competing political claims over who best represents the Constitution’s founding ideals.
At the heart of the contest are three questions: who represents Ambedkar’s legacy, who is genuinely defending the Constitution, and what kind of Republic did the members of the Constituent Assembly envision?
By sending its current and two former national presidents to Delhi, Patna and Gujarat, the BJP is seeking to make its own case on all three.
Quick Answers
On Constitution Day, the BJP deployed top leadership across three regions to underline the occasion's political importance. Union Home Minister Amit Shah led the event in Delhi as the chief guest at the Civic Centre, BJP national president Nitin Nabin inaugurated the programme at Gyan Bhawan in Patna, and Union Health Minister JP Nadda attended the main event at Ahmedabad's Tagore Hall in Gujarat.

title: 53 Fall Sick After Eating Shawarma at Thane Roadside Stall, 17 Children Among Hospitalised
description: The affected people had eaten shawarma at a stall in the Vanzarpatti Naka area on Monday night. They later developed symptoms such as vomiting and loose motions.
author: Yimkumla Longkumer, News Desk
content:
53 Fall Sick After Eating Shawarma at Thane Roadside Stall, 17 Children Among Hospitalised
The affected people had eaten shawarma at a stall in the Vanzarpatti Naka area on Monday night. They later developed symptoms such as vomiting and loose motions.
At least 53 people, including 17 children, have been hospitalised with suspected food poisoning after eating shawarma at a roadside eatery in Bhiwandi, in Maharashtra’s Thane district, officials said on Wednesday.
The patients, who include 25 women, are being treated at the state-run Indira Gandhi Memorial (IGM) Hospital. Their condition is currently stable, said Dr Sandeep Gadekar, Medical Officer of Health at the Bhiwandi-Nizampur City Municipal Corporation (BNCMC).
- Within 24 Hours Of Inauguration, Mumbai's New Anti-Drug Van Hits First Concert; 12 Booked
- Saif Ali Khan Gets Threat In Name Of Zeeshan Akhtar, Baba Siddique Murder Accused Tied To Lawrence Bishnoi Gang
- Pune Techie Beats Girlfriend To Death After Argument, Sits Beside Body All Night
- Viral Video: Mumbai Couple Attacked With Sticks And Stones Near Phoenix Mall; Internet Divided
The affected people had eaten shawarma at a stall in the Vanzarpatti Naka area on Monday night. They later developed symptoms such as vomiting and loose motions.
The number of hospitalised patients has risen sharply from 11 reported on Tuesday to 53.
Eatery Owner Absconding, Probe Underway
According to PTI, police have registered a case against the eatery owner under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. The owner is currently absconding, Gadekar said.
FDA officials have inspected the eatery and launched an investigation into the incident. Stool samples from the patients have also been collected for laboratory tests to establish the cause of their illness.
FDA Assistant Commissioner Santosh Shisodia said the municipal corporation had been asked to identify designated areas for street food vendors to ensure better monitoring and hygiene checks.
He also pointed out that the drinking water supplied in Bhiwandi appeared yellow, but said laboratory tests would be needed to establish whether it had any connection with the reported illnesses.
The BNCMC health department is monitoring the situation, Gadekar said.
(With inputs from PTI)
Quick Answers
At least 53 people, including 17 children and 25 women, suffered from suspected food poisoning after eating shawarma at a roadside stall in the Vanzarpatti Naka area of Bhiwandi on Monday night.

Prompted by a Supreme Court rebuke over inaccurate reports on encroached Lodhi-era tombs in Zamrudpur, the Municipal Corporation of Delhi has mandated annual inspections, geo-tagged photo logs, and blue plaques across 1,318 heritage structures—including 87 Grade-I monuments.
The Municipal Corporation of Delhi on Wednesday notified a mandatory annual inspection plan for 1,318 heritage sites under its jurisdiction, requiring officials to maintain photographic records of their condition, document encroachments and identify structures at risk of damage or collapse.
The framework, which includes 87 Grade-I heritage sites of the highest historical importance, comes after the Supreme Court pulled up the civic body over inaccurate inspection reports on five Lodhi-era tombs in south Delhi’s Zamrudpur village.
The monuments were found encroached upon, neglected and being used as dumping grounds and a cattle shed, despite earlier MCD reports suggesting otherwise.
The court had expressed serious displeasure over the discrepancy and warned that officials could face action if inspection reports submitted by agencies were found to be incorrect.
Under the plan, each maintenance and building division will inspect at least two notified heritage properties every month, ensuring that every site is covered at least once a year.
Officials will have to take at least three dated, labelled and location-referenced photographs of each property and maintain records of its condition, ownership, encroachments and repair history.
Inspections will document structural cracks, seepage, vegetation, unsafe portions and changes in the use of heritage buildings, officials said.
The civic body will also survey heritage structures that have not been formally notified, including those whose location or ownership details remain unclear, to identify and bring them on record.
The framework also mandates installation of standardised blue plaques on notified heritage buildings, carrying the site’s name, year of origin and the corporation’s logo.
It provides for regular inspections of privately owned and other government-owned heritage properties, with owners or occupying agencies responsible for repairs and restoration.
For MCD-owned properties, the Land and Estate Department will have 90 days from the plan’s notification to verify ownership records and enter them in the IP Register. The Heritage Cell will maintain a central database, while zonal offices will handle inspections and conservation work.
Repair proposals and alterations will require scrutiny by the Heritage Cell and Town Planning Department, along with Heritage Conservation Committee advice wherever applicable.

title: Centre’s fiscal restrictions straining Keralam, says CM; asks MPs to push for funds in Parliament
description: On the Ecologically Sensitive Areas (ESA) issue, the meeting decided to urge the Centre to issue the final notification for the first phase, covering 98 villages across 8,590.69 sq km, as recommended by the state. A decision on the 33 villages proposed for exclusion in the second phase should be taken only after the Centre and the state reach a consensus, it said.
author: PTI
content:
Centre’s fiscal restrictions straining Keralam, says CM; asks MPs to push for funds in Parliament
- Published OnNov 25, 2026 | 21:49 IST
- Last Updated OnNov 25, 2026 | 21:49 IST
On the Ecologically Sensitive Areas (ESA) issue, the meeting decided to urge the Centre to issue the final notification for the first phase, covering 98 villages across 8,590.69 sq km, as recommended by the state. A decision on the 33 villages proposed for exclusion in the second phase should be taken only after the Centre and the state reach a consensus, it said.
Chief Minister V D Satheesan said on Wednesday that financial restrictions imposed by the Centre are putting severe economic strain on Keralam.
He urged the state's MPs to intervene jointly to secure its legitimate share of central funds.
Addressing a meeting of MPs convened ahead of the winter session of Parliament at the Chief Minister's Conference Hall, Satheesan said the complete withdrawal of revenue deficit grants, which amounted to ₹55,000 crore during the 15th Finance Commission period, has created serious financial difficulties for the state.
He said the state's borrowing limit is fixed at 3.5% of its Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP). The Centre's refusal to allow an additional 0.5% of borrowing linked to investment in the energy sector has dealt another blow to the state's finances, he added, according to a statement.
The Centre's new methodology for calculating GDP has reportedly reduced the state's GSDP by an estimated 20%. Because the borrowing limit is determined by GSDP, this could further reduce the state's borrowing capacity, he said.
These concerns, along with other demands, were conveyed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a memorandum submitted by the state government, the CM said.
Satheesan cautioned departments against lapses in utilising funds under central schemes.
All departments have been directed to study the schemes, prepare detailed project reports and submit proposals to secure the maximum central assistance.
He urged MPs to work as a united team and press the Centre to approve projects and release funds.
The meeting resolved to raise in Parliament the states' concerns over the reduction in GSDP figures under the new methodology, and to demand that the figures be finalised only after those concerns are addressed.
The meeting discussed the possibility of establishing a maritime university in the state, building on Mission Samudra and the Maritime Institute at Kollam.
New maritime-related courses are planned through polytechnics to widen educational opportunities in the sector. The state has identified 12 academic programmes of international standard, to be developed with academic institutions, and expects to introduce at least half of them in the next academic year, Satheesan said.
The meeting further decided to take up with the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister (C Joseph Vijay) and government the issue of Keralam not receiving its rightful share of water under the Parambikulam-Aliyar project.
MPs were urged to secure favourable decisions from the Centre on key projects and demands in the memorandum the CM submitted to the PM this month.
These include the Vizhinjam-Balaramapuram railway line, on which the state has already spent ₹541 crore.
Keralam has sought a review of the proposed non-government railway development model and has demanded that the Railway Ministry take over the funding, construction and operation of the line.
The memorandum covers a greenfield shipbuilding and ship-repair cluster in the Poovar-Vizhinjam region, green bunkering and green hydrogen initiatives, expansion of port capacity, port-related industries, logistics parks, and improved rail and road connectivity.
The meeting reviewed demands relating to the Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment scheme, reconsideration of the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) notification, and additional borrowing limits linked to energy-sector reforms.
The state sought central intervention on projects in a separate memorandum submitted to Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari.
These cover the state's share of land acquisition costs for National Highway 66, the Palakkad-Kozhikode greenfield highway and the Thiruvananthapuram Outer Ring Road.
On the Ecologically Sensitive Areas (ESA) issue, the meeting decided to urge the Centre to issue the final notification for the first phase, covering 98 villages across 8,590.69 sq km, as recommended by the state. A decision on the 33 villages proposed for exclusion in the second phase should be taken only after the Centre and the state reach a consensus, it said.
Ministers Sunny Joseph, K Muraleedharan, K M Shaji and P C Vishnunadh, along with MPs and senior officials, took part in the meeting both online and in person, the statement added.

title: दर्शन से पहले ही अपराधियों पर शिकंजा! तिरुपति में AI कैमरों ने पकड़े 18 संदिग्ध, टली बड़ी वारदातें
description: तिरुपति मंदिर परिसर में सुरक्षा के लिए लगाए गए हाई-टेक AI कैमरों की मदद से पुलिस ने दर्शन से पहले ही 18 वांछित संदिग्धों को दबोच लिया है. जानें कैसे फेशियल रिकग्निशन तकनीक से टली बड़ी वारदातें और क्या है सुरक्षा का पूरा अपडेट.
author: रवींद्र प्रताप सिंह
content:
तिरुमाला की पावन पहाड़ियों पर रोजाना हजारों की तादाद में श्रद्धालु भगवान वेंकटेश्वर के दर्शन के लिए लंबी कतारों में लगते हैं. चारों तरफ आस्था का माहौल और गोविंदा के जयकारे गूंजते रहते हैं. लेकिन, इसी भक्ति और भारी भीड़ के बीच कुछ ऐसे शातिर अपराधी और जेबकतरे भी छिपे होते हैं, जो मासूम श्रद्धालुओं की जेब काटने या उनका कीमती सामान उड़ाने की फिराक में रहते हैं.
आम तौर पर पुलिस और सुरक्षा एजेंसियों का काम चोरी या वारदात होने के बाद शुरू होता है. सीसीटीवी फुटेज खंगाले जाते हैं और फिर चोरों की तलाश होती है. मगर, क्या हो अगर किसी श्रद्धालु के साथ अपराध होने से पहले ही संदिग्ध की पहचान कर ली जाए? तिरुमाला तिरुपति देवस्थानम यानी टीटीडी ने अब तीर्थयात्रियों की सुरक्षा के लिए कुछ ऐसा ही हाई-टेक और अनोखा रास्ता अपनाया है.
तिरुमाला में रोज उमड़ने वाली भारी भीड़ का फायदा उठाकर कई बार चोरी करने वाले गिरोह सक्रिय हो जाते हैं. मंदिर प्रशासन की तरफ से लाउडस्पीकर पर लगातार अनाउंसमेंट करके लोगों को अपने सामान और गहनों के प्रति सतर्क रहने की सलाह दी जाती है. अब टीटीडी ने पारंपरिक सुरक्षा व्यवस्था से एक कदम आगे बढ़ते हुए आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस आधारित 'फेशियल डिटेक्शन टेक्नोलॉजी' (चेहरा पहचानने वाली तकनीक) का इस्तेमाल शुरू कर दिया है.
इस सिस्टम के तहत पूरे मंदिर परिसर और कतारों में लगे हाई-रेज़ोल्यूशन सीसीटीवी कैमरों को पुराने और संदिग्ध अपराधियों के डेटाबेस से जोड़ा गया है. जैसे ही कोई आदतन अपराधी या संदिग्ध व्यक्ति कैमरे की नजर में आता है, सिस्टम तुरंत कंट्रोल रूम को अलर्ट भेज देता है.
जब कंट्रोल रूम में किसी संदिग्ध चेहरे का अलर्ट आता है, तो वहां तैनात सुरक्षाकर्मी सबसे पहले तस्वीर का मिलान करते हैं. इसके बाद ग्राउंड पर मौजूद विजिलेंस टीम को उस व्यक्ति की लोकेशन भेजी जाती है. सुरक्षाकर्मी भीड़ के बीच से उस संदिग्ध को अलग ले जाकर पूछताछ और उसके दस्तावेजों की जांच करते हैं.
अगर व्यक्ति का पुराना आपराधिक रिकॉर्ड मिलता है, तो उसे कड़ी चेतावनी दी जाती है और पूरे समय उस पर निगरानी रखी जाती है. इस पूरी प्रक्रिया में इस बात का खास ख्याल रखा जाता है कि किसी भी आम श्रद्धालु की आस्था या दर्शन की यात्रा में कोई खलल न पड़े. टीटीडी के मुख्य सतर्कता एवं सुरक्षा अधिकारी (CV&SO) मुरली कृष्णा (IPS) के मुताबिक, इस पहल का मुख्य मकसद तकनीक के जरिए अपराध होने से पहले ही उसे रोकना है, ताकि दर्शन के लिए आने वाले भक्त खुद को पूरी तरह सुरक्षित महसूस कर सकें.
इस नई तकनीक के नतीजे भी अब साफ दिखने लगे हैं. हाल के दिनों में इस सिस्टम की मदद से तिरुपति बालाजी मंदिर परिसर में करीब 18 संदिग्धों की समय रहते पहचान की गई है, जिससे कई संभावित चोरियों को होने से पहले ही रोक लिया गया.
हालांकि, सुरक्षा अधिकारी यह भी मानते हैं कि मशीन से मिलने वाला अलर्ट सिर्फ एक शुरुआती संकेत होता है, जिसे किसी के अपराधी होने का पक्का सबूत नहीं माना जा सकता. इसलिए किसी भी कार्रवाई से पहले सुरक्षाकर्मियों द्वारा व्यक्तिगत रूप से जांच और कानूनी प्रक्रिया का पूरा पालन किया जाता है.
टीटीडी के इस कदम से मंदिर आने वाले भक्त भी काफी खुश और आश्वस्त नजर आ रहे हैं. मुंबई से आए श्रद्धालु विश्वनाथ शेट्टी, जो पिछले 16 सालों से लगातार तिरुपति आ रहे हैं, कहते हैं कि यह टीटीडी की एक शानदार पहल है. उनके मुताबिक, चोरी और अन्य अपराधों को रोकने के लिए देश के सभी बड़े मंदिरों और तीर्थ स्थलों पर इस तरह की तकनीक लागू की जानी चाहिए.
हर भक्त तिरुमाला की पहाड़ियों पर एक गहरी आस्था और विश्वास लेकर आता है. कोई भी यह नहीं चाहेगा कि दर्शन के बाद वह चोरी जैसी किसी दुखद घटना का शिकार होकर घर लौटे. सीसीटीवी कैमरों से लेकर फेशियल डिटेक्शन तक, टीटीडी का यह नया सुरक्षा मॉडल आने वाले समय में देश के अन्य बड़े धार्मिक स्थलों के लिए भी एक बेहतरीन मिसाल बन सकता है.

title: 'भीड़ में जाने के लिए किसने कहा?' राजीव गांधी की सिक्योरिटी को लेकर राहुल के आरोपों पर हरिवंश का पलटवार
description: पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री राजीव गांधी की सुरक्षा में चूक को लेकर राहुल गांधी के आरोपों पर राज्यसभा के उपसभापति हरिवंश नारायण सिंह ने तीखा पलटवार किया है. जानिए उन्होंने भीड़ में जाने की सलाह और तत्कालीन सुरक्षा व्यवस्था को लेकर क्या बड़े सवाल उठाए.
author: रवींद्र प्रताप सिंह
content:
पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री राजीव गांधी की सुरक्षा हटाए जाने को लेकर कांग्रेस नेता राहुल गांधी के आरोपों पर अब राज्यसभा के उपसभापति हरिवंश नारायण सिंह ने अपनी प्रतिक्रिया दी है. तत्कालीन प्रधानमंत्री चंद्रशेखर के कार्यकाल में प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय (PMO) में अतिरिक्त सूचना सलाहकार रहे हरिवंश ने इस पूरे प्रकरण पर तथ्यों को सामने रखते हुए कहा कि संवेदनशील मुद्दों पर केवल प्रमाणित सत्य ही जनता के सामने रखा जाना चाहिए.
हरिवंश नारायण सिंह के अनुसार, राजीव गांधी की हत्या भारतीय राजनीति का एक बेहद दुखद अध्याय है. उन्होंने कहा कि उच्च पदों पर बैठे लोगों को ऐसे गंभीर और संवेदनशील मामलों में भ्रम फैलाने या प्रोपेगेंडा करने के बजाय केवल सत्य और सत्यापित तथ्य ही सामने रखने चाहिए. उन्होंने इस मामले से जुड़े सात प्रमुख पहलुओं का जिक्र करते हुए तत्कालीन परिस्थितियों का हवाला दिया.
हरिवंश ने पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री चंद्रशेखर की आत्मकथा 'चंद्रशेखर: जिंदगी का कारवां' किताब में लिखी कोट का जिक्र करते हुए बताया कि सुरक्षा एजेंसियां राजीव गांधी की सुरक्षा को लेकर लगातार चिंतित थीं. आत्मकथा के मुताबिक, एजेंसियों ने उनसे बार-बार सुरक्षा प्रोटोकॉल न तोड़ने का आग्रह किया था. हरिवंश ने बताया कि जब तत्कालीन प्रधानमंत्री चंद्रशेखर को इसकी जानकारी मिली, तो उन्होंने स्वयं राजीव गांधी को सावधानी बरतने की सलाह दी और सुरक्षा उपायों का पालन करने के लिए उन्हें दो बार पत्र भी लिखा.
#WATCH | Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh | Over Rahul Gandhi's allegation of the security removal of his father and former PM Rajiv Gandhi, Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, Harivansh Narayan Singh says, "There is a crucial question that the nation deserves an answer to: who within the Congress party were in contact with the LTTE? Who assured Rajiv Gandhi that he could trust the LTTE—claiming that talks had taken place and that the group would not engage in any hostile acts? Furthermore, who were the individuals in Rajiv Gandhi’s inner circle who encouraged him to go into crowds, suggesting that the government was merely using "security alerts" to undermine his popularity? These individuals must be identified, and the people of this country should demand an investigation—even now, if one has not yet been conducted." Harivansh Narayan Singh served as the Additional Information Adviser in the PMO during former Prime Minister Chandra Shekhar's tenure
— ANI (@ANI) November 25, 2026
चंद्रशेखर के लेखन का हवाला देते हुए हरिवंश ने कहा कि राजीव गांधी के अपने सहयोगियों ने ही उनकी सुरक्षा के ऊपर राजनीतिक लाभ को प्राथमिकता दी थी. आत्मकथा में दर्ज विवरण के अनुसार, उनके सहयोगियों ने उन्हें जनता से सीधे घुलने-मिलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया, जिससे सुरक्षा घेरा टूटने की स्थितियां पैदा हुईं. हरिवंश का कहना है कि सुरक्षा में हुई इस चूक के लिए उनके अपने करीबी ही जिम्मेदार थे.
हरिवंश नारायण सिंह ने आत्मकथा के उस हिस्से को भी साझा किया जिसमें चुनावी दौर की घटनाओं का जिक्र है. इसके अनुसार, ऐसी खबरें थीं कि राजीव गांधी ने अपने कुछ विश्वस्त सहयोगियों के माध्यम से लिट्टे (LTTE) से संपर्क साधा था, और लिट्टे ने उन्हें भविष्य में सहयोग का आश्वासन दिया था. हरिवंश ने स्पष्ट किया कि उनके करीबी लोगों ने सुरक्षा अधिकारियों को अंधेरे में रखकर यह संपर्क किया था. राजीव गांधी ने इस आश्वासन पर भरोसा कर लिया, जबकि सरकार के पास अलग खुफिया जानकारी थी और वह लगातार चेतावनी जारी कर रही थी. न तो राजीव गांधी और न ही उनके समर्थकों ने सरकार की सुरक्षा संबंधी खुफिया रिपोर्टों पर ध्यान दिया.
राजीव गांधी की सुरक्षा को लेकर राहुल गांधी के आरोपों पर राज्यसभा के उपसभापति हरिवंश नारायण सिंह ने कांग्रेस से कई सवाल पूछे हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि देश यह जानना चाहता है कि कांग्रेस के भीतर कौन लोग लिट्टे (LTTE) के संपर्क में थे और किसने राजीव गांधी को यह भरोसा दिलाया था कि लिट्टे उनसे बातचीत कर चुका है और कोई नुकसान नहीं पहुंचाएगा.
हरिवंश ने यह भी सवाल उठाया कि राजीव गांधी के करीबी कौन लोग थे, जिन्होंने उन्हें भीड़ के बीच जाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया और सुरक्षा अलर्ट को उनकी लोकप्रियता कम करने की सरकारी कोशिश बताया. उन्होंने कहा कि इन लोगों की पहचान होनी चाहिए और यदि इस मामले की जांच नहीं हुई है, तो अब भी जांच की मांग उठनी चाहिए. हरिवंश नारायण सिंह पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री चंद्रशेखर के कार्यकाल में प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय में अतिरिक्त सूचना सलाहकार भी रह चुके हैं.
चंद्रशेखर की किताब के हवाले से हरिवंश ने बताया कि राजीव गांधी के साथ धोखा हो रहा था, जिसका अंदाजा नहीं लगाया जा सका. सरकार की ओर से बार-बार अलर्ट जारी किए गए थे कि उन्हें गुमराह किया जा रहा है, लेकिन यह आकलन की विफलता साबित हुई और अंततः वे एक 'मानव बम' की घातक साजिश का शिकार हो गए.
उस रात की यादों को ताजा करते हुए हरिवंश ने बताया कि चंद्रशेखर को राजीव गांधी की हत्या की खबर भुवनेश्वर में मिली थी. हरिवंश उस रात चंद्रशेखर के साथ ही यात्रा कर रहे थे. उन्होंने कहा कि उन्होंने अपनी आंखों से देखा था कि इस खबर से चंद्रशेखर कितने आहत और व्यथित हुए थे. अंत में हरिवंश ने कहा कि यदि हम अपने निजी स्वार्थों के लिए राष्ट्र के सामने प्रामाणिक तथ्य रखने के बजाय लोगों में भ्रम फैलाते हैं, तो इससे बड़ा अन्याय और कुछ नहीं हो सकता.
The proposal didn’t go according to plan and neither did my seventh birthday. The decision in 2004 gave some of us relief but others joy. There was an intention behind withdrawing Papa’s security. And even after 500+ pages there are some things Ma has left out of her book. Priyanka and I sat down with our mother to talk through all of it. Going back to those memories brought back the joy, the laughter and even the pain we felt at the time. Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage.

राहुल गांधी की पोस्ट की गई इस वीडियो में 16 मिनट के बाद राहुल गांधी ने दावा किया है कि उनके पिता राजीव गांधी की सिक्योरिटी जानबूझकर हटाई गई थी ताकि उनकी हत्या की जा सके...
इसके पहले राहुल गांधी ने इस बात का दावा किया था कि 'मेरे पापा की सुरक्षा इसलिए हटा दी गई थी ताकि उनकी हत्या हो सके.' पूर्व एयरलाइन पायलट रहे राजीव गांधी, अपनी मां- इंदिरा गांधी की हत्या के बाद प्रधानमंत्री बने. कई सालों तक उन्होंने सुरक्षा के चलते बुलेटप्रूफ जैकेट पहनी और उनकी कड़ी सुरक्षा की गई, जिस पर उनके विरोधियों ने उनका मजाक भी उड़ाया. फिर 1989 के चुनाव आए, जिसमें राजीव गांधी हार गए. 21 मई को तमिलनाडु के श्रीपेरंबदूर पहुंचे. वहां एक महिला सुसाइड बॉम्बर एक धमाका करती है, जिसमें राजीव गांधी की जान चली जाती है. उस समय उनकी उम्र 46 साल थी.

title: एनालिसिस- 15वें साल में आम आदमी पार्टी: सर्वाइवल का सवाल क्यों बना पंजाब विधानसभा चुनाव?
description: भ्रष्टाचार विरोधी आंदोलन से जन्मी आम आदमी पार्टी ने भारतीय राजनीति में स्थापित दलों के वर्चस्व को चुनौती दी है. उसने शासन का एक नया चुनावी ग्रामर तैयार किया और महज एक दशक में राष्ट्रीय दल का दर्जा हासिल किया. लेकिन दिल्ली की सत्ता गंवाने, संगठनात्मक बिखराव के बीच पार्टी का 15वां साल उसके राजनीतिक भविष्य के लिए निर्णायक साबित हो सकता है.
author: अमित सिंह
content:
भ्रष्टाचार के खिलाफ आंदोलन से जन्मी आम आदमी पार्टी ने चौदह साल का सफर पूरा कर लिया है. 26 नवंबर 2012 को अस्तित्व में आई यह पार्टी उस दौर की राजनीतिक परिस्थितियों की उपज थी.
तत्कालीन यूपीए सरकार के खिलाफ देश में व्यापक जनाक्रोश था. 2011 के अन्ना आंदोलन ने इस असंतोष को संगठित आवाज दी. अरविंद केजरीवाल ने आंदोलन से निकली ऊर्जा को चुनावी विकल्प में बदल दिया.
आप की राजनीतिक यात्रा को दो चुनावी आंकड़ों से समझा जा सकता है. फरवरी 2015 में दिल्ली विधानसभा की 70 में से 67 सीटें जीतने वाली पार्टी फरवरी 2025 में महज 22 सीटों पर सिमट गई. इन दस सालों में पार्टी ने एक राजनीतिक प्रयोग से राष्ट्रीय पहचान तक का सफर तय किया. फिर उसे अपने सबसे मजबूत चुनावी क्षेत्र में सत्ता गंवानी पड़ी.
दिसंबर 2013 के दिल्ली विधानसभा चुनाव में आप ने 28 सीटें जीती थीं. कांग्रेस के बाहरी समर्थन से सरकार बनाई. इसके बाद 2015 में 67 और 2020 में 62 सीटें जीतकर अपनी राजनीतिक स्वीकार्यता साबित की. पंजाब में भी पार्टी ने तेजी से विस्तार किया. 2017 में 20 सीटों से शुरू हुआ सफर 2022 में 92 सीटों के ऐतिहासिक जनादेश तक पहुंचा.
गुजरात विधानसभा चुनाव में 12.92 प्रतिशत मत और पांच सीटें हासिल करने के बाद गोवा में भी पार्टी को दो सीटें मिलीं. इन उपलब्धियों के आधार पर 10 अप्रैल 2023 को निर्वाचन आयोग ने उसे राष्ट्रीय दल का दर्जा दिया.
क्षेत्रीय अस्मिता या किसी राजनीतिक परिवार की विरासत के बिना इतनी तेजी से राष्ट्रीय पहचान हासिल करना भारतीय राजनीति में उल्लेखनीय उपलब्धि थी.
आप का सबसे बड़ा राजनीतिक योगदान सार्वजनिक सेवाओं को चुनावी विमर्श के केंद्र में लाना रहा. सरकारी स्कूलों का आधुनिकीकरण, मोहल्ला क्लीनिक, रियायती बिजली, मुफ्त पानी और महिलाओं के लिए सार्वजनिक परिवहन की सुविधाओं ने निम्न और मध्यम आय वर्ग के मतदाताओं के बीच उसकी स्वीकार्यता बढ़ाई.
इन योजनाओं की वित्तीय व्यावहारिकता पर सवाल उठते रहे. इसके बावजूद उनकी चुनावी लोकप्रियता ने दूसरे दलों को भी अपनी प्राथमिकताएं बदलने के लिए मजबूर किया. हालांकि, संगठन के भीतर पार्टी की यात्रा उसके शुरुआती सिद्धांतों से टकराती रही.
स्वराज, विकेंद्रीकरण और आंतरिक लोकतंत्र की पैरवी करने वाली पार्टी में अप्रैल 2015 में योगेंद्र यादव और प्रशांत भूषण का निष्कासन एक बड़ा मोड़ था. इससे नेतृत्व के केंद्रीकरण पर सवाल उठे. बाद के सालों में कुमार विश्वास और आशुतोष जैसे प्रमुख चेहरों की विदाई ने भी संगठन की कार्यशैली पर बहस तेज की.
विचारधारा के स्तर पर आप ने आर्थिक कल्याणवाद, राष्ट्रवाद, धार्मिक प्रतीकों और चुनावी व्यावहारिकता का मिश्रण अपनाया. इससे उसका सामाजिक आधार बढ़ा लेकिन वैकल्पिक राजनीति के शुरुआती समर्थकों के बीच वैचारिक स्पष्टता को लेकर असंतोष भी पैदा हुआ.
दिल्ली की 2021-22 की आबकारी नीति से जुड़े कथित भ्रष्टाचार के मामले ने पार्टी की नैतिक विश्वसनीयता को प्रभावित किया. अरविंद केजरीवाल और मनीष सिसोदिया की गिरफ्तारियों ने इस मुद्दे को और बड़ा बनाया. आप ने इन कार्रवाइयों को राजनीतिक प्रतिशोध बताया.
इस मामले में एक महत्वपूर्ण न्यायिक घटनाक्रम भी हुआ. 27 फरवरी 2026 को दिल्ली की निचली अदालत ने सीबीआई के मामले में केजरीवाल, सिसोदिया और 21 अन्य आरोपियों को आरोपमुक्त कर दिया. सीबीआई ने इस आदेश को उच्च न्यायालय में चुनौती दी है.
2025 के दिल्ली चुनाव में भाजपा को 45.56 प्रतिशत और आप को 43.57 प्रतिशत मत मिले. करीब दो प्रतिशत अंकों के अंतर के बावजूद सीटों के मामले में तस्वीर बिल्कुल अलग रही.
भाजपा ने 48 और आप ने 22 सीटें जीतीं. दस सालों की सत्ता विरोधी भावना, बुनियादी सुविधाओं से जुड़ी शिकायतें, भ्रष्टाचार के आरोप और भाजपा की चुनावी रणनीति इस हार के संभावित कारण रहे.
दिल्ली की हार के बाद पार्टी की राजनीतिक गतिविधियों का केंद्र पंजाब बन गया है. अब उसके शासन मॉडल और राष्ट्रीय विस्तार की संभावनाओं की सबसे बड़ी परीक्षा इसी राज्य में होगी.
पंजाब की 117 विधानसभा सीटों का चुनाव आप के लिए सामान्य सत्ता संघर्ष नहीं है. दिल्ली की पराजय के बाद पंजाब उसका एकमात्र पूर्ण राज्य है. करीब तीन करोड़ की आबादी वाला यह सीमावर्ती प्रदेश पार्टी को प्रशासनिक अनुभव और अपनी नीतियों के प्रदर्शन का अवसर देता है.
दिल्ली और पंजाब के प्रशासनिक ढांचे में बड़ा अंतर है. दिल्ली में पुलिस, भूमि और प्रशासनिक अधिकारों को लेकर केंद्र सरकार तथा उपराज्यपाल के साथ टकराव आप की राजनीति का हिस्सा रहा.
इसके उलट पंजाब में पुलिस और सार्वजनिक व्यवस्था सहित राज्य सूची के विषयों पर निर्वाचित सरकार के पास अपेक्षाकृत व्यापक अधिकार हैं. इसलिए कानून-व्यवस्था, कृषि संकट, औद्योगिक विकास और वित्तीय प्रबंधन पर उसकी जवाबदेही भी अधिक प्रत्यक्ष है.
पंजाब में दूसरी बार सत्ता हासिल करना आप के इस दावे को मजबूती देगा कि उसका शासन मॉडल दिल्ली से बाहर भी सफल हो सकता है. हार की स्थिति में राष्ट्रीय विस्तार, कार्यकर्ताओं के मनोबल और राजनीतिक संसाधनों पर दबाव बढ़ सकता है.
2022 में पंजाब के मतदाताओं ने कांग्रेस और शिरोमणि अकाली दल के नेतृत्व को निर्णायक चुनौती दी थी. आप को 42.01 प्रतिशत मतों के साथ 92 सीटें मिलीं. कांग्रेस 18, अकाली दल तीन और भाजपा दो सीटों पर सिमट गई.
भगवंत मान के नेतृत्व में बदलाव की राजनीति को किसानों, युवाओं, महिलाओं और परंपरागत राजनीतिक व्यवस्था से असंतुष्ट मतदाताओं का समर्थन मिला. इसके साथ रोजगार, नशे की समस्या, कृषि संकट, भ्रष्टाचार और प्रशासनिक सुधारों को लेकर बड़ी उम्मीदें भी जुड़ी थीं.
इन उम्मीदों और सरकार के प्रदर्शन के बीच बढ़ती दूरी का संकेत 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में मिला. पंजाब की 13 सीटों में कांग्रेस ने सात और आप ने तीन सीटें जीतीं. अकाली दल को एक सीट मिली, जबकि दो सीटों पर निर्दलीय उम्मीदवार विजयी रहे. आप का मत प्रतिशत करीब 26 फीसदी रह गया. विधानसभा क्षेत्रों के आधार पर पार्टी केवल 33 क्षेत्रों में आगे रही.
हालांकि, लोकसभा और विधानसभा चुनावों में मतदाताओं की प्राथमिकताएं अलग होती हैं. इसलिए इन आंकड़ों को 2027 का सीधा पूर्वानुमान मानना उचित नहीं होगा. जून 2025 में लुधियाना पश्चिम विधानसभा उपचुनाव में आप के संजीव अरोड़ा की 10,637 मतों से जीत ने दिखाया कि पार्टी की चुनावी क्षमता अब भी बनी हुई है.
फिर भी, 2022 की तुलना में परिस्थितियां बदल चुकी हैं. पहली बार सत्ता मांगने वाली पार्टी के सामने अब अपने विधायकों के प्रदर्शन और पांच साल के शासन का हिसाब देने की चुनौती है.
ग्रामीण पंजाब में कृषि की घटती लाभप्रदता, युवाओं का विदेश पलायन और स्थानीय रोजगार की कमी जैसे मुद्दे चुनावी असंतोष को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं.
आम आदमी पार्टी की स्थापना की चौदहवीं वर्षगांठ से दो दिन पहले, 24 नवंबर 2026 को पंजाब की राजनीति में बड़ा घटनाक्रम हुआ. केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह, भाजपा के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष नितिन नवीन और शिरोमणि अकाली दल के अध्यक्ष सुखबीर सिंह बादल की मौजूदगी में दोनों दलों ने छह साल बाद गठबंधन की औपचारिक घोषणा की.
सितंबर 2020 में तीन कृषि कानूनों के विरोध में एनडीए से अलग हुआ अकाली दल अब अपने पुराने सहयोगी के साथ चुनाव लड़ेगा. इस गठबंधन का महत्व पंजाब के सामाजिक और भौगोलिक समीकरणों में है.
परंपरागत रूप से अकाली दल का प्रभाव ग्रामीण सिख मतदाताओं और कृषि समुदाय के एक हिस्से में रहा है. भाजपा की पकड़ शहरी हिंदू मतदाताओं, व्यापारियों और पेशेवर वर्ग में रही है. इस समीकरण ने दोनों दलों को 2007 और 2012 में लगातार विधानसभा चुनाव जिताए थे.
हालांकि, मौजूदा राजनीतिक स्थिति पुराने दौर से अलग है. 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में भाजपा को पंजाब में 18.56 प्रतिशत और अकाली दल को करीब 13.42 प्रतिशत मत मिले. दोनों का संयुक्त मत प्रतिशत लगभग 32 फीसदी बैठता है. यह कांग्रेस और आप को अलग-अलग मिले मत प्रतिशत से अधिक है.
लेकिन केवल मतों का जोड़ जीत की गारंटी नहीं है. असली परीक्षा यह होगी कि दोनों दलों के मतदाता एक-दूसरे के उम्मीदवारों को कितना समर्थन देते हैं. किसान आंदोलनों की स्मृति, अकाली दल की कमजोर हुई पंथक स्वीकार्यता और ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में भाजपा के विस्तार की कोशिश गठबंधन के सामने चुनौती रहेंगी.
दूसरी ओर कांग्रेस भी अपनी जमीन वापस पाने की कोशिश में जुटी है. राहुल गांधी का 'पंजाब मंगदा हिसाब' अभियान, चरणजीत सिंह चन्नी की 'जवानी संभाल' यात्रा और राजा वड़िंग की 'इंसाफ यात्रा' इसी रणनीति का हिस्सा हैं. पार्टी युवाओं, किसानों और दलित समुदायों के बीच अपनी पहुंच बढ़ाना चाहती है.
पंजाब में अनुसूचित जाति की आबादी करीब 32 प्रतिशत है. दोआबा सहित राज्य की 34 आरक्षित विधानसभा सीटों पर इस वर्ग के अलग-अलग सामाजिक समूहों की प्राथमिकताएं निर्णायक हो सकती हैं.
कांग्रेस के सामने नेतृत्व की गुटबाजी चुनौती बनी हुई है. छोटे पंथक दलों और निर्दलीय उम्मीदवारों की मौजूदगी भी कई सीटों पर मुकाबले को बहुकोणीय बना सकती है. विपक्षी मतों का बंटवारा कुछ क्षेत्रों में आप के लिए फायदेमंद हो सकता है.
चुनाव से पहले उम्मीदवार घोषित करने की आप की रणनीति ने प्रचार के लिए अतिरिक्त समय दिया है. लेकिन इसके साथ संगठन में असंतोष भी सामने आया है.
31 अक्टूबर 2026 को पार्टी ने 40 उम्मीदवारों की पहली सूची जारी की. इसके दो दिन बाद, 2 नवंबर को समाना से चेतन सिंह जौड़ामाजरा, सनौर से हरमीत सिंह पठानमाजरा और अमृतसर उत्तर से कुंवर विजय प्रताप सिंह भाजपा में शामिल हो गए.
12 नवंबर को दूसरी सूची जारी हुई. इसमें 31 उम्मीदवारों के नाम थे. इस तरह आप कुल 71 सीटों पर उम्मीदवार घोषित कर चुकी है. दूसरी सूची में कृषि मंत्री गुरमीत सिंह खुड्डियां सहित कई मौजूदा विधायकों के टिकट काटे गए. इससे असंतोष बढ़ा.
चमकौर साहिब के विधायक डॉ. चरणजीत सिंह ने नेतृत्व के फैसले पर सार्वजनिक नाराजगी जताई. राजासांसी में संगठन से जुड़े पदाधिकारियों के इस्तीफे की खबरें भी सामने आईं.
इन घटनाओं को अप्रैल 2026 के बड़े संगठनात्मक झटके के साथ भी देखना चाहिए. उस समय राघव चड्ढा, संदीप पाठक और हरभजन सिंह सहित आप के दस राज्यसभा सांसदों में से सात भाजपा में चले गए थे. इनमें छह पंजाब से निर्वाचित हुए थे.
पार्टी नेतृत्व असंतुष्ट नेताओं के जाने को अनुशासनहीनता और राजनीतिक अवसरवाद से जोड़ता है. वहीं टिकट बदलने के पीछे सत्ता विरोधी भावना को नियंत्रित करने और जीतने की क्षमता बढ़ाने का तर्क दिया जा रहा है.
इसके बावजूद स्थानीय नेतृत्व की स्वायत्तता का सवाल बना हुआ है. भगवंत मान पंजाब में पार्टी के सबसे लोकप्रिय चेहरों में हैं. लेकिन उम्मीदवार चयन, संगठनात्मक नियुक्तियों और चुनावी रणनीति में राष्ट्रीय नेतृत्व की भूमिका पर विपक्ष सवाल उठाता रहा है.
पंजाब की राजनीति में क्षेत्रीय अस्मिता और स्थानीय नेतृत्व का खास महत्व है. इसलिए केंद्रीय नेतृत्व और राज्य इकाई के बीच संतुलन जरूरी होगा. मुख्यमंत्री की निर्णय लेने की क्षमता पर संदेह पैदा होना पार्टी के लिए चुनावी चुनौती बन सकता है.
भगवंत मान सरकार की प्रमुख उपलब्धियों में घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को हर महीने 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली और प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं का विस्तार शामिल है. मार्च 2026 के सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार प्रदेश में 881 आम आदमी क्लीनिक संचालित थे. यहां मुफ्त दवाओं और जांच की सुविधाएं उपलब्ध थीं.
महिलाओं को आर्थिक सहायता देने की 2022 की चुनावी गारंटी भी चार साल बाद लागू हुई. एक जुलाई 2026 से शुरू मुख्यमंत्री मावां-धीयां सत्कार योजना के तहत पात्र महिलाओं को 1,000 रुपये और अनुसूचित जाति की पात्र महिलाओं को 1,500 रुपये मासिक देने का प्रावधान है. नवंबर में सरकार ने 37.43 लाख महिलाओं के खातों में 1,291 करोड़ रुपये हस्तांतरित करने की जानकारी दी.
इन योजनाओं के साथ पंजाब की वित्तीय स्थिति चिंता का विषय है. 2026-27 के बजट में 31 मार्च 2027 तक राज्य का बकाया कर्ज करीब 4.48 लाख करोड़ रुपये पहुंचने का अनुमान है.
राजकोषीय घाटा सकल राज्य घरेलू उत्पाद का लगभग 4.1 प्रतिशत रहने की संभावना है. बिजली सब्सिडी के लिए 15,550 करोड़ और महिला आर्थिक सहायता योजना के लिए 9,300 करोड़ रुपये का प्रावधान किया गया है.
कर्ज का संकट पिछली सरकारों से विरासत में मिला है. लेकिन इसे नियंत्रित करने की जिम्मेदारी मौजूदा सरकार की भी है. बढ़ते ब्याज भुगतान के बीच रोजगार, सिंचाई, औद्योगिक बुनियादी ढांचे और कृषि विविधीकरण के लिए पर्याप्त संसाधन जुटाना बड़ी चुनौती है.
नशे के खिलाफ सरकार का 'युद्ध नशेआं विरुद्ध' अभियान और पुलिस की कार्रवाई चुनावी प्रचार का अहम हिस्सा होंगे. हालांकि, केवल गिरफ्तारियों और जब्ती के आंकड़ों से सफलता नहीं मापी जा सकती.
नशे की उपलब्धता, पुनर्वास की स्थिति और तस्करी नेटवर्क पर कार्रवाई का स्वतंत्र आकलन भी जरूरी है. गैंगस्टरवाद और फिरौती की घटनाएं कानून-व्यवस्था को लेकर चिंता बढ़ाती हैं.
आम आदमी पार्टी अपने पंद्रहवें साल में ऐसे मोड़ पर है, जहां राष्ट्रीय महत्वाकांक्षाओं से पहले अपने मौजूदा राजनीतिक आधार को बचाना उसकी प्राथमिकता बन गई है.
पंजाब में उसके पास भगवंत मान की लोकप्रियता, कल्याणकारी योजनाओं के लाभार्थियों का बड़ा वर्ग और सत्तारूढ़ संगठन की चुनावी क्षमता है. वहीं विपक्ष के पास शासन से जुड़ा असंतोष, संगठनात्मक बगावत और बदले हुए गठबंधन समीकरणों को अपने पक्ष में करने का अवसर है.
पंजाब में लगातार दूसरी जीत आप को दिल्ली की हार के बाद राजनीतिक वापसी का मौका दे सकती है. लेकिन हार की स्थिति में राष्ट्रीय दल का दर्जा अपने आप समाप्त नहीं होगा. इसके बावजूद पार्टी की राजनीतिक प्रासंगिकता, संगठनात्मक स्थिरता और विस्तार की क्षमता पर गंभीर सवाल खड़े हो सकते हैं.
चौदह साल पहले भारतीय मतदाताओं के एक वर्ग ने आप को स्थापित राजनीति के विकल्प के रूप में स्वीकार किया था. 2027 में पंजाब के मतदाता उसके पांच साल के शासन का मूल्यांकन करेंगे.
उनका फैसला तय करेगा कि आम आदमी पार्टी भारतीय राजनीति में अपना अगला दशक किस दिशा में तय करती है.

title: Delhi to Get Two New Hospitals with 1,815 Beds in 2027; 40 Ayushman Arogya Mandirs to Open in December
description: According to the CM's Office, the govt is also planning to open 40 new Ayushman Arogya Mandirs next month, coinciding with the 102nd birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, to strengthen primary healthcare services and provide treatment facilities closer to people's homes.
author: Asian News International
content:
Delhi to Get Two New Hospitals with 1,815 Beds in 2027; 40 Ayushman Arogya Mandirs to Open in December
According to the CM's Office, the govt is also planning to open 40 new Ayushman Arogya Mandirs next month, coinciding with the 102nd birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, to strengthen primary healthcare services and provide treatment facilities closer to people's homes.
- India News
- 4 min read
New Delhi: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Wednesday said two major hospitals in Siraspur and Hastal, together offering 1,815 beds, will become operational next year as the government steps up efforts to expand healthcare infrastructure and improve access to medical services across the capital.
According to the Chief Minister's Office, the government is also planning to open 40 new Ayushman Arogya Mandirs next month, coinciding with the 102nd birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, to strengthen primary healthcare services and provide treatment facilities closer to people's homes.
Gupta made the announcements while reviewing the progress of various Health Department projects at the Delhi Secretariat. She directed officials to ensure that all hospital and healthcare infrastructure projects are completed within their stipulated timelines, making it clear that negligence or unnecessary delays would not be tolerated.
Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh and senior officials from the Health Department and the Public Works Department (PWD) attended the meeting.
Advertisement
The Chief Minister said the government's focus was on providing accessible, quality and timely healthcare to every citizen. She said expanding healthcare infrastructure involved not only constructing new hospitals but also ensuring the availability of modern medical equipment, doctors and other healthcare personnel to improve patient care.
She also stressed the need to strengthen primary healthcare facilities so that residents would not have to travel long distances for treatment of common ailments. Officials were directed to ensure that public welfare projects were implemented with responsibility, promptness and sensitivity.
Advertisement
Providing an update on the two major hospital projects, CM Gupta said the 1,164-bed hospital in Siraspur was ready, with the procurement of medical equipment underway and targeted for completion by the end of January. Construction of the 651-bed hospital in Hastal is also nearing completion, and the facility is expected to become operational next year.
The two hospitals are expected to improve access to medical services in their respective areas and ease the patient load on existing healthcare facilities.
On primary healthcare expansion, Gupta said 1,139 Ayushman Arogya Mandirs were being developed across Delhi, of which 415 were already operational. The government aims to open 40 more centres next month. She added that facilities receiving a higher number of patients were being considered for two-shift operations to ensure timely treatment at the local level.
The government is also developing two hospitals with 691 beds each in Madipur and Jwalapuri, both scheduled for completion by 2028. The Madipur hospital is being constructed at an estimated cost of Rs 466.50 crore, while the Jwalapuri project has been pegged at Rs 484.04 crore.
Alongside new hospitals, the government is expanding maternal and child healthcare facilities at existing institutions. A 463-bed maternal and child healthcare block is being developed at Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital in Rohini, while its OPD block is ready for inauguration.
A 270-bed maternal and child healthcare block at Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital and a 460-bed block at Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital in Khichripur are also nearing completion. Efforts are underway to make these facilities operational shortly.
The review also covered the proposed integrated redevelopment of Lok Nayak Hospital and the Maulana Azad Medical College campus. The project has an estimated timeline of around 30 months, covering both planning and construction.
The government is also working towards bringing Guru Teg Bahadur (GTB) Hospital, Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital, Delhi State Cancer Institute and the Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences (IHBAS), all located in the Trans-Yamuna region, under a common institutional framework. The move is aimed at strengthening specialised medical services and improving coordination among these institutions.
In another major initiative, the government plans to establish medical colleges at Indira Gandhi Hospital in Dwarka and Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital, with 150 MBBS seats proposed at each institution.
The government is also working to increase the number of seats at Baba Saheb Ambedkar Medical College from 125 to 200 and at the Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences from 50 to 70. These measures are aimed at expanding medical education capacity while increasing the availability of trained and specialist doctors.
Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh said the government was working to strengthen hospital infrastructure, medical facilities, equipment and human resources as part of a coordinated effort to improve Delhi's healthcare system.
He said the Health Department was regularly monitoring projects and coordinating with the departments concerned to ensure the timely completion of construction work, procurement of medical equipment and other necessary arrangements. Along with building new hospitals and expanding existing facilities, the government was focused on improving treatment infrastructure and ensuring adequate support for medical services.

title: Fire Breaks Out at Cloth Godown on Kolkata’s AJC Bose Road; 10 Families Rescued
description: West Bengal Minister of State for Fire and Emergency Services Koushik Chowdhury said the situation is currently under control.
author: Asian News International
content:
Fire Breaks Out at Cloth Godown on Kolkata’s AJC Bose Road; 10 Families Rescued
West Bengal Minister of State for Fire and Emergency Services Koushik Chowdhury said the situation is currently under control.
- India News
- 2 min read
Kolkata, West Bengal: A fire broke out at a cloth godown in a multi-storey building on AJC Bose Road in the Mullickbazar area on Wednesday.
Multiple fire tenders were rushed to the spot, and firefighting operations are underway. No casualties have been reported so far.
Fire officer Shyam Chandra Mondal said the fire is on the ground floor and operations are still underway.
"It seems to be under control for now; we'll see how things progress. Ten fire tenders have arrived. We have also set up a fire pump at an open water source, which we are using to draw water for firefighting," he told ANI.
Advertisement
West Bengal Minister of State for Fire and Emergency Services Koushik Chowdhury said the situation is currently under control.
"There isn't a major fire, perhaps a small amount inside, but mostly, it is just smoke. Our fire brigade officers, including all the Assistant Fire Officers (AFOs), are doing an excellent job; they arrived promptly after receiving the alert. The local residents have also been very helpful, assisting right from the very beginning. Ten families were living here, and we have successfully rescued all of them; everyone else is safe," he told ANI.
Advertisement
On reaching the site, TMC MLA Sovandeb Chattopadhyay said the fire appears to be still burning with a great deal of smoke rising.
"It seems the fire originated in a godown located beneath the site, and subsequently spread to the entire area. It is likely that there will be significant damage, but the government will surely assist. Since the fire was not caused intentionally, but rather by an accident, it is expected that the government will extend some form of support," he told ANI.
