आर्थिक रिश्तों के मामले में भी भारत ने सुधार किया है. इस श्रेणी में भारत दो स्थान ऊपर चढ़कर सातवें नंबर पर पहुंच गया है. क्षेत्रीय व्यापार और निवेश से जुड़े रिश्तों में मजबूती का फायदा भारत को मिला है.
रक्षा और सांस्कृतिक प्रभाव भी बढ़ा
रक्षा के क्षेत्र में भी भारत की स्थिति मजबूत हुई है. भारत का रक्षा नेटवर्क स्कोर बढ़कर 18.6 अंक हो गया है. इस श्रेणी में भारत नौवें स्थान पर पहुंचा है. क्षेत्रीय देशों के साथ रक्षा सहयोग बढ़ने और दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया में ब्रह्मोस मिसाइलों की बिक्री से भारत को इस क्षेत्र में फायदा मिला है.
वहीं, भारत का सांस्कृतिक प्रभाव भी बढ़ा है. इस श्रेणी में भारत का स्कोर 43.8 अंक तक पहुंच गया है. रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, दूसरे देशों तक भारतीय संस्कृति की पहुंच, लोगों के बीच संपर्क और आपसी रिश्तों में सुधार हुआ है.
रिपोर्ट में यह भी बताया गया है कि 2023 के बाद पहली बार भारत के पास मौजूद संसाधनों और एशिया में उसके वास्तविक प्रभाव के बीच का अंतर कम हुआ है. इसका मतलब है कि भारत अपनी उपलब्ध ताकत का इस्तेमाल क्षेत्रीय स्तर पर पहले से बेहतर तरीके से कर रहा है.
चीन अब भी भारत से काफी आगे
भारत की रैंकिंग में सुधार जरूर हुआ है, लेकिन चीन से मुकाबला अभी आसान नहीं है. रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, चीन की कुल ताकत भारत से करीब 80 फीसदी ज्यादा है. हालांकि, दोनों देशों के बीच का अंतर 2018 के बाद सबसे कम स्तर पर आ गया है.
एशिया पावर इंडेक्स 2026 में कुल 27 देशों और क्षेत्रों को शामिल किया गया है. इनकी ताकत का आकलन 131 अलग-अलग पैमानों के आधार पर किया गया है. इसमें आर्थिक क्षमता, सैन्य ताकत, संकट से निपटने की क्षमता, कूटनीतिक प्रभाव और आर्थिक रिश्तों समेत कुल आठ क्षेत्रों को देखा जाता है.
लोवी इंस्टीट्यूट की रिपोर्ट में क्या खास है?
लोवी इंस्टीट्यूट ऑस्ट्रेलिया का एक स्वतंत्र संस्थान है, जिसकी स्थापना 2003 में कारोबारी सर फ्रैंक लोवी ने की थी. यह दुनिया की राजनीति, सुरक्षा, विदेश नीति और अर्थव्यवस्था से जुड़े मुद्दों पर अध्ययन करता है. संस्थान की एशिया पावर इंडेक्स रिपोर्ट साल 2018 से जारी हो रही है. इसमें एशिया के अलग-अलग देशों की ताकत और प्रभाव का आकलन किया जाता है.
हंटर मार्सटन ने भी भारत की बढ़ती ताकत का किया जिक्र
लोवी इंस्टीट्यूट के एशिया पावर इंडेक्स के डायरेक्टर हंटर मार्सटन ने भी नई रिपोर्ट को लेकर एक्स पर जानकारी साझा की है. उन्होंने बताया कि इस बार के इंडेक्स में भारत का स्कोर बढ़कर 40.5 हो गया है. इससे एशिया में एक बड़ी ताकत के रूप में भारत की स्थिति और मजबूत हुई है.
उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि 2018 के बाद पहली बार चीन और भारत के बीच ताकत का अंतर इतना कम हुआ है. आर्थिक क्षमता के मामले में भारत को कुछ चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ा है, लेकिन इसके बावजूद प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी को शी जिनपिंग के बाद एशिया का दूसरा सबसे प्रभावी नेता माना गया है.

title: राम की नगरी अयोध्या से माता सीता के मायके जनकपुर तक चलेगी ट्रेन, पीएम मोदी-बालेन शाह दिखाएंगे हरी झंडी
description: अयोध्या और जनकपुर धाम के बीच सफर करने वाले लोगों के लिए बड़ी खुशखबरी है. भगवान श्रीराम की नगरी अयोध्या अब माता सीता की जन्मस्थली जनकपुर धाम से सीधे रेल मार्ग के जरिए जुड़ने जा रही है.
author: Bharat24live
content:
Ayodhya-Janakpur Train: अयोध्या और जनकपुर धाम के बीच सफर करने वाले लोगों के लिए बड़ी खुशखबरी है. भगवान श्रीराम की नगरी अयोध्या अब माता सीता की जन्मस्थली जनकपुर धाम से सीधे रेल मार्ग के जरिए जुड़ने जा रही है. सोमवार को प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री बालेन्द्र शाह नई साप्ताहिक ट्रेन सेवा 'सरयू-कमला एक्सप्रेस' को वर्चुअल माध्यम से हरी झंडी दिखाएंगे. इस मौके पर केंद्रीय रेल मंत्री अश्विनी वैष्णव और उत्तर प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ भी अयोध्या में मौजूद रहेंगे.
इस नई रेल सेवा से भारत और नेपाल के बीच धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक संबंधों को मजबूती मिलेगी. अयोध्या को भगवान श्रीराम की जन्मभूमि माना जाता है, जबकि नेपाल का जनकपुर धाम माता सीता की जन्मस्थली के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है. दोनों शहरों का रामायण में विशेष महत्व है. ऐसे में यह ट्रेन सिर्फ यात्रा का साधन नहीं होगी, बल्कि दोनों देशों की साझा आस्था और परंपराओं को भी करीब लाएगी.
604 किलोमीटर का होगा ट्रेन का सफर
करीब 604 किलोमीटर लंबी यह रेल सेवा उत्तर प्रदेश और बिहार के कई प्रमुख शहरों से होकर गुजरेगी. रास्ते में ट्रेन के व्यावसायिक ठहराव जयनगर, मधुबनी, शीशो, सीतामढ़ी, रक्सौल, नरकटियागंज, गोरखपुर, बस्ती और मनकापुर में होंगे. इसके अलावा अयोध्या धाम और दोनों अंतिम स्टेशन भी इस रेल मार्ग में शामिल रहेंगे.
इस ट्रेन का संचालन सप्ताह में एक दिन किया जाएगा. यह शनिवार को जनकपुर धाम से चलेगी, जबकि सोमवार को अयोध्या कैंट से इसकी वापसी यात्रा होगी. इससे दोनों देशों के यात्रियों को आने-जाने के लिए एक नया विकल्प मिलेगा.
श्रद्धालुओं को मिलेगी बड़ी सुविधा
अयोध्या और जनकपुर के बीच सीधी ट्रेन शुरू होने से दोनों देशों के श्रद्धालुओं को काफी सुविधा होगी. खासकर राम और माता सीता से जुड़े धार्मिक स्थलों के दर्शन करने वाले लोगों के लिए यात्रा आसान हो जाएगी. अभी तक इन शहरों के बीच सफर करने के लिए यात्रियों को दूसरे साधनों और रास्तों का सहारा लेना पड़ता है.
नई रेल सेवा से धार्मिक पर्यटन को भी बढ़ावा मिलने की उम्मीद है. अयोध्या और जनकपुर आने वाले श्रद्धालुओं की संख्या बढ़ सकती है. इसके अलावा शिक्षा, कारोबार और पारिवारिक कामों से दोनों देशों के बीच यात्रा करने वाले लोगों को भी फायदा होगा.
बिहार और सीमावर्ती इलाकों को भी होगा फायदा
इस ट्रेन का लाभ केवल यात्रियों तक सीमित नहीं रहेगा. इसके रास्ते में पड़ने वाले शहरों और कस्बों में कारोबार और पर्यटन को भी बढ़ावा मिल सकता है. होटल, परिवहन, स्थानीय दुकानों और हस्तशिल्प से जुड़े लोगों के लिए रोजगार और कमाई के नए अवसर पैदा हो सकते हैं.
खास तौर पर बिहार और नेपाल के सीमावर्ती इलाकों में रहने वाले लोगों के लिए यह रेल सेवा काफी उपयोगी साबित हो सकती है. इससे दोनों देशों के बीच रहने वाले परिवारों और स्थानीय समुदायों का आपसी संपर्क भी आसान होगा.
भारत-नेपाल के रिश्तों को मिलेगी नई मजबूती
भारत और नेपाल के बीच लंबे समय से धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक और पारिवारिक संबंध रहे हैं. दोनों देशों के लोगों की आस्था और परंपराएं एक-दूसरे से जुड़ी हुई हैं. अयोध्या और जनकपुर के बीच शुरू होने वाली यह ट्रेन सेवा इन्हीं रिश्तों को आगे बढ़ाने की दिशा में एक अहम कदम मानी जा रही है.
इसके शुरू होने से रामायण सर्किट को भी बढ़ावा मिलने की उम्मीद है. श्रद्धालु अब अयोध्या से जनकपुर तक का सफर रेल के जरिए कर सकेंगे. इससे भगवान श्रीराम और माता सीता से जुड़े धार्मिक स्थलों की यात्रा पहले के मुकाबले ज्यादा आसान हो जाएगी. साथ ही भारत और नेपाल के बीच पर्यटन और लोगों के आपसी जुड़ाव को भी नई गति मिल सकती है.

title: असम को बड़ी सौगात: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने दी सिलचर में ग्रीनफील्ड एयरपोर्ट की बधाई
description: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह की दूरदर्शिता और मोदी सरकार की प्रतिबद्धता का ही परिणाम है कि पूर्वोत्तर के दूरस्थ क्षेत्रों तक आधुनिक सुविधाएं पहुंचाई जा रही हैं.
author: Bharat Express Desk
content:
गृह एवं सहकारिता मंत्री अमित शाह ने असम के भाइयों-बहनों को बधाई देते हुए कहा कि केंद्रीय कैबिनेट ने सिलचर के डोलू में ग्रीनफील्ड एयरपोर्ट को मंजूरी दे दी है. यह 2,014 करोड़ रुपये की महत्वपूर्ण इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर परियोजना है.
अमित शाह ने स्पष्ट किया कि यह एयरपोर्ट सिलचर की हवाई कनेक्टिविटी और परिवहन क्षमता को मजबूत करेगा. बराक घाटी की बढ़ती रणनीतिक और आर्थिक महत्वता के अनुरूप यह परियोजना मोदी सरकार के नेतृत्व में आगे बढ़ाई जा रही है. असम जैसे पूर्वोत्तर राज्य के विकास के लिए बेहतर एयर कनेक्टिविटी बेहद जरूरी है और यह कदम उसी दिशा में एक मजबूत प्रयास है.
Congratulations to our sisters and brothers of Assam on the Union Cabinet’s approval today of a Greenfield Airport at Doloo in Silchar.
This ₹2,014 crore infrastructure project will enhance Silchar’s air connectivity and transport bandwidth, commensurate with the Barak Valley’s growing strategic and economic importance under the Modi govt.
— Amit Shah (@AmitShah) November 25, 2026
गृह मंत्री अमित शाह की दूरदर्शिता और मोदी सरकार की प्रतिबद्धता का ही परिणाम है कि पूर्वोत्तर के दूरस्थ क्षेत्रों तक आधुनिक सुविधाएं पहुंचाई जा रही हैं. सिलचर एयरपोर्ट से व्यापार, पर्यटन और आम लोगों की आवाजाही आसान होगी. इससे क्षेत्र की अर्थव्यवस्था को भी नई गति मिलेगी.
अमित शाह ने हमेशा पूर्वोत्तर के समग्र विकास पर जोर दिया है. उनका यह बधाई संदेश असमवासियों में उत्साह बढ़ाने वाला है. मोदी सरकार और अमित शाह के नेतृत्व में देश के हर कोने को विकास की मुख्यधारा से जोड़ा जा रहा है. सिलचर का यह ग्रीनफील्ड एयरपोर्ट असम के लिए नई संभावनाओं का द्वार खोलेगा.
आत्मनिर्भर भारत की दिशा में बड़ा कदम: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने मोदी सरकार की नई योजना की सराहना
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: आत्मनिर्भर भारत की दिशा में बड़ा कदम: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने मोदी सरकार की नई योजना की सराहना
description: मोदी सरकार की यह योजना मेक इन इंडिया और आत्मनिर्भर भारत अभियान को नई ऊंचाई देगी. अमित शाह के नेतृत्व में देश लगातार अपनी क्षमताओं का विस्तार कर रहा है.
author: Bharat Express Desk
content:
गृह एवं सहकारिता मंत्री अमित शाह ने कहा कि केंद्रीय कैबिनेट द्वारा आज मंजूर की गई कंस्ट्रक्शन एंड इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर इक्विपमेंट मैन्युफैक्चरिंग इकोसिस्टम स्कीम भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था को उसकी जड़ों से मजबूत करने वाला महत्वपूर्ण कदम है. यह प्रधानमंत्री नरेन्द्र मोदी के आत्मनिर्भरता के सिद्धांत पर आधारित है.
The Construction and Infrastructure Equipment Manufacturing Ecosystem Scheme, approved by the Union Cabinet today, is a giant stride towards strengthening the Indian economy at its core, under Modi Ji’s principle of Aatmanirbharta.
This ₹11,000 crore initiative will support the manufacturing of seven different types of equipment, attract ₹21,000 crore in investments, create import substitution worth ₹22,500 crore and pave the way to building India with its own tools and capabilities.
— Amit Shah (@AmitShah) November 25, 2026
अमित शाह ने बताया कि यह 11,000 करोड़ रुपये की पहल सात अलग-अलग प्रकार के उपकरणों के विनिर्माण को समर्थन देगी. इससे 21,000 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश आकर्षित होगा और 22,500 करोड़ रुपये के आयात प्रतिस्थापन का रास्ता खुलेगा. भारत अब अपने उपकरणों और क्षमताओं से खुद को बनाएगा.
गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने इस स्कीम को अर्थव्यवस्था की रीढ़ मजबूत करने वाला बताया. निर्माण और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर क्षेत्र में घरेलू विनिर्माण बढ़ने से रोजगार के अवसर बढ़ेंगे तथा विदेशी निर्भरता घटेगी. अमित शाह की सक्रिय भूमिका और मोदी सरकार के विजन से ही ऐसे दूरगामी फैसले संभव हो रहे हैं.
यह योजना मेक इन इंडिया और आत्मनिर्भर भारत अभियान को नई ऊंचाई देगी. अमित शाह के नेतृत्व में देश लगातार अपनी क्षमताओं का विस्तार कर रहा है. निर्माण क्षेत्र में स्वदेशी उपकरणों का उपयोग बढ़ने से विकास की गति और तेज होगी. गृह मंत्री का यह संदेश देश के उद्योग जगत और युवाओं के लिए प्रेरणादायक है.
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: ‘बड़े अच्छे, चंगे बंदे हैं, ले जाओ…’ जब प्रकाश सिंह बादल ने PM मोदी के लिए भेज दिया था अपना खास रथ – दिलचस्प किस्सा
description: 'मोदी स्टोरी' के एक वीडियो में सामने आया दिलचस्प किस्सा: जानिए कैसे पंजाब के पूर्व सीएम प्रकाश सिंह बादल ने चुनाव प्रचार के लिए नरेंद्र मोदी को अपना खास लिफ्ट वाला रथ, ड्राइवर और फुल टैंक के साथ दिया था.
author: Vijay Ram
content:
भाजपा और शिरोमणि अकाली दल के बीच एक बार फिर गठबंधन की कड़ी जुड़ने के बीच प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और पंजाब के पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री प्रकाश सिंह बादल से जुड़ा वर्षों पुराना एक दिलचस्प किस्सा सामने आया है. ‘मोदी स्टोरी’ नाम के एक्स अकाउंट ने एक वीडियो पोस्ट किया है, जिसमें बताया गया है कि चुनाव के दौरान पीएम नरेंद्र मोदी के लिए प्रकाश सिंह बादल ने अपना खास ‘लिफ्ट वाला रथ’ ड्राइवर और फुल टैंक के साथ दे दिया था.
वीडियो में बताया गया है कि भाजपा और शिरोमणि अकाली दल का रिश्ता दशकों पुराना है और दोनों नेताओं के बीच भी आत्मीय संबंध रहे हैं. इसी रिश्ते से जुड़ा यह किस्सा उस दौर का है, जब प्रकाश सिंह बादल ने पैर में चोट के बाद एक विशेष रथ बनवाया था, जिसमें लिफ्ट की सुविधा थी और वह उसके जरिए मंच या वाहन से बाहर निकलते थे.
बड़े अच्छे बंदे हैं, चंगे बंदे हैं, ले जाओ…”
जब नरेंद्र मोदी के लिए स्व. प्रकाश सिंह बादल जी ने अपना खास ‘लिफ्ट वाला रथ’ ड्राइवर और फुल टैंक के साथ भेज दिया था।
लगभग 3 दशक पुराने इसी भरोसे और गठबंधन की कड़ी को जोड़ते हुए, कल पंजाब विधानसभा चुनाव के लिए अकाली दल और भाजपा फिर साथ आए हैं।
सुनिए यह अनसुना किस्सा।
#Modistory #AkaliDal
— Modi Story (@themodistory) November 25, 2026
बादल साहब का रथ इस्तेमाल करना
वीडियो में किस्सा सुनाते हुए बताया गया कि एक चुनाव के दौरान पीएम मोदी ने बादल साहब का रथ इस्तेमाल करने की इच्छा जताई थी. इसके बाद रथ लेने के लिए प्रकाश सिंह बादल से संपर्क किया गया.
किस्सा सुनाने वाले व्यक्ति के मुताबिक, जब वह बादल साहब के पास रथ मांगने पहुंचे तो उन्होंने पहले पूछा कि रथ किसके लिए चाहिए. जवाब में नरेंद्र मोदी का नाम बताया गया. इस पर प्रकाश सिंह बादल ने कहा, “बड़े अच्छे बंदे हैं, चंगे बंदे हैं, ले जाओ.”
उन्होंने बताया कि जब ड्राइवर की भी मांग की गई, तो बादल साहब ने इसके लिए भी तुरंत सहमति दे दी. इतना ही नहीं, उन्होंने रथ का तेल भी फुल कराने की बात कही.
‘गुजरात वालों को पता नहीं चलना चाहिए’
वीडियो में बताया गया कि रथ और ड्राइवर मिलने की सूचना नरेंद्र मोदी को दी गई, लेकिन उन्होंने इसे गुजरात में सार्वजनिक नहीं करने की बात कही. किस्सा सुनाने वाले के अनुसार, मोदी ने कहा था कि रथ रात में लेकर आना, गुजरात वालों को पता नहीं चलना चाहिए कि इसे बादल साहब से मांगकर लाया गया है.
यह किस्सा भाजपा और शिरोमणि अकाली दल के बीच लंबे समय से चले आ रहे राजनीतिक सहयोग और दोनों नेताओं के आपसी संबंधों की एक दिलचस्प झलक पेश करता है.
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: 'Gen Z Should Support Those Who...': Dipke's Message To Uttar Pradesh Ahead Of Polls | WATCH
description: Abhijeet Dipke urged Gen Z voters in UP to support parties focusing on essential services like quality education, job creation, public infrastructure, and healthcare.
author: Ananya Varma
content:
Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke, speaking on the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, said Gen Z voters should back political parties that prioritise quality education, employment opportunities, robust public infrastructure, and accessible healthcare. He said it was ultimately up to political parties to decide whether they were willing to deliver these essential services to the younger generation.
"Gen Z should support those who will provide them with quality education, employment opportunities, robust public infrastructure, and good healthcare facilities. It is ultimately up to the various political parties to decide whether or not they wish to provide these essentials to Gen Z," he told reporters.
"When I speak of quality education, healthcare, employment, and public infrastructure, why is this interpreted as being 'against the BJP'? Are you suggesting that the BJP has no intention of working on these issues? I never said that. My point is simply this: Gen Z should cast their vote for whoever commits to delivering quality education, employment, public infrastructure, and healthcare," Dipke added.
CJP to hold 'Save Democracy, Save Constitution' protest in Nagpur
The Cockroach Janta Party will hold a 'Save Democracy, Save Constitution' protest and public meeting in Nagpur on Thursday to target the government over the alleged irregularities of the Election Commission of India (ECI).
CJP founder-convenor Abhijeet Dipke made the announcement in a press conference here on Wednesday, where he added that his group will also embark on a six-day 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign in drought-affected Vidarbha and Marathwada districts to give voice to the farmers to express their woes.
The 'Save Democracy, Save Constitution' agitation will be held at Sanvidhan Square in Nagpur at 4 pm, he said.

title: Memories And Scars Of 26/11 Mumbai Attacks Stay Alive, 18 Years On
description: Eighteen years after the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, the tragedy remains a vivid reminder of the human cost of terrorism.
author: Times Now Digital
content:
Eighteen years after the 2008 terror attacks that shook Mumbai and exposed glaring lacunae in India's security and intelligence apparatus, the horrors of the 60-hour assault and bloodletting remain etched in public memory.
As the financial capital, know for its unbreakable spirit and courage in the face of adversity, prepares to commemorate the 18th anniversary of 26/11, the carnage remains a grim reminder of the human cost of terrorism and the importance of sustained vigilance and preparedness against security threats.
The November 26, 2008 attacks, carried out by 10 heavily armed Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorists who sailed into Mumbai from Pakistan, left 166 people, including foreigners, dead and more than 300 injured, making it one of the deadliest terror strikes in an Indian city.
Mumbai has endured several major terrorist attacks over the past three decades or so. On March 12, 1993, bomb blasts struck 12 locations in the megapolis killing 257 and injuring thousands. The city reeled under the serial train blasts on July 11, 2006, killing 188 people, while 27 people died in triple explosions at Dadar, Zaveri Bazaar and Opera House on July 13, 2011.
The 2008 attacks, which began on the night of November 26 and continued until the morning of November 29, targeted several prominent locations, including the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, the Trident Hotel, Nariman House (Chabad House), Leopold Cafe and Cama and Albless Hospital.
The heavily armed terrorists launched coordinated attacks, taking hostages and engaging security personnel in prolonged gun battles. The operations posed enormous challenges as the attackers occupied buildings, used their height and layout to their advantage and held people hostage.
The coordinated response by the Mumbai Police, armed police personnel, Indian Navy's Marine Commandos and the National Security Guard (NSG) eventually brought the roughly 60-hours siege to an end.
The sea-borne attacks exposed vulnerabilities in coastal security, intelligence gathering and coordination among security agencies, prompting a major overhaul of India's counter-terrorism preparedness.
Among the 10 attackers, Mohammed Ajmal Kasab was captured alive. He was subsequently tried, convicted and hanged in November 2012. David Coleman Headley, one of the key conspirators who conducted reconnaissance of Mumbai before the attacks, later deposed before an Indian court through video-conferencing from the United States.
Tahawwur Hussain Rana, another accused in the 26/11 conspiracy, was extradited from the US in 2025 to stand trial in India.
However, several masterminds and handlers of the attacks continue to remain beyond India's reach, with many believed to be based in Pakistan.
The chargesheet filed in the case had stated that the manner in which the attacks were conducted showed they were meticulously planned and executed after extensive training, preparation and briefing.
The attacks prompted global condemnation and led to significant changes in India's counter-terrorism measures.
Every year floral tributes are paid at the Mumbai Police headquarters to those who made the ultimate sacrifice while fighting terrorists during the attacks. Homage is also paid at Mumbai CSMT, Cama and Albless Hospital and other locations which were targeted by the Pakistani terrorists.
Mumbaikars also gather at "Prerana Sthal", the statue of Assistant Sub-Inspector Tukaram Ombale, who fought with terrorists with a lathi and was killed while catching the terrorist Kasab at Girgaon Chowpatty in south Mumbai.

title: Nearly 7,000 Trees Felled For Jharkhand Highway Projects; NHAI Cites Commercial Confidence On Material Data
description: In Jharkhand, 6,894 trees were removed for highway projects as reported by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).
author: Times Now Digital
content:
A total of 6,894 trees were cut for highways in Jharkhand and adjoining areas, according to the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).
The figures were shared in response to RTI applications, as recorded in a Central Information Commission (CIC) order.
The numbers relate to three projects - the NH-80 Mirzachowki-Farakka section, a four-lane Ganga bridge project connecting Sahibganj in Jharkhand with Manihari in Bihar, and the four-laning of NH-114A in Deoghar district.
According to NHAI, 5,285 trees were cut for Package-I of the NH-80 section, 143 for the Ganga bridge project on NH-133B in Sahibganj and NH-131A in Manihari, and 1,466 for the NH-114A project in Deoghar.
The applicant had sought details of tree felling, construction material procurement, land acquisition, corporate social responsibility (CSR) expenditure and audit records.
On construction material procurement for the Deoghar project, the concessionaire told NHAI that disclosing the sources and rates of materials could affect its commercial interests.
It cited the exemption under Section 8(1)(d) of the RTI Act, which covers commercial confidence and trade secrets.
The applicant also sought details of construction materials, such as sand, steel, cement, boulders, gravel and bitumen, along with bills, vouchers and GST records.
NHAI said records of vehicles transporting materials, their arrival and departure timings, check-post details, and drivers' names and signatures were not maintained.
On tree-felling records for the Deoghar project, NHAI said the list of trees and documents relating to their species were voluminous and could be inspected at its Project Implementation Unit office after prior notice.
Regarding CSR expenditure, NHAI said its agreement with the concessionaire for the Deoghar project did not mention a CSR fund and, therefore, no expenditure was incurred under that head.
In a separate reply concerning the Sahibganj project, its Project Implementation Unit reported zero expenditure under the CSR head.
In an order, Information Commissioner Jaya Varma Sinha dismissed three second appeals filed by the applicant, observing that he sought voluminous information with an apparent intention of deliberately diverting the time and resources of the public authority.
"The Commission expresses displeasure on the conduct of the Appellant aimed at misusing the provisions of the RTI Act," the order read.
The commission referred to a Supreme Court judgment which observed that indiscriminate demands for "all and sundry information" could adversely affect administrative efficiency.
It advised the applicant to make "judicious and sensible use" of the RTI Act.

title: Assam enters defence manufacturing sector; Rs 50-crore unit to come up at Rangia
description: Assam on Wednesday took its first step into defence manufacturing, with Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma performing the bhumi pujan of Northeast India's first defence manufacturing unit at the AIDC Industrial Estate in Tulsibari near Rangia in Kamrup district.
author: Digjyoti Lahkar
content:
Assam enters defence manufacturing sector; Rs 50-crore unit to come up at Rangia
Assam on Wednesday took its first step into defence manufacturing, with Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma performing the bhumi pujan of Northeast India's first defence manufacturing unit at the AIDC Industrial Estate in Tulsibari near Rangia in Kamrup district.
TULSIBARI (RANGIA): Assam on Wednesday took its first step into defence manufacturing, with Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma performing the bhumi pujan of Northeast India’s first defence manufacturing unit at the AIDC Industrial Estate in Tulsibari near Rangia in Kamrup district.
Mumbai-based Speed Defence Systems Private Limited will initially invest around Rs 50 crore to set up the facility on approximately 14 acres. Production is targeted to begin by January 2028.
At full capacity, the unit will manufacture around 5,000 prefabricated rapidly deployable structures, 300 underground bunkers and protective structures, 100 counter-drone systems and 1,500 drones annually.
The project is expected to generate around 150 direct jobs in its first phase, with employment likely to rise to approximately 500 when the facility becomes fully operational. The company also plans to involve local suppliers, MSMEs and ancillary industries in 25 to 30 per cent of its production and supply chain.
The company will also collaborate with IIT Guwahati on research, development and technological innovation, providing students, researchers and faculty members opportunities to work on practical defence and engineering projects.
Addressing a public meeting after the ceremony, Sarma described the project as a new chapter in Assam’s industrial development. He said the government was moving beyond traditional industries to sectors that could meet national requirements and strengthen the state’s industrial base.
Following the establishment of the semiconductor manufacturing facility at Jagiroad, the government is now focusing on defence manufacturing. Sarma said the Assam Aerospace and Defence Manufacturing Policy, 2025, would be amended to attract more companies to the sector.
Pointing out that India’s defence forces procure equipment worth around Rs 2 lakh crore annually and that the country also exports defence products, he said Assam and the Northeast had so far lacked a defence manufacturing facility. Speed4 Defence Systems had now come forward to fill that gap.
The Chief Minister also referred to the proposed Defence Park on around 6,000 bighas of land at Jagiroad. He said India had made significant progress in indigenous defence production under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership.
Earlier, around 80 per cent of the weapons and equipment used by India’s defence forces were imported from Russia, while the remaining 20 per cent came from other countries, he said, adding that the country had since expanded domestic manufacturing of defence equipment.
Sarma said the Rs 27,000-crore semiconductor project at Jagiroad would be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in April next year.
He also outlined several other industrial projects, including the transportation of crude oil through pipelines from Paradip in Odisha to Numaligarh Refinery, a fertiliser plant worth over Rs 10,000 crore at Namrup and steps to establish a second plant there. Work has also started on a 3,200 MW thermal power project at Chapar in Dhubri district.
These projects are expected to generate direct and indirect employment for lakhs of young people in the state, reducing the need to migrate elsewhere for work, he said.
The government is also planning to send 10,000 young people to Gujarat in 20 batches to familiarise them with the state’s industrial ecosystem and development model.
Claiming that investments worth Rs 3,400 crore had been attracted to the Rangia Assembly constituency, Sarma said a water storage tank manufacturing unit would soon be established at Tulshibari.
Assam BJP president and MP Dilip Saikia, MLA Bhabesh Kalita, Additional Chief Secretary J.B. Ekka, AIDC vice-chairman Nabadeep Kalita, managing director Meghnidhi Dahal, District Commissioner Deba Kumar Mishra, Speed4 Defence Systems Private Limited managing director and CEO Devang Shah, and co-founder and vice-chairman Vishal Shah were among those present.

title: Karthigai Deepam row deepens as Tamil Nadu governor seeks explanation from CM Vijay
description: Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Arlekar has asked Chief Minister Vijay why the Karthigai Deepam lamp was lit at the customary shrine site in Thiruparankundram after the Supreme Court allowed a one-time lighting at the Deepathoon stone pillar. The temple board defended its decision on religious grounds. Madurai District Collector Nishant Krishna apologised to the court and said he had taken steps to secure the temple administration’s approval.
author: Adan Khan
content:
Karthigai Deepam row deepens as Tamil Nadu governor seeks explanation from CM Vijay
Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Arlekar has asked Chief Minister Vijay why the Karthigai Deepam lamp was lit at the customary shrine site in Thiruparankundram after the Supreme Court allowed a one-time lighting at the Deepathoon stone pillar. The temple board defended its decision on religious grounds. Madurai District Collector Nishant Krishna apologised to the court and said he had taken steps to secure the temple administration’s approval.
New Delhi: Tamil Nadu Governor Rajendra Arlekar on Wednesday sought an explanation from Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay over the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam lamp at Thiruparankundram near Madurai. The lamp was lit at the Deepa Mandapam near the Uchi Pillayar Temple on November 24. The Supreme Court had allowed a one-time lighting at the Deepathoon, a stone pillar higher up the hill.
Hindustan Times, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that Arlekar invoked Article 167(b) of the Constitution to seek information from the chief minister. An official who spoke on condition of anonymity confirmed that the governor had sought an explanation.
Temple board cites tradition
The temple’s board of trustees said it had unanimously resolved to light the lamp at the customary site. The board said the Deepa Mandapam sits directly above the temple’s presiding deity and that the ceremony at that spot forms part of the temple’s established religious practice.
“Such long standing continuous practices, religious traditions and rituals and the Agama rules are considered the unique religious identity of the temple,” a statement signed by board chairperson V Shanmugasundaram said.
Collector apologises to court
Madurai District Collector Nishant Krishna apologised to the Supreme Court in a status report on Wednesday. He said he had taken steps between November 21 and 24 to secure authorisation from the Devasthanam for a team to light the lamp at the Deepathoon in line with the court’s November 20 order.
“I sincerely apologise for the lamp not been lit at the Deepathoon,” the collector said in his report.
Parties split over lighting
Congress, Left parties and the Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) welcomed the lighting at the customary site. The BJP, the All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) and Hindu groups criticised the Vijay-led TVK government over the decision.
The dispute centres on where the lamp should be lit and who should light it. For decades, the ceremony has taken place at the Deepa Mandapam. Hindu groups had sought permission to light the lamp at the Deepathoon, about 50 metres from the Hazrat Sultan Sikandar Badusha Auliya Dargah.

title: जेब में पैसे कम थे, लेकिन हौसला बड़ा था, गांव के लिए युवाओं ने कर्ज लेकर खरीदी एंबुलेंस
description: एंबुलेंस खरीदने के बाद उसे चलाने की जिम्मेदारी भी युवाओं ने खुद उठाई है. समूह के 6 सदस्य बारी-बारी से एंबुलेंस भी चलाएंगे. वे अपनी नौकरी और दूसरे काम के साथ यह जिम्मेदारी निभाएंगे.
author: Samarth Saraswat
content:
किसी की तबीयत अचानक बिगड़ जाए या कोई हादसे का शिकार हो जाए तो समय पर अस्पताल पहुंचना बहुत जरूरी होता है. लेकिन गांवों में कई बार एंबुलेंस समय पर नहीं पहुंच पाती. ऐसे में मरीज और उसके परिवार को काफी परेशानी होती है. कर्नाटक के दक्षिण कन्नड़ जिले के कुछ युवाओं ने इसी समस्या का समाधान निकालने के लिए एक अनोखी पहल की है. 
इन युवाओं ने खुद पैसे जोड़कर और लोन लेकर अपने गांव के लिए एंबुलेंस खरीदी है. खास बात यह है कि ये युवा कोई बड़े कारोबारी या अमीर परिवार से नहीं आते हैं. ये आम नौकरी और मजदूरी करके अपना घर चलाते हैं. इसके बावजूद गांव के लोगों की मदद के लिए इन्होंने 10 लाख रुपए की एंबुलेंस खरीदी है.
15 किलोमीटर दूर से बुलानी पड़ती थी एंबुलेंस
यह मामला कर्नाटक के दक्षिण कन्नड़ जिले के बेल्थंगडी तालुक के कनियूर गांव के पदमुंजा मलेनगल्लू इलाके का है. यहां मेडिकल इमरजेंसी के दौरान लोगों को काफी मुश्किलों का सामना करना पड़ता था. गांव में किसी की तबीयत खराब होने या दुर्घटना होने पर एंबुलेंस के लिए करीब 15 किलोमीटर दूर उजीरे या उप्पिनंगडी से संपर्क करना पड़ता था. एंबुलेंस आने में देरी होने से मरीज को समय पर अस्पताल पहुंचाना मुश्किल हो जाता था.
युवाओं ने मिलकर जुटाए 7 लाख रुपए
गांव के लोगों की इस परेशानी को देखते हुए नवकेसरी नाम के स्थानीय युवा समूह ने अपनी एंबुलेंस खरीदने का फैसला किया. हालांकि, इसके लिए 10 लाख रुपए की जरूरत थी. समूह के ज्यादातर युवा सामान्य काम करके अपनी रोजी-रोटी चलाते हैं. उनके लिए इतनी बड़ी रकम जुटाना आसान नहीं था. फिर भी उन्होंने हार नहीं मानी. सभी युवाओं ने अपनी बचत से पैसे दिए और आपस में चंदा इकट्ठा किया. इस तरह कुल 7 लाख रुपए जमा हो गए. जबकि 3 लाख रुपए की कमी पूरी करने के लिए युवाओं ने कर्ज लिया.
6 युवा बारी-बारी से चलाएंगे एंबुलेंस
एंबुलेंस खरीदने के बाद उसे चलाने की जिम्मेदारी भी युवाओं ने खुद उठाई है. समूह के 6 सदस्य बारी-बारी से एंबुलेंस भी चलाएंगे. वे अपनी नौकरी और दूसरे काम के साथ यह जिम्मेदारी निभाएंगे. एंबुलेंस को खड़ी करने के लिए मलेनगल्लू में उमामहेश्वर भजन मंदिर के पास एक शेड भी बनाया गया है. इसमें ऑक्सीजन और फर्स्ट ऐड के लिए जरूरी सामान भी रखे गए हैं. 
'हमारा मकसद गांव के लोगों की जान बचाना है'
नवकेसरी समूह के सदस्य शरथ पदमुंजा ने न्यूज18 को बताया कि गांव के लोगों को मेडिकल इमरजेंसी के दौरान होने वाली परेशानी देखकर उन्होंने यह फैसला लिया.उन्होंने कहा, "हमारा मकसद गांव के लोगों की जान बचाना है. इसके लिए अगर हमें कर्ज भी लेना पड़े तो हम तैयार थे. यह एंबुलेंस पूरे गांव की है."
युवाओं की इस पहल की गांव के लोग जमकर तारीफ कर रहे हैं. इन युवाओं ने साबित कर दिया कि समाज की मदद करने के लिए अमीर होना जरूरी नहीं है. अगर इरादे मजबूत हों तो मिलकर बड़ी से बड़ी परेशानी का हल निकाला जा सकता है.

title: बांग्लादेश वापस लौटने की तैयारी में शेख हसीना, 16 दिसंबर को वापसी की जताई इच्छा, बांग्लादेश सरकार से मांगा सरक
description: अगस्त 2024 में बांग्लादेश में हुए छात्र आंदोलन के बाद शेख हसीना को सत्ता गंवानी पड़ी थी. इस आंदोलन में 1400 लोगों की मौत होने का अनुमान जताया गया है और मौजूदा सरकार इसके लिए शेख हसीना को जिम्मेदार घोषित कर चुकी है.
author: Saurabh Sharma
content:
बांग्लादेश की पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना 16 दिसंबर को भारत से अपने देश लौटने की योजना बना रही हैं. उन्होंने बांग्लादेश सरकार से दिल्ली से ढाका तक वापसी के लिए सरकारी एयरलाइंस का विमान उपलब्ध कराने की मांग की है. हालांकि, बांग्लादेश सरकार ने साफ कर दिया है कि हसीना की वापसी केवल भारत से प्रत्यर्पण के जरिए ही संभव है. ये जानकारी समाचार एजेंसी रॉयटर्स ने दी है.
शेख हसीना के प्रवक्ता सैयद मोजम्मेल अली ने मंगलवार को बताया कि हसीना 16 दिसंबर को बांग्लादेश के विजय दिवस के अवसर पर स्वदेश लौटना चाहती हैं. यह दिन 1971 के मुक्ति संग्राम में पाकिस्तान के खिलाफ बांग्लादेश की जीत और स्वतंत्रता की याद में मनाया जाता है. हसीना के लिए यह पहली बार है जब उन्होंने भारत में दो साल से अधिक समय के निर्वासन के बाद अपनी वापसी की कोई निश्चित तारीख बताई है.
प्रवक्ता के मुताबिक, हसीना ने बांग्लादेश सरकार से उनकी वापसी के लिए विमान की व्यवस्था करने को कहा है. उन्होंने दलील दी है कि 5 अगस्त 2024 को उन्हें बांग्लादेशी विमान से भारत लाया गया था, इसलिए अब सरकार की जिम्मेदारी है कि उनकी वापसी के लिए भी विमान उपलब्ध कराए. हसीना हाल ही में अपना पासपोर्ट और अन्य यात्रा दस्तावेज हासिल करने की कोशिश भी कर रही हैं. उनका पासपोर्ट भारत आने के कुछ महीने बाद रद्द कर दिया गया था.
सरकार का कड़ा रुख
बांग्लादेश सरकार ने हसीना की इस मांग को खारिज कर दिया है. विदेश मामलों के राज्य मंत्री हुमायूं कबीर ने कहा कि हसीना एक दोषी अपराधी हैं और उनकी वापसी केवल प्रत्यर्पण संधि के तहत ही हो सकती है. उन्होंने कहा कि भारत से प्रत्यर्पण के बाद हसीना को हथकड़ी लगाकर और कड़ी निगरानी में बांग्लादेश लाया जा सकता है. सरकार ने उनके लिए विशेष विमान भेजने की मांग को भी स्वीकार करने से इनकार किया है.
बांग्लादेश के इंटरनेशनल क्राइम्स ट्रिब्यूनल के मुख्य अभियोजक अमीनुल इस्लाम ने भी कहा कि एक दोषी व्यक्ति की ओर से सरकार से अपनी वापसी के लिए विमान की व्यवस्था करने की उम्मीद करना उचित नहीं है. इससे पहले रविवार को बांग्लादेश के एक मंत्री ने भी कहा था कि अगर हसीना देश लौटती हैं तो उन्हें गिरफ्तार कर जेल भेज दिया जाएगा. भारत से उन्हें वापस लाने के लिए विमान भेजने को लेकर दोनों देशों के बीच कोई आधिकारिक बातचीत नहीं हुई है.
छात्र आंदोलन में 1,400 लोगों की मौत का आरोप
गौरतलब है कि अगस्त 2024 में बांग्लादेश में छात्र आंदोलन के बाद शेख हसीना की सरकार सत्ता से बाहर हो गई थी. इसके बाद 5 अगस्त 2024 को वह भारत आ गई थीं और तब से दिल्ली में रह रही हैं. संयुक्त राष्ट्र के मुताबिक, उस दौरान हुई हिंसा में करीब 1,400 लोगों की मौत हुई थी.
बांग्लादेश की अदालत ने पिछले साल नवंबर में उनकी गैरमौजूदगी में छात्र आंदोलन के दौरान हुई कार्रवाई का आदेश देने के मामले में उन्हें मौत की सजा सुनाई थी. हसीना ने निर्वासन में रहते हुए इन आरोपों को खारिज किया है. उनकी पार्टी अवामी लीग की राजनीतिक गतिविधियों पर भी बांग्लादेश में प्रतिबंध लगा हुआ है.
भारत के विदेश मंत्रालय ने फिलहाल हसीना की ताजा वापसी संबंधी मांग पर कोई टिप्पणी नहीं की है. हालांकि, अप्रैल में मंत्रालय ने कहा था कि वह बांग्लादेश की ओर से किए गए प्रत्यर्पण अनुरोध की जांच कर रहा है और नई सरकार के साथ रचनात्मक तरीके से बातचीत कर द्विपक्षीय संबंध मजबूत करना चाहता है. ऐसे में 16 दिसंबर को हसीना की प्रस्तावित वापसी अब केवल उनकी इच्छा तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि यह भारत-बांग्लादेश संबंधों और दोनों देशों के बीच प्रत्यर्पण प्रक्रिया से जुड़ा अहम मुद्दा बन गई है.

title: जेन्सन हुआंग संग अफेयर के दौरान चीनी जासूसी एजेंसी के संपर्क में थी एलिस हुआंग! जानिए फिर क्या हुआ?
description: रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, एलिस हुआंग साल 2025 में चीन की मिनिस्ट्री ऑफ स्टेट सिक्योरिटी के एक अधिकारी के संपर्क में थी. यह जानकारी खुफिया रिपोर्ट्स से जुड़े लोगों के हवाले से दी गई है.
author: Samarth Saraswat
content:
Nvidia और उसके पूर्व सीईओ जेनसन हुआंग (Jason Huang) से जुड़े मामले में एक नया खुलासा हुआ है. न्यूयॉर्क टाइम्स की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, जेनसन हुआंग के साथ अफेयर के दौरान एलिस हुआंग (Alice Huang) चीन की जासूसी एजेंसी के एक अधिकारी के संपर्क में थी. रिपोर्ट में दावा किया गया है कि दोनों के बीच एक साल से ज्यादा समय तक बातचीत होती रही.
चीन की जासूसी एजेंसी के अधिकारी से था संपर्क
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, एलिस हुआंग साल 2025 में चीन की मिनिस्ट्री ऑफ स्टेट सिक्योरिटी के एक अधिकारी के संपर्क में थी. यह जानकारी खुफिया रिपोर्ट्स से जुड़े लोगों के हवाले से दी गई है. हालांकि, अभी तक यह साबित नहीं हुआ है कि एलिस चीन के लिए जासूसी कर रही थी. अमेरिकी अधिकारियों ने भी इस मामले में कोई बयान नहीं दिया है. 
सिंगापुर की कंपनी भी जांच के दायरे में 
एलिस हुआंग पहले सिंगापुर की कंपनी मेगास्पीड इंटरनेशनल (Megaspeed International) की टॉप टीम का हिस्सा भी रह चुकी हैं. यह कंपनी Nvidia के बड़े क्लाइंट्स में शामिल थी और एक समय Nvidia से अरबों डॉलर की खरीदारी करती थी. अमेरिकी अधिकारी 2024 से ही मेगास्पीड की जांच कर रहे हैं. जांच का मुख्य कारण यह शक है कि कंपनी ने Nvidia के एडवांस AI चिप्स की चीन में तस्करी की है.
जेनसन हुआंग ने दिया था इस्तीफा
इस मामले में 29 अक्टूबर को न्यूयॉर्क टाइम्स की एक रिपोर्ट सामने आई थी. इसके बाद Nvidia से जुड़ा विवाद काफी बढ़ गया. रिपोर्ट में एलिस पर जासूसी से जुड़े शक जताए गए थे. इसके करीब दो हफ्ते बाद जेनसन हुआंग ने अपने पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया. इस विवाद के कारण Nvidia के शेयरों में भी भारी गिरावट आई.
अमेरिकी सरकार ने क्या कहा
अमेरिका के अटॉर्नी जनरल टॉड ब्लैंच ने कहा है कि जस्टिस डिपार्टमेंट ने अभी यह तय नहीं किया है कि एलिस हुआंग चीन की जासूस थीं या नहीं. वहीं, अमेरिकी खुफिया प्रमुख जे क्लेटन ने भी रविवार को CNN के कार्यक्रम में कहा कि एलिस और उनकी कंपनी से जुड़े कई मामलों की जांच चल रही है. इसलिए जांच पूरी होने तक किसी नतीजे पर पहुंचना सही नहीं होगा.
चीन को चिप सप्लाई पर भी उठे सवाल
इस विवाद के बाद अमेरिका में चीन को एडवांस सेमीकंडक्टर चिप बेचने के नियमों पर भी सवाल उठने लगे हैं. देश के दोनों प्रमुख राजनीतिक दलों (रिपब्लिक और डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी) के कुछ सांसदों का मानना है कि सरकार को इन नियमों को और सख्ती से लागू करना चाहिए. 
रिपब्लिकन सांसद जॉन कैनेडी ने इस मामले पर टिप्पणी करते हुए कहा कि उन्हें जेनसन हुआंग के निजी संबंधों से ज्यादा चिंता चिप की सुरक्षा और चीन को होने वाली सप्लाई की है. 
फिलहाल, एलिस हुआंग पर लगे आरोपों की जांच जारी है. यह पता चलना अभी बाकी है कि उनका चीनी अधिकारी से संपर्क किस मकसद से था और क्या इस मामले का Nvidia के कारोबार पर कोई सीधा असर पड़ा था.

title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return to Bangladesh separate from extradition request, says India
description: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said the decision regarding Hasina's voluntary return was a matter between the former prime minister and the Bangladesh government.
author: Business Today Desk
content:
“It is a matter between Sheikh Hasina and the Government of Bangladesh,” the MEA said, responding to her announcement of a proposed return on December 16.
Hasina, 79, has expressed her intention to return to Bangladesh after spending more than two years in exile in India, Reuters reported. However, the Bangladesh government has maintained that she can only be brought back through extradition.
Hasina seeks return on Victory Day
Hasina's spokesperson, Syed Mozammel Ali, said on Tuesday that the former prime minister intends to return on December 16, when Bangladesh commemorates its victory over Pakistan in the 1971 Liberation War.
She has also requested the Bangladesh government to arrange her air travel from New Delhi to Dhaka aboard the country's national carrier, Biman Bangladesh Airlines.
According to Ali, Hasina has sought the necessary travel documents from the Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi through communications sent by her lawyer on November 9 and 19.
“Since Sheikh Hasina was flown to India on a Bangladesh aircraft on August 5, 2024, she now calls upon the Government to arrange for her air transport from Delhi back to Dhaka,” he said.
Ali argued that the Bangladesh government had a responsibility to facilitate her return, alleging that she had been exiled in violation of the country's Constitution.
Dhaka insists on extradition
Hasina's announcement has triggered strong reactions in Dhaka, with the Bangladesh government insisting that she would be brought back “in handcuffs” and treated under the same legal provisions applicable to other convicted fugitives residing abroad.
India's clarification distinguishes between an individual's voluntary decision to return and the formal legal process involved in responding to an extradition request from another country.
Hasina has been living in India since August 5, 2024, when she fled Bangladesh following a student-led uprising that brought an end to her 15-year rule.

title: Saurav Das asked to explain passport discrepancies within 7 days, told not to travel abroad
description: The controversy erupted after Das claimed that immigration officials stopped him at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport before he could board his scheduled 1 am flight to London
author: Business Today Desk
content:
“Passport applicants are required to provide accurate information,” Jaiswal said, explaining that authorities issue show-cause notices when discrepancies involving possible suppression of facts are detected or reported.
READ THIS: ‘I wish I was Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya…’: CJP’s Saurav Das says he was stopped from flying to London
The controversy erupted after Das claimed that immigration officials stopped him at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport before he could board his scheduled 1 am flight to London. He was travelling to the United Kingdom to participate in a panel discussion organised by the Oxford University Students’ Union on the “cockroach movement”.
In a post on X, Das accused the Centre of preventing him from travelling abroad, alleging that the government was uncomfortable with his participation in discussions at international institutions.
“I have been stopped by this cowardly Govt at the Delhi Airport from flying to London to deliver a lecture at the University of Oxford,” Das wrote.
He also claimed that he had received invitations to speak at Cambridge University, the London School of Economics (LSE) and the University of Edinburgh. Das alleged that the government was attempting to restrict his participation in these engagements.
The passport-related action centres on discrepancies in his personal details. According to reports citing official sources, authorities are examining differences in his birth-related particulars across documents. His passport was issued by the Chennai RPO on August 21, 2019.
ALSO READ: 'Think for yourselves': Saurav Das unveils Cockroach Club's plan for India's youth to debate and unwind
The notice gives Das seven days to submit an explanation and supporting documents. Authorities will examine his response before deciding on further action. If his explanation is found unsatisfactory, the passport could face further proceedings, including possible impounding under the Passports Act, 1967.
Das has criticised the timing of the notice and questioned the circumstances surrounding the travel restriction. The government, however, has said the notice followed information received by the authorities and the prescribed passport verification process.

title: 6.8 lakh PDFs, 54.8 crore records: How 18-year-old Sarthak Sidhant made UP voter rolls searchable
description: Sidhant said his team used Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to process every voter roll PDF published by the ECI for Uttar Pradesh.
author: Avinash Kateel
content:
The Election Commission of India (ECI) had already made the electoral rolls available online. But much of the data was available as scanned, image-based PDFs. Finding a name, checking an entry or comparing voter lists could therefore require people to download individual files and manually go through them.
Sidhant's project aims to make that process easier by turning the scanned documents into searchable data.
From scanned PDFs to searchable data
Sidhant said his team used Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to process every voter roll PDF published by the ECI for Uttar Pradesh.
"We OCR'd every voter roll PDF that the ECI put out of Uttar Pradesh," he wrote on X.
The team processed 6.8 lakh PDFs, most of them scans, and converted them into 54.8 crore rows of data. The records were organised into tables corresponding to each of the state's 403 Assembly constituencies.
Optical Character Recognition (OCR) allows a computer to recognise text from scanned images and convert it into machine-readable information.
That means a voter, journalist or researcher can search through large amounts of electoral data instead of opening PDFs and checking them page by page.
Don't Miss: IDBI Bank not a ‘State’, Supreme Court ruling may impact strategic sale as govt assures staff safety
The project covers four sets of electoral rolls: the roll used for the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, the draft and final rolls prepared during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), and the 2027 draft electoral roll.
The publicly downloadable files also have safeguards. Sensitive details such as names, relatives' names, EPIC numbers and house numbers are replaced with keyed-hash tokens. The underlying entries can still be checked against the original ECI PDFs.
Why the voter roll project matters
The exercise comes amid wider demands for machine-readable electoral rolls during the ECI's SIR.
Electoral rolls are central to the voting process, and changes made during a revision can affect whether a citizen's name appears on the voter list.
Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi has also demanded machine-readable electoral rolls. The Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer's office introduced searchable and downloadable PDFs for the 2027 draft electoral roll on November 17.
Sidhant's exercise goes further by bringing together four sets of electoral rolls and processing hundreds of thousands of documents into a consolidated dataset.
'This is true public service'
The initiative has drawn praise from opposition leaders, journalists and civil society groups.
Congress Lok Sabha MP from Assam Gaurav Gogoi backed Sidhant's work.
"I support the work done by Sarthak Sidhant. It is long and painstaking but essential. Democracy is served when citizens are vigilant and the institutions meant to serve the public are under scrutiny," Gogoi, the MP from Jorhat, posted on X on Tuesday.
Senior journalist Pankaj Pachauri also praised the initiative, saying the team was doing what the ECI did not undertake.
"This is true public service. Doing Government's work because the ECI will not dare to do it," Pachauri posted on X.
From CBSE to the ECI
This is not Sidhant's first attempt to make public systems easier to examine.
His earlier work began in May after the declaration of his CBSE Class 12 results. After noticing discrepancies in his marks, he sought scanned copies of his evaluated answer sheets and began examining how the board's newly introduced OSM system worked.
By late May and early June, Sidhant was examining successive versions of CBSE's tender documents. He flagged changes in eligibility criteria, technical requirements and other conditions for selecting the company responsible for the digital evaluation system.
On June 2, the ethical hacker presented his findings in a seven-page document before the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Education, chaired by Congress MP Digvijaya Singh.
Later that month, on June 26, he shared a public database containing approximately 1.66 crore government procurement records scraped from the Centre's Central Public Procurement Portal, extending his work from education to public spending.
Sidhant's work received international recognition on November 20 when he was included in TIME100 Next India 2026.
Four days later, he announced the voter roll digitisation project, taking his work into another institution central to India's democracy.
From examining the CBSE's digital evaluation system to opening up government procurement records and now making electoral data easier to search, Sidhant's work has followed a simple idea: making information public and making it accessible are not always the same thing.
At 18, the Ranchi teenager is now applying that idea to India's electoral rolls.

title: 'Has doxxing been legalised?': CJP's Saurav Das alleges passport leak by BJP-aligned handles, questions MEA over privacy- Moneycontrol.com
description: In a post on X, Das asked whether the government considered the circulation of citizens' passport details a routine matter and whether "doxxing" had been legalised in what he described as "New India".
content:
Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das on Wednesday alleged that social media accounts aligned with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) had circulated his passport details, raising concerns over the alleged leak of his personal information. He questioned the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) over the circulation of the document and said he would file a criminal complaint against the handles involved.
In a post on X, Das asked whether the government considered the circulation of citizens' passport details a routine matter and whether "doxxing" had been legalised in what he described as "New India".
"Certain BJP-aligned social media handles have now leaked my passport. This is a matter of serious concern. Will the Ministry of External Affairs clarify whether such leaks of citizens' passports are a routine affair? Has doxxing been legalised in New India?" he wrote.
The allegations come days after Das approached the Delhi High Court, claiming that he was prevented from travelling to London, where he was scheduled to deliver a lecture at Oxford University. He alleged that the BJP-led central government issued him a show-cause notice over discrepancies in his passport just five hours before his scheduled departure.
Saurav Das alleges targeted harassment
Das also alleged that his Delhi residential address had previously been circulated online, following which YouTubers entered his house in his absence. He further claimed that fabricated stories about his family life and a morphed photograph of him had been circulated.
"First, a BJP-aligned lowlife leaked my Delhi residential address. Then sent propagandist YouTubers who barged into my house while I was out of town. This was followed by fabricated stories about my family life and even a morphed picture of me. Now, my passport is being circulated to peddle yet another stupid, ridiculous narrative," he said.
Citing concerns over his personal safety and privacy, Das said he had specifically asked the SEM court to ensure that his rent agreement was not leaked.
He also said he would approach the relevant authorities with criminal complaints against every social media account allegedly involved in circulating his passport details.
"I shall be filing a criminal complaint with the relevant authorities against EVERY social media handle involved in circulating my passport," he posted.
Das added that he was documenting every instance of alleged harassment and the accounts involved, warning that those responsible could face legal action in the future.
CJP founder questions passport leak
CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke also questioned how Das's passport details could allegedly be leaked and circulated online while information about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's educational qualifications remained inaccessible.
"Saurav's passport has been leaked from within the system and is now being circulated by several BJP supporters. What kind of world are we living in where nobody can access the Prime Minister's degree, but a citizen's passport can be leaked and circulated so openly?" Dipke wrote on X.
MEA says Das was asked to clarify place of birth
Responding to the controversy, the Ministry of External Affairs said on Wednesday that its Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai had issued a show-cause notice to Das over discrepancies concerning his place of birth in his passport.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said the notice was issued on November 23, asking Das to provide clarification within seven days. He was also advised not to use the passport until he submitted his response.
"The passport application process requires the applicant to provide accurate information. If, at any stage, a discrepancy is noted or reported by the authorities, amounting to a suppression of facts, we issue a show-cause notice to the applicant, allowing them to present their side of the matter," Jaiswal said during a media briefing.
He added that the notice followed reports received from the relevant law enforcement authorities.
The MEA's statement came amid Das's allegations that the notice was issued shortly before his scheduled departure to London for the Oxford University lecture.

title: Over $5 billion of Indian exports to US could face stiffer competition from Asian rivals under new tariff proposal- Moneycontrol.com
description: Indian exports worth $3.93 billion could face increased competition from Malaysia alone, followed by $2.28 billion from Indonesia and $1.19 billion from Bangladesh
content:
Over $5 billion of Indian exports to US could face stiffer competition from Asian rivals under new tariff proposal
Indian exports worth $3.93 billion could face increased competition from Malaysia alone, followed by $2.28 billion from Indonesia and $1.19 billion from Bangladesh
Over $5 billion worth of Indian exports to the United States could face stiffer competition from Asian rivals if Washington proceeds with its latest tariff proposal and New Delhi fails to conclude a trade agreement, a Moneycontrol analysis of trade data suggests.
The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) on November 25 proposed a tariff of 25 percent on Indian goods following its investigation into structural excess manufacturing capacity across major economies.
The new tariffs are expected to kick in from January 2027.
Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, in comparison, would face tariffs of 18 percent, giving exporters from these countries a seven-percentage-point advantage over their Indian counterparts.
A Moneycontrol analysis of 2024 trade data shows that $3.93 billion worth of Indian exports are vulnerable to competition from Malaysia alone, followed by $2.28 billion from Indonesia and $1.19 billion from Bangladesh.
The proposed tariff rate for India would come down to 17 percent if the two countries conclude a trade agreement, giving Indian exporters a one-percentage-point advantage over Bangladesh, Indonesia, Cambodia, Malaysia and Thailand and bringing $5 billion worth of trade advantage.
India would also enjoy a three-percentage-point advantage over Vietnam, which faces a proposed tariff of 35 percent that could come down to 20 percent under a trade agreement.
Textiles, seafood and engineering goods vulnerable
Malaysia’s competitive advantage is likely to be most pronounced in industrial products. India’s electrical static converter exports worth $627 million and wooden furniture shipments worth $352 million were among the categories vulnerable to competition from Malaysian suppliers.
Indonesia could gain market share in jerseys, shrimps and prawns, categories in which India's exports to the US stood at around $850 million in 2024.
Bangladesh’s potential gains are concentrated in textiles and garments, particularly jerseys, pullovers, T-shirts and shirts. The country also competes closely with India in coffee and tea preparations.
Thailand could emerge as another challenger in processed seafood, rubber and plastic products.
Trade deal could deliver eight-percentage-point swing
The latest proposal also underlines the importance of concluding the India-US trade agreement.
However, even with a trade agreement, India would face higher proposed tariffs than the European Union, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland and Taiwan, which are slated to attract duties of 15 percent.

title: Supreme Court says Allahabad HC’s 'Hijab not essential' ruling will not be precedent, issues notice on challenge- Moneycontrol.com
description: Student Sukaina Rizvi was denied Class XI admission at Prayagraj's Tagore Public School for insisting on wearing a hijab with the prescribed uniform.
content:
The Supreme Court has issued notice on a challenge to the Allahabad High Court's ruling that wearing a hijab is not an essential religious practice in Islam, while directing that the disputed judgment should not be relied upon as a precedent. The matter has been tagged with the pending appeals concerning the Karnataka hijab controversy.
A bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M Pancholi passed the order on November 20 seen by Moneycontrol, while hearing a Special Leave Petition (SLP) filed by the Muslim Women's Study Circle, an organisation representing Muslim women.
The petition challenges the Allahabad High Court's August 21, 2026 decision in the case involving Sukaina Rizvi, a student who was refused admission to Class XI at Tagore Public School in Attarsuiya, Prayagraj, over her insistence on wearing a headscarf with the prescribed school uniform.
In its November 20 order, the Supreme Court permitted the petitioner to institute the proceedings and directed that notice be issued to the respondents. It further ordered, "Tag with Civil Appeal No.7095/2022 and this judgment shall not be treated as precedent."
The case challenges the Allahabad High Court's August 2026 judgment. The Allahabad High Court bench comprising Justices JJ Munir and Indrajeet Shukla had rejected Rizvi's challenge to the school's decision. It held that wearing a hijab was not an indispensable religious practice under Islam. The court also observed that students could not demand additions to institutional uniforms where the prescribed dress code was applied consistently, was non-discriminatory, and served legitimate objectives such as discipline and maintaining the institution's identity.
The High Court had relied on the Karnataka High Court's 2022 Full Bench ruling, which upheld educational institutions' power to prescribe uniforms that did not accommodate the hijab.
Muslim women's organisation challenges religious freedom ruling
Before the Supreme Court, the Muslim Women's Study Circle has argued that the Allahabad High Court's conclusions are discriminatory and arbitrary, infringing Articles 14, 15, 19(1)(a), 21 and 25 of the Constitution. According to the petitioner, restrictions on wearing the hijab undermine Muslim women's freedom to practise their religion and create barriers to accessing education.
The plea also disputes the application of the essential religious practices test, maintaining that wearing a hijab attracts constitutional protection under Article 25. It contends that the restriction places Muslim students at a disadvantage, particularly when religious attire worn by other communities, including Sikh turbans, is treated differently.
Relying on the Supreme Court's decisions in Shirur Mutt and Bijoe Emmanuel, the petitioner has argued that courts must give due consideration to sincerely held religious beliefs. It has also questioned the High Court's approach in applying the essential religious practices doctrine, whose constitutional validity is under consideration before a nine-judge Constitution Bench in the Sabarimala reference proceedings.
Petition cites Quranic verses on hijab
The petitioner has maintained that covering the head is rooted in Quranic teachings, specifically Surah Al-Noor, Verse 31 and Surah Al-Ahzab, Verse 59. It argues that the practice cannot be considered non-essential merely because certain members of the Muslim community do not observe it.
The plea additionally invokes the Supreme Court's observations in M Siddiq v Mahant Suresh Das, the Ayodhya title dispute, that constitutional courts should avoid adjudicating between competing theological interpretations and recognise the faith and beliefs of worshippers.
The Supreme Court in October 2022 delivered a split verdict on the hijab ban in Karnataka’s educational institutions, with one judge holding permitting a community to wear its religious symbols will be an ”antithesis to secularism” and the other insisting that wearing the Muslim headscarf should be simply a ”matter of choice”.
While Justice Hemant Gupta dismissed the appeals challenging the March 15 judgement of the Karnataka High Court which had refused to lift the ban, Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia held there shall be no restriction on the wearing of hijab anywhere in the schools and colleges of the state.
With the apex court delivering a split verdict, the high court’s judgement still holds the field. However, the split verdict held off a permanent resolution of the vexed row over hijab as both judges suggested placing the matter before a larger bench for adjudication.

title: భారత్ ఎదిగితే వారి దుకాణాలు మూతపడతాయి.. ఆర్ఎస్ఎస్ చీఫ్‌ కీలక వ్యాఖ్యలు
description: ప్రపంచంలో ఏ శక్తి కూడా భారత్‌ అభివృద్ధి చెందాలని కోరుకోవడం లేదని ఆర్ఎస్ఎస్ చీఫ్‌ మోహన్‌ భాగవత్‌ తెలిపారు. తమ ఆధిపత్యాన్ని చాటుకోవడానికి  బలమైన దేశాలు ప్రయత్నిస్తుంటాయన్నారు.
author: ABN
content:
భారత్ ఎదిగితే వారి దుకాణాలు మూతపడతాయి.. ఆర్ఎస్ఎస్ చీఫ్‌ కీలక వ్యాఖ్యలు
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 25 , 2026 | 09:58 PM
ప్రపంచంలో ఏ శక్తి కూడా భారత్‌ అభివృద్ధి చెందాలని కోరుకోవడం లేదని ఆర్ఎస్ఎస్ చీఫ్‌ మోహన్‌ భాగవత్‌ తెలిపారు. తమ ఆధిపత్యాన్ని చాటుకోవడానికి బలమైన దేశాలు ప్రయత్నిస్తుంటాయన్నారు.
ఇంటర్నెట్‌ డెస్క్‌: ప్రపంచంలో ఏ శక్తి కూడా భారత్‌ అభివృద్ధి చెందాలని కోరుకోవడం లేదని రాష్ట్రీయ స్వయంసేవక్ సంఘ(ఆర్ఎస్ఎస్) చీఫ్‌ మోహన్‌ భాగవత్‌ (Mohan Bhagwat) తెలిపారు. తమ ఆధిపత్యాన్ని చాటుకోవడానికి బలమైన దేశాలు ప్రయత్నిస్తుంటాయని, భారత్‌ మాత్రం తమను ద్వేషించే వారికీ సహాయం చేస్తుందన్నారు. మహారాష్ట్రలోని ఛత్రపతి శంభాజీనగర్‌లో ఏర్పాటు చేసిన ఐదవ పద్మా ఉత్సవంలో భాగవత్ ఈ వ్యాఖ్యలు చేశారు.
ఈ కార్యక్రమంలో మోహన్ భాగవత్ మాట్లాడుతూ..'ప్రపంచంలో ఏ శక్తి కూడా భారత్‌ అభివృద్ధిని కోరుకోవడం లేదు. ఆయా దేశాలు ‘బలవంతుడిదే పైచేయి’ అనే సూత్రాన్ని బలంగా నమ్ముతాయి. అందుకే ఇతరులను ఎప్పుడూ ఒత్తిడిలో ఉంచడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తాయి. మనం అభివృద్ధి చెందితే వారి దుకాణాలు మూతపడతాయి. అందుకే మనల్ని ఇబ్బంది పెట్టాలని చూస్తుంటాయి. కానీ, భారత్‌ మాత్రం మనల్ని ద్వేషించే పొరుగు దేశాలకు కూడా సహాయం చేస్తుంది. మాల్దీవులు, శ్రీలంక, నేపాల్‌, బంగ్లాదేశ్‌తో పాటు పాకిస్థాన్‌కు కూడా కష్టాల్లో భారత్ సహాయం చేసింది’ అని మోహన్‌ భాగవత్‌ గుర్తుచేశారు.
బానిసత్వ సంకెళ్ల నుంచి నేటి దేశ యువత విముక్తి పొందిందని భాగవత్‌ అభిప్రాయపడ్డారు. నేటి తరం అబద్ధాలను ద్వేషిస్తుందని, ఎవరైనా నిజాయతీగా మాట్లాడితే వారికి మద్దతుగా నిలుస్తుందని ఆయన వెల్లడించారు. తమ దేశాన్ని అత్యంత గొప్ప స్థానంలో చూడాలని నేటి యువత కోరుకుంటోందన్నారు. ఈ కార్యక్రమంలో మరో ముఖ్య అతిథిగా పాల్గొన్న మాజీ చీఫ్‌ ఆఫ్‌ డిఫెన్స్‌ స్టాఫ్‌ జనరల్‌ అనిల్‌ చౌహాన్‌ ప్రసంగిస్తూ.. 2047 నాటికి వికసిత్‌ భారత్‌ లక్ష్యాన్ని చేరుకునే విషయంలో యువతదే కీలక పాత్ర అని, అభివృద్ధి ఫలాలు కూడా వారికే చెందుతాయన్నారు. జ్ఞానజ్ఞ ఫౌండేషన్ అనే సంస్థ పద్మ ఉత్సవాన్ని నిర్వహించింది. వివిధ రంగాలకు చెందిన పద్మ పురస్కార గ్రహీతలను ప్రజలతో మమేకమయ్యేలా చేసేందుకు ఈ కార్యక్రమం ఏర్పాటు చేశారు. మూడు రోజుల పాటు సాగిన ఈ ఉత్సవంలో పలువురు ప్రముఖులు పాల్గొన్నారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి:
పుణెలో విద్యార్థులపైకి దూసుకెళ్లిన లారీ.. ఐదుగురి పరిస్థితి విషమం!
కాంగ్రెస్‌-ఎస్పీ పొత్తు.. అమేథీ, రాయ్‌బరేలీతో అసలు సమస్య..

title: చికెన్ షవర్మా తిని 43 మందికి అస్వస్థత.. బాధితుల్లో గర్భిణీ, చిన్నారులు!
description: ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: మ‌హ‌రాష్ట్ర‌లోని భివండీ ప్రాంతంలో చికెన్‌ షవర్మా  తిని 43 మంది అస్వస్థతకు గురయ్యారు. బాధితుల్లో 17 మంది పురుషులు, 16 మంది మ‌హిళ‌లు, 10 మంది చిన్నారులు ఉన్నారు.
author: ABN
content:
చికెన్ షవర్మా తిని 43 మందికి అస్వస్థత.. బాధితుల్లో గర్భిణీ, చిన్నారులు!
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 25 , 2026 | 09:16 PM
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: మ‌హ‌రాష్ట్ర‌లోని భివండీ ప్రాంతంలో చికెన్‌ షవర్మా తిని 43 మంది అస్వస్థతకు గురయ్యారు. బాధితుల్లో 17 మంది పురుషులు, 16 మంది మ‌హిళ‌లు, 10 మంది చిన్నారులు ఉన్నారు.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: మ‌హ‌రాష్ట్ర‌లోని భివండీ ప్రాంతంలో చికెన్‌ షవర్మా తిని 43 మంది అస్వస్థతకు గురయ్యారు. బాధితుల్లో 17 మంది పురుషులు, 16 మంది మ‌హిళ‌లు, 10 మంది చిన్నారులు ఉన్నారు. అలానే ఓ గర్భిణీ కూడా ఉండటం ఆందోళన కలిగిస్తోంది. న‌గ‌రంలోని వంజార్‌పట్టి నాకా ప్రాంతంలో ఉన్న ఓ షాపులో సోమవారం రాత్రి షవర్మా తిన్నవారిలో కొంద‌రికి మంగళవారం ఉదయం నుంచి వాంతులు, విరేచనాలు అయ్యాయి.
బాధితులను వెంటనే సమీపంలోని ఆస్పత్రులకు తరలించారు. ఒకే కుటుంబానికి చెందిన ఐదుగురు బాధితులను చికిత్స కోసం ఇందిరాగాంధీ స్మతి ఉపజిల్లా ఆస్పత్రిలో చేర్చారు. షవర్మా తినడం వల్లే వీరు అస్వస్థతకు గురైనట్లు వైద్యాధికారులు తెలిపారు. ఆ తరువాత కాసేపటికి ప‌లువురు బాధితులు ఇదే లక్షణాలతో చికిత్స కోసం ఆస్పత్రిలో చేరారు. ఒకేసారి పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో బాధితులు ఆస్పత్రిలో చేరడంతో అక్కడి సిబ్బంది పోలీసులకు సమాచారం అందించారు.
దీంతో పోలీసులు ఆస్పత్రికి చేరుకుని ఘటనకు సంబంధించిన వివరాలు సేకరించారు. మరోవైపు ఈ ఘ‌ట‌న‌కు కార‌ణ‌మైన‌ షవర్మా దుకాణాన్ని కార్పొరేషన్‌ అధికారులు కూల్చివేశారు. కాగా, ఈ ఏడాది జూన్‌ 15న భివండిలోని ఖండుపాడా ప్రాంతంలో చికెన్‌ షవర్మా తిని ఏకంగా 107 మంది ఫుడ్‌ పాయిజనింగ్‌ బారినపడ్డారు. తాజాగా మరోసారి ఫుడ్‌ పాయిజనింగ్‌ ఘటన చోటుచేసుకోవడంతో కార్పొరేషన్‌ అధికారుల పర్యవేక్షణ, ఆహార భద్రత చర్యలపై ప్రజలు ఆందోళన వ్యక్తంచేస్తున్నారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి:
పుణెలో విద్యార్థులపైకి దూసుకెళ్లిన లారీ.. ఐదుగురి పరిస్థితి విషమం!
కాంగ్రెస్‌-ఎస్పీ పొత్తు.. అమేథీ, రాయ్‌బరేలీతో అసలు సమస్య..

title: పుణెలో విద్యార్థులపైకి దూసుకెళ్లిన లారీ.. ఐదుగురి పరిస్థితి విషమం!
description: మహారాష్ట్రలోని పుణె నగరంలో ఇవాళ మధ్యాహ్నం ఘోర రోడ్డు ప్రమాదం చోటుచేసుకుంది. బస్సు కోసం వేచిచూస్తున్న కాలేజీ విద్యార్థులపైకి ఓ వేగంగా వచ్చిన లారీ అదుపుతప్పి దూసుకెళ్లింది.
author: ABN
content:
పుణెలో విద్యార్థులపైకి దూసుకెళ్లిన లారీ.. ఐదుగురి పరిస్థితి విషమం!
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 25 , 2026 | 07:59 PM
మహారాష్ట్రలోని పుణె నగరంలో ఇవాళ మధ్యాహ్నం ఘోర రోడ్డు ప్రమాదం చోటుచేసుకుంది. బస్సు కోసం వేచిచూస్తున్న కాలేజీ విద్యార్థులపైకి ఓ వేగంగా వచ్చిన లారీ అదుపుతప్పి దూసుకెళ్లింది.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: మహారాష్ట్రలోని పుణె నగరంలో ఇవాళ(బుధవారం) మధ్యాహ్నం ఘోర రోడ్డు ప్రమాదం చోటుచేసుకుంది. బస్సు కోసం వేచిచూస్తున్న కాలేజీ విద్యార్థులపైకి ఓ వేగంగా వచ్చిన ట్రక్కు (ఐషర్ వాహనం) అదుపుతప్పి దూసుకెళ్లింది. ఈ ఘటనలో పలువురు విద్యార్థులు గాయపడగా, ఐదుగురి పరిస్థితి విషమంగా ఉన్నట్లు సమాచారం. బోప్‌దేవ్ ఘాట్‌లోని గార్వా హోటల్ సమీపంలో మధ్యాహ్నం 1.34 గంటల ప్రాంతంలో ఈ ఘటన చోటుచేసుకుంది.
ఘటనా స్థలంలోని సీసీటీవీ దృశ్యాల్లో ట్రక్కు అదుపుతప్పి రహదారి పక్కకు వెళ్లడం స్పష్టంగా కనిపిస్తోంది. వేగంగా వస్తున్న వాహనాన్ని గమనించిన విద్యార్థులు ప్రాణాలు అరచేతిలో పెట్టుకుని పరుగులు తీసినప్పటికీ, కొందరు ప్రమాదంలో చిక్కుకున్నారు. బ్రేకులు ఫెయిల్ కావడం లేదా వేగం కారణంగా డ్రైవర్ నియంత్రణ కోల్పోయి ఈ ప్రమాదం జరిగి ఉండవచ్చని అధికారులు ప్రాథమికంగా భావిస్తున్నారు. ప్రమాదం జరిగిన వెంటనే డ్రైవర్ వాహనాన్ని ఆపకుండా అక్కడి నుంచి వెళ్లిపోయాడు.
ఈ ప్రమాదంలో గాయపడిన వారిని వెంటనే చికిత్స నిమిత్తం ఆసుపత్రికి తరలించారు. బాధితుల కుటుంబాలతో రోదనలతో ఆసుపత్రి ప్రాంగణం దద్దరిలింది. ఈ ఘటనపై స్థానిక పోలీసులు కేసు నమోదు చేసి దర్యాప్తు చేపట్టారు. సీసీటీవీ ఫుటేజీ ఆధారంగా పరారైన వాహనం, డ్రైవర్ కోసం గాలింపు చర్యలు ముమ్మరం చేశారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి:
ఖతర్‌లో తెలుగు కళా సమితి వనభోజనం
కీరవాణి ఆధ్వర్యంలో గ్లోబల్ సమ్మిట్ ఆంథమ్.. నాలుగు భాషల్లో ప్రత్యేక గీతం: సీఎస్ సంజయ్ జాజు

title: సీజేపీ కో కన్వీనర్ సౌరవ్ దాస్⁭కు షాక్.. పాస్⁭పోర్ట్ వాడకూడదంటూ నోటీసులు
description:
కాక్రోచ్ జనతా పార్టీ కో కన్వీనర్ సౌరవ్ దాస్ కు ఇమిగ్రేషన్ అధికారులు షాకిచ్చారు. విదేశాలకు వెళ్లకుండా షోకాజ్ నోటీసులు జారీ చేశారు. పాస్ పోర్టును వాడకూడదని ఆదేశాలు జారీ చేశారు. లండన్ వెళ్లేందుకు 2026 నవంబర్ 2న తెల్లవారుజామున ఎయిర్ పోర్టుకు వెళ్లిన తనను ఇమ్మిగ్రేషన్ అధికారులు అడ్డుకున్నట్లు సౌరవ్ పేర్కొన్నారు. 

చెన్నైలోని ప్రాంతీయ పాస్‌పోర్ట్ కార్యాలయం  సౌరవ్ దాస్‌కు షోకాజ్ నోటీసు జారీ చేసింది. పుట్టిన స్థలం వివరాలపై ఏడు రోజుల్లోగా స్పష్టత ఇవ్వాలని అధికారులు ఆదేశించారు. విదేశీ వ్యవహారాల శాఖ అధికార ప్రతినిధి రణధీర్ జైస్వాల్ బుధవారం (నవంబర్25) ఈ వివరాలను వెల్లడించారు. తన వివరణ ఇచ్చే వరకు పాస్‌పోర్ట్‌ను వాడకూడదని సౌరవ్ దాస్‌కు అధికారులు సూచించినట్లు చెప్పారు. 

దర్యాప్తు సంస్థల నుంచి వచ్చిన నివేదికల ఆధారంగా నవంబర్ 23న ఈ నోటీసు ఇచ్చామని రణధీర్ జైస్వాల్ తెలిపారు. సౌరవ్ దాస్ తన పుట్టిన స్థలం విషయంలో ఇచ్చిన సమాచారంలో తేడాలు ఉన్నాయని, వాటిపై వివరణ ఇచ్చే అవకాశం ఆయనకు కల్పించామని పేర్కొన్నారు. అయితే ఆ తేడాలు ఏమిటనేది ఆయన వెల్లడించలేదు. 

లండన్ వెళ్లేందుకు సోమవారం తెల్లవారుజామున 1 గంటకు ఢిల్లీ విమానాశ్రయానికి వెళ్లిన తనను ఇమ్మిగ్రేషన్ అధికారులు అడ్డుకున్నారని సౌరవ్ దాస్ ఆరోపించారు. తన పాస్‌పోర్ట్‌ను నిలిపివేసినట్లు అధికారులు చెప్పారని ఆయన పీటీఐకి తెలిపారు. ఆక్స్‌ఫర్డ్, కేంబ్రిడ్జ్, ఎల్ఎస్ఈ, ఎడిన్‌బర్గ్ వంటి యూనివర్సిటీల్లో ప్రసంగించేందుకు తనను ఆహ్వానించారని సౌరవ్ దాస్ చెప్పారు. కేంద్ర ప్రభుత్వం కావాలనే తన ప్రయాణాన్ని అడ్డుకుందని ఆయన ఎక్స్ వేదికగా విమర్శించారు.

ఈ ఘటనపై సౌరవ్ దాస్ బుధవారం ఢిల్లీ హైకోర్టును ఆశ్రయించారు. తనను విదేశాలకు వెళ్లకుండా అడ్డుకుంటున్నట్లు ఎలాంటి ఉత్తర్వులు అధికారులు చూపలేదని ఆయన తరపు న్యాయవాది కోర్టుకు తెలిపారు. నవంబర్ 27న కూడా బ్రిటన్ వెళ్లే అవకాశం ఉందని, పిటిషన్‌పై అత్యవసరంగా విచారణ జరపాలని కోరారు. దీనిపై స్పందించిన తాత్కాలిక ప్రధాన న్యాయమూర్తి నితిన్ వాసుదేవ్ సాంబ్రే, జస్టిస్ సంజయ్ శర్మలతో కూడిన ధర్మాసనం విచారణను మరుసటి రోజుకు వాయిదా వేసింది. ఆక్స్‌ఫర్డ్ యూనివర్సిటీ స్టూడెంట్స్ యూనియన్ ఆహ్వానం మేరకు తాను వెళ్తున్నానని సౌరవ్ దాస్ చెప్పారు.
