title: US, India enhance defence ties with Javelin Deal, Quad collaboration
description: India and the United States have significantly expanded their defence partnership in 2026 through a series of major military exercises, defence sales, co-production initiatives and enhanced cooperation under the Quad framework, reinforcing their shared commitment to regional security and a free and open Indo-Pacific.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
NEW DELHI: India and the United States have significantly expanded their defence partnership in 2026 through a series of major military exercises, defence sales, co-production initiatives and enhanced cooperation under the Quad framework, reinforcing their shared commitment to regional security and a free and open Indo-Pacific.
According to a fact sheet titled ‘US-India Major Defense Partnership’, the two countries continued to build on their Major Defence Partnership, which was strengthened by a new 10-year framework signed in 2025 to expand military cooperation and defence industrial collaboration.
“The United States and India share a strong and growing Major Defense Partnership built on trust, mutual respect, and shared security interests,” the fact sheet stated, highlighting the growing scope of bilateral military engagement.
The fact sheet noted that India conducts more military exercises with the United States than with any other country, reflecting the depth of their defence ties.
Among the major military engagements in 2026 was the 22nd edition of Exercise Yudh Abhyas, held from September 15 to 27 across Auli in Uttarakhand and the Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan. The exercise brought together approximately 500-600 military personnel from each country and focused on integrated combat operations, counterterrorism, drones, autonomous systems and live-fire training.
The United States also participated in the Indian Air Force’s multinational Exercise Tarang Shakti from September 26 to October 12 in Jodhpur, alongside six other foreign air forces. The exercise marked the first participation of American F-35 fifth-generation fighter aircraft in a military exercise on Indian soil, demonstrating growing cooperation between the two air forces.
Another significant engagement was the fifth edition of Exercise Tiger Triumph, conducted from October 31 to November 5 in Visakhapatnam. The bilateral tri-service exercise focused on humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR), including joint amphibious operations, staff planning and coordination between the armed forces of both countries.
Maritime cooperation also remained a key pillar of the partnership, with the United States, India, Australia and Japan participating in Exercise Malabar 2026 from November 5 to 12 in Japan. Originally established as a bilateral US-India naval exercise in 1992, Malabar has evolved into a major multilateral maritime exercise involving all four Quad partners. On the defence industrial front, the two countries advanced cooperation through major agreements involving American military platforms and equipment. (ANI)

title: FairPoint: Cong crosses another line by dragging cricket into religious politics
description: Somehow, it did not come as a shock when Congress MP Imran Masood alleged religious discrimination against pacer Mohammed Siraj over his exclusion from the playing XI in the first Test against New Zealand.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
NEW DELHI: Somehow, it did not come as a shock when Congress MP Imran Masood alleged religious discrimination against pacer Mohammed Siraj over his exclusion from the playing XI in the first Test against New Zealand. The reason is not that there is any truth in the statement, but that the Congress has now crossed all limits of constitutional propriety and general political etiquette.
Masood's statement came at a time when his party leader and the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, was making equally controversial statements during his US visit. From claiming that India is heading towards an economic disaster to saying that the country has become a "side player" in international affairs, Gandhi's statements are being viewed as attempts to undermine India's standing on foreign soil.
Gandhi has also been drawing comparisons with Pakistan, almost praising Islamabad's involvement in negotiating the US-Iran conflict. The BJP was quick to label him a "Pakistan fan boy".
Earlier, during the investor summit in Hyderabad, named 'Bharat Summit 2026', Gandhi, on the concluding day on November 14, stated that India was "no longer functioning as a democracy" and claimed that the democratic system had been destroyed in 2014. He was even seen clapping and appearing excited when Italian politician Giacomo Filibeck raised 'vote chori' slogans during the business summit. Filibeck also expressed support for Rahul Gandhi's campaign against the BJP-led government in India, bringing an international political dimension to the domestic debate.
Gandhi, who often holds a pocket-sized copy of the Constitution in his hand, needs to understand that questioning the government is one thing, but celebrating foreign criticism of India's democratic institutions is quite another. A political leader may have differences with the government of the day, but that should not mean taking every opportunity to run down the country on foreign soil. The question that arises is why Gandhi should have celebrated the statement of a foreigner on the Indian electoral system. The answer may not be difficult to comprehend. In his endeavour to run down the Modi-led government, he does not hesitate to take any steps. (IANS)

title: FSSAI to initiate action against Bisleri over unsafe water sample
description: The FSSAI on Sunday said it has initiated prosecution proceedings against popular packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International, after a laboratory examination found its water sample unsafe.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
NEW DELHI: The FSSAI on Sunday said it has initiated prosecution proceedings against popular packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International, after a laboratory examination found its water sample unsafe.
The food safety regulator said in a statement that the initial analysis of the Bisleri water found that the sample did not meet the prescribed limits for bromate, following which it was declared unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The company subsequently exercised its right to appeal, and the sample was forwarded to a referral food laboratory for further examination. However, the second laboratory assessment also classified the water as unsafe, identifying the presence of polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). (IANS)

title: West Bengal govt to provide financial assistance to unemployed youth under Bharsha scheme from January 1
description: The BJP government in West Bengal, led by Suvendu Adhikari, will provide financial assistance to unemployed youth under the Bharsha scheme from January 1, 2027.
content:
Kolkata (West Bengal) [India], November 25 (ANI): The BJP government in West Bengal, led by Suvendu Adhikari, will provide financial assistance to unemployed youth under the Bharsha scheme from January 1, 2027.
According to a press note, under the scheme, unemployed graduates and those who have passed government vocational courses will receive Rs 2,000 per month, while non-graduates will get Rs 1,500 per month. These amounts will rise to Rs 3,000 and Rs 2,000 respectively from April 2028.
The assistance will be credited by direct bank transfer to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account held solely by the beneficiary monthly or at regular intervals. A beneficiary can receive the benefit for a maximum of five years, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.
An applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal, aged between 21 and 45 years as on January 1, 2027. They must have passed Madhyamik or an equivalent examination under the non-graduate or undergraduate category, or must have completed graduation under the graduate category, the release said. 
However, the West Bengal government also mentions that applicants must not be self-employed or employed in the government or private sector and not more than two applicants from the same family will be eligible for the scheme. 
Moreover, they must not be covered under the Annapurna Yojana or any other social security scheme of the Government of West Bengal, but beneficiaries receiving a pension for Divyangjan, such as the Manabik pension, will be eligible.
In addition, the applicant's name must appear in the finally published electoral roll following SIR 2026, or their case must be pending before the SIR Appellate Tribunal, or their application must be pending under the CAA.
The scheme will be implemented on the basis of field verification of data against the eligibility criteria, after which the designated officer will recommend the list of eligible applicants.
Later, the applications received through the Apnar Sarkar Apnar Pase public grievance redressal system will be examined and the verified data integrated with the Bharsha database. (ANI)

description: According to an official statement, Telangana Director General of Police (DGP) CV Anand and Hyderabad City Police Commissioner M Mahesh Muralidhar Bhagwat conducted a surprise inspection of the police station on Wednesday to review the ongoing technical work and assess the implementation of the AI-based system.
content:
Hyderabad (Telangana) [India], November 25 (ANI): Panjagutta Police Station in Hyderabad is being developed as the country's first Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered police station, with the technology set to be integrated into policing services under a pilot project, from handling complaints to preparing chargesheets.
According to an official statement, Telangana Director General of Police (DGP) CV Anand and Hyderabad City Police Commissioner M Mahesh Muralidhar Bhagwat conducted a surprise inspection of the police station on Wednesday to review the ongoing technical work and assess the implementation of the AI-based system.
During the inspection, senior officers interacted with complainants visiting the police station and enquired about their experience with the staff and the resolution of their grievances through the AI system.
They also monitored the performance of police personnel and observed how staff members were using AI technology while carrying out their duties. 
Along with Khairatabad Zone DCP Shilpavalli, ACP Murali Krishna and Inspector Jahangir Yadav, the officials inspected the AI infrastructure being installed at the police station and reviewed the technical arrangements at the ground level.
According to the police, the initiative is being implemented as a pilot project, under which all policing services at Panjagutta Police Station will be integrated with advanced AI technology. The AI-based police station is expected to be officially inaugurated soon.
Additional DGP (Law and Order) Akun Sabharwal, Hyderabad Additional Commissioner of Police (Crimes and SIT) M Srinivasulu, Intelligence DIG Bhaskaran, Khairatabad Zone DCP Shilpavalli, SP TSPARK Rupesh, DCP Aravind Babu (SMIT) and other senior police officials also participated in the inspection. (ANI)

title: 26/11 Mumbai Terror Attack mastermind gets permission to make video call to see newborn granddaughter
description: A Special NIA Court in New Delhi on Wednesday, a day before the 18th anniversary of the deadly Mumbai Terror Attack 2008, granted permission to Tahawur Hussain Rana, alleged mastermind of the 26/11 Mumbai Terror Attack, to make a video call to see his newborn granddaughter.
content:
New Delhi [India], November 25 (ANI): A Special NIA Court in New Delhi on Wednesday, a day before the 18th anniversary of the deadly Mumbai Terror Attack 2008, granted permission to Tahawur Hussain Rana, alleged mastermind of the 26/11 Mumbai Terror Attack, to make a video call to see his newborn granddaughter. 
Rana has been lodged in a high-security cell of Tihar Jail of New Delhi since April 10, 2025. He was extradited from the USA in connection with the Mumbai Terror Attack of November 2008.
He had sought permission to make video calls to his family in the US on Thanksgiving Day on November 27 (which is November 26 in the US), 26 December (Christmas celebration week) and January 2 on New Year.
Special Judge (NIA) Prashant Sharma, after hearing the submissions on the application, permitted Tahawur Hussain Rana to make a 10-minute video call to his family on December 14 and January 4, 2027 from Tihar Jail.
The court allowed the application with directions, including that the video call shall be made in the presence of the jail superintendent and the same will be recorded.
It is also directed that the video call shall be made between 6 and 7 PM on the dates given by the court. It is also said that the first jail superintendent will say hello and, after getting a response from the other end, will give the call to Rana.
The court also said that the accused shall not request for such facility in the future on these grounds.
An application was moved on behalf of Tahawur Hussain Rana through Amicus curiae Nishant Singh with a prayer to permit him to make video calls to his family in the US. It was submitted that he is in custody since April 10, 2025 and has not seen his family since then and the new born grand daughter. However, he is availing a phone call facility.
The NIA opposed the application on the ground that the accused does not have a legal right to have video calling facility from custody. The application deserves to be dismissed.
Tahawur Hussain Rana is in judicial custody in the Mumbai Terror Attack case. The NIA has already filed a second supplementary charge sheet. The court has listed the matter for hearing arguements on charge next month. 
He had undergone a 14-year sentence in the USA before his extradition to India in 2025. (ANI)

title: A new book charts how the National Rural Livelihoods Mission made India’s women financially capable
description: An excerpt from ‘Claiming Our Skies: The Story of National Rural Livelihoods Mission’, edited by Nagendra Nath Sinha and Neelima Khetan.
author: Sarada Muraleedharan
content:
The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) is among the largest social sector programmes in the world. Started in 2011, it has completed 15 years. India should justifiably be proud of the programme’s achievements, such as the remarkable progress both in women’s empowerment and livelihoods, and in bringing prosperity to rural areas.
If the metric for judging success was merely numbers, then the achievements of the NRLM are enormous. The number of women enrolled in self-help groups (SHG) is over 100 million (100.06 million as of February 2025), and has, in fact, crossed the projected enrolment. The programme has saturated all the states and union territories which have rural areas and all the districts. In terms of coverage of blocks, it is near saturation. By February 2025, about 9.8 million SHGs had been formed, federated into 504,000 village organisations and 34,000 cluster-level federations.
[…]
Kudumbashree formally commenced operations in 1998 and has since become a byword for the empowerment of poor women in the state of Kerala. It served as an important precursor to Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM), particularly because of its distinctive experience in organising and working with federations of the poor.
Creating the network of federations, particularly with an enthusiastic panchayat taking the lead and the high visibility accorded to the network, was not difficult. However, ensuring that it stayed together and that the three tiers worked in harmony proved to be a difficult proposition. It was noticed that, over time, vested interests tended to creep into the system: bookkeeping would become slack, transparency and information flow across and within neighbourhood groups faded, and trust among members could get replaced with suspicion and obeisance to power within the group.
Another issue was to establish protocols to ensure that the women’s groups were not subsumed by the panchayats and local governance structures, and could participate in local decision-making to benefit the community, as well as retain their autonomy and identity within the system.
Kudumbashree undertook two interventions to address these issues: it adopted uniform byelaws for community organisations; and conducted elections within the community network.
It is also a fact that the empowered community network became a happy hunting ground for political candidates, as elected women representatives (EWR) of local governments. In 2020, of the 10,177 EWRs in Kerala, 7,450 were from the Kudumbashree network (73.2%).
The impact of the continuous citizenship-training of the community-based organisation is perhaps best captured in the observation of Laly Baby, former panchayat member of Udumbannoor, Kerala: “The thousands of women who did not have the courage to hold their own in any conversation, totally panicked coming to NHGs [neighbourhood groups] for the first time. […] Women who had been too shy to come out began to take on executive positions in the NHGs. Our NHGs had become workshops to catapult women into public life.”
[…]
The metaphor of a “leaking bucket” captures the potential paradox – where institutional achievements may not translate into substantive gender transformation if core gender norms remain unchallenged.
For women’s empowerment to move beyond the confines of economic participation, men must be engaged as co-responsible partners: sharing domestic responsibilities, reducing women’s unpaid work burdens, and supporting women’s right to dignity, mobility, and public visibility. Without this shift, the transformative potential of the NRLM will remain partial and fragile.
Below are key recommendations emerging from the analysis in this essay:
- Institutionalise gender mainstreaming across all NRLM verticals 
  - Integrate gender goals, indicators, and accountability mechanisms into every programme vertical, not just as add-ons via the Gender Unit.
- Expand and deepen gender training to address restrictive gender norms 
  - Revamp existing gender training modules to sensitise participants to the ideological and structural roots of patriarchy;
  - Incorporate sessions on sexuality, bodily autonomy, household bargaining power, and caste-gender intersectionality; and
  - Develop special modules for male community members and adolescent boys to reshape masculinities and engage them as allies in the transformation.
- Strengthen and standardise gender resource centres (GRCs) 
  - Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for referrals to police, legal aid, one-stop crisis centres, and shelters;
  - Expand GRC mandates to include legal literacy camps, property rights support, and campaigns on time poverty and unpaid care work; and
  - Ensure budgetary allocations to pay counsellors at the centres well and regularly.
- Shift focus from economic advancement to economic empowerment 
  - Redesign financial interventions to ensure women have control – not just access – to resources.
- Mandate equitable representation in leadership and federations 
  - Reform leadership structures at the SHG, VO, and CLF levels to ensure inclusion of SC/ST/OBC/minority and differently-abled women; and
  - Introduce rotational quotas and leadership mentoring for marginalised groups within federated structures.
Adopting the above strategies will enable the NRLM programme to transit from a gender-specific stage to a gender transformative stage, a leap that is long awaited and much required for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals.
[…]
Above all, the Mission has given rural women what development rarely promises: visibility, voice, and space in institutions that once excluded them. Women are today sitting across from bank managers as clients, negotiating with traders as entrepreneurs, auditing accounts as monitors of the state, and contesting elections as representatives of their communities. These are not isolated stories; they are the everyday reality of a movement that has altered the grammar of development.
To claim our skies is therefore not simply to escape poverty. It is to lift one’s eyes and see oneself in places once thought unattainable – in positions of authority, in spaces of decision-making, in the imagination of what the future can be. It is to insist that women belong not at the margins but at the very heart of India’s democratic and developmental journey.
In this sense, the NRLM is not only about livelihoods; it is about liberation into visibility. It is about millions of rural women stepping forward to say: we are here, we count, and we will lead. In their collective flight lies the promise of an India that is more just, more inclusive, and more humane – one that enables women and communities to claim their skies. In their collective flight lies the promise of an India that is more just, more inclusive, and more humane – one that enables women and communities to claim their skies.
Excerpted with permission from Claiming Our Skies: The Story of National Rural Livelihoods Mission, edited by Nagendra Nath Sinha and Neelima Khetan, Social Science Press.

title: The nine best books with yearning protagonists for readers who are pining
description: Yearning is a tradition that has flourished in English literature since 18th-century romanticism, a movement that celebrated the personal and the emotional.
author: Sarah Olive, The Conversation
content:
There is nothing like the agonising yet delicious slow burn of wanting someone you cannot have. Yearning is behind many great romance tropes, from the tragedy of “right person, wrong time” to the tension of “will they, won’t they”.
The cultural critic bell hooks saw yearning as a universal human condition, which could range from a “passionate collective longing for peace and justice” to an individual longing for a lover.
Yearning is a tradition that has flourished in English literature since 18th-century romanticism, a movement that celebrated the personal and the emotional. For such bittersweet desire to take root, there must be a significant hurdle that makes togetherness seem unattainable. That obstacle can take many forms: unrequited affection, painful shyness, or forces external to the pair.
In literature, these commonly include social stigma, geographical distance and mortality. Whatever the barrier, both it and the longing between the two characters must endure. Suspended between memory and fantasy, caught between a lost past and an imagined future, yearning should consume vast amounts of time and energy. The author must allow the reader to access the inner workings of the pining protagonist, so we can sit with their ache and share it.
If you are ready to luxuriate in the angst, here are nine books to pine over.
Eugene Onegin by Alexander Pushkin (1833)
Two of the book’s characters experience yearning and rejection: cosmopolitan Onegin and country girl Tatyana. Moreover, both characters get a turn at being the pursuer and the pursued in their taut encounters.
Pushkin wrote in Russian. English-language translations variously convey the book’s historic and contemporary qualities.
But if they smack too much of the 19th-century for you, try Clémentine Beauvais’ young adult reimagining, In Paris with You (2018). It transposes the story to 21st-century France. Like the original, it tells the story through the medium of poetry, rather than prose.
Love in the Time of Cholera by Gabriel García Márquez (1985)
García Márquez won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1982. But the yearning in this Colombian novel deserves an endurance award of its own.
Rejected by the beautiful, young Fermina Daza, trainee telegraph operator Florentino Ariza nevertheless continues to love her for 51 years, nine months and four days.
This does not, however, prevent him from having an enjoyable sex life over the decades. In depicting this, the book underscores that yearning and sexual desire are not synonymous. It is just one way in which the book offers an ultimately hopeful take on an initially tortuous experience.
Bel Canto by Ann Patchett (2001)
Also set in South America, the action of Bel Canto is condensed into a few months rather than half a century. Events feel further compressed as they occur under a single roof, in an embassy full of guests taken hostage by revolutionaries.
The hostages are initially kept in cramped conditions, under the watchful eyes of the guards. Language barriers abound as captives from an array of nations work through a single translator. For these reasons, the relationships smoulder before consummation.
Some of the yearnings arise within the group of hostages, others between hostages and their captors. However, they are not limited to the sexual or romantic. They include longings for freedom, home and the characters’ previously mundane lives.
The Gift of Rain by Tan Twan Eng (2007)
Malaysian novelist Tan Twan Eng should earn a triple entry in this list because yearning is a staple of his writing.
The longings in three of his books (The Gift of Rain, The Garden of Evening Mists and The House of Doors) eschew yearning that is narrowly romantic or erotic for something more ambiguous.
The stories are steeped in the complex social and political contexts of their setting in colonial and wartime Malaya. The yearnings are straight and queer, familial and national, and treacherous for the characters in both political and personal ways.
The Painted Veil by Somerset Maugham (1925)
Eng’s novel The House of Doors takes inspiration from Somerset Maugham’s life and works. These include The Letter (1926) and The Painted Veil (1925). That book gets its own entry here for its plot of yearning that jumps tracks from the selfish to the selfless, the unworthy to the worthwhile.
That may sound moralistic, but the novel mines many grey areas as young socialite Kitty Fane searches for meaning in her life as a doctor’s wife in cholera-ridden rural China.
There’s also a gorgeous film adaptation from 2006 to enjoy once you’ve read the book.
Under the Udala Trees by Chinelo Okparanta (2015)
Yearning is a characteristic strongly associated with queer literature. This is unsurprising given the legal, religious and cultural prohibitions of, and discrimination against, same-sex relationships.
The publication of homoerotic literature in such contexts required that authors finely balance expression and suppression. Building on hooks’ work, literature professor Elleke Boehmer argues that a “rarefied intensity of desire” emerges in repressive contexts.
Under the Udala Trees is set in one such context, the 1960s Nigerian civil war. The protagonist, Ijeoma, pines first for a classmate, then for a customer. Yet arguably her greatest longing is for self-acceptance and her mother’s acceptance of her sexuality.
The End of the Affair by Graham Greene (1951)
The heart-wrenching yearning in this novel comes in the aftermath of an ecstatic affair, with writer Maurice still pining for married Sarah Miles.
Maurice assumes Sarah has forsaken him for her dutiful but dull husband, Henry. But the eventual plot twist that follows is sharper than a hairpin bend.
The novel is one of several by Greene with a strong Catholic focus. As such, the lovers’ relationships with God form a second triangle in this book. Ultimately, Maurice discovers his true rival is not Henry, but the Almighty himself, transforming an obsessive tale of earthly adultery into an agonising collision between human desire and divine grace.
Wuthering Heights by Emily Brontë (1847)
“Haunt me then … drive me mad! Only do not leave me in this abyss, where I cannot find you!”
Wuthering Heights is a tale of dark, destructive yearning across several generations of the same two families. It is also widely found on school curricula, so film versions abound. These include Emerald Fennell’s 2026 movie released to coincide with Valentine’s Day, proving that the novel’s afterlife is as perverse as its plot and characters.
If you’re looking for a barrier to true love rooted more explicitly in the supernatural, Stephanie Meyer’s third novel in the Twilight saga, Eclipse (2007), draws strongly on Brontë’s love-triangle classic.
Mr Loverman by Bernadine Evaristo (2013)
This novel is a reminder that you are never too old to yearn. Or perhaps, that age is a spur to acting on your feelings. Mr Loverman vies with Love in a Time of Cholera for endurance but exhibits a lighter, more worldly-wise tone throughout.
It spans greater distances, from Antigua to Hackney. Barrington’s wife suspects he is consumed with extramarital passion. She manages to indict most of their acquaintances, except the real object of his affection. The book is unashamedly humorous and poignant. The BBC adapted it as a miniseries in 2024.
This article first appeared on The Conversation.
Sarah Olive, Senior Lecturer in Literature, Aston University.

title: Top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat killed in encounter in J&K's Kulgam
description: Security forces in Kulgam trapped wanted Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat on Wednesday. Despite officers offering him an opportunity to surrender, Bhat refused, following a gunfight linked to a previous CRPF attack.
author: Onmanorama Staff
content:
Top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat killed in encounter in J&K's Kulgam
Mail This Article
Srinagar: Top Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) commander Lateef Bhat was killed in an encounter with security forces in Kulgam district of Jammu and Kashmir on Wednesday, officials confirmed to PTI.
Security forces had earlier offered Bhat an opportunity to surrender after trapping him during an encounter in Zangalpora village in the Devsar area of south Kashmir. However, he refused to surrender and opened fire after entering a mosque around 2.45 am, Kulgam Senior Superintendent of Police Anayat Ali said.
The police had made repeated appeals to Bhat to surrender, including through a video call and a phone provided to him inside the cordoned-off area. Ali said he had personally spoken to the terrorist for a considerable time, urging him to give up arms and pointing out that he was still young and had his whole life ahead of him. However, Bhat refused to comply.
Security forces were exercising maximum restraint to minimise damage to the mosque while following standard operating procedures (SOPs), the SSP said before the operation concluded.
Ali described Bhat's killing as one of the biggest successes for security forces in 2026. He said Bhat had joined the LeT on November 18, 2025, and was heavily self-radicalised. He was allegedly receiving instructions from across the border to disrupt peace, tourism and the economy through attacks.
The encounter began early Wednesday following credible intelligence inputs received by the Jammu and Kashmir Police. Security forces launched a coordinated cordon-and-search operation in Zangalpora village, trapping Bhat inside the cordoned-off area.
The encounter comes two days after Umar Nisar Dar, one of the terrorists allegedly involved in the November 11 attack on CRPF personnel in Kulgam, was killed in a gunfight near the Laru bypass in the same district on Monday. Bhat had managed to escape from the encounter site.
Both Bhat and Dar are believed to have carried out the November 11 attack on a CRPF post, in which three paramilitary personnel were injured.
Following specific intelligence inputs, security forces had launched a focused search operation in the area. While Dar was killed on Monday, security personnel continued extensive searches in the surrounding areas to track down Bhat. Contact with Bhat was re-established during searches early Wednesday, triggering a fresh exchange of fire.
According to officials, Dar had allegedly provided shelter and logistical support to Bhat for nearly six months. The duo had also conducted reconnaissance before carrying out the attack on the CRPF post.
Dar, a former breadmaker who had been reported missing by his family, was allegedly associated with The Resistance Front (TRF), an offshoot of the Pakistan-based LeT.

title: Delhi to get two new hospitals with 1,815 beds next year, says CM Rekha Gupta
description: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta says two hospitals in Siraspur and Hastal, with 1,815 beds, will open next year as the government plans 40 new Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.
author: DNA Web Team
content:
INDIA
Delhi CM Rekha Gupta says two hospitals in Siraspur and Hastal, with 1,815 beds, will open next year as the government plans 40 new Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.
Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Wednesday said two major hospitals in Siraspur and Hastal, together offering 1,815 beds, will become operational next year as the government steps up efforts to expand healthcare infrastructure and improve access to medical services across the capital.
According to the Chief Minister's Office, the government is also planning to open 40 new Ayushman Arogya Mandirs next month, coinciding with the 102nd birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, to strengthen primary healthcare services and provide treatment facilities closer to people's homes.Gupta made the announcements while reviewing the progress of various Health Department projects at the Delhi Secretariat. She directed officials to ensure that all hospital and healthcare infrastructure projects are completed within their stipulated timelines, making it clear that negligence or unnecessary delays would not be tolerated.
Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh and senior officials from the Health Department and the Public Works Department (PWD) attended the meeting.The Chief Minister said the government's focus was on providing accessible, quality and timely healthcare to every citizen. She said expanding healthcare infrastructure involved not only constructing new hospitals but also ensuring the availability of modern medical equipment, doctors and other healthcare personnel to improve patient care.
She also stressed the need to strengthen primary healthcare facilities so that residents would not have to travel long distances for treatment of common ailments. Officials were directed to ensure that public welfare projects were implemented with responsibility, promptness and sensitivity.
Providing an update on the two major hospital projects, CM Gupta said the 1,164-bed hospital in Siraspur was ready, with the procurement of medical equipment underway and targeted for completion by the end of January. Construction of the 651-bed hospital in Hastal is also nearing completion, and the facility is expected to become operational next year.The two hospitals are expected to improve access to medical services in their respective areas and ease the patient load on existing healthcare facilities.On primary healthcare expansion, Gupta said 1,139 Ayushman Arogya Mandirs were being developed across Delhi, of which 415 were already operational. The government aims to open 40 more centres next month. She added that facilities receiving a higher number of patients were being considered for two-shift operations to ensure timely treatment at the local level.
The government is also developing two hospitals with 691 beds each in Madipur and Jwalapuri, both scheduled for completion by 2028. The Madipur hospital is being constructed at an estimated cost of Rs 466.50 crore, while the Jwalapuri project has been pegged at Rs 484.04 crore.
Alongside new hospitals, the government is expanding maternal and child healthcare facilities at existing institutions. A 463-bed maternal and child healthcare block is being developed at Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital in Rohini, while its OPD block is ready for inauguration.
A 270-bed maternal and child healthcare block at Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital and a 460-bed block at Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital in Khichripur are also nearing completion. Efforts are underway to make these facilities operational shortly.
The review also covered the proposed integrated redevelopment of Lok Nayak Hospital and the Maulana Azad Medical College campus. The project has an estimated timeline of around 30 months, covering both planning and construction.
The government is also working towards bringing Guru Teg Bahadur (GTB) Hospital, Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital, Delhi State Cancer Institute and the Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences (IHBAS), all located in the Trans-Yamuna region, under a common institutional framework. The move is aimed at strengthening specialised medical services and improving coordination among these institutions.
In another major initiative, the government plans to establish medical colleges at Indira Gandhi Hospital in Dwarka and Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital, with 150 MBBS seats proposed at each institution.
The government is also working to increase the number of seats at Baba Saheb Ambedkar Medical College from 125 to 200 and at the Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences from 50 to 70. These measures are aimed at expanding medical education capacity while increasing the availability of trained and specialist doctors.
Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh said the government was working to strengthen hospital infrastructure, medical facilities, equipment and human resources as part of a coordinated effort to improve Delhi's healthcare system.
He said the Health Department was regularly monitoring projects and coordinating with the departments concerned to ensure the timely completion of construction work, procurement of medical equipment and other necessary arrangements. Along with building new hospitals and expanding existing facilities, the government was focused on improving treatment infrastructure and ensuring adequate support for medical services.
(Except for headline, the article hasn't been edited by DNA staff but is directly published from ANI)

title: US proposes 25% tariffs on Indian goods: Why is Trump raising duties amid trade deal talks?
description: Washington has proposed raising the base tariff on Indian goods to 25%, reversing its earlier decision to reduce the rate to 18% after waiving the additional 25% punitive duty linked to India's purchases of Russian oil. What does it mean for India and the US-India BTA?
author: Pramode Mallk
content:
INDIA
Washington has proposed raising the base tariff on Indian goods to 25%, reversing its earlier decision to reduce the rate to 18% after waiving the additional 25% punitive duty linked to India's purchases of Russian oil. What does it mean for India and the US-India BTA?
The US has proposed a base tariff of 25% on Indian goods. It has come weeks after Washington waived 25% punitive tariffs on India for buying cheap Russian oil and reduced the base rate to 18%. Practically, it would raise tariffs from 18% to 25% for India. It has come at a time when back-channel talks for the India-US Bilateral Trade Agreement are going on. Foreign Minister S Jaishankar and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal have claimed that most of the contentious issues have been resolved and only a few of them are yet to be discussed.
According to news agency Reuters, the US Trade Representative's office has proposed to impose a base tariff of 25% on India, Cambodia, Indonesia, South Korea, Malaysia, Taiwan and Thailand. However, China will have to pay a higher base tariff of 40%. The USTR has come to this conclusion after an eight-month-long probe into the allegation of 16 countries indulging in unfair trade practices to keep the products cheaper and uncompetitive for US firms in their own country.
The USTR Office said in a statement that the measure will be taken because these countries "create, sustain, or contribute to structural excess capacity and production in manufacturing sectors through various acts, policies, and practices that we find to be unreasonable and burden or restrict US commerce". China, known for its state subsidies and other benefits offered to a state-controlled business environment, will have to pay 40% tariffs, while its neighbour Vietnam will face a tariff of 35%. The EU member states, Japan, Switzerland, Singapore and Bangladesh face proposed rates of up to 20%.
The USTR has also said that India will have to pay only 17% base tariffs if it signs the Bilateral Trade agreement. Does it mean that Washington has used it as a tool to force India to sign the trade deal, even if it is against its own interest? Analysts believe the Donald Trump administration is blackmailing New Delhi to get access to its farm sector. Experts believe that the main stumbling block is the farm sector, which India has refused to open.
The USTR said, "The rates we're proposing will be consistent with what we call agreements on reciprocal trade or certain frameworks and joint statements on reciprocal trade," a senior US trade official told reporters on Tuesday. If those agreements fall away, or negotiations stop, "there could potentially be higher tariffs in the offing."
Earlier in March this year, the office of the USTR said in a statement, "Evidence of structural excess capacity and production exists for India. In 2025, India had a bilateral trade surplus with the United States of $58 billion. India's global goods trade surplus sectors include textiles, health, construction goods, and automotive goods. For example, evidence suggests the solar module sector is plagued by excess capacity, including that India's current module manufacturing is nearly triple the annual domestic demand. India also has created significant excess capacity in petrochemicals, steel, and other industries."
However, analysts believe that In an attempt to reduce the pressure on the US economy, Donald Trump may strike a deal with China or reach an understanding, and it may impact India the most. According to data of the Ministry of Commerce, the bilateral trade between India and China reached $155.6 billion in 2025. It widened further, and the deficit widened to a record $83 billion in just the first seven months of the current financial year. It is projected to hit $150 billion by the end of the fiscal year 2027. If the US and China allow concessions to each other, India may have to face increased competition, and its exports to the US and EU countries may come down, further increasing the gap. India may lose business in solar panels, electronics, green hydrogen, and other products.

title: ‘Following Indian laws’: Meta breaks silence on Congress’s allegations of post restrictions
description: Meta's policy team has told a Congress delegation that the company follows Indian laws and maintains transparent policies.
author: Manisha Chauhan
content:
INDIA
Meta's policy team has told a Congress delegation that the company follows Indian laws and maintains transparent policies.
Meta's policy team has told Congress representatives that the company complies with Indian laws and follows transparent policies, sources said after a meeting between the two sides.
The discussion was the first since Congress accused the social media company of restricting posts and accounts associated with the party and the Indian Youth Congress (IYC). During the meeting, the Congress delegation presented material that it claimed showed Meta was limiting the reach of posts mentioning Rahul Gandhi, according to sources.
The talks came after Youth Congress workers staged protests outside Meta offices in Hyderabad, Gurugram and Mumbai, demanding the restoration of accounts belonging to party leaders.
Youth Congress protests at Meta's offices
The protests began in Hyderabad on November 20, when Telangana Youth Congress president Jakkidi Shiva Charan Reddy alleged that Instagram had suspended or restricted the accounts of IYC national president Uday Bhanu Chib and national in-charge Manish Sharma.
The Telangana Youth Congress said its workers entered Meta's Gachibowli office and demanded that the affected accounts be restored. Police detained Reddy and several other protesters and took them to a police station.
The following day, the IYC issued a warning on X, saying it would “storm your offices across the country and stage protests” if Meta did not restore the accounts.
Further demonstrations were held on November 22.
IYC seeks details of accounts restricted under government orders
On November 21, the Youth Congress gave Meta seven days to publicly explain the alleged restrictions. It warned that protests would continue and said it could approach the courts if the company failed to respond.
The organisation also sought details of how many Indian accounts Meta had restricted following government orders over the previous six months and how many of them remained blocked.
It demanded an explanation for what it described as automated restrictions on posts mentioning Rahul Gandhi or criticising the Narendra Modi government.
The IYC also called on Meta to remove restrictions that it considers illegal on the accounts and posts of opposition leaders, journalists and content creators.
Hoardings in Bengaluru target Zuckerberg and Meta
The campaign against Meta has also taken a visual form in Bengaluru, where the Youth Congress put up hoardings accusing the company of favouring the BJP and failing to control fake news and hate speech.
One such hoarding near Sadahalli Gate on the airport road shows Meta founder Mark Zuckerberg dressed in Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) attire.
It carries the slogan “Meta, BJP Ka Beta” (Meta, BJP’s son).
Government tightens rules for social media platforms
The dispute comes amid increased government oversight of social media companies in India.In February, the Centre reduced the time available to platforms to remove unlawful content after receiving a government notification. The deadline was brought down from 36 hours to three hours.
Meta's disclosures show that the company restricted more than 5.4 million posts or accounts in India under local laws during the first half of 2026. This compares with around 70,000 restrictions across the whole of 2025.
The meeting between Congress and Meta comes as the party seeks answers over the alleged restrictions, while the company has maintained that it operates in accordance with Indian law.

title: अरुणाचल में नाम विवाद के बीच बड़ी पहल, भारत-चीन के वरिष्ठ सैन्य अफसरों ने LAC पर की हाई लेवल बैठक
description: पिछले डेढ़ साल में दोनों देशों ने अपने संबंधों को फिर से सुधारने के लिए कई कदम उठाए हैं। वर्ष 2020 में पूर्वी लद्दाख की गलवान घाटी में हुई हिंसक झड़पों के बाद दोनों देशों के संबंधों में भारी तनाव आ गया था।
author: Pramod Praveen
content:
अरुणाचल में नाम विवाद के बीच बड़ी पहल, भारत-चीन के वरिष्ठ सैन्य अफसरों ने LAC पर की हाई लेवल बैठक
पिछले डेढ़ साल में दोनों देशों ने अपने संबंधों को फिर से सुधारने के लिए कई कदम उठाए हैं। वर्ष 2020 में पूर्वी लद्दाख की गलवान घाटी में हुई हिंसक झड़पों के बाद दोनों देशों के संबंधों में भारी तनाव आ गया था।
पिछले दिनों अरुणाचल प्रदेश के कुछ जगहों का नाम बदलने को लेकर भारत और चीन के बीच तनातनी रही है। इस बीच, दोनों देशों ने वास्तविक रेखा (LAC) पर गलवान घाटी जैसी घटना को टालने और तनाव को कम करने के लिए हाई लेवल बैठकें की हैं। विदेश मंत्रालय (MEA) ने बुधवार (25 नवंबर) को बताया कि भारतीय और चीनी सेनाओं ने इस महीने अरुणाचल प्रदेश सेक्टर में उच्चस्तरीय वार्ता की, जिसमें सीमा प्रबंधन एवं LAC पर लंबित मुद्दों के समाधान पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया। माना जा रहा है कि कई दिनों तक चली यह वार्ता सीमा पर चीनी सैनिकों की आक्रामक सैन्य गतिविधियों की खबरों के बीच हुई। खासतौर पर अरुणाचल प्रदेश के अपर सुबनसिरी क्षेत्र में ऐसी गतिविधियों की खबरें सामने आई थीं।
सितंबर में भी दोनों सेनाओं के वरिष्ठ सैन्य कमांडरों ने अरुणाचल प्रदेश सेक्टर में सीमा के दोनों ओर दो चरणों में फ्लैग मीटिंग की थी। विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल ने एक सवाल के जवाब में बुधवार को नियमित प्रेस वार्ता के दौरान कहा, "भारत और चीन कूटनीतिक एवं सैन्य माध्यमों से नियमित रूप से संपर्क में रहते हैं और आप इन माध्यमों से भली-भांति परिचित हैं।" उन्होंने कहा, "हाल ही में पूर्वी सेक्टर में वरिष्ठ सैन्य कमांडरों की एक बैठक हुई। दोनों पक्षों के बीच बातचीत में सीमा प्रबंधन को बेहतर बनाने और LAC पर लंबित मुद्दों के समाधान पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया।"
बातचीत का उद्देश्य शांति और स्थिरता बनाए रखना
जायसवाल ने कहा कि इस तरह की बातचीत का उद्देश्य सीमावर्ती क्षेत्रों में शांति और स्थिरता बनाए रखना तथा किसी भी तरह के तनाव को बढ़ने से रोकना है। इस महीने के दूसरे सप्ताह में हुई वार्ता में भारतीय प्रतिनिधिमंडल का नेतृत्व लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल गिरीश कालिया ने किया, जो नगालैंड के दीमापुर के पास मुख्यालय वाली सेना की तीसरी कोर के जनरल ऑफिसर कमांडिंग हैं। वहीं, चीनी पक्ष का नेतृत्व उनके समकक्ष अधिकारी ने किया। सैन्य और कूटनीतिक वार्ताओं में भारत चीन को यह बताता रहा है कि समग्र द्विपक्षीय संबंधों के निरंतर विकास और प्रगति के लिए सीमावर्ती क्षेत्रों में शांति एवं स्थिरता बनाए रखना महत्वपूर्ण है।
50,000 जवान पूर्वी लद्दाख में तैनात
पिछले डेढ़ साल में दोनों देशों ने अपने संबंधों को फिर से सुधारने के लिए कई कदम उठाए हैं। वर्ष 2020 में पूर्वी लद्दाख की गलवान घाटी में हुई हिंसक झड़पों के बाद दोनों देशों के संबंधों में भारी तनाव आ गया था। दोनों पक्षों के बीच कई दौर की बातचीत के बावजूद तनाव कम करने की दिशा में कोई ठोस नतीजा नहीं निकलने के कारण भारतीय सेना के करीब 50,000 जवान पूर्वी लद्दाख के विभिन्न पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में तैनात हैं। अधिकारियों के अनुसार, चीन ने भी इतनी ही संख्या में सैनिकों की तैनाती की है। पिछले साल पूर्वी लद्दाख में हुए सैन्य गतिरोध के बाद भारत ने अरुणाचल प्रदेश सेक्टर में भी वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा पर अपनी समग्र सैन्य तैयारियां मजबूत की हैं।
दोनों देशों के संबंधों में आई थी गिरावट
जायसवाल ने उस रिपोर्ट पर पूछे गए एक सवाल का भी जवाब दिया, जिसमें कहा गया था कि ऑपरेशन सिंदूर के दौरान भारतीय सैनिकों की गतिविधियों पर नजर रखने और सैन्य ठिकानों की निगरानी करने के लिए पाकिस्तान ने चीन के उपग्रहों से मिले आंकड़ों का इस्तेमाल किया हो सकता है। उन्होंने कहा, "हमने इस विशेष मुद्दे पर मीडिया की कुछ खबरें देखी हैं। हम ऐसे घटनाक्रमों पर करीब से नजर रखना जारी रखेंगे, जिनका हमारे सुरक्षा हितों पर असर पड़ सकता है और उचित कदम उठाएंगे।" चीनी उपग्रहों से मिले आंकड़ों के इस्तेमाल को लेकर यह नई खबर ऐसे समय आई है, जब नई दिल्ली और बीजिंग दोनों देशों के बीच संबंधों को सामान्य बनाने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं। पूर्वी लद्दाख में चार साल से अधिक समय तक चले सैन्य गतिरोध के दौरान दोनों देशों के संबंधों में भारी गिरावट आई थी।
नई दिल्ली आए थे शी जिनपिंग
अक्टूबर 2024 में दोनों पक्षों ने पूर्वी लद्दाख में तनाव के अंतिम दो बिंदुओं देपसांग और डेमचोक से सैनिकों की वापसी के समझौते को अंतिम रूप दिया था। समझौते को अंतिम रूप दिए जाने के कुछ दिनों बाद प्रधानमंत्री नरेन्द्र मोदी और चीन के राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग ने कजान में बातचीत की और द्विपक्षीय संबंधों को बेहतर बनाने के लिए कई फैसले किए। पिछले साल अगस्त में मोदी वार्षिक एससीओ (शंघाई सहयोग संगठन) शिखर सम्मेलन में हिस्सा लेने के लिए चीन के तियानजिन शहर गए थे। एससीओ शिखर सम्मेलन से इतर मोदी और शी के बीच व्यापक बातचीत हुई थी। इसके बाद सितंबर में मोदी ने नई दिल्ली में आयोजित ब्रिक्स शिखर सम्मेलन से इतर शी जिनपिंग के साथ द्विपक्षीय बातचीत की थी।

title: बांग्लादेश में फिर पैदा होगा बिजली संकट? भारत से आधी होने जा रही पावर सप्लाई
description: अडानी के गोड्डा प्लांट में दो 800-MW यूनिट में से एक आज आधी रात से बंद हो जाएगी। यह हर साल होने वाले मेंटेनेंस की वजह से होगा और यह 18 दिसंबर तक चलेगा। यानी कि अगले 25 दिनों तक जब तक बांग्लादेश को बिजली संकट से जूझना पड़ेगा।
author: Madan Tiwari
content:
बांग्लादेश में फिर पैदा होगा बिजली संकट? भारत से आधी होने जा रही पावर सप्लाई
अडानी के गोड्डा प्लांट में दो 800-MW यूनिट में से एक आज आधी रात से बंद हो जाएगी। यह हर साल होने वाले मेंटेनेंस की वजह से होगा और यह 18 दिसंबर तक चलेगा। यानी कि अगले 25 दिनों तक जब तक बांग्लादेश को बिजली संकट से जूझना पड़ेगा।
कई मामलों में भारत के रहमो-करम पर जी रहे बांग्लादेश को एक और तगड़ा झटका लगने वाला है। उस पर अगले महीनेभर के लिए बिजली संकट पैदा हो सकता है, जिसकी वजह से वो अंधेरे में डूब जाएगा। दरअसल, बांग्लादेश को बड़े पैमाने पर भारत से बिजली सप्लाई होती है, लेकिन अब झारखंड में अडानी पावर प्लांट से होने वाली बांग्लादेश को सप्लाई आधी होने जा रही है। अगले 25 दिनों तक बांग्लादेश को यह संकट उठाना पड़ सकता है। गोड्डा में स्थित पावर प्लांट में दो में से एक जेनरेटिंग यूनिट मेंटेनेंस की वजह से बंद (ऑफलाइन) हो रही है। सितंबर में एक यूनिट में खराबी आई थी, जिसके बाद कुछ समय के लिए बिजली सप्लाई कम कर दी गई थी।
bdnews24.com के अनुसार, अडानी के गोड्डा प्लांट में दो 800-MW यूनिट में से एक आज आधी रात से बंद हो जाएगी। यह हर साल होने वाले मेंटेनेंस की वजह से होगा और यह 18 दिसंबर तक चलेगा। यानी कि अगले 25 दिनों तक जब तक बांग्लादेश को बिजली संकट से जूझना पड़ेगा। वहीं, प्लांट की दूसरी 800 मेगावॉट की यूनिट सही तरह से काम करती रहेगी। इन दिनों बांग्लादेश में महंगाई, गारमेंट इंडस्ट्री में काम करने वाले वर्कर्स की सैलरी बढ़ाने को लेकर प्रोटेस्ट हो रहे हैं।
इसके अलावा, राजनैतिक तौर पर भी उठापटक जारी है। पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना ने वतन वापसी का ऐलान किया है। इससे उनकी पार्टी अवामी लीग के कार्यकर्ताओं में काफी उत्साह भरा हुआ है। पिछले दिनों बुलाए गए बंद के दौरान काफी तोड़फोड़ और आगजनी भी देखने को मिली। ऐसे में अगर अब जब बांग्लादेश में बिजली संकट पैदा हो रहा है तो इस तरह के प्रोटेस्ट में लोगों का गुस्सा और बढ़ सकता है।
रेगुलर प्रोग्राम का हिस्सा हैं मेंटेनेंस
'द बिजनेस स्टैंडर्ड' की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, अडानी पावर का कहना है कि प्लांट में मेंटेनेंस प्लान किया गया है और इसके रेगुलर मेंटेनेंस प्रोग्राम का हिस्सा है। बांग्लादेश पावर डेवलपमेंट बोर्ड (BPDB) ने शटडाउन के लिए सहमति दे दी थी। मेंटेनेंस के काम में सर्विसिंग, इंस्पेक्शन आदि शामिल होगा। इसको इसलिए समय समय पर किया जाता है, ताकि अगर कोई दिक्कत हो तो वह दूर हो जाए। भविष्य में भी किसी तरह की कोई तकनीकी दिक्कत का सामना न करना पड़े। बता दें कि अडानी पावर के साथ बांग्लादेश की बिजली कंपनी ने 2017 में बिजली खरीदने के लिए समझौते पर साइन किया था। यह समझौता अगले 25 सालों के लिए है।

title: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश के बावजूद दीपाथून पर क्यों नहीं जला दीया? राज्यपाल ने थलपति विजय से मांगा जवाब
description: तमिलनाडु के गवर्नर राजेंद्र आर्लेकर ने मुख्यमंत्री सी जोसेफ विजय से सवाल किया है कि तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम में कार्तिगई दीपम त्योहार के दौरान सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश के मुताबिक दीपाथून पर दीया क्यों नहीं जलाया गया।
author: Devendra Kasyap
content:
सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश के बावजूद दीपाथून पर क्यों नहीं जला दीया? राज्यपाल ने थलपति विजय से मांगा जवाब
तमिलनाडु के गवर्नर राजेंद्र आर्लेकर ने मुख्यमंत्री सी जोसेफ विजय से सवाल किया है कि तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम में कार्तिगई दीपम त्योहार के दौरान सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश के मुताबिक दीपाथून पर दीया क्यों नहीं जलाया गया।
मदुरै के पास तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम की पहाड़ी पर 24 नवंबर की रात दीया तो जला, लेकिन वह दीया सुप्रीम कोर्ट के बताए गए पत्थर के खंभे (दीपाथून) पर नहीं, बल्कि उची पिल्लयार मंदिर के पास दीप मंडपम में जलाया गया। इसी फैसले को लेकर तमिलनाडु के गवर्नर राजेंद्र आर्लेकर ने मुख्यमंत्री सी जोसेफ विजय से सीधा सवाल पूछा है और लिखित जवाब मांगा है। गवर्नर ने संविधान के अनुच्छेद 167 (b) का इस्तेमाल करते हुए मुख्यमंत्री से पूछा है कि कोर्ट के आदेश का पालन क्यों नहीं किया गया। इस प्रावधान के तहत मुख्यमंत्री को राज्य के प्रशासन से जुड़ी जानकारी और गवर्नर द्वारा मांगे गए प्रस्तावों का विवरण देना होता है। एक अधिकारी ने नाम न बताने की शर्त पर हमारे सहयोगी HT को बताया कि हां, गवर्नर ने मुख्यमंत्री से जवाब मांगा है।
क्या है पूरा मामला?
मदुरै के पास तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी पर हर साल कार्तिगई दीपम त्योहार मनाया जाता है। 24 नवंबर को इस त्योहार के दौरान दीया जलाया गया, लेकिन वह सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा बताई गई जगह दीपाथून पर नहीं, बल्कि उची पिल्लयार मंदिर के पास दीप मंडपम में जलाया गया। दरअसल, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने हाल ही में एक आदेश में कहा था कि इस बार एक बार के उपाय के तौर पर दीपाथून (पत्थर का पुराना खंभा) पर दीया जलाया जाए। कोर्ट का यह फैसला हिंदू संगठनों की याचिका पर आया था। बावजूद इसके दीया पारंपरिक जगह पर ही जलाया गया।
यही कारण है कि गवर्नर राजेंद्र आर्लेकर ने मुख्यमंत्री को पत्र लिखकर पूछा है कि कोर्ट के आदेश का पालन क्यों नहीं किया गया। उन्होंने संविधान के अनुच्छेद 167 (b) का हवाला दिया है। इस प्रावधान के तहत मुख्यमंत्री को राज्य के प्रशासन से जुड़ी कोई भी जानकारी और गवर्नर द्वारा मांगे गए कानून या प्रस्तावों की जानकारी देनी होती है।
क्या है मंदिर बोर्ड का पक्ष?
वहीं, मंदिर प्रशासन ने इस फैसले का बचाव किया है। उची पिल्लयार मंदिर के न्यासी बोर्ड के अध्यक्ष वी. षणमुगसुंदरम ने एक प्रेस नोट जारी कर कहा कि कार्तिगई दीपम को सदियों से पहाड़ी के ऊपर उची पिल्लयार मंदिर के पास दीपा मंडपम में ही जलाया जाता रहा है। यह जगह मुख्य देवता (मूलवर) के सिर के ठीक ऊपर है। बोर्ड का कहना है कि यह सर्वसम्मति से तय किया गया कि दीया उसी पारंपरिक जगह पर जलाया जाए जहां आमतौर पर जलाया जाता है। प्रेस नोट में लिखा गया है कि ऐसी दीर्घकालिक सतत प्रथाएं, धार्मिक परंपराएं और अनुष्ठान तथा आगम नियम मंदिर की विशिष्ट धार्मिक पहचान माने जाते हैं। इनकी रक्षा जरूरी है।
कलेक्टर ने मांगी माफी
वहीं, मदुरै के जिला कलेक्टर निशांत कृष्णा ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट को दी गई स्टेटस रिपोर्ट में माफी मांगी है। उन्होंने लिखा है क दीपाथून में दीया न जलाने के लिए मैं दिल से माफी मांगता हूं। कलेक्टर ने बताया कि उन्होंने कोर्ट के 20 नवंबर के आदेश के अनुसार दीपाथून पर दीया जलाने के लिए 21 से 24 नवंबर के बीच 'सभी जरूरी कदम' उठाए थे। उन्होंने देवस्थानम से मंजूरी दिलाने के लिए टीम भी भेजी थी, लेकिन अंततः दीया पारंपरिक जगह पर ही जलाया गया।
प्रदेश में सियासत तेज
वहीं, इसको लेकर प्रदेश में सियासत तेज है। एक तरफ कांग्रेस, लेफ्ट पार्टियों और विदुथलाई चिरुथैगल काची (VCK) ने इस कदम का स्वागत किया है। उनका कहना है कि सदियों पुरानी परंपराओं का सम्मान किया गया। वहीं भारतीय जनता पार्टी (BJP), ऑल इंडिया अन्ना द्रविड़ मुनेत्र कड़गम (AIADMK) और कई हिंदू संगठनों ने टीवीके सरकार की तीखी आलोचना की है। उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश की अनदेखी की गई।
बहुत पुराना है विवाद
बता दें कि यह विवाद सालों पुराना है। दशकों तक दीया तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी की निचली ढलान पर उची पिल्लयार मंदिर के पास दीपा मंडपम में जलाया जाता रहा। हिंदू संगठनों ने मांग की थी कि दीया दीपाथून पर जलाया जाए।दीपाथून पहाड़ी के ऊपरी हिस्से पर स्थित एक पुराना पत्थर का दीया-स्तंभ है। यह हजरत सुल्तान सिकंदर बादुशा औलिया दरगाह से लगभग 50 मीटर की दूरी पर है। कुछ संगठनों का कहना है कि दीपाथून पर दीया जलाना उनकी पुरानी मांग है, जबकि मंदिर बोर्ड इसे पारंपरिक प्रथा के खिलाफ बताता है।

title: संविधान हमारी प्रेरणा, विकसित छत्तीसगढ़ हमारा संकल्प
description: जनजातीय इलाकों के विकास में नक्सलवाद सबसे बड़ी बाधा था। यह लोकतंत्र के लिए भी सबसे बड़ा संकट था। नक्सलवादी, पूज्य बाबा साहेब के संविधान द्वारा बनाए गए गणतंत्र की जगह हिंसा और डर के माध्यम से गन तंत्र बनाना चाहते थे...
author: Anupam Rajiv Rajvaidya
content:
बाबासाहेब डाॅ. भीमराव आंबेडकर के नेतृत्व में संविधान निर्माताओं ने देश की प्राचीन लोकतांत्रिक परंपराओं और आधुनिक लोकतांत्रिक विचारों को ध्यान में रखकर हमारा संविधान तैयार किया। 26 नवंबर को इसे अंगीकार किया गया। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के नेतृत्व वाली सरकार ने वर्ष 2015 में 26 नवंबर को संविधान दिवस के रूप में मनाने का निश्चय किया और हर वर्ष हम उत्साह से संविधान दिवस मनाते हैं।
हमारा देश दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा लोकतंत्र है। भारत के साथ ही दुनिया के अनेक देशों को आजादी मिली, अनेक देशों ने लोकतंत्र अपनाया लेकिन चुनिंदा देशों में ही लोकतंत्र सुरक्षित रह पाया। भारत का लोकतंत्र समय के साथ मजबूत होता गया, इसके पीछे हमारे संविधान की ठोस बुनियाद है।
मुझे इस बात का गौरव है कि मेरे बड़े पिताजी नरहरि प्रसाद साय ने आपातकाल के कठिन दौर में जेल जाकर लोकतंत्र की रक्षा के लिए संघर्ष किया और अनेक कष्ट सहे। उनका यह त्याग संविधान और लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों के प्रति हमारी प्रतिबद्धता को और मजबूत करता है। वर्ष 2024 में संविधान को अपनाने के 75 वर्ष पूरे हुए।
पीएम मोदी ने देश के माथे पर कलंक अनुच्छेद 370 को हटाकर हमारे लोकतंत्र को मजबूती दी है। उन्होंने बता दिया कि देश संविधान के मुताबिक चलता है तुष्टीकरण की राजनीति से नहीं चलता। हमारे संविधानविदों ने संविधान के रूप में देश को चलाने के लिए एक गाइडलाइन दी है। हमारा संविधान अंतिम व्यक्ति के उत्थान को सर्वाेच्च प्राथमिकता देता है। मोदी जी ने प्रधानमंत्री गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना, प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना, उज्ज्वला योजना आदि योजनाओं से गरीब परिवारों को आर्थिक संबल प्रदान किया। जनजातीय इलाकों के विकास में नक्सलवाद सबसे बड़ी बाधा था। यह लोकतंत्र के लिए भी सबसे बड़ा संकट था।
नक्सलवादी, पूज्य बाबा साहेब के संविधान द्वारा बनाए गए गणतंत्र की जगह हिंसा और डर के माध्यम से गन तंत्र बनाना चाहते थे और इसके लिए बस्तर को उन्होंने प्रयोगशाला बनाया था। मोदी जी के नेतृत्व और केंद्रीय गृहमंत्री अमित शाह के मार्गदर्शन में हमने सुनियोजित रणनीति बनाकर देश की धरती से माओवाद को हटाया है। आज बस्तर रेड काॅरिडोर नहीं, ग्रीन काॅरिडोर के रूप में जाना जाता है।
हमारा संविधान नागरिक समानता की बात भी करता है। समान नागरिक संहिता पर हमारी पार्टी का सबसे ज्यादा जोर है। यूसीसी को प्रदेश में लागू करने के लिए हमने समिति गठित की है जिसकी अनुशंसा आने पर इस दिशा में उचित निर्णय लिया जाएगा। हमने स्पष्ट किया है कि यूसीसी में हमारे जनजातीय भाइयों के अधिकार, उनकी परंपरा, उनकी संस्कृति पूरी तरह सुरक्षित रहेगी।
हमारा संविधान सबको अपनी आस्था की आजादी देता है। लोगों को निर्बाध रूप से अपनी आस्था के पालन का वातावरण देने के लिए हमने छत्तीसगढ़ धर्म स्वातंत्र्य कानून लागू किया है। हमने विकसित छत्तीसगढ़ का रोडमैप बनाया है। संविधान की जनकल्याणकारी भावनाएं और आदर्श विकसित छत्तीसगढ़ के निर्माण के लिए प्रकाश स्तंभ की तरह हैं और हम तेजी से यह लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने की दिशा में बढ़ रहे हैं। - विष्णु देव साय, मुख्यमंत्री, छत्तीसगढ़

title: आम यात्रियों के बीच एसटी बस में सफर करने निकले राज्यपाल, गांव में किया पौधरोपण
description: गांधीनगर. राज्यपाल आचार्य देवव्रत ने बुधवार को पुनः एक प्रेरणादायी उदाहरण प्रस्तुत किया। गांधीनगर जिले की कलोल तहसील के नारदीपुर और गोलथरा में आयोजित ग्राम कल्याण कार्यक्रम में शामिल होने के लिए राज्यपाल ने गुजरात राज्य सड़क परिवहन निगम यानी एसटी की सामान्य बस में यात्रा की। राज्यपाल जब गांधीनगर से नारदीपुर जाने के लिए एसटी बस में सवार हुए, तब बस में बैठे आम यात्रियों में आश्चर्य के साथ अत्यंत प्रसन्नता का माहौल देखने को मिला।
author: Rajesh Bhatnagar
content:
एसटी की सामान्य बस में कलोल के नारदीपुर की यात्रा करते राज्यपाल आचार्य देवव्रत।
गांधीनगर. राज्यपाल आचार्य देवव्रत ने बुधवार को पुनः एक प्रेरणादायी उदाहरण प्रस्तुत किया। गांधीनगर जिले की कलोल तहसील के नारदीपुर और गोलथरा में आयोजित ग्राम कल्याण कार्यक्रम में शामिल होने के लिए राज्यपाल ने गुजरात राज्य सड़क परिवहन निगम यानी एसटी की सामान्य बस में यात्रा की। राज्यपाल जब गांधीनगर से नारदीपुर जाने के लिए एसटी बस में सवार हुए, तब बस में बैठे आम यात्रियों में आश्चर्य के साथ अत्यंत प्रसन्नता का माहौल देखने को मिला।
यात्रा के दौरान राज्यपाल ने बिना किसी औपचारिकता के सहयात्रियों के साथ सहज और आत्मीय संवाद किया। उन्होंने यात्रियों की कुशलक्षेम पूछी और उनके रोजमर्रा के जीवन के बारे में बातचीत की। राज्यपाल ने सहयात्रियों के साथ ग्रामीण विकास एवं प्राकृतिक खेती के विषय पर भी चर्चा की। नारदीपुर गांव में उन्होंने ग्राम पंचायत स्थित वाटर सप्लाई टैंक के पास ग्रामीणों के साथ प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के ‘एक पेड़ मां के नाम 3.0’ अभियान के तहत पौधरोपण किया और पर्यावरण संरक्षण का संदेश दिया।
इस अवसर पर राज्यपाल ने कहा कि प्रधानमंत्री का ‘एक पेड़ मां के नाम’ अभियान और स्वच्छता अभियान प्रत्येक नागरिक की सामाजिक जिम्मेदारी है। ग्लोबल वार्मिंग, अतिवृष्टि और ऋतुचक्र में बदलाव जैसी वैश्विक समस्याओं का सबसे प्रभावी समाधान पौधरोपण है। उन्होंने शास्त्रों के ‘मातृ देवो भव, पितृ देवो भव और अतिथि देवो भव’ के सूत्र में ‘वृक्ष देवो भव’ का संदेश जोड़ते हुए कहा कि मनुष्य भोजन के बिना एक महीने और पानी के बिना कुछ दिन गुजार सकता है, लेकिन ऑक्सीजन के बिना तीन मिनट भी जीवित नहीं रह सकता। पेड़ हमें प्राणवायु, छाया, फल और आश्रय देते हैं तथा बदले में कुछ नहीं लेते।
राज्यपाल ने ग्रामीणों को पौधों के संरक्षण का संकल्प दिलाते हुए अपील की कि यदि लगाए गए पौधे की केवल एक साल तक अच्छी तरह देखभाल की जाए तो वह जीवनभर और आने वाली पीढ़ियों तक लोगों का पालन-पोषण करेगा। उन्होंने नागरिकों से अपने और बच्चों के जन्मदिन तथा विवाह की वर्षगांठ जैसे शुभ अवसरों पर कम से कम एक पौधा लगाने और उसका संरक्षण करने की अपील की। इस अवसर पर जिला पंचायत अध्यक्ष राजेश पटेल, कलोल विधायक बकाजी ठाकोर, जिला कलक्टर रवींद्र खताले, जिला विकास अधिकारी डी.के. ब्रह्मभट्ट, ग्राम पंचायत सरपंच रचनाबेन ठाकोर और बड़ी संख्या में ग्रामीण उपस्थित रहे।

title: पोरबंदर में करोड़ों रुपए की कीमत का 3 किलो संदिग्ध एम्बरग्रीस जब्त, दो गिरफ्तार
description: जामनगर. पोरबंदर में स्थानीय अपराध शाखा (एलसीबी) की टीम ने बड़ी कार्रवाई करते हुए करीब 3 किलो संदिग्ध एम्बरग्रीस (व्हेल मछली की उल्टी) जब्त किया। अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार में इस दुर्लभ पदार्थ की कीमत करोड़ों रुपए तक बताई जाती है। पुलिस ने इस मामले में दो लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया है। हालांकि, जब्त किया गया पदार्थ वास्तव में एम्बरग्रीस है या कोई अन्य वस्तु, इसकी पुष्टि एफएसएल की जांच रिपोर्ट आने के बाद ही होगी।
author: Rajesh Bhatnagar
content:
जामनगर. पोरबंदर में स्थानीय अपराध शाखा (एलसीबी) की टीम ने बड़ी कार्रवाई करते हुए करीब 3 किलो संदिग्ध एम्बरग्रीस (व्हेल मछली की उल्टी) जब्त किया। अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार में इस दुर्लभ पदार्थ की कीमत करोड़ों रुपए तक बताई जाती है। पुलिस ने इस मामले में दो लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया है। हालांकि, जब्त किया गया पदार्थ वास्तव में एम्बरग्रीस है या कोई अन्य वस्तु, इसकी पुष्टि एफएसएल की जांच रिपोर्ट आने के बाद ही होगी।
जानकारी के अनुसार, एलसीबी को सूचना मिली थी कि पोरबंदर शहर में भावसिंहजी अस्पताल रोड पर कुछ लोग संदिग्ध पदार्थ का सौदा करने पहुंचे हैं। यहां पर दो संदिग्ध व्यक्ति करीब 3 किलो पदार्थ के साथ मौजूद थे। सूचना के आधार पर पुलिस टीम ने कार्रवाई कर दोनों को पकड़ लिया और उनके पास से संदिग्ध पदार्थ बरामद किया।
पकड़े गए आरोपियों की पहचान राजकोट के जामकंडोरणा के महेश उर्फ कालू बालघा और राजकोट जिले की गोंडल तहसील के मूल निवासी और वर्तमान में सूरत में रहने वाले परेश पाघडाल के रूप में हुई है। प्रारंभिक पूछताछ में सामने आया है कि एक आरोपी पदार्थ बेचने और दूसरा उसे खरीदने के लिए पहुंचा था। पुलिस ने जब्त पदार्थ के नमूने जांच के लिए एफएसएल भेजे हैं।
एम्बरग्रीस स्पर्म व्हेल के पाचन तंत्र में बनने वाला दुर्लभ पदार्थ है, जिसे आम बोलचाल में व्हेल की उल्टी कहा जाता है। इसका उपयोग मुख्य रूप से महंगे परफ्यूम उद्योग में किया जाता है। इसकी अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार में काफी कीमत बताई जाती है। इसी वजह से इसके अवैध व्यापार के मामले भी सामने आते रहे हैं। स्पर्म व्हेल भारत में संरक्षित वन्यजीव प्रजाति है। यदि जब्त पदार्थ के एम्बरग्रीस होने की पुष्टि होती है तो वन्यजीव संरक्षण कानून के तहत आगे की कार्रवाई की जा सकती है।

title: MP News: Kuno Forest Retreat Opens Its Third Edition, Offering Luxury Glamping, Jungle Safaris and Adventure Activities
description: Third edition of Kuno Forest Retreat at Ranipura, Sheopur blends wildlife experiences, adventure, culture and sustainable tourism in Madhya Pradesh.
author: Oneindia Staff
content:
MP News: Kuno Forest Retreat Opens Its Third Edition, Offering Luxury Glamping, Jungle Safaris and Adventure Activities
The third edition of Kuno Forest Retreat launches at Ranipura, Sheopur, near Kuno National Park, offering luxurious glamping, adventure activities, local art, and cultural experiences. The initiative promotes experiential, sustainable tourism and employment for local communities, with a three-day programme featuring safaris, nature walks, and cultural performances.
Sheopur, November 25, 2026: The third edition of Kuno Forest Retreat has been inaugurated at Ranipura village in Sheopur, near Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh. The retreat brings together wildlife experiences, adventure activities, local art and crafts, folk music and traditional cuisine, offering visitors an opportunity to explore the region's natural beauty and cultural heritage.
A tent city equipped with modern amenities has been developed amid the natural surroundings. Visitors can enjoy a luxurious glamping experience in well-appointed, all-weather Swiss tents. Launched in 2023, the initiative aims to establish Kuno as a prominent eco-tourism destination at both national and international levels.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
Dr. Ilayaraja T., Secretary, Tourism and Managing Director of the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board, said that Madhya Pradesh attracts tourists from across the world because of its rich wildlife heritage and diverse natural landscapes. He added that the Tourism Department is making continuous efforts to promote experiential tourism around national parks, with a focus on environmental conservation and the active participation of local communities.
Adventure Activities and Cultural Experiences for Visitors
Kuno Forest Retreat offers a range of adventure activities, including high-rope courses, archery, air-gun shooting, cycling, battery-operated car rides and ATV rides. Visitors can also explore nearby villages, participate in local art and craft workshops, and enjoy folk music, cultural performances and traditional cuisine. These activities are designed to provide visitors with a closer experience of the region's culture and local traditions.
Three-Day, Two-Night Programme Offers an Immersive Experience
A specially curated three-day, two-night tourism programme has been designed for visitors. The itinerary includes jungle safaris, riverside nature walks, birdwatching, stargazing, visits to the Dev Kho eco-tourism site, along with yoga and meditation sessions. Jungle safari facilities will be subject to permission from the Forest Department, availability and prevailing weather conditions.
Initiative to Create Employment Opportunities for Local Communities
The Kuno Forest Retreat initiative is expected to give a boost to regional tourism while creating new employment and self-employment opportunities for local youth, artists, artisans and small businesses. By encouraging local participation and showcasing the region's natural and cultural attractions, the initiative also aims to support sustainable tourism development in the area.
How to Book Kuno Forest Retreat
Visitors interested in bookings and further information can visit the official website www.kunoforestretreat.com . They can also contact the organisers at +91 96247 99166 or write to [email protected] .

title: Sikkim CM Prem Singh Tamang's Mother Dhanmaya Tamang Dies At 87 In Siliguri
description: Sikkim CM Prem Singh Tamang's mother, Dhanmaya Tamang, dies at 87 in Siliguri after prolonged illness. Governor Dushyant Gautam, Suvendu Adhikari and Pawan Kumar Chamling offer condolences.
author: PTI
content:
Sikkim CM Prem Singh Tamang's Mother Dhanmaya Tamang Dies At 87 In Siliguri
Sikkim Chief Minister Prem Singh Tamang's mother Dhanmaya Tamang died at a hospital in adjoining West Bengal's Siliguri city on Wednesday evening following prolonged illness, a statement said.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
She was 87, and is survived by four sons, three daughters, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren. She had been ill for the past seven to eight months and was receiving treatment in Siliguri. She was a resident of Singling in Soreng district. Her husband Kalu Singh Tamang predeceased her in 2022.
Governor Dushyant Gautam expressed deep sorrow over her demise, extending his condolences to the chief minister and the bereaved family. "The news of the passing of the mother of Sikkim's Hon'ble Chief Minister, Shri Prem Singh Tamang, is deeply saddening and distressing. May God grant the departed soul a place at His divine feet and give the Hon'ble Chief Minister and the entire bereaved family strength and solace in this difficult time," the governor said in a social media post.
 Thank you for your kind words and prayers. Your love and support mean so much to me and my family during this difficult time.@SuvenduWB
— Prem Singh Tamang (Golay) (@PSTamangGolay) November 25, 2026
West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari also condoled the death. "I am deeply grieved to hear about the unfortunate news of the passing of Smt. Dhan Maya Tamang, the beloved mother of Hon'ble Chief Minister of Sikkim, Shri Prem Singh Tamang (Golay), today in Siliguri," he said in a social media post.
"Losing one's mother is an irreparable loss and my thoughts are with Shri Tamang and his entire family during this hour of profound grief. I extend my deepest and most heartfelt condolences to them, as well as to their friends and well-wishers. May the Almighty grant strength to the bereaved family to bear this immense loss and may the departed soul attain eternal peace," Adhikari added.
Sikkim Democratic Front supremo and former chief minister Pawan Kumar Chamling also condoled the CM's mother's death and prayed for eternal peace for the departed soul. The ruling Sikkim Krantikari Morcha (SKM), in a statement, paid heartfelt tributes to the departed soul and extended its deepest condolences to Chief Minister Tamang, his son and MLA Aditya Golay, and the entire bereaved family.
The party also prayed for eternal peace for the departed soul and strength for the family to endure this irreparable loss.

title: CJP Leader Sourav Das Gets MEA Notice Over Passport Details, Given 7 Days To Respond
description: MEA issues a show-cause notice to CJP co-convenor Sourav Das over birthplace details in his passport, seeking a response within seven days after he alleged being stopped from boarding a London flight.
author: Swastika Sruti
content:
CJP Leader Sourav Das Gets MEA Notice Over Passport Details, Given 7 Days To Respond
In the latest update, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has sent a show-cause notice to the co-convenor of Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), Sourav Das, asking for an explanation regarding the place of birth given in his passport. According to the Chennai Regional Passport Office, Das has been given seven days time to reply to the notice.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
MEA spokesman Randhir Jaiswal revealed the news on Wednesday. As per the official, Sourav Das has been told not to use his passport until he replies to the authorities regarding the same.
As per Jaiswal, the show-cause notice has been sent to Sourav Das on November 23 following some information obtained from law enforcement agencies. Jaiswal stated that it is the responsibility of every passport applicant to give true and complete information at the time of application.
MEA spokesman further stated that any time the authorities get any information that the applicant has hidden something or given wrong information, then they can ask for his/her explanation.
 🚨This coward government did not allow me to board my flight to London where I was invited by prestigious universities like Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, Edinburgh to deliver talks on the cockroach movement. Indian students put their heart and soul to organise the events but this anti-intellectual govt was scared of me going to these prestigious institutions!@Cockroachisback
— Saurav Das (@SauravDassss) November 23, 2026
Why Has Sourav Das Received A Passport Notice?
The notice specifically seeks clarification from Sourav Das regarding his birthplace information in his passport. The passport office has asked him to submit his response within seven days.
The authorities have not publicly disclosed the specific discrepancy or the information received from law enforcement agencies that led to the notice.
Jaiswal emphasised that providing accurate information is a necessary requirement for obtaining a passport. He said the passport authorities follow the procedure of seeking an explanation whenever questions arise about the details provided by an applicant.
Until the matter is clarified, Das has been advised against using his passport for international travel.
Sourav Das Claims He Was Stopped From Boarding London Flight
The Passport Notice has been issued after Sourav Das made allegations that he was stopped from boarding a London-bound flight at Delhi airport.
As per Das, he was supposed to fly to the UK at one in the morning. But, on reaching the airport, he was allegedly told that his passport had been put under notice.
Sourav Das had gone to the UK to attend a discussion regarding the 'Cockroach Movement'.
The case became viral after Sourav Das made allegations against the immigration authorities through X..
CJP Co-Convenor Accuses Modi Government Of Blocking His Travel
In his social media post, Sourav Das accused the Narendra Modi-led government of deliberately stopping him from travelling abroad. He alleged that the action was intended to prevent him from expressing his views on international platforms.
Das also claimed that he had received invitations to speak at several reputed institutions, including the University of Oxford, the University of Cambridge, the London School of Economics (LSE) and the University of Edinburgh.
Despite the incident, he said that he would not stop his work or international engagements and would continue travelling abroad.
Cockroach Janata Party founder Abhijit Dipke also criticised the development. He alleged that someone in a position of power was unhappy with Das receiving an invitation to speak at Oxford.
