title: PM Modi meets Balen Shah: 8 MoUs signed as India pledges $1.62 billion package for Nepal
description: India and Nepal signed eight MoUs and advanced six connectivity and energy projects during Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah's first bilateral foreign visit, while India announced a ₹240 billion-equivalent economic package for flood-hit Nepal
author: FP News Desk
content:
PM Modi meets Balen Shah: 8 MoUs signed as India pledges $1.62 billion package for Nepal
India and Nepal signed eight MoUs and advanced six connectivity and energy projects during Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah's first bilateral foreign visit, while India announced a ₹240 billion-equivalent economic package for flood-hit Nepal
On his first bilateral trip abroad since taking office in March 2026, Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah held talks with his Indian counterpart, Narendra Modi, in New Delhi on Monday, with the two sides concluding eight Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) and moving forward six infrastructure and connectivity projects.
Shah is on a two-day visit to India, from November 22 to 23. The agreements span policing, forensic sciences, civil service training, traditional medicine, satellite communication, sustainable urban development, healthcare, livestock and fisheries.
Economic package after floods
Addressing the media after the talks, PM Modi said India would extend to Nepal an economic package worth 240 billion Nepalese rupees, roughly $1.62 billion.
The announcement follows devastating floods in Nepal in August, which killed around 1,500 people. A further 5,200 were reported missing and presumed dead.
PM Modi said India had kept supplies of fuel and other essential goods flowing to Nepal despite difficulties with oil supplies this year. "We will together write a golden chapter of India-Nepal relations," he said.
Describing India's relationship with Nepal as one that extends well beyond mere proximity, PM Modi said it was defined by closeness and unwavering trust.
"Our joys are shared. We share our challenges as well. We are partners in each other's progress and support each other in difficult times," he stated.
Shah said the relationship rests on mutual respect, trust and goodwill. "Mutual respect, steadfast trust and unbroken goodwill are the bedrock of India-Nepal relations," he said, adding that ties between the two nations were "as firm as the Himalayas and as vast as oceans".
Security, governance and health agreements
Under the first of the MoUs, the National Forensic Sciences University in Gandhinagar will collaborate on academic and research work with the Crime Investigation Department of Nepal Police. A separate agreement links Rashtriya Raksha University with Nepal's National Police Academy.
The National Centre for Good Governance, which functions under India's Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances, has signed a pact with the Nepal Administrative Staff College to provide capacity-building training for Nepalese civil servants.
The governments also agreed to cooperate in Ayurveda and other traditional systems of medicine.
Space, urban development and livelihoods
The Indian Space Research Organisation (Isro) and Nepal's Ministry of Information and Communication signed an agreement to set up a satellite communication network using the South Asia Satellite.
The remaining MoUs provide for technical cooperation in sustainable urban development, healthcare and medicine, and livestock and fisheries development.
The six projects cover cross-border transport, trade infrastructure and energy cooperation. Among them is the Saryu-Kamala Express rail service between Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh and Janakpur in Nepal, which is expected to strengthen rail links between the two countries.
India laid the foundation stone for a new Integrated Check Post (ICP) at Banbasa, while work on the ICPs at Bhairahawa, Sunauli and Dodhara Chandani is progressing. A new motorable bridge linking Dharchula in India with Darchula in Nepal was also inaugurated.
In the energy sector, the foundation stone was laid for the 669-MW Lower Arun Hydroelectric Project, and the two countries dedicated Phase II of the Motihari-Amlekhgunj Pipeline. A petroleum terminal at Jhapa, part of the proposed Siliguri-Jhapa petroleum pipeline, also received its foundation stone.

title: ‘Government did not pay Sarvam directly’: AI startup defends hosting Chinese models
description: Sarvam says IndiaAI Mission subsidies helped train its indigenous 105B model, but its Token Factory, which offers access to Chinese AI models such as DeepSeek, runs entirely on privately procured GPUs
author: Dheeraj Kumar
content:
‘Government did not pay Sarvam directly’: AI startup defends hosting Chinese models
Sarvam says IndiaAI Mission subsidies helped train its indigenous 105B model, but its Token Factory, which offers access to Chinese AI models such as DeepSeek, runs entirely on privately procured GPUs
Indian artificial intelligence startup Sarvam AI has defended its decision to host Chinese-developed AI models on its Token Factory platform, saying government support under the IndiaAI Mission was used to train its own model and did not fund its commercial inference business.
"The government did not pay Sarvam directly, instead like with every supported startup, the subsidy went to GPU cloud providers, helping seed AI infra in the country," Sarvam co-founder Pratyush Kumar said in a post on X.
The clarification comes amid criticism of Sarvam's decision to offer models developed by Chinese companies, including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Z.AI, through its Token Factory. The move has raised questions about the startup's commitment to technological sovereignty, given its positioning around building homegrown AI capabilities and reducing India's dependence on foreign technology.
The debate has also intensified over the company's approach to American AI models. Sarvam has previously been associated with efforts to limit or curtail access to some US-developed models in favour of indigenous alternatives. Its decision to make Chinese models available has therefore prompted questions about how consistently it applies its argument against dependence on foreign AI technology.
Kumar said the IndiaAI Mission, implemented by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), played an important role in supporting India's AI ecosystem by providing around 20 startups with subsidised access to GPUs at a 40 per cent discount.
Sarvam used this computing support to train its 105-billion-parameter Sarvam 105B model from scratch. The model was completed and open-sourced in February 2026.
He clarified that Token Factory operates on GPUs privately procured by Sarvam and receives no government support. The company also said its access to subsidised computing capacity ended in March 2026.
Why is Sarvam AI hosting Chinese models?
Launched in November, Sarvam's Token Factory allows developers and businesses to access multiple AI models through a single application programming interface (API). Customers pay according to the number of tokens processed, without having to procure GPUs or manage the underlying infrastructure.
Alongside its proprietary models, the platform offers open-weight models developed by international companies, including Chinese AI firms. Open-weight models allow developers and businesses to access and deploy models on their own infrastructure, giving them greater flexibility over how they use the technology.
The decision has brought a larger question surrounding India's AI ambitions into focus. Does technological sovereignty depend on developing indigenous AI models, or can it also involve running foreign-developed models on computing infrastructure located within India?
Sarvam's argument is that offering foreign models does not undermine its domestic AI ambitions. Open-weight models have gained popularity globally because of their cost advantages and the flexibility they offer businesses to build and operate their own AI systems.
Kumar said Indian enterprises also need AI services that allow their data to remain within the country while providing low latency for interactive applications.
"Sarvam Token Factory is one of the first large inference offerings in India. We serve multiple open-weight models on GPUs we have privately procured, without any government support," he said.
The company has optimised its data centre infrastructure to make inference costs comparable to or lower than those offered by established providers such as Fireworks AI, Baseten and Together AI.
Kumar said India currently consumes a few trillion AI tokens every day, importing the majority of them. Tokens are the basic units of text processed and generated by AI models. Their consumption increases as businesses and individuals use AI-powered applications.
"Scaling this consumption up and building sovereign capability requires investing in GPU infra, running efficient token factories, and guaranteeing advantages in cost, latency, and data residency," he said.
Sarvam releases upgraded 105B model
Kumar also rejected suggestions that building an inference business would divert the startup from its core objective of developing indigenous AI models.
"Building inference capability does not conflict with our core mission: training our own models," he said.
Sarvam has released an improved version of its proprietary model, called Sarvam 105B-1711. The company said the upgraded model offers improvements in reasoning, tool-calling and collaborative tasks, while performing strongly in Indian languages.
The model is priced at Rs 10 per million input tokens and Rs 25 per million output tokens. Sarvam has also optimised it to run on a single RTX Pro workstation GPU, allowing its Indus agentic AI product to operate on local hardware.
The startup plans to release additional models across vision, speech and edge computing over the next two weeks. Kumar said it was also working with partners to bring the latest training-grade computing infrastructure into India to support the development of its next generation of larger AI models.
I am a Business Correspondent at Firstpost (Network18). I am particularly interested in covering the AI revolution and how it is changing businesses, industries and the way we live and work. I also follow developments in energy, defence and aerospace, especially as technology, geopolitics and changing global priorities reshape these sectors. My broader reporting interests include the Indian economy, macroeconomics, financial markets, corporate affairs, international trade and geopolitics. I enjoy reporting on stories that help explain what is changing in the business world, why it matters and what it means for India and the global economy. Before joining Firstpost, I worked with Reuters News as an Associate Correspondent. I hold a postgraduate diploma in English Journalism from the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), New Delhi. title: ‘India, Nepal share unwavering trust’: PM Modi reviews ties in talks with Balen Shah amid changing geopolit...
description: PM Modi said India would extend a development package worth Rs 24,000 crore to Nepal, reaffirming New Delhi's commitment to supporting the country's development
author: FP News Desk
content:
‘India, Nepal share unwavering trust’: PM Modi reviews ties in talks with Balen Shah amid changing geopolitics
PM Modi said India would extend a development package worth Rs 24,000 crore to Nepal, reaffirming New Delhi's commitment to supporting the country's development
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah are holding a joint press conference in New Delhi after holding bilateral and delegation-level talks.
In his official statement, PM Modi said India would extend a development package worth Rs 24,000 crore to Nepal, reaffirming New Delhi's commitment to supporting the country's development.
He said India and Nepal share deep historical, cultural and people-to-people ties that go beyond diplomatic relations. Referring to the religious and cultural connection between the two countries, Modi said Lord Ram and Goddess Sita brought the two nations closer. He added that Nepal was an integral part of India's spiritual traditions, saying that India's pilgrimage circuit and the story of Lord Ram remained incomplete without Nepal.
PM Modi also highlighted the growing number of devotees visiting Ayodhya, noting that 30 crore people had visited the Ram temple in 2025. He announced the launch of a train service connecting Ayodhya and Janakpur, the birthplace of Goddess Sita, to strengthen religious tourism and people-to-people ties between the two countries.
The Indian PM also announced the expansion scholarship opportunities for Nepali students pursuing higher education in fields such as law and technology India.
Balen Shah invites PM Modi to Nepal
Nepal's PM Shah invited PM Modi to visit Nepal and encouraged Indians to explore the country's religious and tourist destinations, including the Pashupatinath Temple. Describing India-Nepal ties as “as strong as the Himalayas”, Shah called for closer cooperation in education and better air connectivity between the two countries. He also suggested creating opportunities for Indian students to study at IITs established in Nepal.
Shah also expressed gratitude for India's assistance during disasters, describing the close ties between the two neighbouring countries as beyond words.
“I am here on an official visit to India. Thank you to PM Modi for the invitation and the welcome. The close, heartfelt ties between India and Nepal cannot be expressed in words. I thank India for its assistance during the disaster,” he said.
Before the bilateral talks, Shah was accorded a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan before visiting Rajghat to pay tribute to Mahatma Gandhi. He laid a wreath at the memorial as part of the official engagements during his two-day visit.
Additionally, the two leaders exchanged gifts, with the Indian prime minister presenting Shah with Ganga water from Triveni, while Shah gifted him rudraksha and sandalwood from Pashupatinath Temple.

title: Passport rules: When can authorities stop Indians from travelling abroad?
description: The Passports Act, 1967 specifies when overseas travel can be restricted. Here is what authorities can do when discrepancies surface and what remedies citizens have
author: Mini Raghav
content:
Passport rules: When can authorities stop Indians from travelling abroad?
The Passports Act, 1967 specifies when overseas travel can be restricted. Here is what authorities can do when discrepancies surface and what remedies citizens have
Listen to This Article
Saurav Das, a leader of the upstart Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), said he was stopped at Delhi airport on November 23 when he was on his way to the United Kingdom. According to Das, immigration officials flagged alleged discrepancies in the place-of-birth details in his passport.
The Chennai Regional Passport Office (RPO), which issued his passport in 2019, subsequently sent him a show-cause notice seeking his response to the discrepancies within seven days. He also refrained from using the passport until he submitted his response.
Das said he came to know about the notice only when he reached the immigration counter. The authorities had flagged differences in his birth-related details across documents, including Aadhaar and his passport. The notice initiated proceedings that could lead to the passport being impounded.
The incident raises questions about the government’s power to regulate international travel and the legal safeguards available to passport holders.
Can immigration authorities stop you from travelling despite a valid passport and visa?
A valid passport and visa do not, by themselves, guarantee the right to leave India in every circumstance.
Also Read
Immigration officials can restrict departure if there is a legally valid basis, such as a court order or a Look Out Circular (LOC), as the case may be.
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) governs issues relating to LOCs, which are alerts circulated to immigration authorities at airports and other exit points. Depending on the terms of the LOC, it can restrict a person from travelling abroad.
On what grounds can the government impound or revoke your passport?
Section 10(3) of the Passports Act, 1967, says passport authorities can impound or revoke a passport on specified grounds.
These include wrongful possession of a passport, suppression of material information or submission of incorrect information to obtain it, and situations involving national security or public interest.
“The passport authority must examine the nature of the discrepancy, intention behind it and a distinction has to be made between an innocent mistake and deliberate misrepresentation,” said B Shravanth Shanker, managing partner, B Shanker Advocates LLP.
A discrepancy in the place of birth can legally justify impounding a passport if it was obtained by suppressing material facts or providing incorrect information. However, authorities cannot automatically impound a passport over a minor error; they must follow due process, Shanker added.
Section 10(3)(b) empowers authorities to take action if a passport was obtained by suppressing material information or on the basis of incorrect information.
Separately, Section 12(1)(b) provides for criminal punishment when a person knowingly furnishes false information or suppresses material information to obtain a passport.
Can authorities restrict foreign travel without formally impounding a passport?
There is a difference between a show-cause notice and an order restricting the use of a passport.
A show-cause notice gives the passport holder an opportunity to explain why action should not be taken. It is not, by itself, a final order impounding the passport.
“A show-cause notice is an invitation to answer an allegation, not an executive licence to impose a travel ban,” said Tushar Agarwal, founder & managing partner, CLAP JURIS, Advocates & Solicitors.
“A show-cause notice does not by itself invalidate a passport. Interim suspension is possible under Section 10A, but only where impounding is likely on Section 10(3)(c) grounds: sovereignty, security, foreign relations or public interest,” said Raheel Patel, Partner, Gandhi Law Associates.
This provision does not create a general interim suspension power for every case involving alleged incorrect information under Section 10(3)(b).
Therefore, the legal basis for preventing travel in a particular case must be examined separately, including whether an independent restriction or valid immigration alert was issued.
What legal safeguards protect the right to travel abroad?
The Supreme Court, in Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978), recognised that the right to travel abroad constitutes personal liberty under Article 21 of the Constitution.
It held that any procedure restricting this liberty must be fair, just and reasonable.
“The passport authority must generally give notice, disclose the grounds, allow a reasonable opportunity to reply, and give reasons for any adverse order,” said Alay Razvi, managing partner, Accord Juris.
A notice issued only five hours before a flight may raise concerns about fairness and whether there was a practical opportunity to respond. A court may examine whether the timing was necessary, proportionate and supported by proper material, Razvi added.
Section 10(5) of the Passports Act also requires authorities to record reasons when they pass an order impounding or revoking a passport.
The passport holder can also seek a copy of the reasons, except in specified cases involving national security, friendly relations with foreign countries or public interest.
What can you do if authorities prevent you from leaving India?
An aggrieved person can appeal under Section 11 of the Passports Act before the prescribed appellate authority.
The individual may also approach the High Court with jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution if the action is alleged to be arbitrary or contrary to legal procedure.
“Article 226 is not a remedy available only after the passport authority has pronounced its final decision,” said Tushar Agarwal.
The appropriate legal remedy depends on the nature of the restriction, including whether it arises from a passport order, an LOC or another legal direction.

title: Wealth creation must precede equitable distribution: Vice-President
description: Vice President C P Radhakrishnan said economic growth must prioritise wealth creation and productivity alongside equitable distribution, citing the failure of communism to sustain production.
author: Press Trust of India
content:
Wealth creation must precede equitable distribution: Vice-President
Vice President C P Radhakrishnan said economic growth must prioritise wealth creation and productivity alongside equitable distribution, citing the failure of communism to sustain production.
Listen to This Article
Vice President C P Radhakrishnan on Tuesday said the failure of communism to prioritise wealth creation and productivity, while focusing on wealth distribution, contributed to its fall.
 Addressing a gathering at the exchange of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), Delhi School of Economics and the Institute of Economic Growth (IEG) at his official residence here, Radhakrishnan said economic progress must combine wealth creation with equitable distribution to ensure an improvement in people's quality of life.
 The vice president, who is researching the fall of communism for his doctorate, said the system failed to make production and economic growth central to its thinking.
 "Communism's biggest problem is first a fall in productivity, then the production gets shrunk. They are always talking about distribution. They never worried about production. That is where communism has failed," he said.
 He explained that declining productivity led to shrinking production, shortages of essential commodities and people having to wait in long queues for rationed goods.
Also Read
 Attempts to address the situation through increased government employment, he said, created further administrative and economic difficulties.
 Referring to India's development journey under Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Radhakrishnan cited achievements in poverty alleviation, housing, rural electrification and tap water connectivity.
 He said the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047 required inclusive development across all sectors, regions and sections of society.
 He emphasised that economic progress should ultimately translate into an improved quality of life for people, with human development, good governance and citizens' welfare remaining central to domestic and global priorities.
 Describing the MoU exchange as an important milestone, the vice president said the partnership would bring together the academic excellence, research capabilities and policy experience of the three institutions to address pressing economic and social challenges.
 The proposed collaboration will facilitate academic exchanges, joint research, training programmes and student-faculty exchanges.
 Radhakrishnan particularly welcomed the proposal for a joint research seed fund involving the three institutions, saying it would help nurture young researchers, encourage original scholarship and generate practical policy recommendations.
 The identified areas of collaboration include sustainability, artificial intelligence, public policy, geopolitics and international trade.
 He also highlighted the proposed collaboration between IEG and LSE to enhance the training of Indian Economic Service officers, saying international exposure to research and policy practices would strengthen their professional capabilities.
 Referring to India's growing role in the Global South, Radhakrishnan said the country's democratic institutions, diversity and development experience had much to offer the international academic community.
 He stressed that the experiences of developing countries should also inform global academic and policy frameworks.
 As Chancellor of Delhi University, he said he would personally monitor the progress and outcomes of the initiative and extend all necessary support.
 He also encouraged other universities to draw inspiration from the partnership and pursue similar collaborations.
 The ceremony was attended by N K Singh, President of the Institute of Economic Growth; Larry Kramer, President and Vice-Chancellor of LSE; Michael Debabrata Patra, Chairman of IEG; and Yogesh Singh, Vice-Chancellor of Delhi University, among others

title: Scindia announces advisory panel to resolve telecom startup, MSME matters
description: The advisory panel will address concerns of telecom startups and MSMEs, facilitate government support and help Indian entrepreneurs focus on indigenous technology development.
author: Akshat Ayush
content:
Scindia announces advisory panel to resolve telecom startup, MSME matters
The advisory panel will address concerns of telecom startups and MSMEs, facilitate government support and help Indian entrepreneurs focus on indigenous technology development.
Listen to This Article
Communications minister Jyotiraditya Scindia — at the Telecom Startups and MSME Conclave 2026 on Tuesday — said that an advisory panel would be set up to address issues faced by startups and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the telecom space and ensure government support for entrepreneurs.
The conclave, which showcased indigenous telecom technologies, intends to connect startups and MSMEs with industry leaders, investors and policymakers.
Speaking at the event, Scindia said industry players had raised their concerns through individual presentations, adding that “very clear asks from the government have been set.”
He said the government would act as a “facilitator” to ensure that Indian entrepreneurs in the sector could focus on product development. This comes as India “moves from a consumer of technology to a creator and supplier of technology for the world.”
Scindia said Indian entrepreneurs in the sector had received seed funding from the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) through schemes such as the Digital Communication Innovation Square (DCIS), Telecom Technology Development Fund (TTDF) and Technology Development and Investment Promotion (TDIP).
Also Read
This, he said, had enabled companies to reach the stage of full commercialisation.
The DCIS scheme supports startups in developing and commercialising indigenous telecom products, while the TTDF scheme funds research and development in telecom technologies, particularly for rural connectivity.
The TDIP scheme promotes India's participation in global telecom standardisation and the development of indigenous technologies.
He said of around 200 investments under the DCIS scheme, 96 products across 80 companies had reached commercialisation.
Commercialisation implies turning a developed product or technology into a market-ready offering that can be sold to customers and generate revenue.
According to Scindia, the aim is to enable the growth of many more companies through similar government support, for which the advisory group had been set up.
Scindia added that India had grown from a few hundred startups in 2014 to more than 200,000 now.
He said the government aimed to replicate this growth in the telecom sector by supporting more companies through funding and policy interventions.
“The telecom sector is the most profound example of India becoming the creator of technology due to the volume to test technology,” Scindia said.
According to the DoT, the government is also supporting telecom startups through 100 5G Use Case Labs, which help with product testing and deployment.
At the conclave, the DoT also discussed the Regulatory Sandbox and Captive Non-Public Networks (CNPNs), provisions under the Telecommunications Act, 2023, with startups and industry representatives.
The conclave featured discussions across five areas of the telecom technology stack, including radio access network and core, applications, chipsets, security and standards.

title: PLI Auto disbursements surge to  ₹4,385 crore in FY27
description: The Centre has disbursed 26% of the scheme's  ₹25,938 crore outlay since FY25, as electric vehicle adoption gathers pace.
author: Manas Pimpalkhare
content:
New Delhi: The Centre has disbursed ₹4,385 crore under its production-linked incentive (PLI) scheme for automobiles and auto parts in the current fiscal as of 25 November, signalling a sharp acceleration in payouts under a scheme that has faced concerns over slow fund utilization. The disbursement takes the cumulative incentives paid under the ₹25,938 crore PLI Auto scheme to ₹6,771 crore since payouts began in fiscal year 2025 (FY25), or about 26% of its total outlay as of November 2026, the ministry said in a statement on Wednesday. The scheme, which has the largest outlay among those run by the ministry, will continue to provide incentives until FY29. As of November, nine automakers and 10 auto component manufacturers were eligible to receive incentives under it. The latest addition to the list is the Indian arm of South Korean automaker Hyundai Motor, which received government approval in September this year to claim incentives under the scheme for two models of its electric Creta car. The PLI Auto scheme provides incentives to manufacturers on sales of zero-emission vehicles, including electric vehicles and some hydrogen-based vehicles. The objective is to lower manufacturing costs and improve manufacturers' margins. The ministry has previously faced questions over low budget utilization from the Rajya Sabha's department-related standing committee on industry. In March this year, the parliamentary panel, headed by MP Tiruchi Siva, flagged the under-utilization of budget estimates. It noted that the PLI Auto scheme, the ₹18,100 crore PLI scheme for batteries and the ₹11,900 crore PM E-Drive electric vehicle subsidy scheme had all seen reductions of more than 30% between budget estimates (BE) and revised estimates (RE) in multiple years. In its response to the committee, the ministry said the initial under-utilization of funds under PLI Auto was because investments by automakers in cleaner vehicle manufacturing took time to fructify, delaying the sales-based incentives that could be disbursed. Under the scheme's original disbursement plan, payouts were targeted at ₹604 crore in the first year, ₹3,150 crore in the second, ₹5,925 crore in the third, ₹7,199 crore in the fourth and ₹9,060 crore in the fifth year. Against these targets, the government's budget estimates stood at ₹3,500 crore in FY25, ₹2,818 crore in FY26 and ₹5,939 crore in FY27. The acceleration in incentive disbursements comes as electric vehicle adoption in India gains momentum. EV registrations rose to 2.55 million in FY26, from 2.04 million in the previous fiscal year, according to the government's VAHAN registry of new vehicles. Based on its analysis of 2025 data, the International Energy Agency (IEA) ranks India as the world's second-largest electric two-wheeler market, the largest electric three-wheeler market and the third-largest electric bus market. India aims to become a net-zero carbon emitter by 2070. Transport accounts for 12% of the country's carbon emissions, according to the IEA. A shift towards electric vehicles could also help reduce India's dependence on imported oil, with the country currently meeting about 90% of its oil requirements through imports. Manas is a New Delhi-based journalist with Mint, where he covers the intersection of economic policy, industry, and emerging sectors shaping India’s growth. He writes on government regulation, manufacturing, and the clean energy transition, with particular depth in areas such as electric mobility, battery ecosystems, and rare-earth supply chains. He has written on India’s efforts to build domestic capacity in electric vehicles and energy storage, as well as the broader push to reduce import dependence and strengthen supply chain resilience. His reports are not limited to capturing the headline; they also aim to explain complex policy simply.

Manas has studied law in Pune, the city where he grew up, followed by a business journalism diploma from the Asian College of Journalism in Chennai. In his almost two years of being a correspondent for Mint, Manas has reported as major wars unfolded, a general election brought surprises for both the ruling party and the Opposition, and three Union Budget announcements where India has charted its economic course for the days to come.

title: Voltas ordered to pay  ₹33,770 for damaging customer's AC during reinstallation
description: Bengaluru consumer commission found deficiency in service on the part of the company's technicians, observing that the deployment of inadequately trained staff had resulted in damage to the appliance and rendered it completely non-functional
author: Livemint
content:
A Bengaluru consumer commission has directed Voltas Ltd to pay ₹33,770 to a customer after holding the company responsible for damage to his air conditioner during reinstallation following his relocation from Chennai to Bengaluru.
The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (Bengaluru Urban) found deficiency in service on the part of the company's technicians, observing that the deployment of inadequately trained staff had resulted in damage to the appliance and rendered it completely non-functional.
The commission directed Voltas to pay ₹25,000 as consolidated compensation for the damage and operational loss of the air conditioner, along with 3% annual interest from the date of filing the complaint. It also ordered the company to refund ₹1,770 towards installation charges, pay ₹5,000 for mental agony and harassment, and reimburse ₹2,000 towards litigation expenses, according to a report by The Times of India.
Voltas has been directed to comply with the order within 45 days.
The complaint was filed by S Balaji, 37, who said his Voltas 1.5-tonne split air conditioner (Model 183SY) was in working condition when it was dismantled in Chennai in March 2025.
A technical fitness report issued by Dynamic Cool Center had certified that the appliance was functional before it was transported to Bengaluru.
After relocating, Balaji approached Voltas for reinstallation on April 19, 2025, and paid ₹1,770 for the service. However, he alleged that the company's technicians lacked the necessary expertise and allowed the entire refrigerant gas charge to leak during installation, leaving the appliance non-functional.
According to the complaint, Voltas technicians revisited the premises on May 1 and refilled the refrigerant gas without charging him. However, Balaji alleged that they left the cooling system unpressurised and exposed, allowing atmospheric moisture to enter over the following 12 days.
He claimed that this subsequently damaged the printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) and fan motor.
Despite raising several service requests and escalating the matter through emails, Balaji said the air conditioner continued to develop recurring reset problems before eventually stopping completely.
He also approached the National Consumer Helpline, but his grievances were marked as disposed of without any technical resolution.
The consumer commission noted that Balaji had submitted documents establishing that the air conditioner was functional before its relocation and developed major defects after the reinstallation carried out by Voltas.
It further observed that the company had failed to produce contrary technical evidence or provide a written explanation to refute the allegations.
"The deployment of untrained staff and the subsequent terminal damage to the machine amounts to a deficiency of service," the commission observed.
Commission rejects claim for full purchase value
However, the commission declined to award the entire original purchase price of ₹33,000 sought by the complainant.
It observed that the air conditioner was not a new appliance when it was reinstalled in Bengaluru, as it had already been used in Chennai. Awarding the full purchase value without considering depreciation would therefore be inequitable, it said.
The order was passed on September 30, 2026, by a commission comprising president Ramachandra M S and members Nandini H Kumbhar and Savitha Airani.
Voltas Ltd and its Bengaluru branch manager did not appear before the commission despite receiving notice. Consequently, the proceedings against them continued ex parte.

title: IIT Delhi alumnus reveals how he repaid over  ₹1 cr family debt before 25, quit Google to built own startup
description: A Delhi-graduate man, Yash Garg shared that he earned  ₹2 crore from a side business while also working at Google. He later quit his job and launched his dream startup after overcoming multiple failed attempts.
author: Sneha Biswas
content:
An IIT Delhi graduate shared his extraordinary turnaround story on the internet as he went from a debt of more than ₹1 lakh to securing a job at Google and eventually building his app business. This is the story of Yash Garg, who shared his streak of struggles in life while trying to clear off his family debt. Garg took to X and penned a long note on overcoming his family's financial troubles. He discovered his family was in more than ₹1 crore in debt while he was in the second year. "My father ran a real estate business, and he had invested in under-construction flats from builders like Jaypee and Wave, paying most of the price up front through home loans. Years went by without the flats being delivered, but the banks still wanted their EMIs on time. So my parents borrowed from friends and relatives, and when that was not enough, from credit cards," he shared. As collection agents began visiting his home, Garg made his parents sit down and listed every outstanding payment. He shared that the principal amount alone crossed the ₹1 crore mark. Garg realised that his only way out was to secure a high-paying job and clear the debt before pursuing his dream of building a startup. Despite being ranked second in his department with a CGPA of 9.7, Garg's campus placement plans did not go as expected. While he failed to clear the final round at Tower Research, he said he eventually accepted a job at Cohesity for ₹18 lakh a year. He moved to Bengaluru in July 2019 and lived in a paying guest setup under tight monthly expenses below ₹20,000. "My friends would talk about investing and going on trips, but I did none of that," he added. Garg said that although he sent most of his earnings home, it didn't improve the financial worries. He decided to look for vacancies at Google and upgraded himself accordingly. However, hirings were stopped due to COVID-19. Yash Garg, around the same time, joined Spotnana, hoping to earn more from the role and its equity. However, nothing much changed for him. He added, "About a year after I had started sending money home, I sat down to see where it had gone. Almost my entire salary had been spent on interest for our credit card loans. We had not reduced the principal and had not saved anything either. After a full year of hard work and sacrifice, the list was exactly as long as the day I had written it." Garg called it the lowest point of his life. A referral from a college senior eventually helped him land a job at Google. When he joined the company, he still had ₹80 lakh of debt left. To accelerate repayments, Garg began a side hustle. He launched a mobile apps business with his father. He worked nights and weekends alongside his full-time job. After initially struggling to generate money from Android apps, he said that he shifted his focus to iOS games. "I bought a MacBook Pro for a hefty ₹2.1 lakh, picked our most downloaded game on Android, built its Swift version in six days, and launched it on iOS. Installs were high from day one, and within a couple of days we turned on monetization," he shared. Finally, the business generated ₹6 lakh in its first month, which climbed to ₹24 lakh by the fourth month. Over the next 18 months, Garg's games crossed 2,00,000 downloads, mainly from users in the US, and generated more than ₹2 crore in revenue. Along with his Google salary and the earnings from the app business, Yash Garg was able to repay the outstanding loans. In June 2023, he cleared the debt. While Garg was no longer in debt, it was just the beginning of his dream startup. Soon after, he resigned from Google just before turning 25. He turned to entrepreneurship full-time. After several failed attempts, Garg built Super Workday, a business creating apps for users of the project management platform monday. Now, it has more than 300 paying customers, mostly US-based, and is close to $100,000 in annual recurring revenue (ARR). In January 2025, Yash Garg secured a $400,000 investment from Silicon Valley venture capital firm South Park Commons at a valuation of $5.7 million to build an AI executive assistant, as per his post. "I am ready for whatever comes next," he concluded his post. title: 'Indian IT's next big test is getting AI economics right,' says former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke
description: The emergence of AI agents is prompting Indian IT services companies to reconsider their business models. Experts suggest that firms must focus on the economics of AI rather than just deploying coding talent. Proper knowledge and design are crucial to avoid wasted expenditures on AI implementations, leading to significant savings. Dohmke emphasizes the potential for India to create notable global technology companies with the right support.
author: Vinod Mahanta
content:
Dohmke, who quit Microsoft-owned GitHub last year to turn entrepreneur again, believes AI will fundamentally change the economics of technology outsourcing but Indian IT services companies will continue to play a key role, helping global clients make effective use of AI agents without letting the costs of deployment outweigh the productivity gains.
"The GSI (global systems integrator) future will be that the workforce that they provide as consultants to their customers are experts in using these agents. They will have to have the knowledge of how to use the agent to get the project done cheaper than just putting 10 human developers on it," Dohmke said in an interview.
The problem, he said, is that businesses could end up paying thousands of dollars on AI tokens and have little to show for it, eating away at the cost savings of automation if projects are poorly designed or the employees executing them lack the competence to manage AI agents.
"If you're spending all your money on AI, the business will fade away," he said, adding that IT services companies will have to help customers get token economics right while ensuring that both sides benefit financially from transformation projects.
Entire, which has raised $60 million at a $300 million valuation, is partnering with Indian AI startup Sarvam to build what Dohmke calls a "fully sovereign Indian software development lifecycle," allowing developers to store their source code and run AI inference within the country, reducing their reliance on overseas technology infrastructure. The company, which has established infrastructure in Mumbai, is also partnering with Infosys and Open Healthcare Network.
'RIP SDLC'
Dohmke claimed the traditional software development lifecycle (SDLC) is "dead" as AI agents take over coding and developers increasingly oversee agents functioning autonomously for hours.
The whole company is counting on something called "continuous memory", which stores not just the original code but also the interactions that went into creating it, to stop bots from repeating mistakes.
Dohmke sees the US leading the global AI model race, followed by China, with India and Europe catching up, and believes open-weight models offer the latter a good route to compete.
Citing India's success in building the global IT services industry and the innovation coming out of multinational technology centres in the country, Dohmke said AI offers India another opportunity to build global technology giants. "Can you build the next Microsoft here in Bangalore?" he said, adding that AI makes it possible, provided the funding and talent ecosystem develops alongside it.

title: Bengal's legacy needs a Gen Z makeover to power its economic future
description: Faced with the pressing task of economic rejuvenation, West Bengal is striving to retain its youth and attract much-needed investment. During the Economic Times Bengal Ascends event, experts pointed out that the state's traditional economic identity requires transformation. They advocated for improved career opportunities and infrastructure, emphasizing collaboration with micro, small, and medium enterprises to cultivate a supportive investment climate and ensure the regions prosperous future.
author: ET Bureau
content:
These were among the key points raised at a panel discussion on "Imagining the Bengal of Tomorrow" at The Economic Times Bengal Ascends event. The panel featured Suvankar Sen, managing director of Senco Gold and Diamonds; Vibhash Agarwal, general manager at edible oil and foods company Emami Agrotech, Prithish Chowdhary, deputy managing director of Titagarh Rail Systems; and Diva Jain, director at real estate firm Arrjavv.
"Think of Maharashtra and you associate it with finance, Gujarat with enterprise, Tamil Nadu with manufacturing and Karnataka with technology. What comes to mind when we think of Bengal? Glorious past," Jain said. "Of course, our past deserves pride, but we cannot make the case for Bengal's future with this nostalgic and romantic attachment to the past."
GTA 6, the recent global gaming phenomenon, was cited during the discussion as an example of how Bengal recognised its contemporary talent. When the game was launched, much of the attention in Bengal was on Rupa Biswas, whose 1982 disco song featured in it. Less attention went to Devanjana Talukdar, Abhijit Bose, Abhijit Ghosal and Devojit Nandi, who were part of the game's animation team.
Also Read: Bengal needs tech push, talent return to become global business hub, industry leaders say
Sen said Bengal's legacy should be seen as a set of values that could shape its future, rather than as a burden. "For Bengal, legacy would mean the value system. It would be based on creativity, freedom, and thinking out of the box," the Senco Gold and Diamonds MD said, pointing to the state's contributions to India's freedom movement, philosophy, thought and science.
"Let's look at that value system and then connect it to the future, to the new generation. Tell them that this is what we stand for, and let us now change with the times," Sen said. He added that acceptance of modern thinking and a willingness to change were missing in recent years.
Creating opportunities for young people would require Bengal to keep pace with the changing nature of work, Agarwal said. Opportunities in consulting, finance, marketing and agency businesses emerged faster in Mumbai and Delhi, he said. Greater exposure to these sectors opened up new possibilities for young people, and building similar opportunities in Bengal could help reverse the outflow of talent, he said. Jain said Bengal must address the difference in earnings compared with other states, limited opportunities for career progression and the investment gap if it wanted professionals to return. "Ecosystems develop where there is investment," she said.
Chowdhary said Bengal's large micro, small and medium enterprises base could be used to train workers and connect them to larger supply chains. He urged companies to work with industrial training institutes and invest in upskilling young people. Not everyone trained by a company would necessarily join or remain with it, he said, but the effort would help create a larger pool of employable workers. Sen, who is part of the state's National Education Policy Task Force, said colleges were working to make industry participation part of students' courses.

title: Bengal needs tech push, talent return to become global business hub, industry leaders say
description: Industry leaders at The Economic Times Bengal Ascends summit emphasized the need for West Bengal to enhance its technology ecosystem. They noted that improving infrastructure and talent acquisition could position the state as a hub for global services. Key investments, such as Amul's dairy plant expansion, could foster economic growth and benefit local farmers. The role of artificial intelligence in various sectors was also a focal point of discussion.
author: ET Bureau
content:
Jayen Mehta, MD of dairy cooperative Amul, noted that Bengal had 1.5 lakh farmer families, 10 crore population and yet its milk production has stayed below its potential for years.
Amul will invest ₹700 crore in its dairy plant in Howrah to process 30 lakh litres of milk daily and emerge world's largest curd manufacturing facility with a capacity of 10 lakh kg per day. The expansion will potentially transfer nearly ₹5,000 crore annually to dairy farmers in the state. Mehta noted that Bengal needs to expand veterinary and dairy education.
West Bengal should capitalise on its industrial strengths in heavy engineering, chemicals, utilities and banking and develop the technological and domain-specific expertise required by multinational companies.
Pillay said Bengal's biggest untapped opportunity could be its diaspora of experienced technology and business leaders working across India's established GCC hubs.
"If you were to just reach out to the Bengali diaspora all across the country and run a simple ghar wapsi programme, you would get the best talent back here," she said. Sangita Singh, president-India and International at Everforth, said Bengal's economics including land, talent, infrastructure can offer up to 60% cost advantage against other cities for global enterprises to establish engineering hubs. "In the world of AI, I think three things are needed that can help give Bengal a head start," she said, identifying water availability, uninterrupted power and a strong pool of technically skilled professionals.
Also Read: The Great Indian Food Adventure: Indian flavours find a place on global shelves
She said the Ganga basin could support the water requirements of data centres, while the state's power infrastructure and engineering talent could help attract global technology investments. The executives also discussed whether AI could erode India's cost advantage in technology services. KPMG's Pillay said that GCCs are outsourcing routine corporate services and support functions. "Jobs are being redefined. Jobs need to be rethought... What we need to train our young graduates for is very different because the apprenticeship model as we all know it, is collapsing in that avatar," Pillay said. "It started with SAP and we said jobs would go away," Everforth's Singh said.
"It only increased. It started with call centres, and we've seen triple the number of people that you employ in call centres."
Meanwhile, Amul's Mehta discussed an interesting case of how AI is helping India's grassroots levels. Amul's AI voice assistant 'Sarlaben' helps millions of dairy farmers with technical advice in regional languages.
"Sarlaben gives answers on feeding, breeding, animal husbandry, veterinary services, central government schemes and even weather, as well as market prices," Mehta said. "Every day more than 1000 women from Bengal call up Sarlaben."
Manoshi Roychowdhury, co-chancellor of Techno India University, said AI is expanding into education, healthcare, hospitality, design and filmmaking, creating new opportunities for students across disciplines.
However, she cautioned that institutions needed to address the psychological impact of AI on students, particularly concerns about whether automation would eliminate future jobs.

title: जंतर-मंतर पर आज मार्च की तैयारी में संयुक्त किसान मोर्चा, एक्शन में दिल्ली पुलिस
description: दिल्ली पुलिस ने सभी नागरिकों से अपील की है कि वे धारा 163 BNSS के तहत जारी आदेशों का पालन करें. साथ ही पुलिस के साथ सहयोग करें. यदि कोई इन आदेशों का उल्लंघन करता है तो उसके खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई की जाएगी.
author: aajtak.in
content:
संयुक्त किसान मोर्चा की ओर से प्रस्तावित विरोध मार्च को लेकर दिल्ली पुलिस एक्शन में आ गई है. दिल्ली पुलिस ने कहा है कि उन्हें इस मार्च की अनुमति को लेकर कोई आवेदन नहीं मिला है. पुलिस की ओर से इस मार्च के आयोजन की भी कोई अनुमति नहीं दी गई है.
दरअसल, संयुक्त किसान मोर्चा ने ऐलान कर रखा है कि गुरुवार (26 नवंबर) को उनके कार्यकर्ता राजधानी दिल्ली में कनॉट प्लेस के काली बाड़ी से जंतर-मंतर तक विरोध मार्च निकालेंगे. इसी को लेकर दिल्ली पुलिस ने ताजा निर्देश जारी किया है. दिल्ली पुलिस के डीसीपी ने बुधवार रात इसको लेकर सोशल मीडिया पर प्रेस नोट भी शेयर किया.
पुलिस ने कहा कि ताजा निर्देश के बाद भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता (BNSS) की धारा 163 के तहत आदेश लागू हैं. इसके तहत बिना अनुमति के किसी भी प्रकार की सभा, जुलूस, प्रदर्शन, भाषण, नारेबाजी और धरना देने पर पाबंदी है.
पुलिस ने सभी नागरिकों से अपील की है कि वे धारा 163 BNSS के तहत जारी आदेशों का पालन करें. साथ ही पुलिस प्रशासन के साथ सहयोग करें. यदि कोई इन आदेशों का उल्लंघन करता है तो नियमानुसार उसके खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई की जाएगी.
बता दें कि कुछ दिनों पहले ही जंतर-मंतर को लेकर दिल्ली पुलिस ने बड़ा फैसला लिया था. गृह मंत्रालय के निर्देश के बाद अब जंतर मंतर पर धरना प्रदर्शन नहीं हो सकेगा. दिल्ली पुलिस ने प्रोटेस्ट के लिए राजधानी में तीन नए स्थान चुने. ये तीन स्थान हैं- 1 रामलीला मैदान, 2- बुराडी मैदान और 3- CBD ग्राउंड.
गृह मंत्रालय ने एक कमेटी बनाई थी ताकि नागरिक अधिकारों की मांग के लिए प्रदर्शन कर रहे लोगों को उचित स्थान दिया जा सके, जहां वे प्रदर्शन कर सकें. इस कमेटी की सिफारिश पर जंतर-मंतर को प्रोटेस्ट साइट से डिनोटिफाई कर दिया गया.

title: यूपी में कितनी सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ेंगी LJP? चिराग पासवान ने दिया ये जवाब
description: चिराग ने कहा कि चुनाव लड़ने के लिए सीटों को लेकर उनकी कुछ इच्छाएं जरूर हैं, लेकिन वे इन्हें गठबंधन के दलों के सामने रखेंगे. उन्होंने कहा कि सीटों और प्रत्याशियों को लेकर सब कुछ तय है. जैसे ही गठबंधन के बीच चर्चा होगी, उन्हें बता दिया जाएगा.
author: राजेश कुमार
content:
यूपी में कितनी सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ेंगी LJP? चिराग पासवान ने दिया ये जवाब
चिराग ने कहा कि चुनाव लड़ने के लिए सीटों को लेकर उनकी कुछ इच्छाएं जरूर हैं, लेकिन वे इन्हें गठबंधन के दलों के सामने रखेंगे. उन्होंने कहा कि सीटों और प्रत्याशियों को लेकर सब कुछ तय है. जैसे ही गठबंधन के बीच चर्चा होगी, उन्हें बता दिया जाएगा.
उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव को लेकर सभी राजनीतिक दलों की ओर से जोर-शोर से तैयारियां की जा रही हैं. समाजवादी पार्टी ने तो अपनी पहली सूची में पांच उम्मीदवारों के नामों का ऐलान भी कर दिया है. इस बीच, एलजेपी (आर) के अध्यक्ष चिराग पासवान भी यूपी चुनाव लड़ने के इच्छुक हैं. जब उनसे पूछा गया कि यूपी चुनाव में वे बीजेपी से कितनी सीटों की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं, तो उन्होंने कहा कि वे इंडिया गठबंधन के सदस्य नहीं हैं कि एक तरफ बातचीत चल रही हो और दूसरी तरफ वे प्रत्याशियों का ऐलान कर दें.
चिराग ने कहा कि चुनाव लड़ने के लिए सीटों को लेकर उनकी कुछ इच्छाएं जरूर हैं, लेकिन वे इन्हें गठबंधन के दलों के सामने रखेंगे. उन्होंने कहा कि सीटों और प्रत्याशियों को लेकर सब कुछ तय है. जैसे ही गठबंधन के बीच चर्चा होगी, उन्हें बता दिया जाएगा. उन्होंने कहा कि वे तभी गठबंधन में हिस्सा लेंगे, जब सभी सहयोगी दलों को लगेगा कि उनके शामिल होने से फायदा होगा. अन्यथा, वे उस गठबंधन का हिस्सा क्यों बनेंगे?
यूपी चुनाव लड़ने को तैयार चिराग
चिराग ने कहा कि हाल ही में सीएम योगी की माताजी का निधन हुआ है. ऐसे में उनके मन में यह भावना है कि योगी इस समय उसी पीड़ा से गुजर रहे हैं, जिससे वे अपने पिता को खोने के बाद गुजरे थे. उन्होंने कहा कि एलजेपी-आर का गठबंधन राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर बीजेपी के साथ है. बिहार में भी उनकी पार्टी मजबूत एनडीए का हिस्सा है.
उन्होंने कहा कि झारखंड में भी उनकी पार्टी का एक विधायक है, हालांकि नागालैंड में एनडीए के साथ गठबंधन नहीं हो पाया. वहां एलजेपी ने अकेले चुनाव लड़ा और आज उनकी पार्टी के दो विधायक हैं.
चिराग ने कहा कि वे अपनी पार्टी को इतनी मजबूती के साथ तैयार कर रहे हैं कि जरूरत पड़ने पर सभी 403 सीटों पर उम्मीदवार उतार सकते हैं. हालांकि, अभी ऐसा कहना जल्दबाजी होगी, क्योंकि गठबंधन में सीटों को लेकर बातचीत चल रही है.
पार्टी के विस्तार की सोच
चिराग पासवान ने कहा कि पार्टी अध्यक्ष के तौर पर वे चाहते हैं कि उनकी पार्टी का विस्तार हो. उन्होंने कहा कि 2020 में वे किसी वैकल्पिक गठबंधन का हिस्सा नहीं बने और अपना जनाधार बढ़ाने के लिए बिहार में अकेले चुनाव लड़े. उन्होंने कहा कि अगर वे समर्पण की भावना से बैठे रहेंगे, तो पार्टी का विस्तार कैसे होगा?
उन्होंने कहा कि पहले कभी ऐसा नहीं हुआ कि एक सांसद वाली पार्टी को पांच विधानसभा सीटें दे दी जाएं, लेकिन उनकी पार्टी को ऐसा मौका दिया गया था. इसके बाद उन्हें चुनाव लड़ने के लिए 29 सीटें दी गईं. चिराग ने आगे कहा कि गठबंधन में आपको तभी रखा जाएगा, जब उसे आपकी जरूरत महसूस होगी.

title: बच्ची संग खेलती दिखीं सीनेटर, ऑस्ट्रेलियन संसद का मजेदार VIDEO वायरल
description: ऑस्ट्रेलिया की संसद का एक वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर खूब वायरल हो रहा है. इस वीडियो में सीनेटर फातिमा पेमैन अपनी 6 महीने की बेटी आलिया को गोद में लिए भाषण देती दिखाई दे रही हैं.
author: शैलजाकांत मिश्रा
content:
बच्ची संग खेलती दिखीं सीनेटर, ऑस्ट्रेलियन संसद का मजेदार VIDEO वायरल
ऑस्ट्रेलिया की संसद का एक वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर खूब वायरल हो रहा है. इस वीडियो में सीनेटर फातिमा पेमैन अपनी 6 महीने की बेटी आलिया को गोद में लिए भाषण देती दिखाई दे रही हैं.
ऑस्ट्रेलिया की संसद से सामने आया एक वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर खूब वायरल हो रहा है. इस वीडियो में सीनेटर फातिमा पेमैन अपनी 6 महीने की बेटी आलिया को गोद में लिए भाषण देती दिखाई दे रही हैं, वहीं उनके पीछे उनकी साथी सीनेटर लिडिया थोर्प बैठी थीं, जो नन्ही बच्ची के साथ 'पीक-ए-बू' (छुपन-छुपाई) खेलती दिखाई दे रही हैं.
यह वीडियो इंटरनेट पर लोगों का दिल जीत रहा है. कई लोग इस बात की तारीफ कर रहे हैं कि कैसे एक मां अपने बच्चे की देखभाल करते हुए अपनी पेशेवर जिम्मेदारियों को भी बखूबी निभा रही है. बता दें कि ऑस्ट्रेलियाई संसद सांसदों को बच्चों की देखभाल की अनुमति देती है.
सीनेटर थोर्प बच्ची के साथ खेलती दिखीं
सीनेट से सामने आया यह वीडियो तब का है जब फातिमा पेमैन अपनी बच्ची को गोद में लेकर सदन में संबोधन दे रही थीं. भाषण जारी रखते हुए उन्होंने आलिया को आराम से सीने से लगाए रखा, जबकि पीछे बैठी थोर्प मजेदार चेहरे बनाकर बच्ची के साथ खेलती दिख रही थीं. औपचारिक माहौल के बीच यह प्यारा नजारा लोगों का ध्यान खींच रहा है.
पश्चिमी ऑस्ट्रेलिया से सीनेटर हैं फातिमा पेमैन
सीनेटर पेमैन निर्दलीय सीनेटर हैं, जो पश्चिमी ऑस्ट्रेलिया का प्रतिनिधित्व करती हैं. यह मौजूदगी उस खास दिन हुई, जब ऑस्ट्रेलियाई सीनेट ने 'डिजिटल ड्यूटी ऑफ केयर बिल' पारित किया. सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट में पेमैन ने इस कानून के पास होने को 'बिग टेक' के 'मुनाफा-पहले' मॉडल को चुनौती देने की दिशा में पहला कदम बताया. यह बिल डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म्स की जिम्मेदारियों और बच्चों सहित यूजर्स को ऑनलाइन नुकसान से बचाने पर जोर देता है.
कई अन्य देशों की संसदों के उलट ऑस्ट्रेलिया की सीनेट में ऐसे नियम हैं जो सांसदों को अपने छोटे बच्चों को सदन के अंदर लाने की अनुमति देते हैं. संसदीय नियमों के तहत, सीनेटर सदन की कार्यवाही में हिस्सा लेते हुए अपने बच्चों की देखभाल कर सकते हैं.

title: तिरुक्कुरल सीखो, 10 हजार पाओ! काशी-तमिल संगमम 5.0 का शिक्षा मंत्री प्रहलाद जोशी ऐलान
description: तमिलनाडु के 50 शिक्षक वाराणसी आएंगे. वे स्कूलों और कॉलेजों में जाकर तिरुक्कुरल के बारे में विद्यार्थियों को बताएंगे. इसके तहत भाषण इंटरैक्टिव सेशन और क्विज जैसी गतिविधियां आयोजित की जाएंगी.
author: अजातिका सिंह
content:
तिरुक्कुरल सीखो, 10 हजार पाओ! काशी-तमिल संगमम 5.0 का शिक्षा मंत्री प्रहलाद जोशी ऐलान
तमिलनाडु के 50 शिक्षक वाराणसी आएंगे. वे स्कूलों और कॉलेजों में जाकर तिरुक्कुरल के बारे में विद्यार्थियों को बताएंगे. इसके तहत भाषण इंटरैक्टिव सेशन और क्विज जैसी गतिविधियां आयोजित की जाएंगी.
केंद्रीय शिक्षा मंत्री प्रहलाद जोशी काशी तमिल संगमम 5.0 को लेकर कई अहम घोषणाएं कीं. उन्होंने बुधवार (25 नवंबर) को बताया कि यह कार्यक्रम 28 नवंबर से 12 दिसंबर आयोजित होगा. शिक्षा मंत्री ने बताया कि इस बार संगमम का विषय 'तिरुक्कुरल पयिलवोम–आइए तिरुक्कुरल सीखें' रखा गया है. अहम बात यह भी है कि कार्यक्रम को लेकर कई अहम घोषणाएं भी हुई हैं. तमिलनाडु से करीब 1,400 प्रतिनिधि वाराणसी, प्रयागराज और अयोध्या आएंगे.
कार्यक्रम को लेकर क्या-क्या हुई घोषणाएं
- काशी तमिल संगमम का पांचवां संस्करण 28 नवंबर से 12 दिसंबर तक आयोजित होगा.
- तमिलनाडु से करीब 1,400 प्रतिनिधि वाराणसी, प्रयागराज और अयोध्या आएंगे.
- देशभर के 1,000 उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों के विद्यार्थी कार्यक्रम से जुड़ेंगे.
- चयनित विद्यार्थियों को 10 हजार रुपये की छात्रवृत्ति दी जाएगी.
- तमिलनाडु के 50 शिक्षक वाराणसी आएंगे और स्कूल-कॉलेजों में विद्यार्थियों को तिरुक्कुरल की शिक्षाओं से परिचित कराएंगे.
छात्रों के लिए विशेष कार्यक्रम
देशभर के 1,000 उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों से मेरिट के आधार पर विद्यार्थियों का चयन किया जाएगा. चयनित छात्रों को तिरुक्कुरल पर अध्ययन और शोध करने का अवसर मिलेगा.
- छात्रों को इंटर्नशिप/अध्ययन कार्यक्रम के लिए चयनित किया जाएगा.
- तिरुक्कुरल पर 4 से 10 पन्नों का लेख या शोध नोट लिखना होगा.
- अपने संस्थान में तिरुक्कुरल पर प्रेजेंटेशन देना होगा.
- विद्यार्थियों के लिए Quiz प्रतियोगिता और अन्य शैक्षणिक गतिविधियां भी आयोजित होंगी.
- पात्र चुनें हुए छात्रों को 10 हजार रुपये का स्टाइपेंड दिया जाएगा.
यूपी के स्कूल-कॉलेजों में तिरुक्कुरल का प्रसार
तमिलनाडु के 50 शिक्षक वाराणसी आएंगे. वे स्कूलों और कॉलेजों में जाकर तिरुक्कुरल के बारे में विद्यार्थियों को बताएंगे. इसके तहत भाषण, संवाद, इंटरैक्टिव सेशन और क्विज जैसी गतिविधियां आयोजित की जाएंगी, ताकि छात्र इस प्राचीन तमिल ग्रंथ की शिक्षाओं को समझ सकें.
तिरुक्कुरल क्या है?
केंद्रीय शिक्षा मंत्री बताते हैं की तिरुक्कुरल तमिल भाषा का प्राचीन ग्रंथ है, जिसमें जीवन, नैतिकता, आचरण और प्रेम से जुड़ी शिक्षाएं दी गई हैं. इसमें 1,330 दोहे हैं और इसके तीन भाग हैं- अरम (सद्गुण), पोरुल (जीवन और धन व्यवस्था) और इनबम (प्रेम). इसका अनुवाद 25 भारतीय भाषाओं में किया गया है.
1,400 प्रतिनिधियों का वाराणसी, प्रयागराज और अयोध्या दौरा
तमिलनाडु से आने वाले प्रतिनिधियों को करीब 200 लोगों के सात समूहों में बांटा जाएगा. उनका आठ दिन का कार्यक्रम होगा, जिसमें यात्रा, सांस्कृतिक और शैक्षणिक गतिविधियां शामिल होंगी. प्रतिनिधि काशी विश्वनाथ मंदिर, सारनाथ, बीएचयू, रामनगर किला, भारत माता मंदिर, प्रयागराज के त्रिवेणी संगम और अयोध्या के श्रीराम मंदिर का दौरा करेंगे. इसके साथ गंगा आरती, सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम और शैक्षणिक संवाद भी होंगे.
डिजिटल माध्यम से देशभर में पहुंच
तिरुक्कुरल की शिक्षाओं को अधिक लोगों तक पहुंचाने के लिए डिजिटल माध्यमों का भी इस्तेमाल होगा. बहुभाषी ऐप, अनुवाद, ऑडियोबुक, एनिमेशन वीडियो और फिल्मों के जरिए तिरुक्कुरल को देशभर के लोगों तक पहुंचाने की योजना है.
आयोजन का उद्देश्य
काशी तमिल संगमम का उद्देश्य तमिलनाडु और काशी के बीच ऐतिहासिक, सांस्कृतिक और भाषायी संबंधों को मजबूत करना है. पांचवें संस्करण में तिरुक्कुरल के जरिए विद्यार्थियों, युवाओं और देशभर के शिक्षण संस्थानों को भारतीय ज्ञान और साहित्यिक परंपरा से जोड़ने पर विशेष जोर दिया जाएगा.

title: बंगाल के मंत्री बोले-ऋतब्रत गुट पर CM शुभेंदु का आशीर्वाद: समर्थन हटते ही खत्म हो जाएगा बागी गुट; CPI(M) ने...
description: West Bengal political controversy involving Suvendu Adhikari and Ritabrata Banerjee faction updates. Follow Dainik Bhaskar. पश्चिम बंगाल के स्वास्थ्य मंत्री शारद्वत मुखर्जी ने रितब्रत बनर्जी के नेतृत्व वाले टीएमसी गुट पर बड़ा दावा किया है। उन्होंने कहा कि बागी गुट पर मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी का आशीर्वाद है और उनके समर्थन से चल रहा है।
author: दैनिक भास्कर
content:
- Hindi News
- National
- West Bengal Politics: Minister Sharadwat Mukherjee Statement On Suvendu Adhikari
बंगाल के मंत्री बोले-ऋतब्रत गुट पर CM शुभेंदु का आशीर्वाद:समर्थन हटते ही खत्म हो जाएगा बागी गुट; CPI(M) नेता ने वीडियो शेयर किया
- कॉपी लिंक
पश्चिम बंगाल के स्वास्थ्य मंत्री शारद्वत मुखर्जी का वीडियो वायरल हो रहा है। इसमें वह कह रहे हैं कि ऋतब्रत बनर्जी के नेतृत्व वाले टीएमसी गुट पर मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी का आशीर्वाद है और उनके समर्थन से चल रहा है।
मुखर्जी के मुताबिक, मुख्यमंत्री जिस दिन समर्थन वापस ले लेंगे, उसी दिन यह गुट भी खत्म हो जाएगा। उनके बयान से राज्य की राजनीति में विवाद शुरू हो गया है।
CPI(M) नेता शतरूप घोष ने मुखर्जी का वीडियो शेयर किया है, जिसमें वह बिधाननगर में पार्टी कार्यकर्ताओं के साथ बैठक में ममता बनर्जी के नेतृत्व वाले गुट को 'मृत टीएमसी' बताते सुनाई दे रहे हैं।
मुखर्जी ने मुख्यमंत्री के उस दावे का भी जिक्र किया, जिसमें उन्होंने 280 विधायकों का समर्थन जुटाने की बात कही थी। मंत्री ने संकेत दिया कि मुख्यमंत्री ने यह दावा बिना किसी वजह के नहीं किया होगा।
जून में शुरू हुई थी टीएमसी में बगावत
2026 के पश्चिम बंगाल विधानसभा चुनाव में हार के बाद टीएमसी के भीतर सत्ता संघर्ष तेज हो गया था। इसकी शुरुआत जून में हुई, जब पार्टी के 27 लोकसभा सांसदों में से 20 ने अलग होकर NCPI के साथ गठबंधन किया और NDA को समर्थन दे दिया।
इसके बाद बगावत विधानसभा तक पहुंच गई। टीएमसी के करीब 80 विधायकों में से 60 ने ऋतब्रत बनर्जी को विपक्ष का नेता बनाने का समर्थन किया। इन विधायकों ने ममता बनर्जी गुट के उम्मीदवार को स्वीकार नहीं किया।
बागी विधायकों ने अलग बैठक कर वरिष्ठ विधायक अरूप रॉय को अध्यक्ष चुना और समानांतर संगठन बनाने का ऐलान किया। इससे पार्टी के भीतर दो गुटों के बीच टकराव और बढ़ गया।
चुनाव आयोग ने दोनों गुटों को अलग नाम और चुनाव चिह्न दिए
टीएमसी के दोनों गुटों के बीच विवाद पार्टी के नाम और चुनाव चिह्न तक पहुंच गया। चुनाव आयोग ने ममता बनर्जी के नेतृत्व वाले गुट को 'ममता ऑल इंडिया तृणमूल कांग्रेस' नाम और फुटबॉल खिलाड़ी का चुनाव चिह्न दिया।
वहीं, ऋतब्रत बनर्जी के गुट को 'डेमोक्रेटिक तृणमूल कांग्रेस' नाम और लिफाफे का चुनाव चिह्न आवंटित किया गया।
ममता गुट लगातार आरोप लगाता रहा है कि भाजपा अंदरूनी तौर पर ऋतब्रत गुट का समर्थन कर रही है, ताकि टीएमसी को कमजोर किया जा सके। उसका यह भी दावा है कि बागी गुट को विपक्ष के नेता का पद दिलाने में मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी की भूमिका रही है।
बीजेपी और दोनों गुटों ने दी प्रतिक्रिया
स्वास्थ्य मंत्री के बयान पर भाजपा नेताओं ने प्रतिक्रिया देते हुए उसे कमतर बताने की कोशिश की। केंद्रीय राज्य मंत्री सुकांत मजूमदार ने कहा कि मुखर्जी शायद यह बताना चाहते थे कि फिलहाल विपक्ष का अस्तित्व नहीं है। हालांकि, उन्होंने कहा कि मंत्री खुद अपने बयान का मतलब बेहतर तरीके से समझा सकते हैं।
दूसरी ओर, ऋतब्रत गुट के विधायक अखरुज्जमान ने पलटवार करते हुए कहा कि मुखर्जी को जल्द ही पता चल जाएगा कि विपक्ष क्या होता है।
वहीं, ममता बनर्जी गुट के विधायक कुणाल घोष ने कहा कि स्वास्थ्य मंत्री ने प्रतिद्वंद्वी गुट का असली चेहरा सामने ला दिया है।
मुखर्जी का यह बयान इसलिए अहम माना जा रहा है, क्योंकि सत्तारूढ़ खेमे के एक मंत्री ने पहली बार सार्वजनिक तौर पर मुख्यमंत्री पर बागी टीएमसी गुट को समर्थन देने का आरोप लगाया है।

Follow Dainik Bhaskar Latest Updates. भारत ने अमेरिका के उस आरोप को खारिज कर दिया है, जिसमें कहा गया था कि भारतीय मैन्युफैक्चरिंग सेक्टर में जरूरत से ज्यादा उत्पादन क्षमता है। केंद्र सरकार ने कहा कि देश के किसी भी सेक्टर में संरचनात्मक रूप से अतिरिक्त उत्पादन क्षमता नहीं है।
author: दैनिक भास्कर

- Hindi News

भारत ने अमेरिका के ज्यादा प्रोडक्शन के आरोप खारिज किए:अमेरिकी टैरिफ पर कहा- ट्रेड डील जल्द पूरी करेंगे,व्यापारिक मुद्दे बातचीत से सुलझाएंगे
- कॉपी लिंक
भारत ने अमेरिकी आरोपों को खारिज करते हुए कहा है कि देश के किसी भी सेक्टर में जरूरत से ज्यादा उत्पादन क्षमता नहीं है। केंद्र सरकार ने कहा कि व्यापार से जुड़ी चिंताओं का समाधान भारत और अमेरिका के बीच चल रही द्विपक्षीय बातचीत से निकाला जाना चाहिए।
सरकार ने अमेरिकी टैरिफ बढ़ाने के प्रावधानों को लेकर स्पष्ट किया कि वह अमेरिका के साथ ट्रेड डील को जल्द पूरा करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।
अमेरिका ने 11 मार्च 2026 को ट्रेड एक्ट 1974 के सेक्शन 301 के तहत जांच शुरू की थी। इसमें चीन, जापान, दक्षिण कोरिया, वियतनाम समेत 16 देश और आर्थिक क्षेत्र शामिल थे। जांच के बाद 25 नवंबर को अमेरिकी व्यापार प्रतिनिधि कार्यालय (USTR) ने 14 अर्थव्यवस्थाओं के खिलाफ फैसला सुनाया।
भारत की मेक इन इंडिया और PLI योजना पर सवाल
अमेरिकी रिपोर्ट में भारत की मेक इन इंडिया, आत्मनिर्भर भारत और प्रोडक्शन लिंक्ड इंसेंटिव (PLI) योजनाओं पर सवाल उठाए गए हैं। अमेरिका का आरोप है कि इन योजनाओं से भारतीय कंपनियों की उत्पादन क्षमता बढ़ती है, जिससे अमेरिकी कंपनियों को नुकसान होता है।
अमेरिका ने दवा, मेडिकल उपकरण, स्टील, सोलर और आईटी सेक्टर के अलावा भारत की श्रम नीतियों, बाजार तक पहुंच और कच्चे माल के आयात पर निर्भरता को लेकर भी चिंता जताई है।
ट्रेड डील हुई तो 25% की जगह 17% टैरिफ
अमेरिका ने भारत समेत 16 देशों की मैन्युफैक्चरिंग क्षमता की जांच के बाद भारतीय सामानों पर 25% टैरिफ लगाने का प्रस्ताव दिया है। हालांकि, भारत के साथ ट्रेड डील होने पर इसे घटाकर 17% किया जा सकता है। यह दर बांग्लादेश, कंबोडिया, इंडोनेशिया, मलेशिया और थाईलैंड के प्रस्तावित 18% टैरिफ से भी कम होगी।
कुछ उत्पादों को अतिरिक्त शुल्क से छूट देने की भी बात कही गई है। इनमें पेटेंट वाली दवाएं, सेमीकंडक्टर, यात्री वाहन, वाहनों के पुर्जे, स्टील और एल्युमिनियम से जुड़ी कुछ वस्तुएं शामिल हैं।
GTRI ने अमेरिका की रणनीति पर उठाए सवाल
थिंक टैंक ग्लोबल ट्रेड रिसर्च इनिशिएटिव (GTRI) का कहना है कि अमेरिका टैरिफ के जरिए दूसरे देशों पर अपनी शर्तों पर व्यापार समझौता करने का दबाव बना रहा है। संस्था के मुताबिक, समझौता करने वाले देशों को कम और समझौता नहीं करने वालों को ज्यादा टैरिफ देने की व्यवस्था बनाई गई है।
GTRI ने भारत को सलाह दी है कि वह सिर्फ टैरिफ में राहत पाने के लिए एकतरफा रियायतें न दे, बल्कि अमेरिकी आरोपों का सेक्टर के हिसाब से जवाब दे। संस्था ने चेतावनी दी है कि अंतिम फैसला भारत के खिलाफ आने पर अतिरिक्त शुल्क और आयात कोटा लगाने का खतरा भी हो सकता है।

Latest Updates. भारत के मशहूर गणित शिक्षक और सुपर 30 के संस्थापक आनंद कुमार को जापान में प्रतिष्ठित ‘स्पेशल अचीवमेंट अवॉर्ड’ से सम्मानित किया गया है। जापान के प्रमुख व्यावसायिक समूह CGC Group के चेयरमैन एवं CEO श्री अत्सुहिरो होरिउची ने उन्हें यह सम्मान प्रदान किया।

content:
- Hindi News

जापान में आनंद कुमार को ‘स्पेशल अचीवमेंट अवॉर्ड’:शिक्षा के क्षेत्र में भारत का मान बढ़ाया, CGC Group के CEO अत्सुहिरो होरिउची ने किया सम्मानित
- कॉपी लिंक
भारत के मशहूर गणित शिक्षक और सुपर 30 के संस्थापक आनंद कुमार को जापान में प्रतिष्ठित ‘स्पेशल अचीवमेंट अवॉर्ड’ से सम्मानित किया गया है। जापान के प्रमुख व्यावसायिक समूह CGC Group के चेयरमैन एवं CEO श्री अत्सुहिरो होरिउची ने उन्हें यह सम्मान प्रदान किया।
शिक्षा के क्षेत्र में उनके असाधारण योगदान और आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर बच्चों के जीवन में नई उम्मीद जगाने के प्रयासों को इस सम्मान के माध्यम से अंतरराष्ट्रीय पहचान मिली है।
CGC Group जापान का एक प्रमुख व्यावसायिक समूह है, जिसके नेटवर्क में 202 सदस्य कंपनियाँ और 5,083 स्टोर्स शामिल हैं। समूह का वार्षिक कारोबार 5.72 लाख करोड़ जापानी येन से अधिक बताया जाता है।
आनंद कुमार ने दुनिया भर के लोगों को प्रेरित किया
आनंद कुमार को दिए गए प्रशस्ति-पत्र में कहा गया है कि सुपर 30 के संस्थापक के रूप में उन्होंने आर्थिक रूप से वंचित युवाओं को निःशुल्क उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली शिक्षा प्रदान कर उनके जीवन में नई संभावनाओं के द्वार खोले हैं। उनके शैक्षणिक प्रयासों और समाज के प्रति समर्पण की सराहना भारत ही नहीं, अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर भी हुई है और उनके कार्यों ने दुनिया भर के लोगों को प्रेरित किया है।
प्रशस्ति-पत्र में विशेष रूप से सुपर इन्फिनिटी की सराहना करते हुए कहा गया है कि यह पहल राष्ट्रीय सीमाओं और आर्थिक बाधाओं से आगे बढ़कर दुनिया भर के बच्चों तक गणित का आनंद और शिक्षा के अवसर पहुँचाने का प्रयास है। यह पहल भविष्य की शिक्षा के लिए एक नई उम्मीद जगाती है।
2002 में आनंद कुमार ने पटना से सुपर 30 की शुरुआत की थी
अब वे सुपर इन्फिनिटी के माध्यम से गणित की शिक्षा को दुनिया भर के बच्चों तक पहुँचाने का प्रयास कर रहे हैं। मुलाकात के दौरान CGC Group के चेयरमैन ने सुपर इन्फिनिटी की जापानी भाषा में चल रही शैक्षणिक पहल में विशेष रुचि दिखाई। उन्होंने कहा कि जापान के बच्चे भी गणित को पारंपरिक तरीकों से अलग, रोचक और मनोरंजक ढंग से सीखना चाहते हैं।
आनंद कुमार बोले- यह सम्मान मेरा नहीं बच्चों का है
इस सम्मान पर भावुक आनंद कुमार ने कहा, "यह सम्मान मेरा नहीं, बल्कि दुनिया के उन तमाम बच्चों का है, जो कठिन परिस्थितियों में भी अपने सपनों को पूरा करने के लिए संघर्ष कर रहे हैं। Super 30 से सुपर इन्फिनिटी तक मेरी यात्रा का एक ही उद्देश्य रहा है कि दुनिया का कोई भी बच्चा आर्थिक अभाव के कारण अच्छी शिक्षा से वंचित न रहे।" उन्होंने श्री अत्सुहिरो होरिउची और CGC Group के पूरे परिवार के प्रति हृदय से आभार व्यक्त किया।

title: न्यूज अपडेट्स: कल त्रिपुरा में होगा निकाय चुनाव के लिए मतदान, सुरक्षा कड़ी; सीएपीएफ की 15 कंपनियां तैनात
description: न्यूज अपडेट्स: कल त्रिपुरा में होगा निकाय चुनाव के लिए मतदान, सुरक्षा कड़ी; सीएपीएफ की 15 कंपनियां तैनात
author: शिवम गर्ग
content:
न्यूज अपडेट्स: कल त्रिपुरा में होगा निकाय चुनाव के लिए मतदान, सुरक्षा कड़ी; सीएपीएफ की 15 कंपनियां तैनात
त्रिपुरा में नगर निकाय चुनाव के लिए बुधवार (25 नवंबर) को प्रचार थम गया। राज्य में 27 नवंबर 2026 को मतदान होगा। इन चुनावों में अगरतला नगर निगम (AMC) समेत कुल 21 शहरी स्थानीय निकायों (ULB) में चुनाव होने थे। हालांकि, इनमें से पांच निकायों में भाजपा के उम्मीदवार निर्विरोध जीत गए हैं। ऐसे में अब केवल 16 क्षेत्रों में मतदान कराया जाएगा। राज्य चुनाव आयोग ने शांतिपूर्ण तरीके से मतदान कराने के लिए जरूरी इंतजाम करने का भरोसा दिया है। चुनाव के दौरान सुरक्षा और कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने पर विशेष ध्यान दिया जा रहा है।
                                
                
                
                                
                                
                                                                                                               
                                                    
                            
                                 
                                
                               
                                                                                
                                                                 
                
निकाय चुनाव को देखते हुए सुरक्षा व्यवस्था कड़ी कर दी गई है। शांतिपूर्ण मतदान सुनिश्चित करने के लिए केंद्रीय सशस्त्र पुलिस बल (सीएपीएफ) की कंपनियों को अलग-अलग इलाकों में तैनात किया जा रहा है। पश्चिम त्रिपुरा के पुलिस अधीक्षक नमित पाठक ने बताया कि पश्चिम जिले में सीएपीएफ की 15 कंपनियां मौजूद हैं। इन्हें कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के लिए तैनात किया जा रहा है। सुरक्षा के तहत अलग-अलग इलाकों में फ्लैग मार्च निकाले जा रहे हैं। इसके अलावा पुलिस की गश्त बढ़ाई गई है। संवेदनशील क्षेत्रों में विशेष निगरानी रखी जा रही है। जगह-जगह चेकिंग पॉइंट और पुलिस पिकेट भी लगाए गए हैं।
